chapters.title: Chapter 151 - 128: Life Is Born Free...
paragraphs: "You can’t outlast me, Hunter!"
In the sky, that twisted existence emitted a threatening voice that seemed neither male nor female.
The Wild Ranger Spirit looked at the opponent again, frowning deeply.
This was the eighth day of their battle.
Up until now, the Wild Ranger Spirit had destroyed tens of thousands of blood pool altars.
Yet even so, the number of blood pools seemed endless.
Every time it was slain, a stream of blood energy would swiftly escape, then burst again far away.
This creature is simply an endlessly resurrecting monster!
Although the Wild Ranger Spirit’s power could suppress it, as the opponent said.
It had been setting things up in the Land of the Abandoned Gods for who knows how long, and the number of blood pool altars far surpassed the Wild Ranger Spirit’s imagination.
No matter how many times the Wild Ranger Spirit killed it, it could always resurrect.
Facing such an undead enemy is truly despairing.
Meanwhile, that twisted existence transformed again, as hundreds of blood pillars gushed from the distant sky.
The Wild Ranger Spirit felt the entire world tremble slightly.
Suddenly, he saw the creature’s size swell dozens of times!
Originally as large as mountains, the monster now was the size of a planet.
On that planet, tentacles were flourishing, tiny and dense blood vessels crawling on its surface, droplets of blood energy overflowed, dyeing the entire sky blood-red.
Suddenly, a tentacle shot violently toward the Wild Ranger.
The Wild Ranger instantly reacted, shooting an arrow.
Thud!
The blood-colored tentacle was pierced by the arrow, but it didn’t lose its momentum.
The Wild Ranger’s abdomen immediately had a bloody hole, one person and one wolf were knocked backward.
In this collision, the bloody monster held the absolute advantage.
At this moment, a giant eyeball suddenly appeared on the bloody flesh planet.
That eyeball stared at the Hunter below, a gleam of superiority flashed in its eyes.
"Hunter, I can feel you growing weaker and weaker..."
"Hehehe! Is it the Land of the Abandoned Gods’ rejection of you? Or is your divinity gradually fading?"
"Do you think, in this state, you could be a match for me?"
The Wild Ranger Spirit felt like a shadow was cast over his heart; he underestimated this evil god from the alternate space.
This creature absorbed the power of hundreds of blood pools in one breath, swelling its size, its strength terrifyingly increased, even subtly crossing into the demigod level.
Meanwhile, since the beginning of the battle, the Wild Ranger’s power had been continually diminishing.
In this imbalance, he was increasingly no match for that blood-red monster.
If the battle continues, it might truly be as the monster said, his last trace of divinity might vanish from the world.
However, the Wild Ranger showed not even a hint of fear on his face.
The blood-colored monster’s eyes showed a disdainful expression, "Hunter... you can’t hurt me anymore."
Ignoring the monster’s ridicule.
The Wild Ranger firmly drew the bowstring, gathering the terrifying Power of Heaven and Earth within it.
But, in front of that planet-sized behemoth, the figure of the Wild Ranger Spirit seemed so insignificant.
In the next moment, an invisible arrow shot out fiercely.
At that time, a terrifying mass of blood energy erupted from the blood-colored monster!
Buzz!
The two forces collided.
The horrifying tremor spread, sweeping away all clouds in the surrounding thousands of miles!
Countless lives unknowingly perished in the collision of these two terrifying existences.
When the shockwaves dissipated.
A humanoid figure and a severely wounded white wolf were knocked out of the blood pillar.
In the recent clash, the Wild Ranger Spirit was surprisingly outmatched by the monster!
At this moment, he clutched his heart, where there was a thoroughly penetrating bloody hole, and other parts showed numerous deep wounds visible to the bone!
Such fatal injuries would have killed anyone else long ago.
Only the Wild Ranger’s demigod-level constitution enabled barely holding on.
But even so, the Wild Ranger Spirit’s body was largely dyed blood-red, the Blood Curse was eroding his flesh.
From the sky came the creature’s gender-ambiguous, triumphant laughter.
"Hehehe... hahahaha..."
"Hunter... you’ve fallen under my Blood Curse."
"If you retreat now, you might have a slim chance of survival."
"But if you continue, not only will you face total death, you’ll become my blood slave."
"Though, I wouldn’t mind having another demigod-level blood slave, hehe..."
The Wild Ranger ignored the monster’s mocking voice, looking instead at the silver giant wolf beside him.
In the recent clash, the silver wolf was heavily injured, hit by hundreds of attacks to protect him.
At this moment, the silver giant wolf’s body was becoming increasingly ethereal, about to dissipate into the world.
Then, the blood-colored monster wanted to continue its pursuit.
It suddenly saw around its body the emergence of a full moon even larger than its own form!
The binding power of that moon surpassed imagination, as if even space was frozen by it.
With its strength, it couldn’t move at all.
Legendary Skill: Shattered Moon.
However, when released by the Wild Ranger, it caused an effect even more terrifying than Han Xing.
"Hunter! Release me!" shouted the twisted figure in the sky.
The Wild Ranger didn’t pay attention.
Instead, he half-kneeled, gently stroked the mane of the giant wolf, softly said: "Old friend, you’ve fought with me long enough, take a good rest..."
The silver giant wolf stared with eyes full of reluctance at the man.
Then, the body of the giant wolf directly shattered into fragments and dispersed in mid-air.
A slight sigh came from the mouth of the Wild Ranger Spirit.
At this moment, even though controlled by the Shattered Moon Skill, the planet-sized monster’s eyes still showed no trace of fear.
Instead, with a mocking tone, it said, "See, Hunter, this is the outcome of opposing me!"
"To stop me, even your most beloved pet has died, and what have you gained?"
"You must know that outside the Land of the Abandoned Gods, many eyes are watching here..."
"They clearly know what’s happening, yet they are indifferent. Do you guess why?"
Listening to the monster’s voice, the Wild Ranger remained unmoved.
He slowly raised his head, revealing a trace of nostalgia and sadness in his eyes.
The second second of the circular moon’s seal passed.
He slowly drew the bowstring again, strands of peculiar energy gathering in the bowstring.
In the air, the monster obviously felt the difference in this arrow.
At the moment the bowstring was drawn, the airborne monster sensed a rich Power of Rules.
It actually felt some apprehension from this arrow.
The third second of the circular moon’s seal passed.
A small cluster of flame appeared in the Wild Ranger’s hand.
This cluster of flame, like a newly lit candle, emitted weak little flames.
However, in the monster’s eyes, there was a strong fear.
"Hunter! Are you mad?"
"You’re actually going to use the Ultimate Skill?"
"Don’t you know, in this state, using the Power of Rules against me, just the backlash is enough to annihilate the last remnant of your divinity!
The Wild Ranger did not answer.
Moreover, not only that.
Within the Wild Ranger’s arrow, that small flame rapidly expanded, igniting the sky across billions of miles in an instant!
At this moment, he, like a great sun, illuminated the entire sky.
In front of this flaming sun, the planet-shaped blood-red monster appeared so ugly and insignificant.
The massive monster clearly sensed a threat to its life!
"Hunter! Stop!"
"After you release this strike, you will surely die!"
"Quickly abort, I swear, as long as you let me escape, I will definitely not strike you!"
"I also will no longer harm that group of humans! I will immediately roll back to the Alternate Space, never to step into the Holy Spirit Realm again!"
The blood-red monster began to soften, begging frantically.
It admitted that it severely underestimated this man’s strength and underestimated his determination to slay it.
The Wild Ranger did not answer.
He knew that after releasing this strike, he would likely die,
truly meaning death, body, soul, consciousness, all disappearing from this world
The fourth second of the circular moon appeared.
In the sky.
A great sun and a circular moon shone together.
Time seemed to freeze.
The Wild Ranger’s eyes flashed a look of reminiscence, silently thinking in his heart.
I never thought I’d die in such a place.
But thankfully, before dying, I found the thirteenth generation Wild Ranger.
Hope that kid can survive this crisis and grow quickly...
Although still unable to completely remove the means this guy set in the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
But as long as it’s eradicated, the power of those blood pools will also be greatly weakened.
Cheer up, humans from the new world...
And at that moment, the Wild Ranger seemed to sense something, a trace of surprise appeared in his brows.
"Huh? Did that kid really finish Second Transformation so quickly?"
The Wild Ranger Spirit felt very surprised.
Because, from the time he infused Han Xing with power to today, it has been less than ten days.
For these powerful beings.
Ten days truly passes in the blink of an eye.
In the impression of the Wild Ranger Spirit, even for those with extraordinary talent, from First Transformation to Second Transformation, the fastest, would take at least several months.
Yet this seemingly unremarkable human completed the advancement in such a short time.
A smile appeared on the Wild Ranger Spirit’s lips.
"This kid really keeps surprising me time and again!"
"If there’s a chance, he could be taken to the Path of the Giant Dragon to receive the inheritance from those predecessors..."
"But unfortunately..."
The next moment, the arrow carrying the Fire of Civilization was released.
Heaven and earth fell into a moment of stagnation.
The planet-like monster, upon being struck by this arrow, showed a strong fear in its huge eye.
That was the fear of death.
"Why? Hunter?" The monster looked puzzled.
The Wild Ranger’s figure also became more and more dispersed, as he looked at the monster in the sky, he slowly said a sentence.
"Because the moment life is born, it is free..."

chapters.title: Chapter 152 - 129: Mutual Destruction!
paragraphs: "For life, from the moment of its birth, is free..."
"No existence can trample upon this will, including you, me, and even those godly beings high above!"
Indeed, this is why the Wild Ranger Spirit is willing to forsake life to protect these frail humans.
Even though he has been dead for unknown years.
Even though this is the last trace of divinity left in the world.
But he is a Hunter!
The original Hunter of heaven and earth.
Bringing the Fire of Civilization to all beings, the light of hope, teaching life to resist — such a great existence.
Even as only a lingering spirit, the Wild Ranger has always upheld his creed.
"Witness, the power of the Fire of Civilization..."
A sun and moon simultaneously shattered.
The terrifying flames swallowed the figure of the monster.
In the air, that monster could not understand the meaning of the Wild Ranger’s words.
At this moment, it was engulfed in the fear of impending death.
Years ago, even the holy artifact of the Elf Race couldn’t kill it, and now, having hardly resurrected, it was about to die at this man’s hand?
Resentment, hatred, anger, fear!
This evil god from the Alternate Space, the blood surging from its body had completely stained the sky red.
"Damn you, Hunter, you forced me!"
"Even if I die, I’ll make you pay!"
The Wild Ranger furrowed his brow.
"You think, killing me means it’s over?"
"Without my suppression, the monsters in the Blood God Altar will break through the seal in no time, and then, the entire Land of the Abandoned Gods will also be infected by my Blood Curse,"
"Let’s die together! Hahaha..."
The round moon and sun disintegrated together.
In the laughter of the evil god of the Alternate Space.
This wild and free man, along with that terrifying monster, vanished from the world.
At the same time...
In the Land of the Abandoned Gods, those islands engraved with mysterious symbols began to spurt bright red blood.
Numerous monsters crawled out from the blood, some with wings, others with dozens of tentacles, some with four or five arms,
in just a short ten minutes, thousands of malformed monsters emerged.
The terrifying blood aura permeated the Land of the Abandoned Gods, and that night, everyone seemed to see the distant moon turning blood-red.
Meanwhile, Han Xing was receiving the surge of power.
He was unaware of the impending crisis sweeping across the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
Han Xing saw his Attribute Panel rapidly improving.
Especially the Agility Attribute, which jumped from just over three hundred to four hundred instantly and was still rising.
The force infused with ancient breath kept flooding into his body.
Moments later, the transformation was complete, and Han Xing’s attributes stopped increasing.
His Agility Attribute reached 473 (after equipment enhancement), and all other attributes had similar increases.
This transformation, although not as dramatic as the First Transformation, still saw a 50% improvement.
At this moment, Han Xing tightly gripped the giant bow, feeling an unprecedented sense of power throughout his body.
Simultaneously, he discovered that his sensory sensitivity also greatly improved.
Now his hearing can clearly perceive the sound of fish swimming a kilometer away.
He can also see clear details on colossal clouds over ten kilometers away.
Additionally, his perception of danger became sharper.
Han Xing opened his eyes, his gaze bright and fierce, exuding an unprecedented sharpness.
He softly said, "This feeling of getting stronger... is amazing!"
At this moment, the system prompt appeared.
[You have successfully completed the Wild Ranger Profession Second Transformation, automatically learning new skills: Explosive Flame Arrow, Bear Spirit Will, Instant Shadow Flash.]

[Explosive Flame Arrow]: Instantaneously condense a mass of Fire Element power on the arrow tip, causing blast damage in an Agility *0.1 meter range to the enemy, with a damage coefficient of 233% of Attack Power, cooldown time of 15 seconds.
[Bear Spirit Will]: Summon an Elite-level Bear Spirit to assist the Survivor in battle, with Bear Spirit Attributes equal to 150% of the Survivor’s, lasts 150s, cooldown time 300s.

[Instant Shadow Flash]: Survivor charges forward instantly for Agility *0.5 meters, causing 50% Wind Attribute damage to all enemies on the path (can charge twice consecutively, cooldown time 60 seconds).
"So strong!"
These three skills, although they seem not as powerful as the three skills gained during the First Transformation, are not.
The first skill: Explosive Flame Arrow.
As a Group Attack Skill, although it looks less powerful than Fallen Star Arrow Rain, actually, it’s not.
Fallen Star Arrow Rain, although a range skill with absurdly high damage, has a fatal flaw: it requires a pre-aim motion of two to three seconds.
Whereas Explosive Flame Arrow is an instant-cast skill, not only is the damage coefficient absurdly high, but its attack range is larger than Fallen Star Arrow Rain!
The most crucial point is, it has only a 15-second cooldown.
In other words, Han Xing can use this skill as a regular skill.
With everyone’s strength increasing, the Gold Melting Cannon can no longer serve as Han Xing’s monster clearing weapon.
Having this skill is equivalent to replacing the Molten Gold Cannon.
Next, even if challenged with Secret Realms above level 20, Han Xing can still maintain an extremely high monster-clearing efficiency.
The second Bear Spirit Will needs no explanation.
Anyone who has been a Hunter knows how comfortable it is to have a thick-skinned bear spirit blocking in battle.
You can unleash your attacks boldly from behind without worrying about the monster threat in front.
The third skill is a divine skill that combines mobility and group attack.
’Instantly charge forward with agility*0.5 meters, dealing 50% wind attribute damage to all enemies along the path.’
After Han Xing completed the second transformation, his agility reached 473 points, so he can instantly charge over 200 meters.
And he can do it twice back and forth.
These three skills have tremendously enhanced Han Xing’s combat capabilities.
Plus, the attribute enhancements from completing the second transformation.
At this moment, Han Xing is confident enough to take on a level 20 Lord Monster alone and emerge victorious.
Indeed, in this world, every advancement of life is a transformation.
Nearby, watching Han Xing, everyone feels the special aura emanating from him.
An invisible, overpowering presence.
It’s as if Han Xing’s life level has risen to a higher stage than theirs.
Seeing Han Xing’s strength improve, everyone felt gratified.
They also couldn’t help but anticipate the changes their second transformation would bring.
Next, Han Xing continued to lead everyone in leveling.
There’s no need to compete in the leaderboard anymore.
The vast gap has eliminated all suspense.
Even if the others forego sleep and fight to catch up, they can’t overtake the five of them.
Ten thousand meters in high altitude.
The first human main city, Xingyu City, sped through the air.
After advancing, the movement speed of Han Xing’s personal territory also increased by 50%, coupled with a 20% speed bonus from the City Lord’s Mansion.
Now, Han Xing’s territory moves at 139 meters per second, equivalent to a speed of 500 kilometers per hour.
But as mentioned before, this is a magical world, where no matter how fast you move, there’s no air resistance.
Next, Han Xing clicked to enter every Sky Island he saw along the way, regardless of size.
The rise in power also brought him immense confidence.
Unless it was a particularly absurdly large one, with an area exceeding ten or even several hundred thousand square kilometers of Sky Island.
There are basically no monsters that can match Han Xing.
The crowd began leveling fervently.
The next day.
On the 29th day since Blue Star humans arrived in this world.
Cheng Jianyong, Zhang Lianmeng, and Su Xiaoyang reached level 20.
The three of them also need to start undertaking profession advancement tasks like Han Xing.
Han Xing handed them the Molten Gold Cannon, then began looking for suitable challenge targets.
For Cheng Jianyong and Zhang Lianmeng, it was relatively simple; they only need to challenge an Elite Monster of the same level.
Against these level 20 Elite Monsters, Molten Gold Cannon could still deal substantial damage, and with one shot, the battle outcome was no longer in doubt.
But for Su Xiaoyang, it was quite troublesome, needing to find a level 20 Leader Monster.
At this level, the Leader’s power is already quite strong.
Even the Molten Gold Cannon could only inflict minimal harm on such monsters.
The reason Han Xing could cleanly deal with Knight Kaelon.
Partly because of the strength of his equipment and partly because he had a coal ball, a powerful pet.
Along with the Legendary Skill ’Broken Moon.’
Anyone coming must endure Han Xing’s burst skills.
Su Xiaoyang’s profession, Elf Shooter, although stronger than average professions.
In terms of combat capabilities, she’s still a bit weaker than Han Xing.
Of course, provided Su Xiaoyang doesn’t enter the War Witch state.
In that state, even Han Xing now feels a chill down his spine.
Everyone instinctively doesn’t want Su Xiaoyang to enter that state.
So, after several pickings, they finally found a sufficiently safe monster for Su Xiaoyang to complete the challenge.
[Demonized Mountain Forest Elephant, (Two-Star Leader-level Creature)]
This elephant is unimaginably large, like a small hill, the overall length exceeding thirty meters, with a swinging trunk capable of attacking enemies a hundred meters away.
Not only is its hide thick, but its attack power is mighty.
But it has a fatal weakness—it cannot attack airborne units.
Everyone set up a tactic for Su Xiaoyang.
That is, Han Xing will station the Sky Island Territory above the ’Demonized Elephant,’ around a three hundred meter area.
At that time, Su Xiaoyang would activate ’Low Altitude Flight’ skill, gaining flight ability to attack the Mountain Forest Elephant below.
Su Xiaoyang followed Han Xing’s plan.
After activating the skill, she jumped off the Sky Island and began remote attacking the Mountain Forest Elephant below.
[Elf Dance]: After activating Elf Dance state, your skill damage increases by 50%, and within 10 seconds, all Hunter base skill cooldown time is reduced to zero.

Numerous monsters crawled out from the blood, some with wings, others with dozens of tentacles, some with four or five arms,
in just a short ten minutes, thousands of malformed monsters emerged.
The terrifying blood aura permeated the Land of the Abandoned Gods, and that night, everyone seemed to see the distant moon turning blood-red.
Meanwhile, Han Xing was receiving the surge of power.
He was unaware of the impending crisis sweeping across the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
Han Xing saw his Attribute Panel rapidly improving.
Especially the Agility Attribute, which jumped from just over three hundred to four hundred instantly and was still rising.
The force infused with ancient breath kept flooding into his body.
Moments later, the transformation was complete, and Han Xing’s attributes stopped increasing.
His Agility Attribute reached 473 (after equipment enhancement), and all other attributes had similar increases.
This transformation, although not as dramatic as the First Transformation, still saw a 50% improvement.
At this moment, Han Xing tightly gripped the giant bow, feeling an unprecedented sense of power throughout his body.
Simultaneously, he discovered that his sensory sensitivity also greatly improved.
Now his hearing can clearly perceive the sound of fish swimming a kilometer away.
He can also see clear details on colossal clouds over ten kilometers away.
Additionally, his perception of danger became sharper.
Han Xing opened his eyes, his gaze bright and fierce, exuding an unprecedented sharpness.
He softly said, "This feeling of getting stronger... is amazing!"
At this moment, the system prompt appeared.
[You have successfully completed the Wild Ranger Profession Second Transformation, automatically learning new skills: Explosive Flame Arrow, Bear Spirit Will, Instant Shadow Flash.]

[Explosive Flame Arrow]: Instantaneously condense a mass of Fire Element power on the arrow tip, causing blast damage in an Agility *0.1 meter range to the enemy, with a damage coefficient of 233% of Attack Power, cooldown time of 15 seconds.
[Bear Spirit Will]: Summon an Elite-level Bear Spirit to assist the Survivor in battle, with Bear Spirit Attributes equal to 150% of the Survivor’s, lasts 150s, cooldown time 300s.

[Instant Shadow Flash]: Survivor charges forward instantly for Agility *0.5 meters, causing 50% Wind Attribute damage to all enemies on the path (can charge twice consecutively, cooldown time 60 seconds).
"So strong!"
These three skills, although they seem not as powerful as the three skills gained during the First Transformation, are not.
The first skill: Explosive Flame Arrow.
As a Group Attack Skill, although it looks less powerful than Fallen Star Arrow Rain, actually, it’s not.
Fallen Star Arrow Rain, although a range skill with absurdly high damage, has a fatal flaw: it requires a pre-aim motion of two to three seconds.
Whereas Explosive Flame Arrow is an instant-cast skill, not only is the damage coefficient absurdly high, but its attack range is larger than Fallen Star Arrow Rain!
The most crucial point is, it has only a 15-second cooldown.
In other words, Han Xing can use this skill as a regular skill.
With everyone’s strength increasing, the Gold Melting Cannon can no longer serve as Han Xing’s monster clearing weapon.
Having this skill is equivalent to replacing the Molten Gold Cannon.
Next, even if challenged with Secret Realms above level 20, Han Xing can still maintain an extremely high monster-clearing efficiency.
The second Bear Spirit Will needs no explanation.
Anyone who has been a Hunter knows how comfortable it is to have a thick-skinned bear spirit blocking in battle.
You can unleash your attacks boldly from behind without worrying about the monster threat in front.
The third skill is a divine skill that combines mobility and group attack.
’Instantly charge forward with agility*0.5 meters, dealing 50% wind attribute damage to all enemies along the path.’
After Han Xing completed the second transformation, his agility reached 473 points, so he can instantly charge over 200 meters.
And he can do it twice back and forth.
These three skills have tremendously enhanced Han Xing’s combat capabilities.
Plus, the attribute enhancements from completing the second transformation.
At this moment, Han Xing is confident enough to take on a level 20 Lord Monster alone and emerge victorious.
Indeed, in this world, every advancement of life is a transformation.
Nearby, watching Han Xing, everyone feels the special aura emanating from him.
An invisible, overpowering presence.
It’s as if Han Xing’s life level has risen to a higher stage than theirs.
Seeing Han Xing’s strength improve, everyone felt gratified.
They also couldn’t help but anticipate the changes their second transformation would bring.
Next, Han Xing continued to lead everyone in leveling.
There’s no need to compete in the leaderboard anymore.
The vast gap has eliminated all suspense.
Even if the others forego sleep and fight to catch up, they can’t overtake the five of them.
Ten thousand meters in high altitude.
The first human main city, Xingyu City, sped through the air.
After advancing, the movement speed of Han Xing’s personal territory also increased by 50%, coupled with a 20% speed bonus from the City Lord’s Mansion.
Now, Han Xing’s territory moves at 139 meters per second, equivalent to a speed of 500 kilometers per hour.
But as mentioned before, this is a magical world, where no matter how fast you move, there’s no air resistance.
Next, Han Xing clicked to enter every Sky Island he saw along the way, regardless of size.
The rise in power also brought him immense confidence.
Unless it was a particularly absurdly large one, with an area exceeding ten or even several hundred thousand square kilometers of Sky Island.
There are basically no monsters that can match Han Xing.
The crowd began leveling fervently.
The next day.
On the 29th day since Blue Star humans arrived in this world.
Cheng Jianyong, Zhang Lianmeng, and Su Xiaoyang reached level 20.
The three of them also need to start undertaking profession advancement tasks like Han Xing.
Han Xing handed them the Molten Gold Cannon, then began looking for suitable challenge targets.
For Cheng Jianyong and Zhang Lianmeng, it was relatively simple; they only need to challenge an Elite Monster of the same level.
Against these level 20 Elite Monsters, Molten Gold Cannon could still deal substantial damage, and with one shot, the battle outcome was no longer in doubt.
But for Su Xiaoyang, it was quite troublesome, needing to find a level 20 Leader Monster.
At this level, the Leader’s power is already quite strong.
Even the Molten Gold Cannon could only inflict minimal harm on such monsters.
The reason Han Xing could cleanly deal with Knight Kaelon.
Partly because of the strength of his equipment and partly because he had a coal ball, a powerful pet.
Along with the Legendary Skill ’Broken Moon.’
Anyone coming must endure Han Xing’s burst skills.
Su Xiaoyang’s profession, Elf Shooter, although stronger than average professions.
In terms of combat capabilities, she’s still a bit weaker than Han Xing.
Of course, provided Su Xiaoyang doesn’t enter the War Witch state.
In that state, even Han Xing now feels a chill down his spine.
Everyone instinctively doesn’t want Su Xiaoyang to enter that state.
So, after several pickings, they finally found a sufficiently safe monster for Su Xiaoyang to complete the challenge.
[Demonized Mountain Forest Elephant, (Two-Star Leader-level Creature)]
This elephant is unimaginably large, like a small hill, the overall length exceeding thirty meters, with a swinging trunk capable of attacking enemies a hundred meters away.
Not only is its hide thick, but its attack power is mighty.
But it has a fatal weakness—it cannot attack airborne units.
Everyone set up a tactic for Su Xiaoyang.
That is, Han Xing will station the Sky Island Territory above the ’Demonized Elephant,’ around a three hundred meter area.
At that time, Su Xiaoyang would activate ’Low Altitude Flight’ skill, gaining flight ability to attack the Mountain Forest Elephant below.
Su Xiaoyang followed Han Xing’s plan.
After activating the skill, she jumped off the Sky Island and began remote attacking the Mountain Forest Elephant below.
[Elf Dance]: After activating Elf Dance state, your skill damage increases by 50%, and within 10 seconds, all Hunter base skill cooldown time is reduced to zero.

chapters.title: Chapter 153 - 130: Team Advancement!
paragraphs: At this moment, Su Xiaoyang’s low-level skills entered a no-CD state, and she transformed once again into a machine gun shooter.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
One arrow after another, carrying terrifying destructive power, shot down like a barrage of artillery!
Thud, thud, thud!
The demonized mountain forest elephant was suddenly attacked on its broad back, and the pain made it let out an angry roar.
"Moo!"
The sound was dull and loud.
On the scene, everyone except Han Xing felt a burst of oppression.
If some survivors below level 10 were here, just hearing this roar might shatter their insides, killing them on the spot!
This giant creature could cause serious harm to some weaker beings with its sound alone.
Fortunately, although the demonized mountain forest elephant was powerful, it didn’t have long-range attack capabilities.
It could only helplessly swing its trunk to attack.
But Su Xiaoyang, flying a hundred meters high, just stayed at the extreme limit of the demonized mountain forest elephant’s attack range.
When the duration of the low-altitude flight skill was about to end, Su Xiaoyang quickly turned around, returned to the territory, and waited for the skill’s cooldown to pass.
Low-altitude flight could last 120 seconds and had a cooldown of only 200 seconds, in other words, only an 80-second gap.
After repeating this a few times.
The mountain forest elephant’s body was already filled with dense arrows, blood flowing down its massive body, covering the ground.
The grass was stained red with blood, and the surrounding vegetation and trees collapsed in patches.
Su Xiaoyang seemed a bit unwilling, but she knew that at this time she couldn’t go soft.
These monsters were emotionless.
So, she continued to draw her arrows.
After a few minutes.
This demonized mountain forest elephant finally fell due to its severe injuries.
Next.
Zhang Lianmeng and Cheng Jianyong both also completed their challenge tasks one after another.
Since both of them were of ordinary professions, they only needed to deal with the same-level elite monsters, making the task relatively simple.
Cheng Jianyong quickly dealt with a level 20 elite Big-eyed Monkey and completed the challenge task.
But when it was Zhang Lianmeng’s turn, there was a small accident.
On a snowy mountain, Zhang Lianmeng intended to deal with a level 20 Glacial Bear but didn’t expect a level 20 leader monster to be hiding inside.
Ice Giant Lizard.
Everyone rushed over quickly.
Under the combined assault, this level 20 Ice Giant Lizard also died in the siege of the group.
After the battle.
Everyone stood on the territory, excitedly reporting their newly learned skills.
Cheng Jianyong’s newly learned three skills were called: Weakness Slash, Iaijutsu Slash, and Sky Sword.
The first skill, Weakness Slash, not only deals good damage but also reduces the enemy’s power, which is quite a good effect.
The second skill, Iaijutsu Slash.
Anyone who has been a swordsman knows that Iaijutsu Slash is a group attack skill.
Combined with Cheng Jianyong’s Lion Heart Greatsword’s effect, an Iaijutsu Slash could probably clear out all enemies around at once.
The third skill, Sky Sword, is a bit special.
[Sky Sword]: Summons a sword phantom in the air, dealing 222% damage to enemies, with a maximum attack range of 400 meters.
This is the first ranged skill for the swordsman.
And Zhang Lianmeng’s Elemental Master, after advancing, transformed into an Elemental Tutor.
The newly learned three skills are: Ice Crystal Storm, Thunder Baptism, Dark Source Attraction.
The skills of the Elemental Tutor are also very direct; the first two are all group attack skills with impressive damage coefficients.
The last one, Dark Source Attraction, is a rare control skill.
After seeing the new skills of Cheng Jianyong and Zhang Lianmeng, everyone turned their expectant eyes to Su Xiaoyang.
After all, her profession change was to a hidden profession, Elf Hunter, and the skills she can learn after the second transformation must be extremely powerful!
Su Xiaoyang also posted her newly learned three skill information.
They are: [Sky Arrow Rain], [Elf’s Eye], [Breath of Nature]
Among them, the skill ’Sky Arrow Rain’ is the first group attack skill of the Elf Shooter, able to fire five rounds of arrow rain at the target area, each round causing 212% damage.
Moreover, it can attack from the air, highlighting the characteristics of the profession to the fullest.
The second skill, ’Elf’s Eye’, can increase the critical strike rate and critical strike damage by 50%, also very good.
As for the last one, ’Breath of Nature’, it turns out to be a support-type skill that can add a state effect of continuous healing of injuries to oneself or teammates.
"Oh my, this Breath of Nature is quite powerful. With Xiaoyunzi’s Holy Light Healing, isn’t it impossible to die?" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
Everyone also thought of this.
One is for continuous healing, the other for instant healing; combined, it’s indeed impossible to die.
Su Xiaoyang, after advancing, also gained three new powerful skills.
Now, among this five-person team, four people have completed the second transformation advancement, their strength skyrocketed.
Even among all human survivors, they are the first batch to complete the second transformation.
Now, only Shen Yun has not completed the profession advancement yet.
Tomorrow is the day when the leaderboard rewards end.
Han Xing also seized the time and continued leveling with Shen Yun.
Monster after monster fell at their feet.
Finally, in the late night, Shen Yun successfully reached level twenty.
But since it is already late at night.
Plus, Shen Yun’s profession change is to a hidden profession, requiring to challenge a level 20 leader monster.

chapters.title: Chapter 154 - 130: Everyone Levels Up! (Part 2)
paragraphs: So, everyone decided to wait until the next day to find a suitable monster for him to complete the challenge task.
The next day.
It was exactly the thirtieth day since all of humanity descended into this world.
Han Xing started searching for a suitable challenge target for Shen Yun.
Finally, through everyone’s unremitting efforts, they selected a leader monster for Shen Yun.
A Level 20 Dark Element creature, the Angry Ghost.
After a prolonged twenty-minute battle.
Shen Yun managed to beat the Leader Monster successfully, relying on his profession’s advantage, hammering it steadily to death.
Then, Shen Yun directly completed his advancement.
The commotion of his advancement was no smaller than Han Xing’s.
For a moment, the power of Holy Light gathered towards him from all over the sky.
People even vaguely heard melodious singing from the sky, as if angels were whispering beside them.
Cheng Jianyong on the side said speechlessly, "Xiaoyunzi, this profession advancement looks like a coronation ceremony, showing off!"
Shen Yun ignored him and excitedly checked the three skills he just acquired.
They are: Blessing of Honor, Angel’s Shelter, Hammer of Repentance.

[Blessing of Honor]: The recipient of the Blessing of Honor will have their Four-dimensional Attributes increased by the Radiant Knight’s Spirit * 0.2. The effect lasts for 200 seconds, and the skill has a cooldown time of 300 seconds.

[Angel’s Shelter]: Adds a layer of Angel’s Shelter to oneself or a teammate, capable of blocking Radiant Knight’s Constitution * 0.5 damage. In Angel’s Shelter state, the damage impact from mental attacks is reduced by 50%.

[Hammer of Repentance]: Condenses the power of sacred radiance to cause large-scale damage to enemies within 5 meters * 10 meters in front. Hit targets have a 50% chance to betray, with the effect lasting 60 seconds (the chance of this effect applying to Elite Level monsters is greatly reduced).
After seeing these three skills, one can only say it is truly terrifyingly strong as a hidden profession.
With that Blessing of Honor, combined with Blessing of Courage.
Applying those states to any Survivor yields at least a 40% attack power boost, which is quite a frightening number.
And that Angel’s Shelter skill can be described as an enhanced version of the Holy Light Shield!
With Shen Yun’s current attributes, casting an Angel’s Shelter, even Three-star Monsters would take several attacks to break it.
If it’s Two-star Monsters, they can last a good while even when surrounded.
For One-star Monsters, there’s no need to say more, it would be difficult for them even to break the defense.
As for the Hammer of Repentance, there’s no need to explain.
Anyone who has been in the Holy Profession knows how ridiculous a 50% betrayal probability is.
Moreover, the attack range is broad, and the damage is high, making it an almost omnipotent divine level skill!
After calming their excitement, everyone started focusing on the Cloud Secret Realm Points leaderboard.
It was already evening, and there were three hours left until the calculation time.
At this moment.
Han Xing’s group’s scores had all surpassed 1000 points.
Meanwhile, the sixth-ranked Boundless only had 600 points, which was like a cliff-like gap.
With such a huge gap, no one harbored any illusions that Boundless could surpass Han Xing and his group.
There were only three hours left, and the ranking was basically set.
In this round, over 900,000 people competed for 10,000 slots.
The intensity of the competition was imaginable.
Over these ten days, people continuously surged into the top thousand, even the top hundred.
Many names also disappeared silently from the leaderboard.
Those whose names were erased either encountered insurmountable enemies in the Secret Realm challenges.
Or they were found by rival players, who physically eliminated them.
Either scenario meant they permanently left this world.
The chat channel also exploded into lively discussion.
"Brothers, place your bets on who you think will enter the top ten."
"By the way, excluding Star God, they’re not accepting bets, we’re betting on the other five slots."
"Damn it, if you’d said that two seconds later, I would have bet my entire fortune!"
"Hahaha! I was also about to bet everything on Star God."
The Survivor running the betting pool said speechlessly: "I think you all just want to bankrupt me!"
The chat channel was quickly filled with a cheerful atmosphere.
"Speaking of which, the sixth place should surely be Boundless, right? He already has 607 points, nearly 50 points more than the fifth-place Optimus Prime."
"Should be, if it weren’t for Star River popping out halfway, it feels like Boundless had a chance at first place."
"But Alpha from the Digital Celestial Team isn’t bad either, he somehow has 534 points now, closely trailing Optimus Prime."
"Indeed, the Digital Celestial Team, as the top team in Region 199, is usually quite low-key, but in terms of strength, they’re not inferior to these big teams."
The crowd began a heated discussion about those famous figures in the top ten of the leaderboard.
People like Dawn from Peak of Ceasefire, Bai Yunshu from Between the Clouds, Wind Celestial Emperor from Autocratic for Ten Thousand Years, these were subjects of their discussions.
Behind these people were large teams providing support, with the most elite members helping them clear Secret Realms.
Time slipped by quietly.
Soon, it was eleven o’clock at night.
There was one hour left until the reward calculations.
Just when everyone thought the top ten list was set this time.
A stranger’s name appeared in the top ten rankings.
Black Eagle.
Before this, no one had even heard of this character.
Black Eagle first pushed Bai Yunshu of the tenth spot down, then at a terrifying pace, pushed Dawn of the ninth spot to the tenth.
At the same time, Black Eagle’s points continued to rise.
The chat channel exploded once again.
At this time, Bai Yunshu, who was pushed to the eleventh place, looked very upset, staring at his team members, saying coldly, "Can anyone tell me, where did this Black Eagle suddenly appear from?"
The team members remained silent.
Because Black Eagle was too low-key.
Before this, other than once appearing on the celebrity list released by Yunchen.
He hadn’t appeared in the public eye again.
Even the Twilight Mercenary Corps behind him was equally low-key.
If possible, Black Eagle also preferred not to appear in public.
With his personality, he preferred to hide behind the scenes, delivering his most powerful strike at the critical moment.
But in the last hour of reward calculation, Black Eagle chose to sprint.
After all, the top ten rewards were too tempting.
Any reward he acquired would significantly boost his territory’s defense strength.
So, Black Eagle also didn’t want to miss this opportunity.
Originally, everyone had thought their rankings had stabilized and no further changes would happen, but because of Black Eagle’s sudden rise, a strong sense of urgency emerged in their hearts.
They once again began racing against time to impact the Cloud Secret Realm.
However, before the sprint, they also mobilized all means to frantically investigate Black Eagle’s information.
Black Eagle’s personal information quickly flowed into the management layers of those big teams.
Everyone was shocked to find out that this Black Eagle also came from Region 107.
In other words, he came from the same place as those monsters dominating the top five of the leaderboard.
Everyone’s eyes showed astonishment.
"What is going on in this Region 107, how can it produce so many monsters?"
"Having one Star River was surprising enough, and now Black Eagle pops up?"
Yet, none of them could answer.
What they didn’t know was.
Black Eagle benefited significantly because of his cooperative relationship with Han Xing.
Now, the resources Black Eagle had were even no less than those of the leaders of big teams.
Thus, he also bought a lot of top-grade equipment in the trading channel, which greatly improved his strength, allowing him to maintain such a strong momentum.
While everyone was racing against time to impact the leaderboard.
The time came to late at night.
There was just one minute left until the leaderboard calculation.
At this time, Han Xing and the other four stood atop the city wall, waiting quietly for the reward calculation.
As soon as it turned midnight, the system notification appeared in Han Xing’s ear.
[Cloud Secret Realm leaderboard has ended, your ranking: 1st place.]

[You have received the leaderboard rewards: Flamethrower Catapult Blueprint, Moonlight Holy Spring Blueprint, Minotaur Camp Map Blueprint, Wolf Cavalry Camp Map Blueprint, Lord Contract *10, One Orange Weapon Blueprint of your choice *1, Vim Divine Power Horn (Gold) *1, Spirit Core *300000.]
A huge pile of rewards was thrown at Han Xing.
Already having seen these blueprint introductions beforehand, Han Xing didn’t need to check them one by one again, instead, he clicked learn on all of them directly.
After the blueprints disappeared from his backpack, several powerful blueprints appeared in Han Xing’s territory construction interface.
Han Xing couldn’t wait to start checking the construction requirements of these blueprints.
First of all, it was the Flamethrower Catapult blueprint he was most looking forward to.

Those whose names were erased either encountered insurmountable enemies in the Secret Realm challenges.
Or they were found by rival players, who physically eliminated them.
Either scenario meant they permanently left this world.
The chat channel also exploded into lively discussion.
"Brothers, place your bets on who you think will enter the top ten."
"By the way, excluding Star God, they’re not accepting bets, we’re betting on the other five slots."
"Damn it, if you’d said that two seconds later, I would have bet my entire fortune!"
"Hahaha!
I was also about to bet everything on Star God."
The Survivor running the betting pool said speechlessly: "I think you all just want to bankrupt me!"
The chat channel was quickly filled with a cheerful atmosphere.
"Speaking of which, the sixth place should surely be Boundless, right?
He already has 607 points, nearly 50 points more than the fifth-place Optimus Prime."
"Should be, if it weren’t for Star River popping out halfway, it feels like Boundless had a chance at first place."
"But Alpha from the Digital Celestial Team isn’t bad either, he somehow has 534 points now, closely trailing Optimus Prime."
"Indeed, the Digital Celestial Team, as the top team in Region 199, is usually quite low-key, but in terms of strength, they’re not inferior to these big teams."
The crowd began a heated discussion about those famous figures in the top ten of the leaderboard.
People like Dawn from Peak of Ceasefire, Bai Yunshu from Between the Clouds, Wind Celestial Emperor from Autocratic for Ten Thousand Years, these were subjects of their discussions.
Behind these people were large teams providing support, with the most elite members helping them clear Secret Realms.
Time slipped by quietly.
Soon, it was eleven o’clock at night.
There was one hour left until the reward calculations.
Just when everyone thought the top ten list was set this time.
A stranger’s name appeared in the top ten rankings.
Black Eagle.
Before this, no one had even heard of this character.
Black Eagle first pushed Bai Yunshu of the tenth spot down, then at a terrifying pace, pushed Dawn of the ninth spot to the tenth.
At the same time, Black Eagle’s points continued to rise.
The chat channel exploded once again.
At this time, Bai Yunshu, who was pushed to the eleventh place, looked very upset, staring at his team members, saying coldly, "Can anyone tell me, where did this Black Eagle suddenly appear from?"
The team members remained silent.
Because Black Eagle was too low-key.
Before this, other than once appearing on the celebrity list released by Yunchen.
He hadn’t appeared in the public eye again.
Even the Twilight Mercenary Corps behind him was equally low-key.
If possible, Black Eagle also preferred not to appear in public.
With his personality, he preferred to hide behind the scenes, delivering his most powerful strike at the critical moment.
But in the last hour of reward calculation, Black Eagle chose to sprint.
After all, the top ten rewards were too tempting.
Any reward he acquired would significantly boost his territory’s defense strength.
So, Black Eagle also didn’t want to miss this opportunity.
Originally, everyone had thought their rankings had stabilized and no further changes would happen, but because of Black Eagle’s sudden rise, a strong sense of urgency emerged in their hearts.
They once again began racing against time to impact the Cloud Secret Realm.
However, before the sprint, they also mobilized all means to frantically investigate Black Eagle’s information.
Black Eagle’s personal information quickly flowed into the management layers of those big teams.
Everyone was shocked to find out that this Black Eagle also came from Region 107.
In other words, he came from the same place as those monsters dominating the top five of the leaderboard.
Everyone’s eyes showed astonishment.
"What is going on in this Region 107, how can it produce so many monsters?"
"Having one Star River was surprising enough, and now Black Eagle pops up?"
Yet, none of them could answer.
What they didn’t know was.
Black Eagle benefited significantly because of his cooperative relationship with Han Xing.
Now, the resources Black Eagle had were even no less than those of the leaders of big teams.
Thus, he also bought a lot of top-grade equipment in the trading channel, which greatly improved his strength, allowing him to maintain such a strong momentum.
While everyone was racing against time to impact the leaderboard.
The time came to late at night.
There was just one minute left until the leaderboard calculation.
At this time, Han Xing and the other four stood atop the city wall, waiting quietly for the reward calculation.
As soon as it turned midnight, the system notification appeared in Han Xing’s ear.
[Cloud Secret Realm leaderboard has ended, your ranking: 1st place.]

[You have received the leaderboard rewards: Flamethrower Catapult Blueprint, Moonlight Holy Spring Blueprint, Minotaur Camp Map Blueprint, Wolf Cavalry Camp Map Blueprint, Lord Contract *10, One Orange Weapon Blueprint of your choice *1, Vim Divine Power Horn (Gold) *1, Spirit Core *300000.]
A huge pile of rewards was thrown at Han Xing.
Already having seen these blueprint introductions beforehand, Han Xing didn’t need to check them one by one again, instead, he clicked learn on all of them directly.
After the blueprints disappeared from his backpack, several powerful blueprints appeared in Han Xing’s territory construction interface.
Han Xing couldn’t wait to start checking the construction requirements of these blueprints.
First of all, it was the Flamethrower Catapult blueprint he was most looking forward to.

chapters.title: Chapter 155 - 131: Frenzied Scramble!
paragraphs: [Construction Materials for Flamethrower Catapult]: Refined Iron*50000, Rare Earth*250000, Dark Fire Stone*50000, Mithril*1000, Permanent Gold Ingot*100, Power Crystal*100000.
"Great, they’re all regular materials!" Han Xing couldn’t help but clench his fist.
The number of materials needed to construct a Flamethrower Catapult is quite substantial.
Just building one would almost drain the resources of a small group.
But undoubtedly, this is quite a profitable deal!
A large-scale destructive territory building like this requires only one to substantially increase the attack power of the survivors’ territory, a transformative enhancement!
And Han Xing, of course, can’t just build one.
Suppressing his excitement, Han Xing continued to review the construction requirements of the other three blueprints.
[Construction Materials for Moonlight Holy Spring]: Moonlight Stone*10000, Magic Crystal*50000, Mithril*500, Spirit Core*50000.
[Construction Materials for Wolf Cavalry Camp]: Wolf Race Totem*1, Refined Iron*70000, Mithril*2000, Power Crystal*100000, Basic Teleportation Array*1.
[Construction Materials for Minotaur Camp]: Minotaur Totem*1, Refined Iron*100000, Mithril*5000, Power Crystal*150000, Basic Teleportation Array*1.
"Minotaur Totem and Wolf Race Totem? What are these things?" Han Xing was somewhat puzzled.
Of these four blueprints, apart from the more common materials needed for the Flamethrower Catapult and Moonlight Holy Spring, the other two camps both require the corresponding totems.
However, Han Xing has never obtained these two totems, nor does he know if they’re available in the trading channel.
After pondering for a moment.
Han Xing shook his head and said, "Forget it, I’ll check later."
"Let’s build a batch of Flamethrower Catapults first!"
Han Xing was extremely excited and couldn’t wait to see the sight of rows of catapults in his territory!
[Consume materials to construct Flamethrower Catapult?]
"Yes."
[Construction in progress, estimated time remaining 7 hours 59 minutes 59 seconds...]
The location Han Xing chose for the first batch of catapults was on the city walls.
This device, with damage far more terrifying than siege crossbow arrows, can cause a wide range of damage with each shell, akin to a puls version of the Gold Melting Cannon!
Placing it on high ground can maximize its destructive power.
Han Xing paced along the edge of the city wall, constructing one every few dozen meters.
The system prompts kept coming, while a large amount of materials were consumed.
Even with Han Xing’s wealth, it was becoming hard to maintain after building eighty units.
The warehouse’s material reserves were nearly depleted.
Refined Iron and Mithril still had stock, but Permanent Gold Ingot and Power Crystal were almost used up.
"The materials are used up, it seems it’s time to sell another batch of backpacks to replenish supplies."
Thinking of this, Han Xing looked at his backpack reserves.
In the past seven or eight days, he had prepared more than five thousand blue backpacks, in addition to over twenty thousand white ordinary backpacks.
With the survivors’ increasing strength, the grade of these backpacks was quickly becoming inadequate.
But because they are special equipment, their unique space storage function remains irreplaceable.
No matter how much you level up, you need space backpacks to carry supplies.
Moreover, as everyone’s resources increased, more people would come to purchase Han Xing’s space backpacks.
These two blueprints are Han Xing’s sustainable profit means.
Although other survivors also have blueprints, their success rate is currently abysmal.
Even if they managed to make one or two by luck, they couldn’t match Han Xing’s quality.
Without finding buildings like the Refining Workshop and maxing out technologies that increase success rates.
If they sold backpacks at Han Xing’s price, they’d certainly incur substantial losses.
So far, Han Xing’s backpacks remain unique, with no competitors.
In addition, in recent days, Han Xing has stockpiled a large amount of Witch Root Grass, Cursed Blood, Strong Beast Hide, and other materials.
To prepare for the upcoming trade of Blood Curse Resistance Formula and purple backpacks.
The cost was that his Spirit Core count, which was about to break a billion, now dwindled to less than five million, directly hitting bottom.
However, Han Xing was not worried because he was about to earn it back several times over.
Over the past eight days, all the survivors’ levels have been skyrocketing, with most reaching levels fifteen or sixteen, and the faster ones reaching seventeen or eighteen.
Existences like Boundless even reached level 20, executing advancement tasks.
This also means that everyone has accumulated a considerable amount of materials.
Even some powerful golden equipment occasionally appear in the trading channel.
Thinking of this, Han Xing observed the market trends in the trading channel.
Noticing no price changes for space backpacks, Han Xing directly clicked to list them.
When twenty-five thousand backpacks entered the market.
The long-silent trading channel plunged into a frenzy once again.
Previously, Han Xing had only released a few thousand backpacks.
For the channel with over 900,000 people, it was like tossing a small pebble into calm waters, only causing a few ripples.
Up to this point, market demand still exceeded Han Xing’s expectations.
So this time, when Han Xing listed the consignment information of the Space Backpack again, it immediately sparked a buying frenzy among the survivors!
"Brothers, Star God has listed top-tier backpacks for sale again, hurry to the trading channel, or they’ll be gone soon!"
"Oh man! Finally on sale. I couldn’t afford it last time and missed the opportunity. I’ve been saving for days, and now I can finally buy two!"
"I’m buying ten! Flip them on the trading channel and make several times the profit!"
This guy’s words instantly reminded more people.
Indeed, the backpacks sold by Star River have very powerful attributes.
And his pricing is generally lower than the market price to some extent.
Since the last transaction, many people have resold the backpacks acquired from Han Xing on the market, earning a tidy sum!
It could be said that anything sold by Star River, once bought, basically guarantees a profit.
At once, more survivors were woken up by friends and family in the middle of the night, scrambling to make deals with Han Xing.
Before long, over three thousand of Han Xing’s blue backpacks were snapped up, with a vast amount of materials poured into his account.
At the same time, Han Xing stood by the city wall. With the backpacks unable to hold them, a large pile of materials began to stack up at his feet.
Zhang Lianmeng had witnessed such a scene before.
But Shen Yun, Cheng Jianyong, and others had never seen anything like it.
They were shocked into a dazed state, completely forgetting to check the rewards they had just received.
At this moment, both of them stared blankly at Han Xing, swallowing hard.
They knew Han Xing’s ability to amass wealth was terrifyingly impressive.
But witnessing those precious materials piling up at an astounding pace into small mountains left them in a surreal state.
Even Su Xiaoyang on the side couldn’t help but drop his jaw.
Since when does anyone count Permanent Gold Ingots by the pile?
And that mountain of Spirit Cores reaching over ten meters high - such a trade scene was utterly shocking.
If other survivors saw this, they might feel a surge of greed.
But Han Xing didn’t bother to hide it, because there was no need.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun both knew that he was Star River, and the trading channel’s bustling scene couldn’t be concealed.
Besides, these were all people he could trust.
Half an hour later, nearly ten thousand backpacks had been sold by Han Xing!
Most of them were White Level backpacks.
For this mighty item with a 30-slot Storage Space, Han Xing priced it at 10,000 Spirit Cores. Buying two meant 60 slots of Storage Space.
In terms of Storage Space alone, it’s even a better deal than buying blue backpacks, making it the best value for money!
At this time, others in the chat channel were reminding as well.
"Brothers, for those who can’t afford the blue backpack, the white one is also great and costs only 10,000 Spirit Cores, which is very economical!"
"Actually, a 30-slot space is already big enough, buying two gives you 60 slots, perfect for us regular players."
"That’s right, it’s not that we can’t afford the blue backpack, but the white backpack has a better cost-performance ratio!"
For a time, both Han Xing’s blue and white backpacks were warmly welcomed by the crowd.
Another half hour later.
Han Xing’s transaction ended.
This transaction was the largest he had ever conducted.
Calculating by Spirit Cores alone, twenty thousand white backpacks plus five thousand blue backpacks amounted to 450 million Spirit Cores!
This quantity is a figure that ordinary survivors might never encounter in their entire lives!
In fact, Han Xing didn’t receive that many Spirit Cores.
Most of them were exchanged for materials of equivalent value.
In particular, Han Xing made a concerted effort to acquire crucial items such as Witch Root Grass, Cursed Blood, Thunder Stones, Strong Beast Hide, Wolf Race Totem, and Minotaur Totem.
For the first three materials, he acquired quite a lot this time. If not for the need for Divine Aurora, he could produce over 30,000 Blood Curse Antidote Formulas with the materials.
As for Thunder Stones, he obtained around ten thousand pieces in this transaction, nearly monopolizing the Thunder Stones in the entire second district.
Having so many Thunder Stones meant Han Xing could construct over ten Lightning Towers again!
However, the Wolf Race Totem and Minotaur Totem he most wanted didn’t come through.
The appearance rate for these two totems must be very low, and with leaderboard rewards already distributed, everyone knows their importance.
So, it’s even less likely anyone would trade them to Han Xing at the moment.
At this moment, Shen Yun, Cheng Jianyong, and others snapped out of their shock.
Because they’d been squeezed to the outer city wall by the mountain of materials.
Suddenly, a sound like an earthquake emerged from the woods nearby.
Thump! Thump! Thump!
Upon closer inspection, it was a few Puppet Giants, carrying several large boxes on their shoulders, approaching.
These Puppet Giants, of course, were summoned by Han Xing.
Han Xing couldn’t leave these material mountains lying in his territory; he needed to store them in Storage Boxes and then place them in the underground warehouse under the Lord’s Mansion.

chapters.title: Chapter 156 - 132: Orange Weapon, Ice Burial!
paragraphs: The work efficiency of these Puppet Giants is very high.
Under the division of labor, in no time, more than half of the materials were stored into the Storage Box.
Watching the Puppet Giants transport boxes of supplies, everyone couldn’t help but swallow.
"Brother Xing’s speed in gathering materials is really absurd..."
"I can’t even imagine the day when I can see a mountain of Permanent Gold Ingots piled in front of me," Shen Yun couldn’t help but exclaim.
Beside him, Cheng Jianyong nodded in agreement.
"Now, in the entire second district, Brother Xing is probably the Survivor with the most resources."
"At this time, if someone could capture Brother Xing’s territory and take over the City Lord’s Mansion, that would be a real fortune, akin to reaching the sky in a single step!"
Of course, Cheng Jianyong was just joking.

With the Defense Strength of Han Xing’s territory, if someone could withstand thousands of Siege Crossbow Arrows, plus hundreds of Flamethrower Catapults, and over twenty Lightning Towers to reach Han Xing’s territory, then that would truly be remarkable!
Of course, this is an impossible feat, not even a Three-star Lord-level Monster could achieve it.
This time trading, Han Xing only roughly estimated the harvest.
Among them, the Spirit Core quantity barely reached one billion, mostly other materials like Refined Iron, Mithril, and Permanent Gold Ingots.
Blueprints were scarcely received, and those were of relatively low Level.
This thwarted Han Xing’s plan to completely upgrade his equipment.
However, the current strength of his equipment can still hold for some time.
At present, the urgent task is to build more territory facilities.
Hence, Han Xing began to mass-produce Flamethrower Catapults again.
Starting at the edge of the Xingyu City’s walls, he selected some strategic points to build over a hundred Flamethrower Catapults.
Then Han Xing went to the territory below, building a few Catapults or Moonlight Springs scattered around at the foot of some hills or behind large rocks.
In total, about 312 Flamethrower Catapults and over 30 Moonlight Holy Springs were constructed.
The Moonlight Holy Springs can autonomously absorb the energy of the moonlight, and once the Energy Value is full, each Moonlight Holy Spring can instantly heal a creature within the territory once.
This ensures the safety of staying within the territory.
With so many facilities being built, the materials just harvested are being consumed massively.
Nevertheless, Han Xing is unconcerned, as he can earn them back quickly.
In addition, Han Xing also selected a few locations with good visibility to construct 12 more Lightning Towers.
Currently, the entire territory is in a fervent state of development.
A thriving scene is unfolding.
Once all these constructions are completed, the overall strength of Han Xing’s territory will experience earth-shattering changes!
Meanwhile, Shen Yun and others began checking the newly acquired ranking rewards.
This time, they directly took the top five places on the leaderboard, gaining astonishing rewards!
The prizes for the top three are particularly tempting.
Just the choice of Golden Weapons alone included two, and the second place could additionally choose a Golden Accessory.
The second place was Shen Yun, who chose a Hammer of Truth (Gold), Legendary Quality, with a powerful Legendary Effect.
Also, a necklace, the Sacred Purification Pendant (Gold), though only of Rare Quality.
The third place was Zhang Lianmeng, who chose the Golden Weapon, Silver Wing Staff (Gold), also of Legendary Quality.
These Golden Equipment items are all Level 20, which they can equip now.
At this moment, Shen Yun held the Hammer of Truth in his left hand, the Shield of Immortality in his right, wearing the Titan Battle Armor, along with a Golden necklace.
The addition of four Golden Equipment items elevated his All Attributes to a terrifying level.
Cheng Jianyong enviously said, "Envious, Xiaoyunzi’s equipment strength is even more formidable than Brother Xing’s now!"
Everyone realized this upon hearing.
Unbeknownst to them, Shen Yun’s equipment had reached a luxurious level, with half a body of Golden Armor, unmatched in the entire second district.
Yet Shen Yun smiled and said, "I’m a support Profession, isn’t my better equipment a greater benefit for you all?
"Do you still want to receive my Blessing?"
Cheng Jianyong seemed to remember suddenly.
After advancing, Shen Yun learned another powerful Blessing Skill.
With two Blessing Skills combined, any Survivor would experience a huge boost in Power and become incredibly strong.
Having such a powerful support is the dream of many teams!
Cheng Jianyong quickly said, "Yes! I want it!"
"Give me the Blessing of Honor and Courage, and next time, I’ll solo a Three-star Leader Monster for you!"
"What’s a Leader Monster; could you solo a Lord-level Monster for me?" Shen Yun asked with interest,
Cheng Jianyong immediately shriveled.
That’s a joke; a Two-star Lord could still be tackled, but a Three-star Lord is a death wish!
Everyone laughed upon seeing this.
However, Han Xing’s equipment isn’t bad either.
Soul Shattering Longbow, plus Kingdom Ring, and Meteorite Armor, a total of three pieces of Golden Equipment.
Moreover, he received the first place on the leaderboard reward.
At this moment, Shen Yun seemed to remember something and suddenly said, "Brother Xing, I recall that the first-place reward also includes a Golden Horn and an Orange Weapon Blueprint?"
"Have you chosen which Weapon Blueprint yet?"
Upon this reminder, everyone also remembered.
Orange Weapon Blueprint!
Cheng Jianyong’s Level 15 Lion Heart Greatsword has already proven the power of Orange Weapons!
And this Orange Weapon Blueprint that Han Xing has, is a level 20 equipment, and its attributes will certainly be even more formidable!
Since the Cloud Secret Realm points leaderboard opened, Han Xing’s harvest has already been plentiful.
However, when Han Xing looked at the orange blueprint in his backpack, his breathing hastened slightly.
Because, this is an Orange Weapon Blueprint!
The attributes are explosively strong, and combined with Han Xing’s ’Divine-level Artisan’ talent, it has a high probability of creating epic quality equipment!
So, he couldn’t wait to check the requirements for crafting this orange weapon.
[Ice Burial Longbow Blueprint (Orange)]
[Materials Required for Crafting]: Permanent Gold Ingot*120, Purple Gold Stone*50, Stone of Extreme Cold*20, Mithril*1000, Ice Heart*1.
After seeing the materials needed for this longbow blueprint, Han Xing understood.
Among them, Permanent Gold Ingot and Purple Gold Stone are well-stocked in Han Xing’s warehouse, so there’s no need to worry about them.
The only troublesome ones are the Stone of Extreme Cold and the Ice Heart.
Prior to this, Han Xing had never heard of them.
With a try-it-and-see attitude, he opened the trading channel and did a search.
There were actually a dozen listings for ’Stone of Extreme Cold’, with a total of barely 80 pieces on the entire market.
The asking price isn’t too high, about 30,000 spirit cores can trade for one Stone of Extreme Cold, similar to the price of Vitality Ore.
Han Xing spent 2 million spirit cores and directly purchased over 60 pieces.
Then, Han Xing searched for the Ice Heart.
What appeared before his eyes was a blank page.
The joy that had just appeared on Han Xing’s face instantly vanished.
Because, without the Ice Heart, even if all the other materials are gathered it would be useless.
This also meant that in the short term, he couldn’t create the orange weapon longbow.
Noticing Han Xing’s off expression, Shen Yun asked, "What’s wrong, Brother Xing?
Han Xing replied, "One of the materials needed to create the orange longbow is missing, and it’s not in the trading channel."
"The entire trading channel doesn’t have it?"
Han Xing nodded.
The others also frowned.
Shen Yun asked, "Brother Xing, what’s the material?"
"Ice Heart, it seems to drop from ice attribute monsters above level 20."
"Ice attribute monsters?"
Everyone fell into thought.
At this time, Zhang Lianmeng seemed to recall something and took out a snowball-like white object from her backpack.
Suddenly, everyone felt the surrounding temperature drop by a few degrees.
"Brother Xing, is it this?" Zhang Lianmeng asked softly.
Han Xing focused his attention and an introduction of the item appeared before him.
[Ice Heart]: The heart of power from a powerful ice attribute monster. Can be used to create ice-element weapons, greatly enhancing ice skills damage.
Seeing the attributes listed, Han Xing was startled, then excitedly said, "It really is! Where did you get this, Lian’Er?"
Zhang Lianmeng giggled, "Did you forget?"
"Yesterday, when I was completing a challenge task, there was an ice attribute big monster on that Sky Island."
"It was only with your help that it was defeated, and then I disassembled this from its body."
"I was originally going to give it to Little Sister Yang, but luckily Brother Xing can use it."
Off to the side, Su Xiaoyang bashfully lowered her head after hearing this.
Now, everyone knows that apart from her habit of bending people’s fingers, she also has a penchant for collecting hearts.
Even though Su Xiaoyang always explained that those monster hearts were for feeding the Pale Demon Plant in the territory,
every time, the group would give an understanding smile, leaving Su Xiaoyang rather embarrassed.
Zhang Lianmeng handed this snowy heart to Han Xing.
Han Xing happily accepted it.
Happy to help Han Xing, Zhang Lianmeng appeared very pleased.
Now, all the materials to craft the Orange Weapon: Ice Burial Longbow are gathered, and Han Xing was thrilled.
In front of everyone, he directly clicked on crafting.
[Do you want to consume materials: Permanent Gold Ingot*120, Purple Gold Stone*50, Stone of Extreme Cold*20, Mithril*1000, Ice Heart*1, to craft ’Ice Burial Longbow (Orange)’]
"Yes."
[Crafting in progress, 500 seconds remaining...]
In the next moment, a burst of orange light shot up, making it hard for everyone to open their eyes under the illumination of this pillar of light.
As the progress bar continued to deplete, these skyrocketing orange lights became increasingly solid, then converged in front of Han Xing.
In front, the shape of a great bow was beginning to form.
As all the light gathered onto the bow,
when the progress bar reached the end, a system prompt appeared.
[Crafting successful, you obtained Ice Burial Longbow (Orange)*1...]
With a pop!
At Han Xing’s feet appeared a bow as translucent as crystal, its body faintly showing blood-colored veins, like flowing blood vessels.
The appearance gave off a somewhat eerie beauty.

Blueprints were scarcely received, and those were of relatively low Level.
This thwarted Han Xing’s plan to completely upgrade his equipment.
However, the current strength of his equipment can still hold for some time.

In total, about 312 Flamethrower Catapults and over 30 Moonlight Holy Springs were constructed.
The Moonlight Holy Springs can autonomously absorb the energy of the moonlight, and once the Energy Value is full, each Moonlight Holy Spring can instantly heal a creature within the territory once.
This ensures the safety of staying within the territory.
With so many facilities being built, the materials just harvested are being consumed massively.
Nevertheless, Han Xing is unconcerned, as he can earn them back quickly.
In addition, Han Xing also selected a few locations with good visibility to construct 12 more Lightning Towers.
Currently, the entire territory is in a fervent state of development.
A thriving scene is unfolding.
Once all these constructions are completed, the overall strength of Han Xing’s territory will experience earth-shattering changes!

The second place was Shen Yun, who chose a Hammer of Truth (Gold), Legendary Quality, with a powerful Legendary Effect.

The third place was Zhang Lianmeng, who chose the Golden Weapon, Silver Wing Staff (Gold), also of Legendary Quality.
These Golden Equipment items are all Level 20, which they can equip now.

The addition of four Golden Equipment items elevated his All Attributes to a terrifying level.
Cheng Jianyong enviously said, "Envious, Xiaoyunzi’s equipment strength is even more formidable than Brother Xing’s now!"
Everyone realized this upon hearing.
Unbeknownst to them, Shen Yun’s equipment had reached a luxurious level, with half a body of Golden Armor, unmatched in the entire second district.
Yet Shen Yun smiled and said, "I’m a support Profession, isn’t my better equipment a greater benefit for you all?
"Do you still want to receive my Blessing?"
Cheng Jianyong seemed to remember suddenly.
After advancing, Shen Yun learned another powerful Blessing Skill.
With two Blessing Skills combined, any Survivor would experience a huge boost in Power and become incredibly strong.
Having such a powerful support is the dream of many teams!
Cheng Jianyong quickly said, "Yes!
I want it!"
"Give me the Blessing of Honor and Courage, and next time, I’ll solo a Three-star Leader Monster for you!"
"What’s a Leader Monster; could you solo a Lord-level Monster for me?" Shen Yun asked with interest,
Cheng Jianyong immediately shriveled.
That’s a joke; a Two-star Lord could still be tackled, but a Three-star Lord is a death wish!
Everyone laughed upon seeing this.
However, Han Xing’s equipment isn’t bad either.
Soul Shattering Longbow, plus Kingdom Ring, and Meteorite Armor, a total of three pieces of Golden Equipment.
Moreover, he received the first place on the leaderboard reward.

"Have you chosen which Weapon Blueprint yet?"

Cheng Jianyong’s Level 15 Lion Heart Greatsword has already proven the power of Orange Weapons!
