chapters.title: Chapter 157 - 133: Blood Sun Rising, Meteors Falling
paragraphs: This longbow exudes an astonishing chill, and as soon as it lands, a layer of frost forms on the ground.
Han Xing quickly picked up the weapon.
Strangely, once held, he didn’t feel any coldness from it.
Han Xing even felt the pulse of its rhythm within.
The attributes of the longbow appeared before him.
[Ice Burial (Orange) lv20, Quality - Epic, Attack Power 574~632, agility +100, Power +50, Hit Rate +20%.]
[Attached Effect]: Ice Source Energy (When attacking, adds an ice effect to all arrows, reducing the enemy’s Movement Speed by 1%, stacking up to 20 times).
[Attached Effect]: Shattered Ice (When attacking, ignores 100 points of the opponent’s defense).
[Attached Effect]: Extreme Cold Domain (Legendary Effect, when activated, forms an Extreme Cold Domain with a 200-meter diameter centered on the Survivor.

Enemies within the domain suffer ice attribute damage equal to 150% of Attack every second, reducing their Movement Speed by 20% each time, stacking up to five times. Effect lasts for 10 seconds, cooldown time: 40 minutes.
[Attached Effect]: Ice Burial (Epic Effect, when activated, applies 10 layers of Ice Burial Effect to all enemy creatures within an 800-meter radius.
Each layer of Ice Burial Effect reduces enemy Movement Speed and Attack Speed by 10%, exploding after ten seconds to cause 50% extra damage for each layer. Cooldown time: 60 minutes.
Powerful, unbelievably powerful!
The four attributes attached to this longbow left Han Xing stunned for a long time.
Besides the Demon Monarch’s Greatsword, it was the first time he had come across such a powerful weapon!
Among them, the Legendary Effect, Extreme Cold Domain, is an exceptionally strong control Divine Skill!
Any random ice attribute damage can reduce the enemy’s Movement Speed by 20%.
Stacked five times, that’s 100%, making the opponent unable to move at all!
Moreover, there’s an even stronger Epic Effect afterward.
layers of Ice Burial is equivalent to strong control for ten seconds.
Although the monsters can break free early, once it explodes, it’s a 500% group damage.
With Han Xing’s current Attack Power, even a Leader Level monster would suffer severe damage under this blow!
Not to mention those Elite Monsters and Ordinary Monsters, it’s simply a field-clearing Divine Skill.
The key is, the cooldown times for these two effects are not long, and they can be released every half hour.
Seeing Han Xing’s shocked expression, everyone knew that this weapon was definitely something not simple.
Han Xing didn’t keep them in suspense and directly posted the attributes of the Ice Burial Longbow.
When everyone saw the words ’Quality - Epic’, they all gasped.
"My goodness, this weapon is way too powerful!"
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Is this what an Epic Quality weapon is, such abnormal attributes, completely crushing my Lion Heart Greatsword!"
The others nodded in deep agreement.
Compared to ’Ice Burial’, Cheng Jianyong’s Lion Heart Greatsword not only has far inferior attributes but also lacks an Epic Effect.
Han Xing was also very pleased with this Ice Burial Longbow, and after equipping it, his Attack Power increased significantly once again!
Now, in their five-person team, everyone was equipped with Golden Weapons, their equipment strength already top-notch among Survivors.
Except for Su Xiaoyang, who was still using the Level 11 Shattered Spirit Longbow, everyone was equipped with high level Golden Weapons.
No problem, there’s nothing to worry about.
Just need to find an Ice Heart, and Han Xing can make an Epic Quality longbow with matching attributes.
At the same time.
A glimmer of dawn suddenly appeared in the distant sky.
Only then did everyone realize it was almost daybreak.
Since the zero-hour rewards settlement, everyone had been in such an exhilarated state that they forgot about the passage of time.
Unnoticed, it was nearly morning.
However, today’s sunrise seemed a bit unusual, looking exceptionally red.
Cheng Jianyong said with a puzzled expression, "Do any of you feel today’s sunrise is a bit off?"
Shen Yun nodded, "It does seem a bit off, the sun feels unusually red today, flickering at times, like a freshly opened heart..."
With his words, everyone realized what felt wrong to them.
The slowly rising red sun was indeed like a beating heart!
The blood-red sunlight shone on everyone’s faces, as if a layer of red ink had been poured over them, making it sticky and unsettling.
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but shiver, hurriedly saying, "Come on, Xiaoyunzi, don’t say such things, it’s creepy..."
However, aside from these changes, there weren’t any other reactions noted.
Everyone felt it might be just a unique weather phenomenon in this world, so they didn’t mind it much.
At this moment, Su Xiaoyang suddenly looked up at the sky.
"Look up there, it seems like there are meteors..."
As Su Xiaoyang finished speaking, everyone looked up.
One by one, brilliant meteors streaked overhead, falling into various corners of their world.
With each blink, the number of meteors increased.
In just a moment, thousands upon thousands of meteors appeared across the sky.
"Wow, so many meteors!" Zhang Lianmeng was also amazed.
Like a sudden meteor shower descending, covering the sky.
Cheng Jianyong wondered aloud, "Brother Xing, did you just use a skill?"
Han Xing rolled his eyes at him.
This guy, even noticing something amiss, still has the mood to joke.

chapters.title: Chapter 158 - 133: Blood Sun Rising, Meteors Falling
paragraphs: His Fallen Star Arrow Rain can also summon meteors.
But compared to the vast number in the sky, it’s like comparing a witch to a giant.
Meanwhile, it’s not just them.
The billions of survivors who arrived in this world all simultaneously looked up at that moment.
They also saw the massive meteor shower.
The next moment, a system announcement appeared...
"Attention survivors, it has been one month since the first batch of survivors entered the Sky Island Paradise world."
"All remaining humans on Blue Star have now been transferred into Sky Island Paradise."
"Newly arrived human survivors will be placed near their respective relatives. If they have no relatives, a core territory will be generated for them to seek survival independently..."
When the system prompt ended, everyone gasped in unison.
"Damn!!!"
It turned out that today was the thirtieth day since they came to this world.
Unknowingly, everyone had almost forgotten about it.
A month of life on Sky Island had already made them adapt to the rhythm of this world.
The sudden change left everyone a bit dumbfounded.
And this also meant that their family members would join them in this world today!
For some time, some felt overjoyed, while others felt lost and at a loss.
But no matter the case, the arrival of the second batch of humans was already a fait accompli.
Blue Star had completely become history.
Numerous meteors fell upon the territories of those survivors,
Everyone knew that each meteor represented a Blue Star relative arriving in this world.
They were about to meet the family they had long been separated from.
At the same time.
Meteors also descended upon Han Xing’s territory.
An estimated rough count came to at least thirty or forty.
However, they weren’t Han Xing’s relatives.
Instead, they were the family of Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, Zhang Lianmeng, and Su Xiaoyang.
After the meteors fell.
A clearing beneath Han Xing’s territory appeared with over forty unfamiliar faces.
They varied in age and gender.
Their appearances were different, but their faces shared the same expression of terror and bewilderment.
And beside each person was a floating cube, which was their core territory.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun spotted their family members among these people at a glance.
So, they descended from the wall of Xingyu City.
When they approached, these bewildered survivors saw the four of them.
At the sight of Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun, they rushed over like grasping at a life-saving straw, surrounding them tightly.
These people questioned them incessantly, with little variation in their inquiries.
Where is this? Why am I here? What should I do?
Though the system provided an introduction upon entering Sky Island Paradise,
considering the mindset and receptiveness of their relatives to new things, Cheng Jianyong and the others had no choice but to explain the situation of this world to them.
Han Xing didn’t go down; he didn’t feel much about it.
Moreover, explaining a bunch of things to their relatives is a rather troublesome task for him.
At this moment, Han Xing was grateful that he didn’t have many relatives.
While Cheng Jianyong and the others were busy explaining to their family,
he sat in his territory, continuing to open the crafting page.
Then he proceeded to craft various backpacks for sale.
A couple of hours later.
In Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun’s helpless gaze,
they finally explained the basic rules of this world to their relatives and cautioned them about the hidden dangers on Sky Island and how to survive moving forward.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun’s parents were already over fifty years old, and at their age, accepting the concept of crossing worlds was indeed hard to swallow.
But there was no other way; this was their reality.
Blue Star had become the past, and they could never return.
To survive, they could only accept and adapt to the rules of this world.
After a round of psychological comfort, these people seemed to accept the truth, and their emotions stabilized somewhat.
Then, the four of them led their families to settle in their respective territories.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun both had their Lord’s Cottages, managing to house their families of ten or so people was doable.
Su Xiaoyang’s relatives were fewer, just a couple around forty years old, who were Su Xiaoyang’s parents.
Su Xiaoyang also took her parents to settle in her territory.
The one with the fewest relatives was Zhang Lianmeng.
Beside her was only a curvaceous, mature woman exuding an air of sophistication.
Her body, in terms of allure, was only slightly less than Zhang Lianmeng’s.
And her appearance bore a slight resemblance to Zhang Lianmeng; this should be her mother.
Considering Zhang Lianmeng’s age, her mother should also be in her forties.
But whether due to good maintenance or genetic reasons,
she still looked like she was in her forties, that age where a woman’s maturity is at its richest, like a ripe fruit.
Every move she made seemed to emit a particular aura.
Even after Zhang Lianmeng comforted her for hours, the woman’s face still held a fearful expression.
Yet even her fearful look was rather endearing.
Without needing Han Xing to say anything, Zhang Lianmeng took her mother into Xingyu City.
At that time, Zhang Lianmeng’s mother was still wearing modern casual wear, a white t-shirt on top and denim shorts below, the shorts tightly clinging to her thighs.
The two voluptuous women were simply like two peas in a pod.
At that moment, Zhang Lianmeng’s mother craned her neck, looking around Han Xing’s lordly little town with curiosity, an air of mysterious allure seemed to radiate from her eyes.
She was very curious.
A city floating in mid-air like this, she had only seen in movies before coming to this world.
They crossed the streets and arrived at the center of Xingyu City.
When she saw the magnificent palace-like building, her face showed even more surprise.
This building was, naturally, Han Xing’s City Lord’s Mansion.
Then, inevitably, she ran into Han Xing.
Having completed a Second Transformation, Han Xing inadvertently exuded a higher-level life aura.
Zhang Lianmeng’s mother noticed the extraordinary young man from a distance.
From Zhang Lianmeng’s mouth, she learned that this young man was the owner of the city.
Moreover, her daughter seemed to hold this young man in high esteem, even to the point of blind worship.
From childhood to now, she had never seen such an expression on her daughter’s face.
There was a trust and reliance from the very core of her being; she didn’t understand what kind of man could bewitch her daughter to this extent.
This meeting indeed showed him to be quite extraordinary.
After a round of introductions, Han Xing nodded.
Then he had Zhang Lianmeng arrange a room for her mother.
The Intermediate City Lord’s Mansion was immense; even housing a few hundred people wouldn’t make it feel cramped.
Zhang Lianmeng nodded slightly, looking at Han Xing with grateful eyes.
Once everyone’s relatives were settled.
Meanwhile, the chat channel exploded.
The original two major regions already had over 900,000 people.
Now, after the relative arrival event, the number soared to nearly 10 million!
The chat channel turned into a large-scale family recognition scene.
"Wow, brothers, I woke up with seven or eight more sons and daughters; can you believe it?"
"Damn, how come only my wife got transported over; where’s my son?"
"The person upstairs, is your son called Lv Zixuan? He’s here with me!"
"Uncle Chen, it turns out you’re my father?"
"Bastard! The son I’ve raised for so many years isn’t mine..."
"Dad, I miss you so much..."
Various voices rose one after another, and this family matching inadvertently unearthed many long-hidden truths.
The chat channel played out as a series of family melodramas.

sentences.text: His Fallen Star Arrow Rain can also summon meteors.
But compared to the vast number in the sky, it’s like comparing a witch to a giant.
Meanwhile, it’s not just them.
The billions of survivors who arrived in this world all simultaneously looked up at that moment.
They also saw the massive meteor shower.
The next moment, a system announcement appeared...
"Attention survivors, it has been one month since the first batch of survivors entered the Sky Island Paradise world."
"All remaining humans on Blue Star have now been transferred into Sky Island Paradise."
"Newly arrived human survivors will be placed near their respective relatives.
If they have no relatives, a core territory will be generated for them to seek survival independently..."
When the system prompt ended, everyone gasped in unison.
"Damn!!!"
It turned out that today was the thirtieth day since they came to this world.
Unknowingly, everyone had almost forgotten about it.
A month of life on Sky Island had already made them adapt to the rhythm of this world.
The sudden change left everyone a bit dumbfounded.
And this also meant that their family members would join them in this world today!
For some time, some felt overjoyed, while others felt lost and at a loss.
But no matter the case, the arrival of the second batch of humans was already a fait accompli.
Blue Star had completely become history.
Numerous meteors fell upon the territories of those survivors,
Everyone knew that each meteor represented a Blue Star relative arriving in this world.
They were about to meet the family they had long been separated from.
At the same time.
Meteors also descended upon Han Xing’s territory.
An estimated rough count came to at least thirty or forty.
However, they weren’t Han Xing’s relatives.
Instead, they were the family of Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, Zhang Lianmeng, and Su Xiaoyang.
After the meteors fell.
A clearing beneath Han Xing’s territory appeared with over forty unfamiliar faces.
They varied in age and gender.
Their appearances were different, but their faces shared the same expression of terror and bewilderment.
And beside each person was a floating cube, which was their core territory.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun spotted their family members among these people at a glance.
So, they descended from the wall of Xingyu City.
When they approached, these bewildered survivors saw the four of them.
At the sight of Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun, they rushed over like grasping at a life-saving straw, surrounding them tightly.
These people questioned them incessantly, with little variation in their inquiries.
Where is this?
Why am I here?
What should I do?
Though the system provided an introduction upon entering Sky Island Paradise,
considering the mindset and receptiveness of their relatives to new things, Cheng Jianyong and the others had no choice but to explain the situation of this world to them.
Han Xing didn’t go down; he didn’t feel much about it.
Moreover, explaining a bunch of things to their relatives is a rather troublesome task for him.
At this moment, Han Xing was grateful that he didn’t have many relatives.
While Cheng Jianyong and the others were busy explaining to their family,
he sat in his territory, continuing to open the crafting page.
Then he proceeded to craft various backpacks for sale.

they finally explained the basic rules of this world to their relatives and cautioned them about the hidden dangers on Sky Island and how to survive moving forward.

To survive, they could only accept and adapt to the rules of this world.

chapters.title: Chapter 159 - 134: Auction
paragraphs: In the chat channel, people everywhere were looking for their relatives.
Of course, not everyone found their own family members.
Some people came to this world alone, still lonely.
"Chen Hao... my son, where are you?"
"Fang Qingshu, Mom’s here, you left a month ago, Grandpa and Grandma miss you so much..."
"My daughter, please reply to your dad..."
Clearly, the newcomers to this world hadn’t landed near their relatives.
There’s only one possibility: their family members may have already died in this world.
The chaos in the chat channel lasted for a while.
The appearance of so many people couldn’t even be intimidated by the big teams.
Helplessly, they could only establish various small chat channels to communicate within.
However, these things had nothing to do with Han Xing.
Meanwhile, on Han Xing’s territory.
He saw many new notifications on the system interface.
[Your territory building, Thunderbolt Tower, has been completed...]
[Your territory building, Flamethrower Catapult, has been completed...]
[Your territory building, Moonlight Holy Spring, has been completed...]
"Oh? All completed?"
Upon hearing the notifications, Han Xing quickly rushed to the city wall to observe the changes in his territory.
In front of him stood several towers nearly thirty meters tall, black in color, with flickers of electricity on their surface.
At the top of each tower was a giant round sphere, constantly rotating, occasionally emitting sizzling electrical sounds.
This was Han Xing’s newly built Thunderbolt Tower, the strongest attack building in his territory.
Currently, these 11 Thunderbolt Towers can provide omnidirectional coverage of the entire territory, overwhelming any Leader-level monsters in one wave of concentrated fire.
And this is just the first batch.
After gathering materials last night, Han Xing built another twelve Thunderbolt Towers.
In a few hours, they will all be completed.
By then, Han Xing’s firepower will be doubled again.
Moreover, on the city walls of Xingyu City, every ten meters or so, there is a massive catapult, entirely made of refined iron, about eight meters long.
These territory buildings were being completed batch by batch, providing Han Xing with a strong sense of security.
"Great! So many attack buildings, even if under siege, I’m not afraid anymore!" Han Xing said excitedly.
He then invested Spirit Core to activate the Intermediate Shield, protecting his entire territory.
The only regret was that the Wolf Cavalry Camp and the Minotaur Camp were not being built.
Otherwise, he could have started deploying his rush strategy now.
Han Xing planned to check the trading channel to see if there was any consignment information for these two items.
After searching for a while, he still found nothing.
Han Xing regretfully shook his head.
However, when searching for the two totems, he inadvertently saw a batch of construction blueprints being auctioned in the trading channel.
This auction was extremely lively, attracting thousands of survivors to watch.
The auction was initiated by a survivor named Lie An.
He saw that the other party had already completed transactions for two types of blueprints.
They were the ’Rotating Blade Emitter’ and ’Arrow Tower’ construction blueprints.
These two blueprints were quite strong attack-type buildings.
The former could launch a rotating blade to inflict area damage to enemies continuously.
The latter could build a small Arrow Tower, not only automatically shooting crossbow arrows but also allowing ranged units to stand on it to attack invading enemies.
Even Han Xing was tempted when he saw these two blueprints.
"It’s a pity, I came a few steps late, and these two blueprints have already been auctioned off." Han Xing said with some regret.
However, after trading these two blueprints, the survivor named Lie An took out another blueprint to auction.
Whether it was good luck or Lie An’s own substantial strength,
In any case, being able to take out so many blueprints for auction at this stage showed he indeed had some skills.
Han Xing took a glance, and currently being auctioned was a blueprint called [Thorny Shield Wall].
Lie An straightforwardly listed the relevant introduction of the blueprint.

[Thorny Shield Wall Blueprint]: Can build a shield wall with a counterattack effect on the territory, inflicting 10% counter damage to melee units per attack, and the shield wall has 500 Defense Value. (Note, the shield wall cannot be moved.)
Upon seeing the blueprint introduction, everyone was somewhat puzzled.
By now, the chat in the trading channel was flooded by many people.
They asked one after another: "Brother Lie An, this blueprint is strong, but what’s its specific use?"
"Yeah, since the shield wall can’t move, do I need to build a Thorny Shield Wall and lock myself inside?"
A moment later, the survivor named Lie An replied: "Everyone, stay calm, and let me explain its use to you slowly."
"To everyone present, there are many elite and high-ranking members from major teams among you. I suppose some of you have already built catapults or other territorial buildings..."
"But have you noticed, these attack buildings, although highly damaging, have a fatal flaw, which is their low defense value."
"If at this time, you build a thorny shield wall around these attack facilities nearby..."
Lie An stopped speaking.
Because he knew, those who couldn’t understand by now had no right to participate in the bidding for this blueprint.
After listening to Lie An’s introduction, many survivors watching the auction had their pupils contract instantly.
They weren’t fools; they could hear the implication in Lie An’s words.
At this moment, a survivor named Zhu Yu asked, "Brother Lie An, do you mean that the thorny shield wall can increase the defense value of these attack facilities?"
"If used well, it certainly can," Lie An replied confidently.
"Furthermore, its function is not limited to that. Shield wall, shield wall, aside from attack buildings, don’t you have other buildings in your territory?"
After Lie An finished speaking, everyone fell into silence.
They already understood the value of this blueprint.
It’s important to know that each attack-type building requires a large amount of materials to construct.
Even though they are powerful, their defense value is extremely low, and if they are destroyed by accident, it would be a huge loss.
If at this time, a thorny shield wall is built nearby, it would increase the defense of these attack devices several times over!
At this point, Zhu Yu, the survivor, spoke directly: "Brother Lie An, there’s no need for an auction process; just name your price, and I’ll buy it directly!"
"I am the leader of the second-largest group in District 145, Hearts Like Arrows, and I hope everyone can give me face."
Zhu Yu, as the leader of ’Hearts Like Arrows’, has several thousand members under his command and is quite influential.
As soon as he spoke, he made clear his determination to acquire this blueprint.
Lie An did not reply.
At this moment, another survivor named Tinghai said: "Leader Zhu Yu, we at Tingfeng Pavilion also want this blueprint."
"That’s right, we at Mortal World also want this blueprint!"
"And us..."
In an instant, many high-ranking members of major teams emerged.
Seeing so many people competing, Zhu Yu knew that relying on the reputation of Hearts Like Arrows wouldn’t suppress so many people.
With a cold snort, Zhu Yu said, "Then let’s compete fairly, may the highest bid win!"
Only then did everyone satisfiedly close their mouths.
Seeing this, Lie An also smiled and presented his auction terms.
"Now that you have all reached an agreement, let’s begin the auction."
"The starting bid for this blueprint is... 400,000 Spirit Cores!"
This price was enough to deter the vast majority of survivors.
For ordinary players, it was impossible to suddenly come up with so many Spirit Cores, or materials of equivalent value.
But compared to the value of this blueprint, it was considered very cheap.
Bear in mind, the previous two blueprints were each auctioned off at a high price of 800,000, nearly equivalent to a piece of golden equipment with decent attributes.
Yet everyone knew that 400,000 Spirit Cores would not secure this blueprint.
In no time, people began making offers.
The bidders were those with some background.
The price of the blueprint quickly rose from 400,000 to 500,000.
This number already filtered out the leaders of many small groups.
Currently, in the market, even a basic level 10 piece of golden equipment is roughly this price.
Of course, golden equipment with slightly better attributes would see a significant price increase.
At this point, there were less than a hundred bidders left.
Zhu Yu promptly stated, "600,000 Spirit Cores."
He raised the bid by 100,000 Spirit Cores, significantly reducing the number of interested bidders.
At this stage, the bidders were leaders of major teams, and the price quickly reached 850,000, exceeding the price of the previous blueprints.
This was also beyond the limit that many could bear.
Initially, everyone estimated the price to be within 800,000 Spirit Cores, because, after all, this is just an auxiliary-type building blueprint.
Going higher was not cost-effective.
At this moment, Zhu Yu gritted his teeth and offered, "860,000!"
This price left everyone present in silence.
After waiting for a moment, nobody else made a bid.
Zhu Yu’s face was ashen, and although this price pained him, he believed that no one present could offer a higher bid!
Zhu Yu seemed to have a winning expression!
Just then, Lie An suddenly added, "If you don’t have enough Spirit Cores, you can exchange equipment with me, with priority given to equipment and weapons used by warriors."
Nearby, Han Xing, who was prepared to make a last-minute bid, suddenly had a glint in his eyes.
While dealing with Knight Kaelon, a golden weapon, called the Dawn Sword, had dropped from him.
He planned to exchange it for a weapon he could use.
However, the market was mostly circulating low-level golden equipment, which couldn’t compare in value to this Dawn Sword.

chapters.title: Chapter 160 - 135: Divine Aurora
paragraphs: The golden armor circulating in the market can’t compare to the Dawn Sword in value.
But now, exchanging it for a defense blueprint doesn’t seem too bad either?
Thinking of this, Han Xing directly sent a private message to Lie An.
Star River: "A level 20 golden greatsword for your Thorny Shield Wall blueprint, how about it?"
When the Survivor named Lie An saw Han Xing’s name, his eyelid twitched slightly.
The one privately chatting him was none other than the most popular figure in District 2, the same person who just claimed the top position last night!
The legendary figure, Star River!
He quickly opened the private chat window and replied, "Star God, do you have a golden weapon?"
"Yes."
After saying this, Han Xing posted the attributes of the Dawn Sword.
Upon seeing the legendary quality Dawn Sword and its formidable attributes, Lie An’s pupils contracted.
To the extent that even his breathing became somewhat rapid.
Under normal circumstances, Lie An might pretend to be hesitant to make the other party raise the price.
But now, he was dealing with the number one person in District 2.
There’s no need for tricks when interacting with such a figure.
Moreover, in this deal, to be honest, he wasn’t even losing out and might even profit!
A level 20 piece of golden armor with legendary quality is worth at least over a million Spirit Cores!
With this thought, Lie An swiftly replied, "Alright, Star God, I’ll withdraw the auction now."
After saying that, Lie An went to the transaction channel and announced.
"Everyone, sorry, this blueprint has been claimed, I’m withdrawing the auction."
At this moment, Zhu Yu, who thought victory was in grasp, suddenly changed his expression.
"Someone has already claimed it? Who?" Zhu Yu was puzzled.
Lie An’s urgent withdrawal indicated that someone had presented something tempting enough. Linking back to his words, Zhu Yu seemed to understand.
"Damn... Someone really offered golden equipment for trade..." Zhu Yu’s face turned very unpleasant.
After withdrawing the auction information, Lie An immediately initiated a trade with Han Xing.
On the transaction screen, the other party first put up the blueprint. After confirming the item information was correct, Han Xing also placed the Dawn Sword.
Both parties clicked confirm.
[Trade successful, you received Thorny Shield Wall Blueprint*1, you lost Dawn Sword (Gold)*1.]
Looking at the newly acquired blueprint in his inventory, Han Xing smiled satisfactorily and clicked to learn it.
Meanwhile, Lie An was thrilled holding the white-glowing greatsword.

His current level is 18. The thought of being able to equip such a powerful weapon in two levels filled Lie An with motivation to level up, even wanting to rush out now for a three-hundred-round fight with Sky Island Monsters!
But remembering he has another blueprint to auction, Lie An temporarily suppressed his excitement.
The transaction completed, both parties were very satisfied.
Han Xing also looked at the crafting information for the Thorny Shield Wall, a slight smile on his lips.
[Thorny Shield Wall Construction Materials]: Consumes Refined Iron*2000, Mithril*10, Rare Earth*5000, Vibrating Gold Stone*500, can construct a 1m*1m Thorny Shield Wall in a specified area.
"The materials consumed aren’t much, the cost-performance ratio is indeed quite high." Han Xing nodded in satisfaction.
At this time, he noticed the last piece of information in the blueprint’s introduction.
(Note: Thorny Shield Wall can be freely pieced together according to Lord’s needs.)
"Freely pieced together? Meaning, it can be assembled like building blocks." Han Xing’s eyes lit up.
This remark can be said to directly elevate the blueprint’s versatility to another level.
For instance, the Siege Crossbow Arrow Launcher’s attack outlet is at the front.
Now, he could entirely construct a few Thorny Shield Walls to surround the Siege Crossbow Arrow Launcher, leaving only the arrow launch outlet!
In this way, it adds the equivalent of 500 Defense Value to the Siege Crossbow Arrow Launcher!
And this is just one of the Thorny Shield Wall’s uses.
Apart from the Siege Crossbow Arrow Launcher, the Thunderbolt Tower, including the Catapult, can all similarly gain extra defense!
Just as Han Xing was excited, preparing to build a circle of Thorny Shield Walls for those dozen Thunderbolt Towers.
He suddenly saw in the transaction channel that Lie An had brought out another blueprint for auction.
He said in the transaction channel, "Everyone, this is the last blueprint I’m selling today."
"To be honest, I don’t know what this blueprint does, but it’s still a territorial building, so I’ll start with a price of 100,000 Spirit Cores."
Lie An posted the attributes of this blueprint.
[Aurora Aggregator]: Can construct a machine within the territory to collect Divine Aurora, collecting one beam every 5 minutes in good weather, with efficiency halved during rainy days.
Seeing the blueprint’s information, the onlookers were somewhat baffled.
"Divine Aurora? What’s its purpose?"
"I don’t know? Could it be for making lights?"
At this moment, another Survivor said, "Doesn’t this thing remind you of a certain plant in some game?"
With this reminder, everyone seemed to recall something from their memories.
For a moment, many of them smiled knowingly.
Just as Lie An said, although the function of this item is unknown, it’s still a building blueprint after all.
Thus, the leaders of several large teams started bidding one after another.
However, their increments were very low.
Adding only one or two thousand Spirit Cores each time.
After all, the purpose of this thing was unclear; if bought and found useless, it would be a sunk cost.
A loss of hundreds of thousands of Spirit Cores is difficult for even these big teams to bear.
But while others were unaware of its use, Han Xing knew very well.
Since Lie An posted the information about this blueprint, Han Xing had been watching the transaction channel intently!
Because, for his Blood Curse Resistance Formula, the last material missing was the Divine Aurora.
Previously, Han Xing always thought that Divine Aurora, like other materials, could only be found on those peculiar Sky Islands.
But now he knew that it wasn’t something to be dropped but rather collected through the construction of an ’Aurora Aggregator’.
No wonder he couldn’t find any information about it on the transaction channel for so long.
Without today’s auction, he might not find any clues about Divine Aurora even after a long time.
"I must secure this blueprint!" Han Xing resolved in his heart.
However, he did not bid immediately and instead waited and observed quietly.
After three to four minutes of bidding, the highest bid now came from another Survivor named Saber-toothed Tiger, who had offered 134,000 Spirit Cores.
At this price, few people were willing to continue bidding.
Lie An also prepared to conclude the deal.
Just as he was about to declare the sale.
A private message sounded again.
Han Xing directly said, "150,000 Spirit Cores, how about giving me this blueprint?"
Seeing the private message, Lie An was once again surprised.
But he quickly asked, "Star God, what do you want this blueprint for?"
Han Xing didn’t tell him directly but casually replied, "Nothing, I just find this thing quite interesting. Even if it’s useless, it can at least serve as decoration in the territory."
Lie An listened and couldn’t help but believe him, "In that case, if you had mentioned so, Star God, I could have gifted it to you for free."
Offering to give a blueprint worth hundreds of thousands of Spirit Cores for free to Han Xing showed quite the decisiveness.
However, Han Xing wasn’t short of Spirit Cores and chuckled lightly, "No need to gift it; let’s just transact normally."
Lie An thought for a moment and nodded.
By now, everyone knows that the wealthiest person in the entire region is Star River,
Perhaps to him, hundreds of thousands of Spirit Cores are truly insignificant.
Lie An replied, "Alright, Star God, please wait a moment. I’ll go cancel the auction in the transaction channel now."
"That’s fine, no problem."
Lie An took a deep breath as he entered the transaction channel,
"Apologies, everyone, this blueprint has already been reserved by someone, so this auction is canceled."
The crowd was immediately taken aback.
Twice, someone privately messaged Lie An, intercepting the auction.
This style suggested that one person might be behind it.
For a moment, everyone started speculating about who this mysterious figure might be.
After canceling the auction in the transaction channel,
Lie An immediately sent a trade request to Han Xing, and after both parties placed their items, they confirmed the trade.
It wasn’t until the blueprint was in hand that Han Xing finally let out a sigh of relief.
Finally, he found the source for the Divine Aurora material...
Now, he had all the materials needed to make the Blood Curse Antidote!
Han Xing was thrilled and was about to learn the blueprint right away,
When Lie An sent a message.
"Star God, may I add you as a friend? I’ll contact you first if I get new blueprints in the future."
Han Xing was momentarily stunned upon hearing the friend request.
But when Lie An mentioned that he could get more blueprints, it was Han Xing’s turn to be a bit surprised.
"Oh? You mean you can obtain more territory construction blueprints?"
Lie An smiled, "Just a little trick of mine."
However, Han Xing solemnly said, "It’s not a little trick; being able to get so many blueprints at this stage, whether it’s luck or other means, proves your ability."
Lie An said, "You’re flattering me, Star God."
Han Xing did not mind and directly replied, "My name is Han Xing, just add me as a friend."
"Alright," Lie An replied with a hint of excitement.
At this point, a system prompt appeared.
Survivor ’Qi An’ has requested to add you as a friend. Do you accept?
Qi An was Lie An’s real name.
Han Xing clicked to accept.
The friends list had one more entry.

chapters.title: Chapter 161 - 136: Beyond Help
paragraphs: After exiting the trading channel, Han Xing couldn’t wait to learn the second blueprint.
[Construction Materials for Aurora Aggregator]: Light-Gathering Stone*1000, Refined Iron*5000, Mithril*50, Spirit Core*20000.
"Great! These are all common materials, and my warehouse has a very ample supply!" Han Xing exclaimed excitedly.
The materials needed to build the Aurora Aggregator were quite ordinary.
The relatively special material was the Light-Gathering Stone, which could collect light during the day and emit a pure white glow at night.
Previously, Han Xing would occasionally place a few around his territory to use as night lamps.
Unexpectedly, these stones could also be used as construction materials.
"According to the blueprint information, an Aurora Aggregator can collect a batch of Divine Aurora in 5 minutes during good weather, but it takes ten minutes in rainy weather."
"This efficiency is still too low for me."
"It seems I need to build a batch of Aurora Aggregators to improve this situation."
After saying that, Han Xing arrived at a hillside outside Xingyu City and selected the construction site for the Aurora Aggregator.
The Aurora Aggregator doesn’t occupy much space.
Its appearance is like a tilted water vat, with the opening facing the sky to collect the light.
Han Xing directly built over two hundred Aurora Aggregators in bulk, covering the vacant land on the hillside.
A system prompt appeared.
[Constructing Aurora Aggregator, estimated remaining time 3 hours and 42 minutes...]
The Aurora Aggregator is just an ordinary territory building, and its construction time is not long.
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing also constructed a row of Thorny Shield Walls around the Aurora Aggregators to enclose them for protection.
Having done all this.
Han Xing was about to apply a layer of film to his Thunderbolt Tower.
When suddenly, he heard the sound of a quarrel between a man and a woman from the edge of the territory.
After completing the Second Transformation, Han Xing’s hearing and vision were significantly enhanced.
Looking towards the direction of the quarrel, he found it was coming from Cheng Jianyong’s territory.
At this moment, beside Cheng Jianyong, there was a woman with dignified demeanor and rather delicate appearance.
This woman was Cheng Jianyong’s wife, Wen Xinling.
However, Wen Xinling seemed quite displeased at this moment, and her gaze towards Cheng Jianyong was filled with a bit of reproach.
Wen Xinling angrily said, "Cheng Jianyong! You know my parents are not in good health, they haven’t seen their son for a month, what’s wrong with saying they want to visit him?"
"Wen Hao is my brother, why did you say such cruel things?"
"Do you want to anger my parents to death?"
Cheng Jianyong sighed helplessly, "Lingling, it’s not that I’m saying cruel things, but it’s the truth."
"If Wen Hao were not dead, you could have added him as a friend and contacted him already."
"But you also saw it, the people with the same name you added were not your brother."
"But your father and mother don’t believe what I say and still insist on looking for him!"
"It’s so dangerous outside now, going out would be courting death. I can only tell them that Wen Hao is likely already dead."

Upon hearing this, Wen Xinling was so angry that she stomped her foot on the spot, anxious, "You’re talking nonsense, Little Hao is the most promising man in the Wen Family, he just got admitted to a prestigious university and has a bright future!"
"Even someone like you... even you’re not dead, how could Little Hao be dead?"
Upon hearing the latter part, Cheng Jianyong gave a deep look at the woman in front of him.
Cheng Jianyong knew what she was implying.
In Wen Xinling’s eyes, he was always a cowardly man, an incompetent husband.

Since getting married, Cheng Jianyong had taken care of four elderly people by himself, shouldered the pressure of two families, and indeed did not have much ability to provide her with better living conditions.
His parents, to avoid adding pressure to him, moved back to live in the countryside.
But even so, Wen Xinling was never satisfied with him.
She always reminisced about how she ended up choosing such a useless man in university.
Cheng Jianyong endured many times to take care of this family.
Now, Cheng Jianyong sighed again and said, "Lingling, you don’t understand, this world is far more dangerous than you imagine."
"The only reason I’m still alive is that I help and am helped by Brother Xing and others."
"For ordinary people, the mortality rate in this world is still too high."
Cheng Jianyong wasn’t wrong. Almost a tenth of the first humans to arrive had died.
With such a high mortality rate, almost all survivors were elites with rich survival experience.
However, Wen Xinling couldn’t listen to him at all.
She angrily said, "Shut up! You just don’t want to take me to find Wen Hao!"
As the two quarreled, a middle-aged couple emerged from the Lord’s Cottage behind Cheng Jianyong.
They looked to be around fifty years old.
The man appeared frail, while the woman beside him had a high nose and vibrant red lipstick; even after crossing into a new world, she didn’t forget to maintain her makeup.
This couple was Wen Xinling’s parents, namely Cheng Jianyong’s father-in-law and mother-in-law.
Cheng Jianyong’s father-in-law seemed unwell, coughing persistently.
Meanwhile, the woman with heavy makeup lightly patted his back, occasionally casting disdainful glances at Cheng Jianyong.
At this moment, she said in a sarcastic tone, "Lingling, do you understand now what your mother was telling you? You can never depend on others."

chapters.title: Chapter 162 - 136: Beyond Help
paragraphs: "Especially other people’s husbands!"
She deliberately emphasized the last few words.
Beside her, Wen Xinling’s father also coughed and said, "Your mom’s right."
"He talks sweetly, claiming he treats us like his own parents, but when it comes time to really help, he starts making all sorts of excuses."
"I think he just can’t stand to see the Wen family doing well!"
Wen Xinling, hearing this, also looked at Cheng Jianyong with a face full of disappointment.
Faced with their mockery, Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but clench his fists.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong’s mother-in-law continued sarcastically, "Lingling, since he’s not willing to take us to find Wen Hao, we’ll just go ourselves."
"Your dad and mom may be old, but they can still walk a few steps."
Wen Xinling, hearing this, quickly agreed, "Okay mom, let’s go find my brother ourselves!"
With that, she bypassed Cheng Jianyong, took the hands of the two middle-aged adults, and started to run outside the territory.
At this moment, inside Cheng Jianyong’s Lord’s Cottage.
An elderly couple stood at the door, hesitant to speak, while a little girl of four, five, or six stood nearby, watching.
These were Cheng Jianyong’s biological parents, and the little girl was his daughter.
Cheng Jianyong was both angry and helpless.
In fact, with Cheng Jianyong’s current power, he could easily restrain Wen Xinling and her companions.
But after all, the woman was his wife, and the elderly couple were his in-laws, so he couldn’t use forceful means.
At this time, Wen Xinling and her parents quickly reached the edge of the territory, only to be stopped by a transparent protective shield.
Han Xing had set up a protective shield program, enveloping Cheng Jianyong’s territory as well, and without Han Xing’s permission, no one could enter or leave.
Wen Xinling had heard Cheng Jianyong mention this before, so she started shouting, demanding that Han Xing quickly open the defense shield.
"Han Xing! Han Xing! Let us out quickly!"
Wen Xinling’s shouting alarmed others within the territory as well.
Cheng Jianyong, listening, once against looked helplessly and said, "Lingling, don’t be childish."
"Listen to me, you’re not equipped to fight right now, and you’re taking your in-laws with you, you won’t survive in this world!"
However, Wen Xinling didn’t believe him at all and retorted, "I’ve already told you, Cheng Jianyong, if you don’t take my parents to find my brother, I’ll go myself!"
"Don’t think I don’t understand anything, Jiang Heng has told me, this world isn’t as scary as you make it out to be. Ordinary people can survive if they’re careful!"
Cheng Jianyong was taken aback upon hearing this.
Then, a strong anger lit up in his eyes, and he shouted, "Jiang Heng? You’re still in touch with that bastard?"
"Do you know he already has a wife and kids?"
Wen Xinling trembled at the shout, seemingly not expecting the usually obedient Cheng Jianyong to have such an outburst.
Feeling a bit wronged, she said, "You were just thinking about your own parents, without considering my side, so I... of course, I had to ask someone else!"
"Besides, Jiang Heng found me on his own, don’t be mistaken!"
Wen Xinling declared with righteousness.
However, Cheng Jianyong was boiling with anger after hearing this.
Earlier, he had settled Wen Shuling’s parents first, before attending to his own elderly parents.
Yet, in her narrative, it turned into him neglecting them entirely.
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t believe that, in this new world, he was still dealing with these trivial family matters.
He felt a pang of frustration and disappointment filled his heart.
Looking at this woman, his gaze carried a bit of disillusionment.

From Cheng Jianyong, Wen Xinling had learned that Han Xing was the owner of this territory, and only he had the authority to open the defense shield.

He glanced at Cheng Jianyong, as if asking for his decision.

"The outside world is genuinely dangerous, and now, nowhere in the world is safer than Brother Xing’s territory."
"Also, stop causing trouble for Brother Xing."

"Jiang Heng has already told me that ordinary people, as long as they don’t actively touch those clouds outside, won’t be in any danger. He even offered to help if needed."

She had no idea what Han Xing’s territory represented.
Nor did she understand the power of a thousand crossbow launchers and hundreds of flamethrower catapults.
With Jiang Heng’s facile boasting, Wen Xinling was easily misguided into a state of bewilderment.

Before Han Xing could speak.

He took the initiative and said, "Brother Xing, please open the shield."
Han Xing looked at Cheng Jianyong curiously, asking, "Are you sure?"
Everyone knew the implications of this decision.
It essentially meant sending Wen Xinling out to face the dangers of the world alone.
And based on this woman’s behavior, surviving past today seemed unlikely.
However, Cheng Jianyong had made up his mind.
He said again, "Brother Xing, open it."
Wen Xinling was visibly excited as she saw Cheng Jianyong agree: "Cheng Jianyong, you finally are showing some backbone."
Nearby, Wen Xinling’s parents discreetly gave her a thumbs-up.
Han Xing nodded.
He never sympathized with those determined on a fool’s errand.
Since Wen Xinling believed she had better options, Han Xing would oblige her.
Han Xing opened the defense shield.
Wen Xinling seemed to understand the rules of this world.
She voluntarily merged her three pieces of territory with her parents’, gaining more space.
The three boarded the Sky Island and without looking back, left Han Xing’s territory.
At this time, beside Cheng Jianyong, a well-mannered little girl tugged at his pants, softly asking, "Daddy, where’s Mommy going?"
Cheng Jianyong picked up the little girl and sighed, "Yuanyuan, from today, you have to learn to accept that your mommy might not come back."
The little girl looked at Cheng Jianyong, puzzled, but saw only sadness on his face.
After this farce.
Everyone returned to their own territories.
At this time, Wen Xinling stood on the Sky Island, contacting that person named Jiang Heng, and was overjoyed upon receiving his response.
She happily said, "Dad, mom, Jiang Heng agreed to take us to find my brother. He said we can go to him now!"
The two elders smiled with relief upon hearing this.

"Good, good, good! Jiang Heng’s a sensible kid, much better than Cheng Jianyong, sweet talker too, had his family not run into trouble back then, you wouldn’t have ended up with Cheng Jianyong as your husband."
"But it’s fortunate, you kept in touch with Jiang Heng over the years, and the kid remembered us."
Wen Xinling’s expression changed subtly, forcing a smile as she said, "Mom, what are you talking about, we only kept in occasional contact, never actually met up."
The two elder exchanged a knowing smile.
Just as Wen Xinling’s small three-square-meter Sky Island slowly sailed into the distance.
It was sunset.
The blood-red sunset reflected off the clouds, dyeing them a deep red.
And this phenomenon nearly covered the entire Land of the Abandoned Gods.
Survivors under this atmosphere felt as if a shadow hung over their hearts, with a sense of impending doom looming.
As the sun gradually set, the distant sky was suddenly shrouded in a shadow.
The shadow resembled a blood-colored curtain wrapping around the heavens and earth.
An ominous aura loomed.
And as time went on, more areas experienced the same phenomenon.
Many survivors instinctively lifted their heads to look at the sky.
The next moment, everyone’s pupils dilated, and their faces changed dramatically!

chapters.title: Chapter 163 - 137: Omen of Disaster
paragraphs: The blood-red clouds slowly covered the sky.
At this moment, on a Sky Island Territory, a dozen Survivors still had smiles on their faces.
They had just experienced the joy of reuniting with their families and held beautiful aspirations of starting anew in this world.
But right then, they suddenly noticed that it abruptly turned dark overhead.
As if something blocked the sun, a massive shadow was swiftly approaching.
Among the Survivors, a human Stalker said in confusion, "Strange, why did it get dark so early today?"
Beside him, a human Berserker also looked up at the sky in bewilderment, and his pupils suddenly contracted violently!
He pointed overhead in horror, his voice trembling as he said, "There’s something in the sky!!"
The crowd heard the immense fear in his voice and instinctively looked up.
The next moment, everyone’s pupils dilated instantly.
What blocked the sun was not clouds at all.
Instead, it was a swarm of blood-red, grotesquely twisted monsters.
The appearance of those monsters was terrifying, with not a single hair on their bodies, and their limbs were incomparably twisted!
Some had wings on their backs, others had a dozen arms and legs, while some were covered with tumors, with blood continuously oozing from their skin!
Their numbers were endless, literally covering the sky!
At this moment, the monsters above seemed to have noticed the Sky Island below.
The next moment, thousands of monsters suddenly swooped down.
Like a released valve, the blood-red tide instantly covered the Sky Island.
When the tide receded, the place was left totally empty, not even a fragment of the Sky Island could be seen.
This group of Survivors, on their territory, numbering in the dozens, vanished without even letting out a scream...
At the same time, in every corner of the world, an altar spurting blood erupted, and monsters surged out like a tide.
Countless monsters formed a blood-red torrent, sweeping towards the depths of the Land of the Abandoned Gods!
On this day, a large number of Survivors in the Land of the Abandoned Gods encountered these monsters.
In the chat channel, sporadic cries for help had already emerged.
And as time passed, more and more people were calling for help and warning others.
They claimed to be under attack by a large number of monsters!
Initially, people just thought this was a normal phenomenon and didn’t take it seriously.
After all, before this, monsters invading players’ Sky Islands had happened before.
However.
As more and more people sent out requests for help, everyone began to feel that something was wrong.
In the chat channel, a Survivor said in confusion.
"Wow, why are there so many people asking for help today? In just half an hour, I’ve seen hundreds of distress messages."
"Not sure? Could it be because there are a lot of newbies today?"
After this person spoke, everyone felt there was some sense in that.
After all, today, billions of Survivors arrived in this world, distributed across each big district, numbering in the hundreds of thousands.
And at that moment, another Survivor shouted in the announcement channel: "Help!!! Monsters, my god, so many monsters! Save me!"
Hearing the heart-wrenching screams, a Survivor named Broken Heart Ling quickly asked: "Upstairs, don’t howl, quickly tell us, what happened to you?"
The person immediately said: "I don’t know, there are so many monsters, so terrifying, they are covered in blood, and look very scary!"
"Oh my god! They’re coming! Help
The voice was abruptly cut off.
The Survivors watching in the chat channel were silent for a moment,
then the Survivor named Broken Heart Ling analyzed again: "Many monsters, covered in blood..."
"And people are being attacked everywhere."
"Do you remember, ten days ago, what the system announcement said about the upcoming burst of a blood-red catastrophe?"
With this reminder from Broken Heart Ling, everyone recalled something.
"Seems there was something said about it, and I remember the system also mentioned launching a new expansion pack called ’Blood Tide’, could it be related to this?"
In the chat channel, Survivors began to speculate.
"It’s possible, if it’s really the disaster the system mentioned, then it’s a huge deal!"
"The scale of the monsters seems huge, should we prepare and stockpile Life Secret Elixirs and other supplies?"
This statement alerted many people.
Many started contacting the members of their teams.
One passed to ten, ten to a hundred, and the news of the impending Blood Tide disaster quickly spread among the Survivors.
The leaders of the major teams received the news.
Except for a few blindly arrogant people, most leaders took the news very seriously.
They began to gather nearby members at once to unite.
At the same time, everyone started procuring supplies en masse in the trading channel.
For a moment, a panic buying spree started in the trading channel.
Especially those Secret Elixirs for recovering life or increasing attributes, were being grabbed like crazy!
At this time, within Han Xing’s territory.
The five gathered together once again.
Shen Yun said seriously, "Brother Xing, something seems off. Now the chat channel is full of people talking about encountering monsters, and there are a lot of them."
"That disaster, I’m afraid it’s really coming!"
More than half a month ago, Han Xing had mentioned this matter, advising everyone to pay close attention.
The last system update also proved this point.
This matter has always been like a sharp blade hanging over Han Xing’s head, giving him a constant sense of urgency.
Han Xing continuously gathered resources and built up territorial defenses to prepare for this possible disaster.
Now, the omens are becoming more intense.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang also raised an eyebrow.
At this moment, Han Xing nodded and said, "It’s coming soon."
"Right now, you all need to quickly bring your relatives to my City Lord’s Mansion."
"Next, everyone stays inside Xingyu City, ready for battle!"
Everyone nodded at this.
After all, Han Xing’s Xingyu City is the core location of the entire territory, and he has invested innumerable resources and effort around it.
One could say that in the entire Land of the Abandoned Gods, there are few places safer than Han Xing’s territory.
At this moment, Shen Yun reminded, "Brother Xing, I see on the trading channel, people are going crazy grabbing all kinds of potions. Should we stock some too?"
Han Xing glanced at his blueprint interface.
He shook his head and said, "No need for that. I’ve made a lot of Intermediate Life Secret Elixirs lately, just in case. There are still tens of thousands of bottles in reserve now."
"Plus, there are more than seventy Moonlight Holy Springs in the territory which can also be used to heal injuries, so it should be enough."
Shen Yun paused, once again feeling admiration for Han Xing’s foresight.
Han Xing stood up, took a deep breath, and said, "Next, it’s time to test our defensive capabilities."
At this point, Shen Yun suddenly said, "Cheng Jianyong, your wife is still outside, do you want to..."
Cheng Jianyong’s face suddenly changed, then he nodded and said, "I’ll try to contact her."
A moment later, Cheng Jianyong’s face turned even more grim.
He took a breath and said, "She has already rendezvoused with Jiang Heng."
Upon hearing this, everyone paused for a moment.
At this moment, Shen Yun said, "Is that Jiang Heng reliable? I’ve heard she said Jiang Heng has only about a hundred people under him, and the territory’s construction is probably not great."
"Can he hold out if they encounter monsters?"
Cheng Jianyong shook his head, sighed, and said, "Let her be..."
Just then, Han Xing, sitting in a chair, seemed to sense something, and a wave of crisis surged in his heart!
At the same time, Coal Ball also jumped out instantly.
Its limbs were tense, fangs exposed, as if it sensed some kind of terrifying presence.
"Brother Han Xing... what’s wrong with you?" Su Xiaoyang cautiously asked from the side.
Han Xing’s face looked serious, solemnly saying, "Everyone, move now. Transfer your relatives to the Lord’s Mansion, immediately!"
With that, Han Xing, with Coal Ball in tow, rushed out of the City Lord’s Mansion in an instant.
Hearing the gravity in Han Xing’s words, everyone unhesitatingly dropped what they were doing and hurried towards Xingyu City together.
But as soon as they were out of the City Lord’s Mansion, they saw that in the distant sky, there was a dark blood-red tide rolling like a tide surging in the sky!
The previously bright sky suddenly darkened at this moment.
"Oh my god..."
"Oh man..."
Everyone couldn’t help but gasp in awe, their tones tinged with fear.
Han Xing took a deep breath and said, "Hurry, get everyone moving, and transfer your relatives first!"
Finishing the words, Han Xing, with Coal Ball, charged up to the city wall alone and with the wolf.
At the same time, an overwhelming wave of blood-colored monsters rushed towards them!
Meanwhile.
Wen Xinling, who had been moving forward for over an hour, was finally getting close to the coordinate location Jiang Heng sent her.
She and her parents, the three of them walking cautiously, huddled together on a platform just three square meters in size, curling their bodies for fear of falling off.
Along the way, they were under enormous psychological pressure.
Finally, a massive Sky Island appeared ahead, with a rough estimation, at least a kilometer in diameter, over a million square meters.
This Sky Island seemed to have sacrificed thickness for area, continuously spreading out, having only a thin layer.
It now looked like a large platform.
At the moment, the central area of that large platform was densely packed with over a hundred tents, with a group of humans in peculiar attire active atop it.
Upon seeing this Sky Island at first glance, Wen Xinling could clearly feel that this Sky Island was not even in the same league as Han Xing’s Sky Island.
The comparison was like a medieval-style small town versus a primitive tribe.
There was a world of difference between the two!
Before Wen Xinling could think further.
A young man in a full set of purple light armor, with a smile on his face, walked over from the opposite Sky Island.
This person was Jiang Heng.

Shen Yun paused, once again feeling admiration for Han Xing’s foresight.
Han Xing stood up, took a deep breath, and said, "Next, it’s time to test our defensive capabilities."
At this point, Shen Yun suddenly said, "Cheng Jianyong, your wife is still outside, do you want to..."
Cheng Jianyong’s face suddenly changed, then he nodded and said, "I’ll try to contact her."
A moment later, Cheng Jianyong’s face turned even more grim.
He took a breath and said, "She has already rendezvoused with Jiang Heng."
Upon hearing this, everyone paused for a moment.
At this moment, Shen Yun said, "Is that Jiang Heng reliable?
I’ve heard she said Jiang Heng has only about a hundred people under him, and the territory’s construction is probably not great."
"Can he hold out if they encounter monsters?"
Cheng Jianyong shook his head, sighed, and said, "Let her be..."
Just then, Han Xing, sitting in a chair, seemed to sense something, and a wave of crisis surged in his heart!
At the same time, Coal Ball also jumped out instantly.
Its limbs were tense, fangs exposed, as if it sensed some kind of terrifying presence.
"Brother Han Xing... what’s wrong with you?" Su Xiaoyang cautiously asked from the side.
Han Xing’s face looked serious, solemnly saying, "Everyone, move now.
Transfer your relatives to the Lord’s Mansion, immediately!"
With that, Han Xing, with Coal Ball in tow, rushed out of the City Lord’s Mansion in an instant.
Hearing the gravity in Han Xing’s words, everyone unhesitatingly dropped what they were doing and hurried towards Xingyu City together.
But as soon as they were out of the City Lord’s Mansion, they saw that in the distant sky, there was a dark blood-red tide rolling like a tide surging in the sky!
The previously bright sky suddenly darkened at this moment.
"Oh my god..."
"Oh man..."
Everyone couldn’t help but gasp in awe, their tones tinged with fear.
Han Xing took a deep breath and said, "Hurry, get everyone moving, and transfer your relatives first!"
Finishing the words, Han Xing, with Coal Ball, charged up to the city wall alone and with the wolf.
At the same time, an overwhelming wave of blood-colored monsters rushed towards them!
Meanwhile.
Wen Xinling, who had been moving forward for over an hour, was finally getting close to the coordinate location Jiang Heng sent her.
She and her parents, the three of them walking cautiously, huddled together on a platform just three square meters in size, curling their bodies for fear of falling off.
Along the way, they were under enormous psychological pressure.
Finally, a massive Sky Island appeared ahead, with a rough estimation, at least a kilometer in diameter, over a million square meters.
This Sky Island seemed to have sacrificed thickness for area, continuously spreading out, having only a thin layer.
It now looked like a large platform.
At the moment, the central area of that large platform was densely packed with over a hundred tents, with a group of humans in peculiar attire active atop it.
Upon seeing this Sky Island at first glance, Wen Xinling could clearly feel that this Sky Island was not even in the same league as Han Xing’s Sky Island.
The comparison was like a medieval-style small town versus a primitive tribe.
There was a world of difference between the two!
Before Wen Xinling could think further.
A young man in a full set of purple light armor, with a smile on his face, walked over from the opposite Sky Island.
This person was Jiang Heng.

chapters.title: Chapter 164 - 138: Wen Xinling’s Regret
paragraphs: Jiang Heng’s eyes lit up when he saw Wen Xinling.
The goddess of his first love, after several years, still just as beautiful.

Jiang Heng couldn’t help but praise, "Lingling, you’re really amazing, managing to bring auntie and the others here so quickly. I thought you might get lost for a while after arriving in this world, and I was ready to send someone to pick you up."
Wen Xinling forced a smile, "Well, it’s all thanks to Brother Heng’s guidance. I didn’t touch any of the clouds along the way, which is how I got here so quickly."
Jiang Heng laughed heartily, not modest at all.
"That’s for sure, no matter which world I’m in, your Brother Heng can always thrive."
"Look at the size of my territory, isn’t the construction superb?"
Jiang Heng proudly introduced to Wen Xinling.
"There are over a hundred ’Jiangmen’ team members up here, and I’m their leader."
"We fight together regularly, and all the Sky Island fragments we collect are merged together, expanding the territory at a speed a hundred times faster than other survivors!"
"Moreover, with their relatives arriving today, our territory’s population has exceeded a thousand people."
"The more people, the faster the development."
"Next, our territory size will soar again!"
Jiang Heng’s tone was full of pride.
After all, compared to Wen Xinling and others, who had just arrived in this world as newcomers, each standing on only one square of territory.
Jiang Heng’s territory of a full one hundred thousand squares was enough to stun them for a long time.
However, Wen Xinling only showed a forced smile.
What Jiang Heng didn’t know was that Wen Xinling had arrived on Han Xing’s territory right after her descent.
Seeing the degree of construction on his Sky Island, Wen Xinling subconsciously believed that everyone’s Sky Island was like that, and building an island of the same scale was easy.
It was only now she realized that everyone’s Sky Island territory had been pieced together from a small block.
How did Han Xing build such a massive island?
At this moment, she seemed to have a vague understanding of Han Xing’s power.
And she also realized that Jiang Heng’s previously bragged large territory was just this simple appearance.
A shade of disappointment inevitably flashed in Wen Xinling’s eyes.
With over a thousand people crowded on a big platform, forget about personal privacy spaces; even using the toilet would be a problem...
Even Wen Xinling’s parents beside her didn’t look too pleased.
Yet, Jiang Heng was still talking nonstop, "Lingling, you must be tired. Your Brother Heng has already prepared for you. Look at that house; from now on, that’s your residence!"
The three of them followed Jiang Heng’s pointing direction and immediately their faces changed.
What residence—that was just a simple tent made of fabric and wooden poles, less than ten square meters.
They had just come from modern society; how could they adapt to this kind of life?
Seeing Wen Xinling not speaking, Jiang Heng thought she was stunned by the accommodations he provided.
Feeling proud, he couldn’t help but feel his heart race.
Wen Xinling, as his first love goddess, had dated him for over a year.
But later, Jiang Heng had to give up pursuing Wen Xinling because he was overwhelmed by debt and couldn’t afford the betrothal gift her parents demanded.
Years had passed, and Wen Xinling, although now married and a mother...
In Jiang Heng’s eyes, she was still charming and alluring, even more so.
Jiang Heng seemed unable to hold back anymore, directly reaching out to grab Wen Xinling’s hand, and said, "Come on, Lingling, let me show you around."
However, as soon as Wen Xinling’s hand touched his, it was as if she had received an electric shock. She immediately withdrew and kept her distance!
Wen Xinling, with a slightly displeased tone, said, "Brother Heng, please mind yourself."
Jiang Heng’s expression changed, and a trace of anger appeared between his brows.
As the leader of ’Jiangmen,’ Jiang Heng was truly a command obeyed by all in his territory.
Usually, which woman didn’t scramble to throw herself at him?
Jiang Heng knew that Wen Xinling had just arrived in this world and hadn’t reacted yet.
In other words, she hadn’t understood her status.
Jiang Heng’s face showed some anger, but he suppressed it and said, "Fine, then you take uncle and auntie to the camp yourself."
Wen Xinling heard the displeasure in Jiang Heng’s tone, but thinking of her purpose for being here...
She still mustered the courage to ask, "Brother Heng, didn’t you say you’d take us to find my brother?"
"When are we starting?"
By now, Jiang Heng’s attitude had taken a sharp turn.
He impatiently said, "I know, I know, wait a few days. Let the brothers settle their families, and then I’ll take you to find Wen Hao."
After Jiang Heng finished speaking.
Wen Xinling and her parents exchanged glances.
Being told to wait for a few days meant living squeezed with a thousand people on this big platform for so long?
A bad feeling suddenly emerged in Wen Xinling’s heart. She pressed, "Brother... Brother Heng, didn’t you previously say that you could immediately take us to find Wen Hao?"

Beside her, Wen Xinling’s mother also chimed in, "That’s right, little Heng, we haven’t seen Wen Hao for a month now. We’ve been worried sick and can’t sleep each night; back then, Wen Hao had a good relationship with you. You see..."
Jiang Heng responded impatiently, "I told you, a few days later, I’ll go with you. Can’t you see I have over a thousand people to look after?"
Wen Xinling’s mother hesitated, "Little Heng, even if we can’t go these few days, can we have a better place to stay?"
"Lingling’s father’s health isn’t good. He can’t adapt to being crowded with so many people..."
Jiang Heng was thoroughly impatient now, his tone tinged with a sneer.
"I say, auntie, have you figured out your position yet?"
"This isn’t a hotel. Are you not comfortable living here? Really think this is Blue Star?"
"Let me tell you, right now, who knows how many people don’t even have a place to shield them from the wind and rain. I’m leaving you a tent just because of Lingling!"
"If you can’t handle it, then roll back to your little cubicle and stay there!"
Jiang Heng’s voice was somewhat loud, and the other Survivors heard their conversation.
In an instant, hundreds of mocking eyes were cast towards Wen Xinling and the two others.
At this moment, the three of them were almost pale and felt utterly ashamed!
Seeing Wen Xinling’s awkward state, Jiang Heng let out a cold laugh.
He roughly pulled Wen Xinling over. As a level 15 Berserker, Jiang Heng’s Power was dozens of times that of Wen Xinling’s.
With her wrist clamped, Wen Xinling had no chance to break free.
"Let... let go of me..."
Wen Xinling said with difficulty.
However, Jiang Heng sneered relentlessly, "Stupid woman, I’ve already told you, know your place!"
"This is not Blue Star, now I am the boss here, whatever I say goes, understand?"
Wen Xinling looked at the aura bursting from Jiang Heng, as if facing a ferocious beast, and was terrified into silence.
The two elderly ones at the side had not yet spoken.
With just a glare from Jiang Heng, the two elders turned pale with fright.
Especially Wen Xinling’s father, who couldn’t catch his breath and fainted on the spot.
Mrs. Wen screamed in fright, "Oh dear, don’t scare me, old man!"
Mrs. Wen was stunned with fear, yet Jiang Heng remained entirely unmoved.
Wen Xinling, eyes brimming with tears, pleaded in a trembling voice, "Brother Heng... my dad isn’t in good health, please, let me go to him..."
However, Jiang Heng turned his head and, with a wicked smile, said to her, "Go to him? Sure."
"Now, do you understand what I mean?
Wen Xinling was so frightened by his gaze she turned pale and shook her head repeatedly.
"Don’t understand?" Jiang Heng glared at her fiercely.
"If it weren’t for your looks, do you think I would have allowed you to come to my territory and arranged accommodation for you?"
"You should know what I want."
"Wen Xinling, you don’t want anything to happen to your uncle and aunt, do you?"
Jiang Heng’s eyes were full of blatant desire.
Wen Xinling’s eyes were filled with humiliation and regret.
Jiang Heng was using her parents to coerce her.
At this moment, she finally understood what Cheng Jianyong had said to her.
The outside world is dangerous, not just because of those monsters, but also because of other Survivors...
She naively thought that Jiang Heng was helping her for old times’ sake.
Wen Xinling felt a strong sense of regret growing in her heart...
Jiang Heng sneered incessantly, as if thoroughly enjoying the woman’s performance in front of him.
In his eyes, Wen Xinling was already a ready-to-be-pleasured young woman.
Jiang Heng was still immersed in his fantasies.
But suddenly, he noticed a large shadow overhead.
When Jiang Heng looked up and saw the scene in the sky, his pupils suddenly contracted intensely.
"What... what’s happening?"
Jiang Heng incredulously wiped his eyes.
Seeing the all-encompassing tide of blood red surging forth.
Jiang Heng also realized something, his voice trembling as he shouted, "Alert! Alert!!"
On the territory, hundreds of people were startled by Jiang Heng’s shout.
When they snapped back to reality and looked towards the sky, they were instantly shocked by the terrifying scene!
The sky was filled with blood-red, twisted-limb monsters flaunting their claws.
Their numbers were endless, completely covering the sky!
Jiang Heng’s eyes widened as he shouted, "Activate the Spiritual Shield, launch the Catapult!"
"Everyone, enter battle state!"
In an instant, everyone snapped out of their shock.
In the territory of over a thousand people, there were only slightly more than one hundred Professionals above level 10, plus two newly built Catapults.
But the number of monsters far exceeded everyone’s imagination.
Just a glance was enough to make one’s scalp tingle.
Thousands? Or tens of thousands?
It was utterly uncountable!
Now, even the sky was obscured by this horde of twisted monsters, showing how colossal this number truly was.
Simultaneously, the monsters also noticed the crowd below.
The tide of blood red rushed down upon them.
In panic, Jiang Heng could only hurry to operate the Catapults, firing at the monsters in the sky.
Just then, a system notification appeared in everyone’s ears!
