chapters.title: Chapter 165 - 139: Blood Tide Descends!
paragraphs: "Survivors, please pay attention! Survivors, please pay attention!"
"The long-brewing blood-red catastrophe has completely erupted!"
"The Blood Tide will bring endless mutated creatures, which will spread the Blood Curse throughout the Land of the Abandoned Gods!"
"Please make sure the survivors do not get injured by the attacks of these mutated creatures, otherwise, even if you survive, you will turn into the same kind of monster!"
"In response to this disaster, the game content will be adjusted further."
"Adjustment 1: All regional restrictions are lifted, and all humans on Blue Star will be merged into the same region."
"Adjustment 2: During the Blood Tide, all attributes of survivors will increase by 20%."
"Adjustment 3: The gatherings of survivors will no longer attract the attention of monsters from other Sky Islands."
"The Battle Merit Points leaderboard and exchange store will open later."
"New expansion: ’Blood Tide’ is now officially online. Survivors from Blue Star, please pick up your weapons and do everything you can to survive this disaster..."
The sudden system notification echoed in the ears of all survivors.
At the same time.
Nearly 6 billion remaining members of the Human Race on Blue Star were merged into the same region.
Many survivors simultaneously looked up, witnessing the shocking scene of the sky being obscured by monsters.
These monsters, seeing the Sky Islands floating below them, pounced like starving ghosts, eager for sustenance.
At this moment, tens of thousands of Sky Islands faced the assault of these monsters simultaneously.
On a Sky Island where dozens of humans were gathered.
Among them were more than a dozen First Transformation Professionals, who, after hearing the system notification, were still in a daze.
Before they could react, countless mutated armies had already lunged down from the sky.
Crash...
Monsters flapped their wings, like a basin of blood pouring down on them.
This Sky Island was instantly surrounded by monsters.
In the chaos, someone reminded, "Quick! Slay these monsters.
With the reminder, the other Professionals quickly picked up weapons, starting their last stand.
Various skills were unleashed, cutting the mutated bodies apart, dismembered limbs flying everywhere.
The scene turned incredibly gory, even causing physical discomfort to some.
However, in the face of these monsters, none below level fifteen or sixteen.
The number they managed to kill seemed insignificantly small.
Meanwhile, the ordinary people in the territory were also attacked by monsters.
Their weak strength was utterly incapable of confronting this group of monsters.
They could only watch as their bodies were pierced by the mutated tentacles, the places touched by the wounds quickly turning blood red.
In the meantime, tentacles, fleshy wings, and various fleshy masses rapidly grew on them...
"Help... Help! I’ve grown a third hand, a fourth leg!"
"Me too, my skin is decaying, falling off piece by piece, and lots of fleshy lumps are growing on me..."
"Oh my god, are we going to turn into things just like those monsters!?"
The voices of these infected ordinary people were filled with immense fear!
Indeed, that was the truth.
All living beings infected by the Blood Curse would be assimilated into those terrifying creatures.
The time needed varied, depending on the survivor’s strength.
It could take just a few seconds, or for the stronger, several hours.
But for those ordinary people with no combat ability, terrible mutations in their bodies occurred shortly after being struck by monsters.
In just a few seconds, they transformed into the same kind of mutated monsters, attacking their relatives!
At this moment, among the remaining survivors, a chill rushed through their spines, a fear deeper than death surged within them!
At this time, a human Illusionist urgently said, "Quick, get all your relatives into the Lord’s Cottage! They are too weak now and can’t help at all!
Those survivors who had just arrived in this world had never seen such a sight.
Most of them were frightened to the point of losing their wits, only a handful reacting, quickly rushing into the Lord’s Cottage.
But unfortunately, their fate did not improve much.
As the Professionals were annihilated in an instant.
The Lord’s Cottage, with only five hundred Defense Value, was destroyed in the blink of an eye.
The monsters soon found all the humans hiding among the rubble, then captured them into the sky.
A middle-aged man witnessed himself being lifted into the air, one of the monster bird’s claws gripping his shoulder, his heart pounding with terror.
"Don’t grab me... Don’t grab me... Help!"
He screamed loudly, yet the monsters ignored his cries.
And worse horrors awaited.
Among the mutated creatures, another monster resembling a hyena with a tumor-covered back seemed to fancy the monster bird’s prey, coming over to snatch it.
It bit the middle-aged man’s right leg, while the monster bird held onto his shoulder, refusing to let go.
The two monsters tugged at the man’s body.
With a tearing sound, amid a hair-raising scream, the man’s body was ripped into two parts...
Bloody scenes unfolded continuously.
In less than a minute, more than seventy survivors on this Sky Island, spanning over ten thousand square meters, were completely wiped out.
Rumble...
The Sky Island crashed from the air, breaking into fragments.
Such hellish scenes kept occurring throughout the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
Screams echoed through the sky.
In less than a minute, countless humans perished at the hands of these monsters.

On a Sky Island where dozens of humans were gathered.
Among them were more than a dozen First Transformation Professionals, who, after hearing the system notification, were still in a daze.
Before they could react, countless mutated armies had already lunged down from the sky.
Crash...
Monsters flapped their wings, like a basin of blood pouring down on them.
This Sky Island was instantly surrounded by monsters.
In the chaos, someone reminded, "Quick!
Slay these monsters.
With the reminder, the other Professionals quickly picked up weapons, starting their last stand.
Various skills were unleashed, cutting the mutated bodies apart, dismembered limbs flying everywhere.
The scene turned incredibly gory, even causing physical discomfort to some.
However, in the face of these monsters, none below level fifteen or sixteen.
The number they managed to kill seemed insignificantly small.
Meanwhile, the ordinary people in the territory were also attacked by monsters.
Their weak strength was utterly incapable of confronting this group of monsters.
They could only watch as their bodies were pierced by the mutated tentacles, the places touched by the wounds quickly turning blood red.
In the meantime, tentacles, fleshy wings, and various fleshy masses rapidly grew on them...
"Help...
Help!
I’ve grown a third hand, a fourth leg!"
"Me too, my skin is decaying, falling off piece by piece, and lots of fleshy lumps are growing on me..."
"Oh my god, are we going to turn into things just like those monsters!?"
The voices of these infected ordinary people were filled with immense fear!
Indeed, that was the truth.
All living beings infected by the Blood Curse would be assimilated into those terrifying creatures.
The time needed varied, depending on the survivor’s strength.
It could take just a few seconds, or for the stronger, several hours.
But for those ordinary people with no combat ability, terrible mutations in their bodies occurred shortly after being struck by monsters.
In just a few seconds, they transformed into the same kind of mutated monsters, attacking their relatives!
At this moment, among the remaining survivors, a chill rushed through their spines, a fear deeper than death surged within them!
At this time, a human Illusionist urgently said, "Quick, get all your relatives into the Lord’s Cottage!
They are too weak now and can’t help at all!
Those survivors who had just arrived in this world had never seen such a sight.
Most of them were frightened to the point of losing their wits, only a handful reacting, quickly rushing into the Lord’s Cottage.
But unfortunately, their fate did not improve much.
As the Professionals were annihilated in an instant.
The Lord’s Cottage, with only five hundred Defense Value, was destroyed in the blink of an eye.
The monsters soon found all the humans hiding among the rubble, then captured them into the sky.
A middle-aged man witnessed himself being lifted into the air, one of the monster bird’s claws gripping his shoulder, his heart pounding with terror.
"Don’t grab me...
Don’t grab me...
Help!"
He screamed loudly, yet the monsters ignored his cries.
And worse horrors awaited.
Among the mutated creatures, another monster resembling a hyena with a tumor-covered back seemed to fancy the monster bird’s prey, coming over to snatch it.
It bit the middle-aged man’s right leg, while the monster bird held onto his shoulder, refusing to let go.
The two monsters tugged at the man’s body.
With a tearing sound, amid a hair-raising scream, the man’s body was ripped into two parts...
Bloody scenes unfolded continuously.
In less than a minute, more than seventy survivors on this Sky Island, spanning over ten thousand square meters, were completely wiped out.
Rumble...
The Sky Island crashed from the air, breaking into fragments.
Such hellish scenes kept occurring throughout the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
Screams echoed through the sky.
In less than a minute, countless humans perished at the hands of these monsters.

chapters.title: Chapter 166 - 139: Blood Tide Descends!
paragraphs: The chat channels completely exploded.
"Help... help me!"
"Monsters! There are so many monsters! They’re attacking my territory!"
"Oh god, can anyone come and save us?"
"Wuwu... please, don’t bite my face, don’t eat my hands...
"It hurts, it hurts so much..."
The wailing in the chat channels made all the survivors feel their scalp tingling.
Many survivors who hadn’t yet encountered those mutants also felt extremely fortunate at this moment.
At this time, a survivor with a golden ID named Zhou Huang shouted in the chat channel: "Everyone, if you don’t want to die, quickly move closer to the survivors near you!"
"The system already hinted that no matter how many people gather now, it won’t attract the attention of those powerful monsters."
"Most of these mutant monsters are at level fifteen or sixteen, some even over 20. We must gather more survivors to withstand the assault of these monsters!"
With this reminder, the survivors of Blue Star also realized this.
They began frantically posting requests for help in the chat channel and started sharing their locations.
However, the merged chat channel was just too chaotic.
Billions of people sharing screens, messages constantly flooding every moment.
It was then that the second system notification appeared.
"Attention all survivors, to enhance survival, regional chat channels have been activated."
"All survivors have been automatically assigned to chat channels in nearby regions."
"Please note, the number of Blood Tide monsters is extremely large, and more powerful ones will appear as time goes on."
"Please unite quickly and resist the invasion of Blood Tide monsters!"
"New expansion content, Combat Merit Points leaderboard, Combat Merit Points Exchange Store, will go online in an hour..."
This system update appeared just in time, automatically assigning all survivors to nearby regional chat channels.
They began to post their coordinates in there, searching for other survivors in the area.
In an instant, tens of billions of Sky Islands started to take action.
Meanwhile.
Han Xing’s Sky Island was also facing a monster assault.
Admittedly, they were rather unlucky to encounter these monsters at the first moment of the Blood Tide burst.
Seeing tens of thousands of monsters charging at them at once, even the strong-minded felt their scalp tingling.
Han Xing, looking serious, began to operate the attack buildings on his territory.
At this moment, the other team members, having settled their relatives, gathered around Han Xing.
The five stood atop the city wall, the best vantage point of the entire territory, able to oversee everything.
But just then, a dozen monsters covered in blood-red smoke broke away from the main force at extreme speeds, leading the charge toward Han Xing’s territory.
These mutants seemed to be adept at assassination.
Wrapped in the red smoke, their speed instantly skyrocketed.
In no time, they reached the border of the territory and began to assault Han Xing’s defense shield.
Bang! Bang!
The Intermediate Defense Shield’s 1200 defense value began to plummet rapidly.
At this rate, it wouldn’t last half a minute before shattering.
Cheng Jianyong, seeing this, hurriedly lifted his Great Sword, ready to charge and slay the monsters.
Han Xing, noticing his movement, quickly said: "No need to go!"
"Leave it to the Siege Crossbow Arrows!"
Cheng Jianyong instantly halted in his tracks.
The next moment.
Han Xing began operating all the attack buildings on the territory, issuing attack commands.
The sky was filled with mutant monsters, charging toward Han Xing’s territory.
Even before the monsters reached.
The first volley of Siege Crossbow Arrows had already finished charging.
Han Xing’s eyes turned cold, he whispered: "Let’s see if all these days of preparation can handle these monsters!"
The next moment.
Thousands of giant arrows shot out.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
The dense sound of breaking through the air resounded.
The monsters at the forefront, those who reached the edge of Han Xing’s territory, were the first.
Huge arrows pierced through the shield without hindrance, then plunged into their bodies.
Puff, puff, puff!
The sounds of flesh being penetrated echoed.
These monsters covered in red blood mist suddenly had several large blood holes.
Not even making a sound, they died on the spot.
Meanwhile, more arrows flew into the air, targeting the densest area of the monster horde.
Thousands of giant arrows, with unstoppable force, charged into the monster army!
One by one, the monsters were skewered into strings of meat in the air!
Bang! Bang!
The myriad monster corpses fell like raindrops.
The vast and mighty monster army had several huge breaks in its formation suddenly torn open.
This wave alone saw at least thousands of monsters slain by the giant arrows!
The Siege Crossbow Arrow volley showed remarkable effect!
"So strong!"
Those watching couldn’t help but exclaim in delight.
Shen Yun too clenched his fists on the side, exclaiming: "What terrifying killing power!"
Han Xing was equally satisfied with the performance of the Siege Crossbow Arrows.
With a smile, he said: "Great, this is just the first wave of attacks!"
"Next up, let them taste something even spicier!"
Upon hearing this, everyone’s faces showed anticipative expressions.
With those words.
The Flamethrower Catapults finished charging, hundreds of catapults simultaneously raised their arms, flinging hundreds of burning giant projectiles into the sky.
Boom! Boom!
Hundreds of projectiles descended with destructive power, like meteorites.
The projectiles hit the monster horde, producing thunderous explosions.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Massive shockwaves with ferocious force ravaged the monster horde.
The mutants, barely reacting, were blown into pulp!
One wave eliminated a countless number of mutants in the catapult’s attack.
Over three hundred fireballs exploding simultaneously was as spectacular as Armageddon!
Even the sky, obscured by the mutants, was blasted open.
Those at the explosion’s edge, not killed outright, didn’t fare much better.
Mutants scorched by shrapnel were instantly ignited, frantically scurrying amidst the horde.
Their frantic escape ignited more monsters.
The monster army’s charge came to a halt.
The Flamethrower Catapult’s power showed its full might!
Not only Cheng Jianyong and others but even the relatives they arranged in the Lord’s Mansion were stunned.
This spectacular scene, even by modern warfare standards, couldn’t compare!
At this moment, Han Xing, standing on the wall, his eyes showed deeper satisfaction.
Initially, seeing so many monsters indeed shocked him.
He worried whether his territory buildings could withstand the impact of the monsters.
But now it seems, it’s more than enough.
Han Xing roughly estimated the number of monsters in the sky to be between forty to fifty thousand.
With these two waves of attacks, at least tens of thousands of monsters died in the barrage, with many more injured.
Especially the Flamethrower Catapult.
Its damage greatly exceeded his expectations!
The fastest charging monsters were almost entirely wiped out by this wave of attack.
Now, there remain several tens of thousands of mutants.
Such a massive number of companion deaths stirred chaos among the mutants.
But in the next moment, they resolved to take down this human territory.
Thirty to forty thousand mutants, eyes aflame, charged at Han Xing’s territory.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang tightened their grips on their weapons.
This scene, like doomsday approaches, only those who experience it personally can understand the feeling of despair.
If they felt this way, let alone the relatives hiding within the Lord’s Mansion.
They couldn’t imagine how terrifying this world is.
So many monsters, if on Blue Star, could wipe out the entire population of a large city in no time!

chapters.title: Chapter 167 - 140: This Is Divine Punishment!
paragraphs: The relatives hiding inside the Lord’s Mansion were trembling.
Looking at the terrifying number of monsters outside Xingyu City, their faces turned deathly pale in fear.
Blame their bad luck.
As soon as they arrived in this world, they encountered the major event of a blood tide outbreak.
With their strength, they couldn’t defeat even the weakest monster among them.
Now, they could only place all their hope on the five figures on the city wall.
As the monster army got closer.
Han Xing remained unflustered.
Because just an hour ago.
The second batch of Thunderbolt Towers he built had also been announced complete.
Now, there were a total of 23 Thunderbolt Towers in his territory!
The siege crossbow arrows and flamethrower catapults had already proven one point, that although there were many monsters, they couldn’t withstand the power of these attack facilities.
Not to mention, the Thunderbolt Towers, which had even greater power!
This was the source of Han Xing’s confidence.
In fact, with the range of the Thunderbolt Towers, Han Xing could easily wipe out this group of monsters from ten thousand meters away.
But he recalled the scene just after killing that group of monsters, where all the corpses fell down.
For a moment, he felt a bit regretful.
He knew that these monsters could drop quite a lot of materials.
Among them was the Cursed Blood that he urgently needed.
Thus, Han Xing made a bold decision.
Wait until these monsters charged overhead, approached the territory, and then annihilate them in one fell swoop!
When the mutant army charged to within a kilometer of the protective shield, Han Xing still hadn’t acted.
Two seconds later, the monster horde was already less than five hundred meters away from Han Xing.
Everyone held their breath.
At three hundred meters.
Han Xing glanced around the situation.
The vast majority of nearby monsters were already within optimal range.
The next moment, Han Xing exhaled lightly and said, "It’s time."
"Let you witness the power of the Thunderbolt Tower!"
Zzz... Zz zz...
The dense sound of electric currents came.
The next moment.
More than twenty Thunderbolt Towers emitted vast blue beams of destruction, instantly covering the blood-red mutant army.
These beams carrying powerful electric currents intertwined and unleashed terrifying energy.
The entire sky seemed to be covered by a terrifying net of electricity.
Crackling!
The nearest group of mutant monsters, under the horrific electrical discharge, turned directly to ash.
The monsters behind were instantly charred black all over.
Not only that, Han Xing’s second wave of siege crossbow arrows and catapults also launched at this time.
Rumble!
Flame and lightning roared together, interspersed with massive arrows with overwhelming destructive power!
The violent impact made the entire Sky Island tremble constantly.
At this moment.
The scene, like a divine punishment, was deeply etched into the hearts of those relatives.
When the commotion subsided.
Everyone stared blankly at the sky.
Meanwhile, corpses of monsters fell from the sky one by one.
Han Xing hurriedly opened the protective shield.
One by one, scorched monster bodies fell into his territory, making raindrop-like pounding sounds.
The blood-red torrent that had once veiled the sky had vanished.
As if the god controlling thunder and lightning had forcibly driven them out of the sky!
On the territory, dozens of people stared blankly at this scene, hearts filled with mixed emotions.
Even their relatives, who had just arrived in this world, clearly understood what this represented.
In the chat channel, they had long learned how terrifying these monsters were.

Any random mutant could easily kill this group of people in a second, even those teams numbering in the thousands or tens of thousands were frantically summoning their members to collectively resist the monster attack.
But the man before them, without moving a single step, relied solely on those powerful structures in his territory to nearly annihilate tens of thousands of mutated monster tides!
At this moment, they understood the words of Cheng Jianyong.
In this world, there really was no place safer than Han Xing’s territory!
At this time, they thought of the resolutely departing Wen Xinling,
In their hearts, they couldn’t help but feel sympathy for her.
At the same time, they also gained a direct understanding of Han Xing’s abilities!
When the blood-red curtain covering the sky was torn open, only a few hundred scattered mutant monsters were left on the scene.
They seemed to be frightened by Han Xing’s terrifying firepower, and without any hesitation, turned around and fled.
Han Xing pondered for a moment and chose not to pursue them.
Once the monsters had completely disappeared, everyone collectively breathed a sigh of relief.
Sigh...
Shen Yun gulped in awe, saying, "It’s terrifying, is this the power of the Thunder Tower?"
"Such a wide range and enough damage, in one go, at least thousands of monsters are killed, let alone with over twenty towers!"
"My god, just set up one in a territory and it could handle this monster attack of the Blood Tide, right?"
Shen Yun wasn’t wrong. For ordinary survivors, if they could build a Lightning Tower, as long as they formulate a reasonable strategy around it, they could completely withstand this monster wave.
Han Xing’s over twenty towers were already an overflow of firepower!
However, Han Xing still felt unsatisfied.
"No, it’s not enough."
"This time it was relatively easy mainly because the levels of these Blood Tide monsters were quite low, mostly around level fifteen or sixteen."
"Don’t forget, the system prompt mentioned that the following Blood Tide monsters will get stronger and stronger!"
"So, we can’t let our guard down!"
Han Xing valued this Blood Tide disaster more than anyone else.
For this reason, it wouldn’t be excessive to exaggerate the intensity of defense.
He planned that after this battle ends, he would raise another batch of territorial buildings regardless of the cost.
Everyone felt a bit serious after hearing this.
Han Xing also knew that constantly pressuring them wasn’t good, so he changed his tone, waved his hand, and said,
"Alright, in a moment, everyone help me decompose the corpses of these mutants, I need materials from them."
At this time, everyone looked towards the territory again.
The originally scenic Xingyu City now laid with thousands of scorched monster corpses scattered all over.
Some monster corpses had half of their bodies blown away, while others had a few massive fine iron arrows stuck in them.
It looked like a complete mess.
Everyone went down and began to clean up these monster corpses.
[Decomposition Successful, Obtained Cursed Blood *4, Obtained Monster Bird Eye *2...]
[Decomposition Successful, Obtained Cursed Blood *7, Obtained Polluted Heart *1...]
A long string of notifications appeared.
After busying for more than ten minutes, everyone finally cleaned up the thousands of monster corpses in the territory.
The materials found on these monsters were mixed and unclear in their uses.
However, what Han Xing needed was just the cursed blood from them.
After summing up, they collected a total of 14,512 drops of cursed blood in this wave.
Occasionally, there were still a few seriously injured but not yet dead monsters struggling to get up.
At this time, they would meet Han Xing and others’ merciless finishing blows.
As Han Xing just shot an arrow and exploded a mutant bird’s head, the system prompt appeared.
[Killed Mutant Bird (Two-Star Ordinary Creature), Gained Experience Value 4500...]
These mutants provided a lot of experience indeed.
But unfortunately, monsters killed by territorial buildings didn’t give experience points, or else Han Xing would have leveled up one or two levels in one go!
And just then, Shen Yun said with a grim face, "Brother Xing, Cheng Jianyong, come over here, I have a situation!"
Everyone detected something was off in his tone.
Han Xing and Su Xiaoyang hurried over.
Shen Yun saw them and slowly exposed his arm.
On it, there was a thumb-sized blood hole, seemingly from a monster’s tentacle attack.
Moreover, the skin around the wound was already blood red, and it seemed to be spreading across his body.
Han Xing frowned; he seemed to realize something and quickly asked, "Were you struck by those mutant monsters’ attacks?"
Shen Yun nodded, "I wasn’t paying attention while decomposing the corpse."
"I didn’t expect that one of the elite monsters was still alive, and it bit me."
On the scene, everyone’s expressions changed.
Because the system had previously alerted that creatures infected by the Blood Curse would undergo terrifying mutations!
Cheng Jianyong quickly asked, "Xiaoyunzi, how are you feeling?"
Shen Yun shook his head, "I feel alright, but on my status bar, there’s a negative Blood Curse status, and in 174 minutes, it will mutate..."
"174 minutes..."
Hearing this number, Han Xing sighed with relief.
Thankfully, this Blood Curse wasn’t so intense, granting nearly three hours of reaction time.
Of course, this might also be related to everyone’s strength.
Generally, ordinary survivors who have just arrived in this world would mutate in less than a minute upon infection.
At this time, Shen Yun continued, "But the troubling part is, this state seems not removable by the Holy Profession’s Purification Skill."
"Can’t be removed?" Cheng Jianyong asked in confusion.
Shen Yun nodded, "I just tried. With my spiritual power, casting a purification technique on myself only extends the Blood Curse’s outburst by around half an hour."
"And after reaching the 180-minute limit, casting purification again has no effect."
Everyone was stunned; even with Shen Yun’s spiritual power, it couldn’t be removed, highlighting its terror.
Also, Shen Yun was only scratched with a small wound.
If it was a large area of the body infected with Blood Curse, the curse layers would stack, drastically shortening the time to outburst!
However, they didn’t know that a real Blood Curse is far more terrifying than now.
Even a professional like Shen Yun, who had completed the Second Transformation, if infected with the Blood Curse, would become one of those terrifying monsters in less than five minutes.
The Holy Profession’s Purification Skill couldn’t work at all, not even delay could be achieved!
Once cursed, death was inevitable.
All thanks to the Wild Ranger Spirit, who sacrificed itself to unleash the mightiest strike to snip the very core of the Blood Curse.

Everyone stared blankly at the sky.
Meanwhile, corpses of monsters fell from the sky one by one.
Han Xing hurriedly opened the protective shield.
One by one, scorched monster bodies fell into his territory, making raindrop-like pounding sounds.
The blood-red torrent that had once veiled the sky had vanished.
As if the god controlling thunder and lightning had forcibly driven them out of the sky!
On the territory, dozens of people stared blankly at this scene, hearts filled with mixed emotions.
Even their relatives, who had just arrived in this world, clearly understood what this represented.
In the chat channel, they had long learned how terrifying these monsters were.

Any random mutant could easily kill this group of people in a second, even those teams numbering in the thousands or tens of thousands were frantically summoning their members to collectively resist the monster attack.
But the man before them, without moving a single step, relied solely on those powerful structures in his territory to nearly annihilate tens of thousands of mutated monster tides!
At this moment, they understood the words of Cheng Jianyong.
In this world, there really was no place safer than Han Xing’s territory!
At this time, they thought of the resolutely departing Wen Xinling,
In their hearts, they couldn’t help but feel sympathy for her.
At the same time, they also gained a direct understanding of Han Xing’s abilities!
When the blood-red curtain covering the sky was torn open, only a few hundred scattered mutant monsters were left on the scene.
They seemed to be frightened by Han Xing’s terrifying firepower, and without any hesitation, turned around and fled.
Han Xing pondered for a moment and chose not to pursue them.
Once the monsters had completely disappeared, everyone collectively breathed a sigh of relief.
Sigh...
Shen Yun gulped in awe, saying, "It’s terrifying, is this the power of the Thunder Tower?"
"Such a wide range and enough damage, in one go, at least thousands of monsters are killed, let alone with over twenty towers!"
"My god, just set up one in a territory and it could handle this monster attack of the Blood Tide, right?"
Shen Yun wasn’t wrong.
For ordinary survivors, if they could build a Lightning Tower, as long as they formulate a reasonable strategy around it, they could completely withstand this monster wave.
Han Xing’s over twenty towers were already an overflow of firepower!
However, Han Xing still felt unsatisfied.
"No, it’s not enough."
"This time it was relatively easy mainly because the levels of these Blood Tide monsters were quite low, mostly around level fifteen or sixteen."
"Don’t forget, the system prompt mentioned that the following Blood Tide monsters will get stronger and stronger!"
"So, we can’t let our guard down!"
Han Xing valued this Blood Tide disaster more than anyone else.
For this reason, it wouldn’t be excessive to exaggerate the intensity of defense.
He planned that after this battle ends, he would raise another batch of territorial buildings regardless of the cost.
Everyone felt a bit serious after hearing this.
Han Xing also knew that constantly pressuring them wasn’t good, so he changed his tone, waved his hand, and said,
"Alright, in a moment, everyone help me decompose the corpses of these mutants, I need materials from them."
At this time, everyone looked towards the territory again.
The originally scenic Xingyu City now laid with thousands of scorched monster corpses scattered all over.
Some monster corpses had half of their bodies blown away, while others had a few massive fine iron arrows stuck in them.
It looked like a complete mess.
Everyone went down and began to clean up these monster corpses.
[Decomposition Successful, Obtained Cursed Blood *4, Obtained Monster Bird Eye *2...]
[Decomposition Successful, Obtained Cursed Blood *7, Obtained Polluted Heart *1...]
A long string of notifications appeared.
After busying for more than ten minutes, everyone finally cleaned up the thousands of monster corpses in the territory.
The materials found on these monsters were mixed and unclear in their uses.
However, what Han Xing needed was just the cursed blood from them.
After summing up, they collected a total of 14,512 drops of cursed blood in this wave.
Occasionally, there were still a few seriously injured but not yet dead monsters struggling to get up.
At this time, they would meet Han Xing and others’ merciless finishing blows.
As Han Xing just shot an arrow and exploded a mutant bird’s head, the system prompt appeared.
[Killed Mutant Bird (Two-Star Ordinary Creature), Gained Experience Value 4500...]
These mutants provided a lot of experience indeed.
But unfortunately, monsters killed by territorial buildings didn’t give experience points, or else Han Xing would have leveled up one or two levels in one go!
And just then, Shen Yun said with a grim face, "Brother Xing, Cheng Jianyong, come over here, I have a situation!"
Everyone detected something was off in his tone.
Han Xing and Su Xiaoyang hurried over.
Shen Yun saw them and slowly exposed his arm.
On it, there was a thumb-sized blood hole, seemingly from a monster’s tentacle attack.
Moreover, the skin around the wound was already blood red, and it seemed to be spreading across his body.
Han Xing frowned; he seemed to realize something and quickly asked, "Were you struck by those mutant monsters’ attacks?"
Shen Yun nodded, "I wasn’t paying attention while decomposing the corpse."
"I didn’t expect that one of the elite monsters was still alive, and it bit me."
On the scene, everyone’s expressions changed.
Because the system had previously alerted that creatures infected by the Blood Curse would undergo terrifying mutations!
Cheng Jianyong quickly asked, "Xiaoyunzi, how are you feeling?"
Shen Yun shook his head, "I feel alright, but on my status bar, there’s a negative Blood Curse status, and in 174 minutes, it will mutate..."
"174 minutes..."
Hearing this number, Han Xing sighed with relief.
Thankfully, this Blood Curse wasn’t so intense, granting nearly three hours of reaction time.
Of course, this might also be related to everyone’s strength.
Generally, ordinary survivors who have just arrived in this world would mutate in less than a minute upon infection.
At this time, Shen Yun continued, "But the troubling part is, this state seems not removable by the Holy Profession’s Purification Skill."
"Can’t be removed?" Cheng Jianyong asked in confusion.
Shen Yun nodded, "I just tried.
With my spiritual power, casting a purification technique on myself only extends the Blood Curse’s outburst by around half an hour."
"And after reaching the 180-minute limit, casting purification again has no effect."
Everyone was stunned; even with Shen Yun’s spiritual power, it couldn’t be removed, highlighting its terror.
Also, Shen Yun was only scratched with a small wound.
If it was a large area of the body infected with Blood Curse, the curse layers would stack, drastically shortening the time to outburst!
However, they didn’t know that a real Blood Curse is far more terrifying than now.
Even a professional like Shen Yun, who had completed the Second Transformation, if infected with the Blood Curse, would become one of those terrifying monsters in less than five minutes.
The Holy Profession’s Purification Skill couldn’t work at all, not even delay could be achieved!
Once cursed, death was inevitable.
All thanks to the Wild Ranger Spirit, who sacrificed itself to unleash the mightiest strike to snip the very core of the Blood Curse.

chapters.title: Chapter 168 - 141: The Troublesome Curse
paragraphs: If not for the Wild Ranger sniping the Evil God’s body, weakening the Power of the Blood Curse.
Otherwise, in just one encounter, who knows how many people would turn into those terrifying monsters.
Unable to find a solution.
For a moment, everyone furrowed their brows.
Seeing their expressions, Shen Yun comforted, "It’s okay, at worst, I can occasionally cast a Purification Technique on myself, it’s enough to maintain."
"In the Blood Curse state, it’s only a 20% reduction in Attributes, which just offsets the system’s extra 20% enhancement."
Shen Yun’s mindset was rather positive.
However, the others looked worried.
For such a curse, if you don’t find a way to completely eliminate it, who can guarantee not getting hurt when dealing with these monsters again?
Then, even if there’s Purification from the Holy Profession, don’t they still need rest?
More terrifyingly, as the number of injuries increases, the Blood Curse layers stack up, significantly shortening the mutation time.
This indirectly tells the Survivors that when fighting these monsters, they must avoid getting hurt.
But is that possible?
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly said, "Don’t worry, I have a way with the Blood Curse."
Upon hearing this, everyone instantly looked at him.
Han Xing did not explain further.
Instead, he quickly walked to a small hill in the territory to check the over two hundred ’Aurora Aggregators’ he had built.
It’s been about four hours since he built the Aurora Aggregators.
Once completed, these machines began automatically collecting the Divine Aurora from the sky.
Han Xing checked the item information of these Aurora Aggregators.
The 212 Aurora Aggregators have collected 1244 beams of Divine Aurora for him in total.
This efficiency was acceptable.
This was because the monsters blocked the sky, slowing down the collection efficiency of the ’Aurora Aggregators’, otherwise, more Divine Aurora could have been collected.
Han Xing looked at the blueprint section.
[Blood Curse Antidote Formula]: Can remove the negative effects brought by the Blood Curse and render Survivors immune to Blood Curse state effects for 60 minutes.
[Required Materials for Production]: Cursed Blood*1, Witch Root Grass*1, Divine Aurora*1, Spirit Core*100.
Han Xing’s lips curled into a smile, he had been preparing ever since he got this blueprint.
For this, he had stockpiled quite a lot of materials.
The most stored was Cursed Blood, and he now has nearly 47,641 drops.
And the stock of Witch Root Grass has also reached over 20,000 herbs.
This means, he can now make over a thousand bottles of Blood Curse Antidote at once.
Shen Yun was suffering from the Blood Curse, and the Blood Tide had already fully erupted.
Thus, Han Xing decisively started mass production of the Blood Curse Antidote.
The system prompt appeared.
[Producing Blood Curse Antidote, production time required is 5 seconds (with the benefit of High Level assembly line technology, production time has been reduced by 50%).]
It takes five seconds to make one bottle, so making a thousand bottles of Blood Curse Antidote would take over two hours.
Han Xing still felt this time was a bit too slow.
Nevertheless, Shen Yun is currently in the state of Blood Curse erosion and needs to have this state removed quickly.
Minutes later, Han Xing swiftly arrived by Shen Yun and the others, then took a dark red potion from his backpack.
He didn’t explain but directly tossed the potion to Shen Yun.
Seeing the information on it, Shen Yun was amazed, "Blood Curse Antidote! Completely removes the Blood Curse, plus an hour of immunity!"
"Oh my!"
Hearing Shen Yun describe the effect, everyone was equally astonished.
They were most worried now, not just about the persistent effect of the Blood Curse, but also the curse stacking with each injury.
This one bottle of antidote, looking like blood, not only completely removes the Blood Curse effect but also grants one hour of immunity for the Survivors!
The implications of this go without saying!
At this stage, the most troublesome aspects of those Blood Tide Monsters were their terrifying numbers and inherent Blood Curse effects.
Especially when surrounded, each attack increases the Blood Curse layers exponentially.
At this point, even a Survivor of Han Xing’s caliber would feel helpless.
But with this potion, it’s like having full immunity to the Blood Curse effect for an hour.
And those Blood Tide Monsters losing this trait makes them only as challenging as the level fifteen or sixteen Ordinary Monsters, if not weaker.
Equipped with better gear, Survivors can now rush into the monster horde and rampage!
Everyone recognized the potion’s value.
In such pressing times, this is even more crucial than the Life Secret Elixir!
Cheng Jianyong cautiously asked, "Brother Xing, do you have many of these potions?"
Han Xing shook his head, "Not many for now, but by continuing production, we could make tens of thousands of bottles."
"Gasp..."
Upon hearing this number, everyone collectively gasped.
The value of the Blood Curse Antidote needs no elaboration, it’s almost like a life-saving Divine Artifact.
Especially for those already afflicted by the Blood Curse, at this moment, regardless of the cost, they are willing to exchange for the antidote Han Xing holds.
Shen Yun swallowed and said, "Brother Xing, now the entire server has merged, tens of billions of people are all in the same large district."
"During the first wave of Blood Tide Monster attacks just now, many must have been assaulted. Should we sell a batch of Blood Curse Antidotes now?"
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing replied, "I don’t have enough materials now, let’s look into it later."
Everyone also nodded.
Shen Yun was right; the first wave of Blood Tide Monsters claimed countless lives.
Their Sky Islands were invaded one after another, then collapsed and shattered.
At least a million people died in the first wave of Blood Tide Monster attacks.
But many teams, like Han Xing’s, managed to fend off the first wave of Blood Tide Monster assault.
Although they paid a heavy price, at least, they survived.
Those survivors who didn’t encounter the Blood Tide Monsters felt extremely fortunate.
At this time, on a Sky Island over one hundred thousand square meters, bodies were everywhere.
There were those of monsters, and human bodies as well.
A silver-haired man was wielding a blood-stained Golden Greatsword, fighting against a tentacle-filled monster.
Swoosh!
The Greatsword swung, a head fell to the ground.
Other members also promptly slew the monsters in front of them.
After the battle ended.
Behind him, hundreds of well-equipped Survivors were pale-faced, constantly panting heavily.
This person was the Leader of the Boundaryless group, Kunlun.
Along with hundreds of Elite members of his team.
At the first warning in the chat channel, the Leader of the Boundaryless sensed something wrong.
He quickly gathered a thousand team members, all convened on his territory, and merged everyone’s Sky Islands.
But they turned out to be among the unlucky group, shortly after merging, they were attacked by a massive army of Mutated creatures.
Faced with the overwhelming monsters, the Leader of the Boundaryless swiftly reacted.
He instructed all team members to rapidly gather at the center of the territory, and transferred all relatives into his Basic Castle.
A Basic Castle housed over two thousand people. Though crowded, they had no other options during this critical time.
In the center of the territory, ten catapults were built by the Leader of the Boundaryless, plus twenty-two Rotating Blade Emitters.
To have this many attack constructions at this stage, it shows the Leader of the Boundaryless’s capability and resources.
His strategy was centered around these thirty attack buildings, encircling and aiding, then counter-attacking.
With all Shield Knights and Warriors and other melee units upfront, blocking the monsters from attacking his territory’s castle.
Other ranged professions stood on the castle’s towers or walls, providing firepower or support.
The reaction capability and strategy of the Leader of the Boundaryless were undeniably correct.

Due to the sustained damage from the Rotating Blade Launchers, the Blood Tide Monsters were forced to abandon their aerial advantage, rushing to the Sky Island for hand-to-hand combat with the Survivors.
The Blood Tide Monsters could no longer effortlessly devastate the Sky Islands of other Survivors but were forcibly held back by the Elite members of the Leader of the Boundaryless.
After a tough tug-of-war, with the catapults’ tremendous lethality and the Basic Castle’s robust Defense Value.
They managed to eliminate thousands of Mutated monsters.
Seeing they couldn’t conquer this territory easily, the Mutated army collectively chose to flee.
The Leader of the Boundaryless and others sustained minimal damages, holding off this wave of attack.
Suddenly, the gaze of hundreds of Survivors in the Kunlun team towards the Leader of the Boundaryless became fervent!
Because under his command, they managed to easily withstand the Blood Tide’s assault.
"Leader of the Boundaryless is mighty! Vow to die to serve Kunlun!"
"Leader of the Boundaryless, you are my idol!"
Faced with praise.
However, the Leader of the Boundaryless kept a furrowed brow and said, "Stay alert and clean up the battlefield quickly to prevent the second wave of monster attacks!"
The members behind also became tense upon hearing this.
At this time, a beautiful woman, who often appeared beside the Leader of the Boundaryless, jogged over.
She whispered in the Leader’s ear, "Young Master Wu, during the last wave of attacks, many in the team got several layers of the Blood Curse’s negative State."
"Low layers can hold out for one or two hours, high layers have only twenty minutes left!"
After speaking, the beautiful woman’s face paled slightly.
She seemed to have been wounded by a Mutated creature’s attack; a long claw mark stretched from shoulder to chest.
The claw mark tore her neckline, and the Leader of the Boundaryless slightly turned his gaze, seeing exposed skin.
But he had no mind to focus on these matters, instead, he furrowed his brow, "Tried the Holy Profession’s Purification Technique yet?"

chapters.title: Chapter 169 - 142: Battle Merit! Massive Battle Merit!
paragraphs: "Has the Holy Profession’s Purification Technique been tried? Can it expel the Blood Curse state?" Boundless asked.

The beautiful woman nodded slightly, her breath as fragrant as orchids, and said, "We tried, but it cannot be removed completely and each Purification Technique only delays it for about five minutes."
"Right now, we have over nine hundred Professionals here, among whom at least over two hundred brothers are afflicted with the Blood Curse, yet there are fewer than fifty Priests!"
"Though we can barely hold on, if it continues like this, everyone can only rely on the Priests’ Purification Technique to sustain life."
Upon hearing this, Boundless also felt extremely troubled, and he glanced at his own status bar.
[State]: Blood Curse Level 3, All Attributes reduced by 20%, in 1 hour and 34 minutes, you will be transformed into a Blood Thrall.
In the recent battle, as a melee unit, Boundless inevitably got hit by the attacks from those monsters.
The Blood Curse, as a negative state, is really unreasonable.
Even a slight touch from those monsters’ attacks results in a 20% reduction in attributes, and it cannot be completely cleared.
Even he has no solution.
Boundless sighed and said, "I see, let the brothers hold on for now, and let’s see later if there’s any other way to resolve this curse."
"I will summon more brothers to come over; right now, the more people there are, the greater the chance to withstand the impact of the Blood Tide Monsters."
The beautiful woman gave Boundless a sidelong glance with her charming eyes after hearing this.
She nodded gently and then retreated.
At this moment, it was not only ’Kunlun’ where Boundless was that faced such a predicament.
Many of those large teams also successfully resisted the first wave of monsters’ assault.
Of course, they too suffered many casualties.
The survivors bore three to four layers, or even five or six layers of the Blood Curse state on their bodies.
But fortunately, the first wave of Blood Tide Monsters’ impact was finally resisted by everyone.
At this moment, cries of despair filled the chat channel.
"Oh my god... Finally survived!"
"Too tragic, really too tragic... Our team had nearly a hundred people, plus over a thousand relatives, and in the end, fewer than fifty survived..."
"Same goes for us, we barely withstood the monsters’ assault thanks to a few catapults, but nearly half of us died too."
The Survivors who encountered the Blood Tide Monsters recounted their tragic encounters in the chat channel.
At that moment, a Survivor named Shadow Companion spoke up.
"Brothers, I can’t hold on any longer..."
"My wife and children died right in front of me, I watched them turn into those terrifying monsters, and I myself am cursed with the Blood Curse, with not long to live."
"Now, I am standing at the edge of my territory, and I’ll jump off to accompany them soon."
"I’ve taken off all my equipment, left it in the territory, along with all my belongings, the coordinates are 412212, 14522, 55321, if any brother is nearby, feel free to take them."
"I hope these things can help you. Goodbye, and I hope you all can live better in this world..."
Upon hearing his heavy words, everyone in the chat channel tried to offer comfort.
"Brother, please don’t, try to see it through, you’re not the only one facing this, everyone is having a tough time right now..."
"Yeah, stay strong, never give up on life easily!"
"Brother, I’m from the Biological Series, I’ve already discovered the secret to longevity in this world!"
"We Survivors from Blue Star, every time we level up, our body’s power increases, this isn’t just a simple enhancement, it’s more like directly enhancing cell strength!"
"Especially the transformation from level 10 to 11, it’s like completing a higher-level evolution of life!"
"If we can continue to fight and grow stronger, constantly fortifying our cells, living a thousand or even eight hundred years is no dream!"
"So, you must live on, just get through this disaster, and you’ll have a few hundred years of beautiful time left!"
However, the Survivor named Shadow Companion didn’t seem to see the comforting messages from everyone.
After saying those words, his avatar dimmed...
A sigh resonated throughout the chat channel.
And then, the system prompt reappeared.
"Attention Survivors, the new expansion pack ’Blood Tide’ has been updated."
"Update Content 1: The Battle Merit leaderboard is now open, upon killing Blood Tide Monsters, Survivors can earn corresponding Battle Merit."
"Killing 1 Ordinary Monster = 1 Battle Merit; Elite Monster = 10 Battle Merits; Leader Monster = 100 Battle Merits; Lord-level Monster = 5000 Points!"
"Note: Killing monsters above Lord Level grants 1 Human Race exclusive Sacred Artifact Fragment; demolishing 1 Blood Tide Altar grants 10 Human Race exclusive Sacred Artifact Fragments."
"Note: Sacred Artifact Fragments are non-tradable."
"Collecting 10,000 Human Race exclusive Sacred Artifact Fragments grants a Human Race exclusive Sacred Artifact."
"Rewards for this leaderboard will be distributed according to ranking upon victory of the Blood Tide campaign."
"If the campaign fails, all humans on Blue Star die..."
The first update left tens of billions of people on Blue Star utterly shocked.
After the last Cloud Secret Realm leaderboard, a new leaderboard appeared!
This time, it turned out to be based on killing Blood Tide Monsters to earn Battle Merit.
Moreover, they heard of the Human Race exclusive Sacred Artifact!
Prior to this, they had at most heard of Golden Legends, Orange Epics, and even Red Divine Artifacts.
Could Sacred Artifacts be even more advanced than Divine Artifacts?
For a moment, an unknown number of people’s curiosity was piqued.

sentences.text: "Has the Holy Profession’s Purification Technique been tried?
Can it expel the Blood Curse state?" Boundless asked.

The beautiful woman nodded slightly, her breath as fragrant as orchids, and said, "We tried, but it cannot be removed completely and each Purification Technique only delays it for about five minutes."
"Right now, we have over nine hundred Professionals here, among whom at least over two hundred brothers are afflicted with the Blood Curse, yet there are fewer than fifty Priests!"
"Though we can barely hold on, if it continues like this, everyone can only rely on the Priests’ Purification Technique to sustain life."
Upon hearing this, Boundless also felt extremely troubled, and he glanced at his own status bar.
[State]: Blood Curse Level 3, All Attributes reduced by 20%, in 1 hour and 34 minutes, you will be transformed into a Blood Thrall.
In the recent battle, as a melee unit, Boundless inevitably got hit by the attacks from those monsters.
The Blood Curse, as a negative state, is really unreasonable.
Even a slight touch from those monsters’ attacks results in a 20% reduction in attributes, and it cannot be completely cleared.
Even he has no solution.
Boundless sighed and said, "I see, let the brothers hold on for now, and let’s see later if there’s any other way to resolve this curse."
"I will summon more brothers to come over; right now, the more people there are, the greater the chance to withstand the impact of the Blood Tide Monsters."
The beautiful woman gave Boundless a sidelong glance with her charming eyes after hearing this.
She nodded gently and then retreated.
At this moment, it was not only ’Kunlun’ where Boundless was that faced such a predicament.
Many of those large teams also successfully resisted the first wave of monsters’ assault.
Of course, they too suffered many casualties.
The survivors bore three to four layers, or even five or six layers of the Blood Curse state on their bodies.
But fortunately, the first wave of Blood Tide Monsters’ impact was finally resisted by everyone.
At this moment, cries of despair filled the chat channel.
"Oh my god...
Finally survived!"
"Too tragic, really too tragic...
Our team had nearly a hundred people, plus over a thousand relatives, and in the end, fewer than fifty survived..."
"Same goes for us, we barely withstood the monsters’ assault thanks to a few catapults, but nearly half of us died too."
The Survivors who encountered the Blood Tide Monsters recounted their tragic encounters in the chat channel.
At that moment, a Survivor named Shadow Companion spoke up.
"Brothers, I can’t hold on any longer..."
"My wife and children died right in front of me, I watched them turn into those terrifying monsters, and I myself am cursed with the Blood Curse, with not long to live."
"Now, I am standing at the edge of my territory, and I’ll jump off to accompany them soon."
"I’ve taken off all my equipment, left it in the territory, along with all my belongings, the coordinates are 412212, 14522, 55321, if any brother is nearby, feel free to take them."
"I hope these things can help you.
Goodbye, and I hope you all can live better in this world..."
Upon hearing his heavy words, everyone in the chat channel tried to offer comfort.
"Brother, please don’t, try to see it through, you’re not the only one facing this, everyone is having a tough time right now..."
"Yeah, stay strong, never give up on life easily!"
"Brother, I’m from the Biological Series, I’ve already discovered the secret to longevity in this world!"
"We Survivors from Blue Star, every time we level up, our body’s power increases, this isn’t just a simple enhancement, it’s more like directly enhancing cell strength!"
"Especially the transformation from level 10 to 11, it’s like completing a higher-level evolution of life!"
"If we can continue to fight and grow stronger, constantly fortifying our cells, living a thousand or even eight hundred years is no dream!"
"So, you must live on, just get through this disaster, and you’ll have a few hundred years of beautiful time left!"
However, the Survivor named Shadow Companion didn’t seem to see the comforting messages from everyone.
After saying those words, his avatar dimmed...
A sigh resonated throughout the chat channel.
And then, the system prompt reappeared.
"Attention Survivors, the new expansion pack ’Blood Tide’ has been updated."
"Update Content 1: The Battle Merit leaderboard is now open, upon killing Blood Tide Monsters, Survivors can earn corresponding Battle Merit."
"Killing 1 Ordinary Monster = 1 Battle Merit; Elite Monster = 10 Battle Merits; Leader Monster = 100 Battle Merits; Lord-level Monster = 5000 Points!"
"Note: Killing monsters above Lord Level grants 1 Human Race exclusive Sacred Artifact Fragment; demolishing 1 Blood Tide Altar grants 10 Human Race exclusive Sacred Artifact Fragments."
"Note: Sacred Artifact Fragments are non-tradable."
"Collecting 10,000 Human Race exclusive Sacred Artifact Fragments grants a Human Race exclusive Sacred Artifact."
"Rewards for this leaderboard will be distributed according to ranking upon victory of the Blood Tide campaign."
"If the campaign fails, all humans on Blue Star die..."

Moreover, they heard of the Human Race exclusive Sacred Artifact!

Could Sacred Artifacts be even more advanced than Divine Artifacts?
For a moment, an unknown number of people’s curiosity was piqued.

chapters.title: Chapter 170 - 142: Battle Merit! Massive Battle Merit! (Part 2)
paragraphs: However, the difficulty in obtaining this Holy Artifact is insanely high, requiring 10,000 Sacred Artifact Fragments!
Killing one Lord-level creature only gives you one fragment.
In other words, at least ten thousand Lord-level monsters must be killed!
The terror of Lord creatures, Han Xing and the others have already experienced.
Let alone ten thousand of them...
Moreover, the system also warns that if the campaign fails, everyone dies completely.
This shows that the horror of the Blood Tide far exceeds everyone’s imagination.
Yet, before they could recover from the shock.
The second system prompt appeared.
"Update Content 2: Battle Merit Store is now open."

"Survivors can kill Blood Tide Monsters to earn Battle Merit, which can be used to exchange rewards at the Battle Merit Store, including but not limited to treasure chests of various grades, puppets, territory building blueprints, and more..."
"100 Battle Merit can be exchanged for 1 Bronze Treasure Chest; 1000 Battle Merit for 1 Silver Treasure Chest; 10,000 Battle Merit for 1 Golden Treasure Chest;"
"Besides, there are limited exchange Bright Moon Treasure Chests and Sun Treasure Chests."
"Note: During this campaign, Blood Tide Monsters killed by territory buildings also count as Battle Merit Points."
The second update content also shocked everyone to an unimaginable degree.
Because the rewards from the Battle Merit Points Store are truly abundant!
Not only did it release a lot of territory building blueprints, but treasure chests of various kinds can also be exchanged in bulk!
At this moment, in Han Xing’s territory.
Cheng Jianyong said blankly, "Whoa... these rewards are really exaggerated!"
"Let’s not even talk about the Golden Treasure Chest, even the legendary Bright Moon Treasure Chest is out, and it seems like you can get Orange Equipment from it?"
Everyone solemnly nodded.
Since entering Sky Island Paradise, even Han Xing has never come into contact with any Bright Moon level treasure chests.
And as for the more advanced Sun Treasure Chest, they have never even heard of it.
It’s known that Bright Moon Treasure Chests can already yield Orange Level Epic Equipment.
What could be in the Sun Treasure Chest then?
Red Level, Divine Artifact?
Even Han Xing could not help but breathe heavily.
However, when they opened the Battle Merit Store, they couldn’t help but feel a bit disappointed.
"So that’s why, Bright Moon Treasures and Sun Treasures are all limited, I thought everyone could use Orange Epic Equipment next." Cheng Jianyong said disappointedly.
Bright Moon Treasure Chests are limited to 5 exchanges, and each requires one million Battle Merit Points!
While the Sun Treasure Chest is even more exaggerated, not only is it limited to 1, but it also requires 100 million Battle Merit for an exchange!
How many Blood Tide Monsters must be killed? Simply unimaginable!
Shen Yun chuckled on the side, "What are you thinking? Full Orange Equipment, one Bright Moon Treasure Chest already needs a million points, you think you can kill that many monsters?"
After Shen Yun spoke, everyone was stunned.
Yes, a million Battle Merit Points, even if you kill the most ordinary Blood Tide Monsters, you would need a whole million!
Even if those monsters stood still to be chopped, and the weapon got blunt from chopping, one might not get a million Battle Merits.
Shen Yun continued, "So, if we can exchange for a few Golden Treasure Chests, we should count ourselves lucky."
At this moment, Han Xing didn’t hear Shen Yun’s latter words.
But looked at his own Battle Merit Points and fell into a long shock.
A moment later, Han Xing took a deep breath and said with feeling, "Didn’t expect, didn’t expect!"
"This update actually counts the monsters killed by the territory buildings as my Battle Merit!"
Hearing Han Xing’s words, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun also realized something.
They widened their eyes simultaneously, looking at Han Xing, asking tentatively, "Brother Xing, are you saying that those monsters just killed also gave you Battle Merit?"
Han Xing nodded.
At this moment, including Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, all felt their breath catch.
Because before this, they had witnessed the stunning display of the Thunderbolt Tower and Catapult in action!
Furthermore, they knew that Han Xing had killed a terrifying number of mutated monsters in that wave of Blood Tide!
Thousands, even tens of thousands?
My God, so many monsters, how much Battle Merit did they give? How many treasure chests can be exchanged for?
Meanwhile, seeing his staggering 64122 points, Han Xing could hardly suppress the smile at the corner of his mouth!
Over 60,000 points, based on the exchange rate at the Battle Merit Store, that’s equivalent to directly obtaining 6 Golden Treasure Chests!
All five of them together hadn’t opened that many Golden Treasure Chests!
Golden Chests contain various Golden Equipment and there is a chance to get all kinds of building blueprints as well as scarce materials!
Just now, Shen Yun was saying how difficult it is to earn Battle Merit Points, and in the blink of an eye, Han Xing racked up tens of thousands of points!
Leaving everyone dumbstruck.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong eagerly said, "Brother Xing, are we going to use these tens of thousands of points now, or exchange them for something else?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment, nodded, and said, "Let me see what else I can exchange in the store first."
Everyone nodded as well, as the system prompt mentioned that aside from treasure chests, there are also various puppets and building blueprints available for exchange.
Han Xing glanced over briefly, most of the items in the Battle Merit Store were common blueprints.
Such as Lord’s Cottage, Basic Lord’s Castle, Catapult, Rotating Blade Launcher, Arrow Tower, Beast-Catching Net Launcher, etc.
The required Battle Merit for these building blueprints wasn’t high, ranging from 10,000 to 30,000.
Everyone speculated that this was the system’s way of helping other survivors better resist the Blood Tide Monsters.
And since Han Xing already possessed better blueprints, he didn’t need to exchange for these.
Then Han Xing looked at the other exchange option for puppets.
They were Iron Armor, Silver Armor, Golden Armor, and Moon Armor, the four grades of puppets.
These four kinds of puppets were similar to the rewards when the leaderboard was first opened, only their level was higher, around Level 20.
And the newly introduced Moon Armor Puppet was unexpectedly a rare Lord-level Puppet.
Compared to the Leader Level Golden Armor Puppet, the Moon Armor Puppet had an additional domain skill.
[Puppet King Domain]: Exclusive domain skill for the Moon Armor Puppet, adds an extra 20% Defense Value to all allied units (including buildings) within the territory.
(Note: Same-type domain skill states are not stackable.)
Staring at the introduction of this domain skill, Han Xing was stunned for a long time.
Truly befitting a Lord-level Puppet, aside from its combat ability, this one domain skill alone is enough to make all survivors envy!
Even Han Xing himself wanted to exchange for one right then!
But unfortunately, the Lord-level Moon Armor Puppet requires 300,000 Battle Merit Points to exchange and is limited to 1.
Han Xing had no choice but to temporarily give up this idea.

The other grade’s puppets were not limited, and required fewer points, but the Golden Armor Puppet still needed 50,000 points for 1, the Silver Armor Puppet required 10,000, and the Iron Armor Puppet 1,000.
With his current points, he could exchange for 1 Golden Armor Puppet, plus a few other puppets.
But Han Xing weighed his options and decided that the puppets could be set aside for now.
After all, his territory’s defense capability is extremely strong at the moment, at least enough to cope with general large-scale Blood Tide Monsters.
Instead, their equipment levels are somewhat low.
Because everyone had been leveling up too quickly, the equipment they were wearing previously couldn’t keep up with their levels.
So, Han Xing said, "I’ll exchange a few Golden Treasure Chests first, if I can get a few pieces of Golden Equipment, we can upgrade everyone’s equipment."
After hearing this, everyone’s eyes lit up.
Using the 60,000 points to exchange for treasure chests seemed like a good choice.
As long as they could pull 1 or 2 usable pieces of Golden Equipment, the attributes would increase significantly!
Everyone looked at Han Xing expectantly.
Han Xing didn’t hesitate, exchanging for six Golden Treasure Chests in one go!
Clang! Clang!
In the territory, 6 Golden Chests suddenly appeared, the dazzling golden light was so bright, some people couldn’t even open their eyes.
This scene was truly too shocking!
