chapters.title: Chapter 171 - 143: Loot Box Opening!
paragraphs: Six large golden treasure chests were placed in front of everyone.
Han Xing then said, "Xiaoyang, you help me open the chests, okay?"
Su Xiaoyang looked at Han Xing a bit confused and asked, "Huh? Me?"
Han Xing nodded: "Yes, you’ve always been lucky. Let’s see if you can get some golden equipment out!"
It’s not guaranteed that the golden treasure chests will yield golden equipment; it’s just that the probability is high.
Moreover, the equipment level from the treasure chest will vary based on the Survivor’s level, sometimes higher, sometimes lower.
This fluctuation range is between 1 and 5 levels.
Currently, Han Xing is at level 21, and Su Xiaoyang is at level 20.
So, it doesn’t make much difference who opens these chests.
Everyone was also expectantly watching Su Xiaoyang.
Su Xiaoyang nodded, then walked to the golden treasure chests and opened them all.
Dazzling golden light flashed consecutively.
Looking at the items in the chest, a slight smile appeared on Su Xiaoyang’s delicate face.
"Done, Brother Xing!" Su Xiaoyang’s tone carried a hint of delight.
Seeing her expression, Han Xing knew that the items from the chest must be good.
He quickly stepped forward and collected all the items inside.
System prompts appeared in quick succession.
[Successfully opened the golden treasure chest, obtained Permanent Gold Ingot*12, obtained Vitality Ore*7, obtained Fish Guts Sword (Gold)*1...]
The first chest already had a golden armor!
Everyone was even more eager for the upcoming rewards!
Han Xing continued to reach in.
[Successfully opened the golden treasure chest, obtained Permanent Gold Ingot*11, obtained Elemental Magnet Stone*2, obtained Cold Winter Scale Armor (Gold)*1...]
[Obtained Magic Steel Pants (Gold)*1...]
[Obtained Great Mage’s Cloak (Gold)*1...]
[Obtained Natural Law Bracelet (Gold)*1...]
[Obtained Wolf Race Totem*1, obtained Blood Battleaxe (Gold)*1...]
chests produced six pieces of golden equipment!
Among them, three were of legendary quality, three were of rare quality, and all were high-level!
No wonder Su Xiaoyang’s expression was so joyous.
Everyone had a clear understanding of her little lucky hand once again.
Han Xing began to review the attributes of these equipments.
Among them, the Cold Winter Scale Armor and Natural Law Bracelet, Han Xing could equip both.
He didn’t hesitate to equip them on the spot, greatly enhancing his defense and other attributes.
As for the Magic Steel Pants, Han Xing gave them to Shen Yun.
Now, Shen Yun has six pieces of golden armor, practically a Golden Saint, with astonishing defense.
The Great Mage’s Cloak, as the name suggests, is for magic-related professions.
This equipment has an interesting legendary-level effect.
It allows a 50% chance of casting two Large Fireballs consecutively when using Great Fireball Technique, 30% chance for three, and 10% chance for five consecutive Large Fireballs.
Zhang Lianmeng’s magic damage was already high, one Large Fireball could obliterate an ordinary monster of the same level.
If the effect triggers during a Large Fireball cast, even someone like Shen Yun, who is heavily armored, might struggle to withstand it.
As for the other two golden weapons, Fish Guts Sword and Blood Battleaxe.
They are weapons for Swordsmen and Berserkers, and Cheng Jianyong could use them too.
However, he has something better.
The level 15 Lion Heart Greatsword, whose attributes are superior even to these level 20 golden items!
Han Xing directly put those two golden weapons in the consignment channel, hoping to exchange for wrist guards or necklaces and rings of equivalent quality.
As to whether others would trade, Han Xing didn’t worry.
Because, soon, with the opening of the combat merit points store, more and more people would accumulate enough points to exchange for golden treasure chests.
It can be said that the speed at which Survivors acquire high-level equipment has increased exponentially.
Even Han Xing felt that if a few more waves of Blood Tide monsters attacked, he might be able to assemble a full set of golden equipment.
By then, his overall strength wouldn’t just be a level higher!
Of course, at the current stage, besides himself, others don’t have his terrifying monster clearing efficiency.
With more than twenty lightning towers bursting in unison, tens of thousands of monsters perish, among them quite a few elite and leader-level monsters!
Even for Boundless and others, though their territories have a fair number of attack buildings, compared to Han Xing, they are dwarfed by his setup.
Moreover, to protect these attack buildings from destruction.
The optimal combat strategy for others is still to draw these monsters to ground level and collaborate in taking them down.
However, doing so, their kill efficiency is not as high, earning only a few thousand combat merit points per wave.
Dividing among hundreds of individuals results in even less.
So, at the current stage.
Even the Survivors with the most points can only exchange for one or two Silver Treasure Chests.
After handling these pieces of equipment.
Han Xing excitedly stared at a wooden totem-like item in his hand.
Just now, while collecting items from the golden treasure chest, Han Xing heard a special prompt from the last chest.
[Obtained Wolf Race Totem*1.]
Han Xing clearly remembered that the key element to building the Wolf Cavalry Camp was this item.
Previously, he had searched several times on the trading channel but found nothing.
Now, it was actually opened by Su Xiaoyang.
At this moment, he held the small carved wolf head in his hand, on which the item’s attributes floated.
[Wolf Race Totem]: Special item. With this totem, you can gain the recognition of the Wolf Cavalry tribe, consume Spirit Cores, and summon Wolf Cavalry to fight for you.
Han Xing excitedly clenched his fist!
With this item, his mass troop production mode could finally be realized!
Thinking of this, Han Xing couldn’t wait and hurried to the hillside below his territory, removing some soil to form a small cave!
This was where Han Xing chose to build the Wolf Cavalry Camp.
Not only could it provide some concealment, but the soil above could also block a bit of damage.
Later, Han Xing would build a Thorny Shield Wall around it to protect it!
Han Xing entered the cave and directly clicked build.
The system prompted appeared.
"Do you wish to consume the materials: Wolf Race Totem*1, Refined Iron*70000, Mithril*2000, Power Crystal*100000, to build Wolf Cavalry Camp*1?"
Now that all the materials were gathered, Han Xing directly clicked build.
[Building Wolf Cavalry Camp, remaining time needed 8 hours and 32 minutes...]
"Great, in eight hours, I can deploy the first team of Wolf Cavalry!"
Han Xing couldn’t help but feel a slight anticipation in his heart.

After building the Wolf Cavalry Camp, Han Xing went to the city wall perimeter and once again mass-produced catapults and siege crossbow arrows, and in front of each attack structure, he built a ring of Thorny Shield Wall.
After today’s battle, he roughly understood the defensive capability of his territory.
Dealing with tens of thousands of Blood Tide Monsters was no problem.
But who would dislike having too many of these things?
After all, the system had warned that Blood Tide Monsters would continue to grow stronger and in greater numbers.
Han Xing wished he could directly build tens of thousands of Thunderbolt Towers on his territory!
By then, he could truly rest easy!
[Building Flamethrower Catapult, remaining time needed 3 hours and 12 minutes...]
[Building Siege Crossbow Arrow Launcher Platform, remaining time needed 2 hours and 27 minutes...]
[Building Thorny Shield Wall, remaining time needed 1 hour and 2 minutes...]
As a large number of materials were consumed, Han Xing’s material reserves were once again depleted.
"Mithril and Permanent Gold Ingot will soon be used up, as well as Refined Iron."
"Sigh, money really vanishes like water..."
Han Xing couldn’t help but lament.
Last time, he sold tens of thousands of backpacks, exchanging them for materials worth four or five billion Spirit Cores.
But after these rounds of construction, it was almost depleted.
Han Xing pondered for a moment, "Looks like I need to mass-sell another batch of items to exchange for materials."
He glanced at his inventory.
Among the items for sale, apart from over two thousand blue backpacks and over five thousand purple backpacks, there were also more than 700 bottles of already made Curse-Blood Antidote.
Looking at this stock, Han Xing frowned and then sighed, "It’s still not enough..."
Although he had ways to make money, producing anything required time.
As fast as one or two seconds, as slow as dozens of seconds.
These pieces of equipment, unlike territory buildings, couldn’t be mass-produced, and their progress bars didn’t stack.
Whereas making these pieces of equipment, their progress bars could only be completed one by one.
Just making a few hundred bottles of Life Secret Elixir would take one or two hours.
Therefore, even if Han Xing stayed on the crafting interface 24 hours a day, he couldn’t keep up with the consumption.
So, Han Xing had to continue going through the warehouse to see what could be sold.
This search actually turned up quite a lot.
Jade Bamboo Core, Black Soul Grass, Golden Pattern Fruit, etc...
They were all resources found on other Sky Islands.
The most abundant of which was the bamboo core of Jade Heart Bamboo, with over ten thousand.
These over ten thousand bamboo cores were gathered and organized by Zhang Lianmeng during her free time and placed in Han Xing’s warehouse.
Apart from this, whenever Zhang Lianmeng had free time, she would manage the territory.
After hearing that Han Xing needed a large amount of Witch Root Grass, Zhang Lianmeng also collected many Witch Root Grass seeds and began mass planting them.
However, the growth cycle of Witch Root Grass is over a month.
Even with the use of Bone Meal to hasten the growth, it still takes at least a month.
In recent days, Zhang Lianmeng’s contributions did not go unnoticed by Han Xing.
She truly treated Han Xing’s matters as her own, working tirelessly without a word of complaint.
All he needed to do was focus on fighting monsters and expanding the territory, and Zhang Lianmeng never let him worry about any logistics.
In his heart, he was extremely grateful for Zhang Lianmeng’s quiet dedication.
Han Xing opened the trading channel to check the market prices for these materials.
Items that could permanently increase attributes were all quite pricey.
Besides the Jade Bamboo Core, which could increase Spirit, there was also the Cow Blood Fruit that could increase Power, Wind Light Leaf that could increase agility, and so on...
As for items like the Jade Bamboo Core, which increase Spirit, they could sell for about 700 Spirit Cores each.

sentences.text: Six large golden treasure chests were placed in front of everyone.
Han Xing then said, "Xiaoyang, you help me open the chests, okay?"
Su Xiaoyang looked at Han Xing a bit confused and asked, "Huh?
Me?"
Han Xing nodded: "Yes, you’ve always been lucky.
Let’s see if you can get some golden equipment out!"
It’s not guaranteed that the golden treasure chests will yield golden equipment; it’s just that the probability is high.
Moreover, the equipment level from the treasure chest will vary based on the Survivor’s level, sometimes higher, sometimes lower.
This fluctuation range is between 1 and 5 levels.
Currently, Han Xing is at level 21, and Su Xiaoyang is at level 20.
So, it doesn’t make much difference who opens these chests.
Everyone was also expectantly watching Su Xiaoyang.
Su Xiaoyang nodded, then walked to the golden treasure chests and opened them all.
Dazzling golden light flashed consecutively.
Looking at the items in the chest, a slight smile appeared on Su Xiaoyang’s delicate face.
"Done, Brother Xing!" Su Xiaoyang’s tone carried a hint of delight.
Seeing her expression, Han Xing knew that the items from the chest must be good.
He quickly stepped forward and collected all the items inside.
System prompts appeared in quick succession.
[Successfully opened the golden treasure chest, obtained Permanent Gold Ingot*12, obtained Vitality Ore*7, obtained Fish Guts Sword (Gold)*1...]
The first chest already had a golden armor!
Everyone was even more eager for the upcoming rewards!
Han Xing continued to reach in.
[Successfully opened the golden treasure chest, obtained Permanent Gold Ingot*11, obtained Elemental Magnet Stone*2, obtained Cold Winter Scale Armor (Gold)*1...]
[Obtained Magic Steel Pants (Gold)*1...]
[Obtained Great Mage’s Cloak (Gold)*1...]
[Obtained Natural Law Bracelet (Gold)*1...]
[Obtained Wolf Race Totem*1, obtained Blood Battleaxe (Gold)*1...]
chests produced six pieces of golden equipment!
Among them, three were of legendary quality, three were of rare quality, and all were high-level!
No wonder Su Xiaoyang’s expression was so joyous.
Everyone had a clear understanding of her little lucky hand once again.
Han Xing began to review the attributes of these equipments.
Among them, the Cold Winter Scale Armor and Natural Law Bracelet, Han Xing could equip both.
He didn’t hesitate to equip them on the spot, greatly enhancing his defense and other attributes.
As for the Magic Steel Pants, Han Xing gave them to Shen Yun.
Now, Shen Yun has six pieces of golden armor, practically a Golden Saint, with astonishing defense.
The Great Mage’s Cloak, as the name suggests, is for magic-related professions.
This equipment has an interesting legendary-level effect.
It allows a 50% chance of casting two Large Fireballs consecutively when using Great Fireball Technique, 30% chance for three, and 10% chance for five consecutive Large Fireballs.
Zhang Lianmeng’s magic damage was already high, one Large Fireball could obliterate an ordinary monster of the same level.
If the effect triggers during a Large Fireball cast, even someone like Shen Yun, who is heavily armored, might struggle to withstand it.
As for the other two golden weapons, Fish Guts Sword and Blood Battleaxe.
They are weapons for Swordsmen and Berserkers, and Cheng Jianyong could use them too.
However, he has something better.
The level 15 Lion Heart Greatsword, whose attributes are superior even to these level 20 golden items!
Han Xing directly put those two golden weapons in the consignment channel, hoping to exchange for wrist guards or necklaces and rings of equivalent quality.
As to whether others would trade, Han Xing didn’t worry.
Because, soon, with the opening of the combat merit points store, more and more people would accumulate enough points to exchange for golden treasure chests.
It can be said that the speed at which Survivors acquire high-level equipment has increased exponentially.
Even Han Xing felt that if a few more waves of Blood Tide monsters attacked, he might be able to assemble a full set of golden equipment.
By then, his overall strength wouldn’t just be a level higher!
Of course, at the current stage, besides himself, others don’t have his terrifying monster clearing efficiency.
With more than twenty lightning towers bursting in unison, tens of thousands of monsters perish, among them quite a few elite and leader-level monsters!
Even for Boundless and others, though their territories have a fair number of attack buildings, compared to Han Xing, they are dwarfed by his setup.
Moreover, to protect these attack buildings from destruction.
The optimal combat strategy for others is still to draw these monsters to ground level and collaborate in taking them down.
However, doing so, their kill efficiency is not as high, earning only a few thousand combat merit points per wave.
Dividing among hundreds of individuals results in even less.
So, at the current stage.
Even the Survivors with the most points can only exchange for one or two Silver Treasure Chests.
After handling these pieces of equipment.
Han Xing excitedly stared at a wooden totem-like item in his hand.
Just now, while collecting items from the golden treasure chest, Han Xing heard a special prompt from the last chest.
[Obtained Wolf Race Totem*1.]
Han Xing clearly remembered that the key element to building the Wolf Cavalry Camp was this item.
Previously, he had searched several times on the trading channel but found nothing.
Now, it was actually opened by Su Xiaoyang.
At this moment, he held the small carved wolf head in his hand, on which the item’s attributes floated.
[Wolf Race Totem]: Special item.
With this totem, you can gain the recognition of the Wolf Cavalry tribe, consume Spirit Cores, and summon Wolf Cavalry to fight for you.
Han Xing excitedly clenched his fist!
With this item, his mass troop production mode could finally be realized!
Thinking of this, Han Xing couldn’t wait and hurried to the hillside below his territory, removing some soil to form a small cave!
This was where Han Xing chose to build the Wolf Cavalry Camp.
Not only could it provide some concealment, but the soil above could also block a bit of damage.
Later, Han Xing would build a Thorny Shield Wall around it to protect it!
Han Xing entered the cave and directly clicked build.
The system prompted appeared.
"Do you wish to consume the materials: Wolf Race Totem*1, Refined Iron*70000, Mithril*2000, Power Crystal*100000, to build Wolf Cavalry Camp*1?"
Now that all the materials were gathered, Han Xing directly clicked build.
[Building Wolf Cavalry Camp, remaining time needed 8 hours and 32 minutes...]
"Great, in eight hours, I can deploy the first team of Wolf Cavalry!"
Han Xing couldn’t help but feel a slight anticipation in his heart.

After building the Wolf Cavalry Camp, Han Xing went to the city wall perimeter and once again mass-produced catapults and siege crossbow arrows, and in front of each attack structure, he built a ring of Thorny Shield Wall.
After today’s battle, he roughly understood the defensive capability of his territory.
Dealing with tens of thousands of Blood Tide Monsters was no problem.
But who would dislike having too many of these things?
After all, the system had warned that Blood Tide Monsters would continue to grow stronger and in greater numbers.
Han Xing wished he could directly build tens of thousands of Thunderbolt Towers on his territory!
By then, he could truly rest easy!
[Building Flamethrower Catapult, remaining time needed 3 hours and 12 minutes...]
[Building Siege Crossbow Arrow Launcher Platform, remaining time needed 2 hours and 27 minutes...]
[Building Thorny Shield Wall, remaining time needed 1 hour and 2 minutes...]
As a large number of materials were consumed, Han Xing’s material reserves were once again depleted.
"Mithril and Permanent Gold Ingot will soon be used up, as well as Refined Iron."
"Sigh, money really vanishes like water..."
Han Xing couldn’t help but lament.
Last time, he sold tens of thousands of backpacks, exchanging them for materials worth four or five billion Spirit Cores.
But after these rounds of construction, it was almost depleted.
Han Xing pondered for a moment, "Looks like I need to mass-sell another batch of items to exchange for materials."

chapters.title: Chapter 172 - 144: Assessing Assets
paragraphs: Han Xing murmured softly, "Jade Bamboo Core, 700 Spirit Cores each, selling them all would amount to nearly 7 million Spirit Cores, which is quite a significant income."
"Then there’s the Blue Backpack, its market price has risen again, probably because of the merge region reason, the demand has increased."
"So I can slightly adjust my pricing upwards, after all, everyone’s level has caught up, and they have more resources on hand. For now, I’ll price it at 60,000 Spirit Cores per backpack."
"If I sell them all, it would be a value of one or two billion Spirit Cores."
Thinking of this, Han Xing’s eyes lit up with joy.
Just these two things alone are enough for him to make a huge profit.
And these are just a small portion of Han Xing’s inventory.
He glanced at another item, the stock of Purple Backpacks.
During this period, through his continuous efforts, he gathered Strong Beast Hide materials everywhere, and also made more than 5,200 of them.
This is Han Xing’s main asset.
"Purple Backpacks are currently rare in the entire trading channel, if you want to sell, you should at least price them at 250,000 Spirit Cores each."
"Although it seems a bit high, there will always be some team leaders from big groups who can afford it."
"Calculating like this, it’s worth 1.3 billion Spirit Cores!"

"Besides, there’s over ten thousand bottles of Intermediate Life Secret Elixir and more than eight thousand bottles of Wild Bear Power Secret Elixir, selling all these hoarded items could bring in almost 2 billion Spirit Cores!"
He didn’t realize until he counted, and he was startled by the numbers.
Han Xing was only focused on being a hoarder, without ever considering the total value of his assets.
When it was time to sell them, he finally realized how valuable these items were!
"Good, good, good!"
"After this wave of trades is completed, I shouldn’t be short of materials for a while!"
Han Xing felt thrilled.
At this moment, he glanced again at the crafting interface.
The item currently being crafted is the Curse-Blood Antidote.
This elixir is the most urgently desired item by billions of survivors on Blue Star.
If it were to be sold, setting a price would be quite tricky...
Just as Han Xing was pondering what price to set.
About a hundred kilometers away from his territory, there was a giant Sky Island over ten thousand square kilometers in area.
However, this Sky Island was currently in ruins.
The Sky Island seemed to have just been invaded by Blood Tide Monsters.
The territory had tattered tents all over, and various severed body parts of creatures...
Thousands of corpses lay haphazardly, some were humans, others those monsters.
The blood from these corpses continuously flowed, turning the entire platform blood-red.
Amid the thousands of corpses.
A woman, covered in blood and dirt, with a vacant expression, climbed out from the pile of bodies.
She knelt there, glancing around, and upon seeing the hellish terrifying scene, immense fear appeared in her eyes.
Moments later, she seemed unable to hold back any longer and began to cry.
"Sob sob... sob sob..."
This crying woman was Wen Xinling.
Soon after the Blood Tide disaster broke out, she and Jiang Heng encountered an attack by mutated monsters.
In the instant she saw the monsters pounce, Wen Xinling was scared stiff, falling into a daze.
Moreover, her father fainted at that time.
Before she could react, he was swallowed by those mutated monsters.
Wen Xinling’s mother screamed in fear and ran without any aim, fleeing frantically.
When those mutated monsters were about to lock onto Wen Xinling, she detected the danger.
In a life-and-death crisis, she amazingly unleashed an incredible survival instinct.
Wen Xinling immediately took her mother to rush to the center of the territory, where there were several catapults, along with a Lord’s Cottage.
She thought Jiang Heng and others could stop that group of monsters.
However, she never could have imagined, the hundreds of strong individuals Jiang Heng boasted about were so vulnerable.
In one face-off, countless people died under the tentacles of those mutants.
Amidst the panic, Jiang Heng fled with the remaining members to the territory center, relying on those few catapults to retaliate.
However, the number of monsters was too great, and the assault was too fierce.
Jiang Heng desperately held onto those few catapults as his last lifeline.
He had no time to care about anything else.
He could only watch helplessly as the rudimentary camps were destroyed one by one.
Then watch as the families of survivors were dragged out and devoured by the Blood Tide Monsters.
Through the sacrifice of these people, Jiang Heng continuously operated the catapults, hurling giant stones one after another.
Though they were ordinary catapults, the damage was sufficient.
Several rounds of throwing resulted in hundreds of Blood Tide Monsters being crushed by the immense power of the catapults.
The scale of the Blood Tide Monster attack on them wasn’t large, with about a thousand creatures.
The Blood Tide Monsters seemed intimidated by the power of those few catapults and gradually retreated.
After the battle ended, the survivors collapsed limply onto the ground.
The territory originally had over a thousand people, now only seventy or eighty were left alive.
Faced with so many corpses, Wen Xinling went completely numb.
Her heart was filled with agony, regret, and anger.
She kept questioning herself, why didn’t she listen to Cheng Jianyong’s advice at the time and heed his warning, but decided to run out?
Now she not only failed to find her brother, but also got her father killed!
If it weren’t for those few catapults on the territory, whose power was astonishing, blasting hundreds of mutant monsters to death.
Maybe even she would have been buried here.
Moreover, she knows that she hasn’t escaped the danger to her life.
Those monsters just ran away, and nobody knows when they might come back.
For a moment, Wen Xinling’s heart was filled with immense fear.
At this moment, she seemed to have thought of something.
"Those monsters seem to be quite afraid of catapults! Right! Catapults!"
"I remember there are a lot of catapults on Han Xing’s territory, with their strength, they can definitely fend off these monsters!"
Wen Xinling was like grasping the last straw of survival, a glimmer of hope reappeared in her eyes.
She just wanted to contact Cheng Jianyong but suddenly froze, stunned on the spot.
She still remembered the excessive words she said to Cheng Jianyong before leaving.
If she seeks Cheng Jianyong’s help now, even she couldn’t help but feel overwhelming shame.
However, in the face of death, even if she’s ashamed, she can only try to contact him.
(ps: This woman is already dead and will not appear anymore.)
In the deep of night.
The moon over the Land of the Abandoned Gods seems to have also been infected by the Blood Tide, becoming fully blood red.
With the blood moon hanging high, everyone felt a sense of unease.
Han Xing just finished counting the resources at hand and was ready for a round of transactions.
Under the blood moon, a figure walked out from the territory and headed directly towards Han Xing.
This person was Cheng Jianyong.
Seeing Han Xing, Cheng Jianyong said with a smile: "Brother Xing, still not resting? What are you up to?"
Han Xing pointed to the flamethrower catapult beside him and said: "Preparing to build another batch of catapults and Thunderbolt Towers to strengthen territorial defense."
"That’s great, Brother Xing, is there anything I can help with?" Cheng Jianyong said enthusiastically.
Han Xing shook his head directly: "No."
However, Cheng Jianyong still said enthusiastically: "Well, Brother Xing, are you hungry now? I can slaughter a couple of piglets for supper."
Listening to this guy’s remarks, Han Xing said with a peculiar look: "Go ahead, what do you want?"
Cheng Jianyong froze for a moment, hurriedly laughed: "Ah? Nothing."
"No reason you’d be so attentive if there’s nothing?"
Cheng Jianyong beamed with a smile: "Really no matter, just came by casually."
"Brother Xing, I’ll let you handle your business, I’ll go out for a while, see if there’s any monsters for me to brush up on, I’ll be back soon."
Han Xing frowned and asked: "So late, where are you going? Aren’t you afraid of monster attacks?"
"Afraid, of course, afraid!"
Cheng Jianyong replied: "But I’ll just take a look nearby, hoping to seize time to level up, and I’ll be back soon."
Han Xing looked at him seriously.
Cheng Jianyong felt guilty under his gaze.
A moment later, Han Xing directly exposed him: "Is it because of Wen Xinling?"
Cheng Jianyong froze for a moment, he was about to deny it.
But then he thought about it and knew he couldn’t hide from Han Xing.
So he could only smile bitterly and nod: "Yes... Brother Xing."
Upon hearing him admit, Han Xing nodded, thinking it’s true.
Cheng Jianyong said helplessly: "Lingling encountered a Blood Tide monster attack over there, Jiang Heng and those over a thousand people are almost all dead."
"And her father... also died in the monster invasion..."
"She was just crying and sent me a message, saying those monsters flew away not long ago, maybe they’ll come back soon."
"She also said she regretted not listening to me at the time, hoping I could go save her."
"I, sigh..."
Cheng Jianyong sighed.
Han Xing still did not reply.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong continued: "Brother Xing, Lingling and I, after all, have been married for so many years, although she’s a bit stubborn, she actually has no ill intent."
"This time she’s tasted enough of the lesson outside, she’ll definitely not be so cocky afterwards."
"Yuanyuan is still young, I don’t want her to lose her mother at such a young age..."
Cheng Jianyong looked at Han Xing expectantly, eyes filled with some pleading.
A moment later, Han Xing nodded, "I got it, you go."
Upon hearing this answer, Cheng Jianyong was overjoyed, instantly saying: "Thank you, Brother Xing!"
"Time waits for no one, I’ll go now, back in about two hours."
"By the way, don’t tell Shen Yun and them!"
After saying that, Cheng Jianyong picked up his weapon ready to leave.
However, Han Xing stopped him at this moment.
Han Xing shook his head and said: "Now outside are wandering Blood Tide monsters everywhere, although there are some catapults and siege crossbow arrows on your territory, ultimately it’s lacking."
"If you encounter Blood Tide monsters, you won’t withstand them, I’ll go with you."
Cheng Jianyong was startled by what he heard, repeatedly refusing: "Brother Xing, that won’t do!"
"You still have to preside over the big picture here, anyone can be missing here, except for you!"
"I should go alone!"

"Brother Xing, I’ll let you handle your business, I’ll go out for a while, see if there’s any monsters for me to brush up on, I’ll be back soon."
Han Xing frowned and asked: "So late, where are you going?
Aren’t you afraid of monster attacks?"
"Afraid, of course, afraid!"
Cheng Jianyong replied: "But I’ll just take a look nearby, hoping to seize time to level up, and I’ll be back soon."
Han Xing looked at him seriously.
Cheng Jianyong felt guilty under his gaze.
A moment later, Han Xing directly exposed him: "Is it because of Wen Xinling?"
Cheng Jianyong froze for a moment, he was about to deny it.
But then he thought about it and knew he couldn’t hide from Han Xing.
So he could only smile bitterly and nod: "Yes...
Brother Xing."
Upon hearing him admit, Han Xing nodded, thinking it’s true.
Cheng Jianyong said helplessly: "Lingling encountered a Blood Tide monster attack over there, Jiang Heng and those over a thousand people are almost all dead."
"And her father... also died in the monster invasion..."
"She was just crying and sent me a message, saying those monsters flew away not long ago, maybe they’ll come back soon."
"She also said she regretted not listening to me at the time, hoping I could go save her."
"I, sigh..."
Cheng Jianyong sighed.
Han Xing still did not reply.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong continued: "Brother Xing, Lingling and I, after all, have been married for so many years, although she’s a bit stubborn, she actually has no ill intent."
"This time she’s tasted enough of the lesson outside, she’ll definitely not be so cocky afterwards."
"Yuanyuan is still young, I don’t want her to lose her mother at such a young age..."
Cheng Jianyong looked at Han Xing expectantly, eyes filled with some pleading.
A moment later, Han Xing nodded, "I got it, you go."
Upon hearing this answer, Cheng Jianyong was overjoyed, instantly saying: "Thank you, Brother Xing!"
"Time waits for no one, I’ll go now, back in about two hours."
"By the way, don’t tell Shen Yun and them!"
After saying that, Cheng Jianyong picked up his weapon ready to leave.
However, Han Xing stopped him at this moment.
Han Xing shook his head and said: "Now outside are wandering Blood Tide monsters everywhere, although there are some catapults and siege crossbow arrows on your territory, ultimately it’s lacking."
"If you encounter Blood Tide monsters, you won’t withstand them, I’ll go with you."
Cheng Jianyong was startled by what he heard, repeatedly refusing: "Brother Xing, that won’t do!"
"You still have to preside over the big picture here, anyone can be missing here, except for you!"
"I should go alone!"

chapters.title: Chapter 173 - 145: Crushing the Competition
paragraphs: Cheng Jianyong insisted on going alone.
However, Han Xing laughed and said, "Who said it’s just the two of us going over."
Cheng Jianyong asked in confusion, "Brother Xing, what do you mean?"
Han Xing pointed at his feet, "Don’t forget, we’re on a Sky Island. Even after establishing Xingyu City, it doesn’t mean we can’t move."
Cheng Jianyong was stunned.
Since Han Xing founded the city, the Sky Island had become increasingly vast and hadn’t moved much recently.
He subconsciously thought that this city could only stay in place.
After Han Xing’s reminder, Cheng Jianyong then remembered that the city beneath them was indeed a Sky City.
The Sky Island could move freely like an airplane or yacht!
And this was also an advantage for them, the survivors.
Ignoring Cheng Jianyong, who was still bewildered.
The next moment, Han Xing controlled the massive Sky City and moved forward slowly.
Noticing that the Sky Island was moving.
Shen Yun and Zhang Lianmeng, among others, quickly came out with weapons in hand.
Han Xing briefly explained the situation to everyone, and they nodded.
After all, here, as long as Han Xing agreed, the others present had no objections.
The Sky Island moved forward slowly.
On the way, the system notified them that they had automatically entered the regional chat channel.
It seemed that there were many survivors nearby who had also encountered Blood Tide Monsters.
The chat channel was filled with cries for help and voices seeking to team up.
Among them, a team called ’Bathing City’ was rallying survivors in this area to gather with them, and they announced their coordinates.
At this moment, a survivor named Ma Jikou said, "Brothers, Bathing City is heavily recruiting. Inside, there are hundreds of skilled technicians ready to serve everyone.
"Twenty-three types of VIP privileges, seventeen supreme seats, come to Bathing City and enjoy a beautiful life!"
In the local chat channel, everyone was taken aback by Bathing City’s recruitment advertisement.
Such a refreshingly unique recruitment style, it was the first time they had seen it.
At this moment, a survivor named Wei coughed twice in the local channel.
Wei said somewhat helplessly, "Sorry everyone, that’s our Bathing City leader. He occasionally makes mistakes like this, please bear with him."
"Let me translate for you, he means that we have over four hundred survivors above level fifteen in Bathing City, with a vast territory.
"We also have twenty-three Arrow Towers, and seventeen Catapults, with formidable defensive capabilities!"
"Not long ago, we repelled a considerable wave of Blood Tide Monster attacks."
"If you are willing to join us, you can sign the Lord Contract with us, and our Bathing City will provide shelter for you and your relatives."
Upon hearing Wei’s explanation, the survivors in this area paused for a moment.
When they heard that the Bathing City team had over a dozen Catapults and more than twenty Arrow Towers, they were even more amazed.
After all, at this stage, having so many territorial structures not only showcased their strength but also indicated the security of Bathing City’s territory.
For a while, many people’s eyes were filled with longing.
However, just then, Wei continued to speak.
"Here, I’d like to remind everyone what signing a Lord Contract means."
"It means you have to unify your resources and submit them to Bathing City, including your territory."
"Additionally, 40% of future resources will also belong to us, and we will make a unified allocation as necessary."
"After all, to resist those Blood Tide Monsters, we can only build more Catapults and other structures."
"As for how to choose, whether you’re willing or not, it’s up to you."
After listening to Wei’s explanation, everyone fell into silence.
This condition couldn’t be considered unreasonable.
Signing a Lord Contract is akin to signing a life contract.
But the other party clearly stated that they needed the resources to build more territorial structures.
At this time, survivors who lacked confidence in resisting the Blood Tide Monsters began to be tempted.
As previously mentioned.
Although signing a Lord Contract is akin to losing freedom.
But compared to life, it’s insignificant.
For a while, many survivors moved closer to the territory of Bathing City.
Han Xing took a look.
The location of Bathing City is not far from them; at full speed, it would only take twenty minutes.
However, with their strength, there’s no need to join another team.
At this time, Shen Yun couldn’t help but say, "I didn’t expect someone to know how to use this opportunity to recruit so soon, and in the form of signing a Lord Contract."
"If they really manage to execute this model, Bathing City’s size could double in a short time."
Cheng Jianyong asked in confusion, "Xiaoyunzi, what use is it if these teams grow bigger?"
"Don’t they also have to spend resources and effort to protect these survivors and their families?"
Shen Yun explained, "The initial investment is only temporary."
"You have to understand, us humans from Blue Star, whether male, female, young, or old, all have panels, and can level up by fighting monsters."
"Bathing City is currently accepting these relatives and is providing shelter under those conditions."
"Once the crisis is over and these relatives slowly develop, as their levels rise, they can continuously create value for them."
Everyone paused for a moment, only remembering after Shen Yun’s reminder.
Those people who entered this world in the second wave now seem weak because they haven’t yet developed.

chapters.title: Chapter 174 - 145: Crushing the Competition (Part 2)
paragraphs: Once their levels catch up, they can also engage in battle.
In the future, with so many people contributing to a team and handing over 40% of their resource gains from battles, even if it’s only for a year or two, that would be a significant number.
At this point, Cheng Jianyong asked, "By the way, didn’t Brother Xing say he wanted to build a city? Should we also recruit a batch of people?"
Everyone looked at Han Xing.
Han Xing shook his head straight away.
"No need, my development path is different from theirs. I don’t need to recruit a lot of people to collect plenty of resources."
Hearing Han Xing’s response, Shen Yun was also a bit stunned.
Indeed, Han Xing’s tactics are far beyond their imagination.
Being able to gather such a vast amount of resources early on is proof of his strength.
Cheng Jianyong also nodded and didn’t mention it again.
The Sky Island continued to move forward.
A few minutes later.
Han Xing’s expression suddenly tensed, and he swiftly drew his weapon.
Because in front of them,
a small wave of Blood Tide Monsters appeared, numbering around two or three hundred.
At this moment, these Blood Tide Monsters were attacking a survivor’s Sky Island.
The area of that Sky Island wasn’t very large, only a few thousand square meters.
Han Xing’s current vision was excellent; he could see the battle on that Sky Island from several kilometers away.
On the open ground, there were hundreds of corpses, some human, some of the monsters.
At this point, only seven or eight survivors remained on that territory, surrounding a Lord’s Cottage and engaging in the final defensive battle.
However, their eyes revealed a deep despair and fear.
Most of their companions were dead, and the Lord’s Cottage’s defense value was draining away like water.
It seemed they were about to be overrun.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang both looked at Han Xing.
Everyone knew that Han Xing wasn’t the type to meddle in others’ affairs unnecessarily.
But to watch those people die with open eyes, it was still a bit hard to bear.
Zhang Lianmeng tentatively asked, "Brother Xing... Brother Xing, can we save them?"
After she spoke, everyone turned to Han Xing, seemingly waiting for his decision.
Han Xing nodded, "We can."
Seeing him agree, not only Zhang Lianmeng but everyone else also breathed a sigh of relief.
In fact, even if they didn’t say anything, Han Xing would have intervened.
This wasn’t about being a Saint.
Because for him, killing a few hundred mutated monsters was just a matter of convenience, at most a bit wasteful with the giant crossbow arrows.
Sparing others when it didn’t harm his interests was a simple matter.
Moreover, there’s the Battle Merit Store now.
Killing these monsters could earn him battle merits to exchange for rewards. Why not?
The next moment, he controlled hundreds of siege crossbow arrow launchers on the territory interface.
Five hundred giant crossbow arrows shot in a round.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The sound of the arrows slicing through the air rang continuously.
Two to three hundred mutated monsters had tightly surrounded that Lord’s Cottage.
Suddenly, these monsters felt a powerful wind from behind.
Before they could react,
the arrow rain formed by the giant crossbow arrows had already shot through.
Thud! Thud! Thud!
The mutated monsters were pierced through, dying on the spot.
In one wave, at least more than two hundred mutated monsters were killed.
The injured mutated monsters panicked and flew towards the sky,
The remaining survivors in the Lord’s Cottage looked dazed, seemingly not understanding why these monsters suddenly died.
When they saw the massive island in the distance, they couldn’t help being overjoyed.
They realized that someone came to save them!
At this moment, Han Xing also received a system notification.
[Killed Blood Tide Monsters*243, gained 257 Battle Merit points.]
Over two hundred battle merits, not bad.
The few rescued survivors were full of excitement, seemingly wanting to speak with Han Xing.
The Sky Island slowly approached them.
But Han Xing was in a bit of a hurry, just waved his hand at them as a greeting.
Then he directly controlled the Sky Island to move forward.
Leaving the survivors looking at each other in bewilderment.
At this point, a male swordsman, slightly surprised, said, "He just left... didn’t even give us a chance to thank him."
The others were equally puzzled.
"Maybe this expert doesn’t want to be too high-profile, or maybe they don’t care if we thank them," said a male knight beside him.
Everyone smiled wryly and shook their heads.
But anyway, they were alive.
At this point, they curiously watched Han Xing’s enormous Sky Island gradually depart, saying in shock,
"It’s amazing, it’s the first time I’ve seen such a massive Sky Island, with dozens of layers up and down."
"Compared to his Sky Island, ours is just a few broken plots of land!"
Other survivors also sighed, "Yeah, not only is this Sky Island well-constructed, I think I even saw a city on it..."
"I saw it too, that city had numerous red catapults and several hundred giant crossbow arrows lined things nearly filling the walls!"
After saying this, a collective gasp of surprise could be heard.
Knowing that at the current stage.
Even a big group like Bathing City only had a dozen catapults.
And hundreds of catapults, plus more giant crossbow arrow launchers, is self-explanatory.
"It’s terrifying... I really don’t know where this great figure sprang from!"
Everyone was filled with amazement and confusion.
Not paying attention to these people’s speculation.
Han Xing’s Sky Island continued moving.
Along the way, Han Xing also encountered a few instances of minor Blood Tide Monster attacks on survivors.
Han Xing would conveniently deal with these monsters too.
Before long, many people in this area received the news.
That nearby, there was a massive Sky Island, and on it were numerous powerful attack devices, rescuing those survivors in distress.
And those survivors fighting against Blood Tide Monsters suddenly saw a gleam of hope!
After another half hour.
Han Xing also conveniently rescued several survivors.
However, when they were about ten kilometers away from the coordinates given by Wen Xinling,
At this time, on Jiang Heng’s territory.
A few despondent survivors stood scattered around.
Wen Xinling, Jiang Heng, and several other survivors stood on the territory in disarray.
They didn’t know that Wen Xinling had contacted Cheng Jianyong.
At this moment, Jiang Heng was looking pale at his status bar, with four layers of the Blood Curse.
A system prompt said that in half an hour, he would undergo a mutation.
Never would he have imagined,
that two hours ago, he was still the proud leader of the ’Jiangmen’ group.
Summoning others with just a call.
One Blood Tide Monster attack nearly wiped out everything he painstakingly accumulated, and his team was almost completely wiped out.
After enormous sacrifices, he barely survived, only for the system to inform him that he had already been cursed with blood and didn’t have long to live.
Jiang Heng stared blankly at his wounds, then looked at Wen Xinling’s numb face beside him.
He suddenly asked, "Do you have the Blood Curse?"
Wen Xinling looked at him blankly, then shook her head after a moment.
But Jiang Heng noticed that this woman looked at him with resentment and anger in her eyes.
This made him furious on the spot.
He grabbed a fistful of Wen Xinling’s hair, scolding, "You stupid woman! Who allowed you to look at me like that?"
Wen Xinling remained defiant, as her eyes glared back at him.
If it weren’t for him tricking her here, her father wouldn’t have died.
In her heart, Wen Xinling hated Jiang Heng.
Jiang Heng saw Wen Xinling’s stubbornness and was filled with rage.
He grabbed her hair, yelling, "You wretch! Who gave you the right to look at me like that?"
Wen Xinling continued to glare at him defiantly, her loathing evident.
All because this man deceived her and got her father killed,
Wen Xinling was seething with hatred for Jiang Heng.
Jiang Heng saw the defiance in Wen Xinling’s eyes and was beside himself with rage.
He grabbed her by the hair, cursing, "Wretched woman! Who gave you the right to look at me like that?"
Wen Xinling still looked at him defiantly, chest tight with anger.
Just then, the sky was filled again with the returning Blood Tide Monsters.
When they saw the few scattered survivors on Jiang Heng’s territory.
Thousands of Blood Tide Monsters suddenly rushed in and swarmed over.
Before anyone could react, all the survivors on the Sky Island were engulfed!
Wen Xinling, Jiang Heng, and the others didn’t stand a chance, and were gone!
The end.

chapters.title: Chapter 175 - 146: Taking the Initiative!
paragraphs: From afar, everyone saw the scene of the territory being devoured by Blood Tide monsters.
Cheng Jianyong stood there dumbfounded for a moment, a hint of sorrow flashing in his eyes.
As the Blood Tide receded.
The Sky Island collapsed into fragments in the air.
Everyone looked at Cheng Jianyong.
A moment later, they heard him sigh and say, "Let’s go, Brother Xing."
Han Xing glanced at him and nodded.
Then he continued to steer the Sky Island forward.
On the way.
Han Xing looked at everyone and said, "There’s still time; we don’t know when those Blood Tide monsters will erupt again on a large scale."
"Let’s take this opportunity to earn more battle merits at night and explore any monster sky islands we encounter on the way."
Everyone nodded, having no objections to Han Xing’s decision.
Moreover, they indeed needed to seize the time to enhance their strength.
Under the Blood Moon.
A massive Sky Island advanced at a steady pace.
In the sky, mutated monsters could occasionally be seen flying in groups.
But compared to the initial outbreak, their numbers were far fewer.
Han Xing didn’t know the reason.
He only knew that these monsters were essentially piles of battle merits in his eyes.
They could be exchanged for Golden Armor, Moon Armor Puppets, and rewards from various grade chests!
So his enthusiasm for killing these Blood Tide monsters remained high.
Along the way, when he saw monster hordes, he would either bombard them with catapults or unleash a volley of siege crossbow arrows.
At the same time.
His battle merits also began to grow at a terrifying speed.
[Blood Tide mutation (Ordinary Level) killed*473, Blood Tide mutation (Elite Level) killed*3, gained battle merits 503...]
[Blood Tide mutation (Ordinary Level) killed*512, Blood Tide mutation (Elite Level) killed*7, Blood Tide mutation (Leader Level) killed*1, gained battle merits 692...]
At this stage, the levels of these Blood Tide monsters weren’t very high.
In just a single round, at least hundreds of monsters would die.
In less than an hour, Han Xing’s combat merit points increased by more than five thousand.
Unfortunately, compared to the first wave’s tens of thousands of Blood Tide monsters raiding him, this growth rate was much slower.
But compared to others, Han Xing’s rate of gaining battle merits was still like a rocket!
However, because the battle merit leaderboard update wasn’t complete, the rankings couldn’t be seen.
Otherwise, based on the number of monsters Han Xing had killed, if not first, then at least steady in the top three.
Considering this was the combined leaderboard of the entire human race of Blue Star, involving billions of people.
Being in the top three among them was already incredibly remarkable!
However, all these Blood Tide monsters were killed by Han Xing’s domain buildings, so the battle merits earned all belonged to him.
Yet no one had any objections.
To them, exchanging items in the battle merit store didn’t matter much.
Because the equipment from the chests Han Xing exchanged for was distributed based on need.
As Han Xing advanced triumphantly, hunting the Blood Tide monsters.
Everyone couldn’t help but look at the man on the city wall again.
While billions trembled daily under the threat of Blood Tide monsters.
He already effortlessly mitigated the crisis, actively hunting these monsters!
If these facts were publicized, who knows how many would madly rush here, begging to join Han Xing’s territory.
The Sky Island crushed everything in its path.
At this moment, Han Xing seemed to remember something and suddenly said, "Right, there’s something I need to say."
"Next, if we encounter small-scale Blood Tide monsters, I won’t use those attack devices to kill them.
"I plan to lure these monsters into the territory for us to deal with ourselves."
Shen Yun asked in confusion, "Brother Xing, do you mean we should fight these monsters ourselves?"
Han Xing nodded.
"During the ongoing Blood Tide, we can’t enter the Cloud Secret Realm, and monsters killed by catapults don’t give experience."
"To level up quickly, we have to take action ourselves."
"Moreover, given the vast numbers of Blood Tide monsters, if we can keep up with the pace, the leveling speed won’t be slower than when the Cloud Secret Realm is open."
After a pause, Han Xing continued, "But you don’t need to worry."
"The most troublesome aspect of these Blood Tide monsters is the Blood Curse."
"And I have a large number of Blood Curse Antidotes, which effectively nullify this tactic."
"To us, these monsters are just ordinary monsters."
After hearing Han Xing’s analysis, everyone brightened up.
Indeed, while the Blood Tide was terrifying, it also held great opportunity.
Normally, where could they find so many abundant yet low-level monsters?
Moreover, the five of them had all completed the Second Transformation.
Dealing with these low-level monsters wouldn’t be a challenge at all.
Just as he finished speaking, a considerable wave of monsters was sighted ahead in the night sky, about a thousand or so.
This time, Han Xing didn’t use the catapults for bombardment; instead, he led everyone to the open area below Xingyu City.
Han Xing was preparing to make this their main battlefield.
To prevent those monsters from rushing into Xingyu City and attacking everyone’s relatives during the fight.
Han Xing had them all enter the City Lord’s Mansion.
He also gave orders to the thousands of siege crossbow arrows and hundreds of catapults on the city walls.
Any monster approaching within two hundred meters of Xingyu City should be directly bombarded.
After making these preparations, Han Xing actively withdrew the protective shield.
In the sky.
The horde of blood tide monsters, with twisted limbs, instantly turned their gaze upon Han Xing and his companions, surging forward like a tide.
The silhouettes of the blood tide monsters came closer and closer.
This time, they were prepared to take down this horde on their own!
Despite confidence in their own strength, facing opponents dozens of times their number inevitably brought some pressure.
As the sky filled with monsters appeared above everyone’s heads.
All five drank a Blood Curse Antidote.
The next moment, Han Xing directly said.
"Attack!"
The weapons in the hands of the five erupted with intense light.
First, a patch of blue electricity appeared overhead, then, in the next moment, arcs of lightning poured down in a torrential downpour on the heads of the monsters.
Rumble!
At least two to three hundred monsters were covered by the electric light, convulsing ceaselessly from the strikes.
This skill was a new group attack skill learned by Zhang Lianmeng after her Second Transformation.
Thunder Baptism!
Its effect was to create a massive thundercloud, delivering three waves of destructive strikes to enemies below.
Along with Zhang Lianmeng’s exceedingly high magic damage, these over three hundred monsters were annihilated in an instant.
For a time, the kill feed began to flood.
Su Xiaoyang, on this side, was not to be outdone either.
She suddenly retreated a few steps, then leaped several meters high.
Suspended in the air, her graceful figure actually paused.
The next moment, the bowstring was drawn back.
An arrow gathered with a rich green glow, shooting out vigorously.
In the perplexed gaze of the monster horde, wave after wave of arrows, carrying terrifying penetration, descended again from above.
Crash!
With five continuous waves, again nearly two hundred monsters perished.
This skill was also a new group attack skill acquired by Su Xiaoyang after her Second Transformation.
Sky Arrow Rain.
Beside them, Cheng Jianyong seemed to have recovered from his grief as well.
He slowly raised the Lion Heart Greatsword in his hand.
In the next moment, a beam of light flashed across the distant sky.
Everyone saw, an invisible giant sword fell from the sky, sweeping across the monster horde with momentum to sever all.
[Sky Sword]: Summons a phantom of a sword in the air, dealing 222% damage to enemies, with a maximum attack range of 400 meters.
Swish, swish, swish!
In an instant, dozens more monsters were cut down, severed limbs flew randomly.
The first wave of attacks by the three destroyed hundreds of monsters.
"Oh my! I’m so strong!"
Cheng Jianyong, returned to his former state, exclaimed with excitement.
Although he had killed the fewest monsters, he was more excited than anyone else.
Han Xing and Shen Yun exchanged a smile, accustomed to his delight.
At this time, most of the monster horde had been cleared, but more monsters were still charging towards them.
Shen Yun directly cast two blessings on Han Xing consecutively.
Then he cast Angel’s Shelter on himself, turned, and lifted his shield, ready to single-handedly withstand the charge of the monster horde.
At this moment, with two blessings on him, Han Xing could feel his attributes increasing rapidly.
Then, he directly drew back the bowstring.
A flaming arrow appeared in his right hand.
When Han Xing launched the flaming arrow.
Whoosh—
The next moment, the field of vision was abruptly filled with fiery red.
Boom!
After a fierce explosion sound.
It was as though a missile exploded in front of them, the ears buzzing with a droning sound.
The next moment, a massive mushroom cloud over 60 meters in diameter violently rose!
The surging airwaves made everyone’s hair wildly flutter.
Even the distant Xingyu City felt this impact of the heatwave.
When the flames dissipated, hundreds of charred monster corpses lay on the ground.
Some monster corpses in the explosion were directly vaporized.
Standing at the center of the explosion, Shen Yun turned back, trembling in voice, asked: "Bro... Brother Xing, what skill was that?"
At this moment, Shen Yun’s eyes held a trace of fear.
Because when Han Xing unleashed the skill, Shen Yun was also engulfed in it.
He believed, if not for the system’s feature of ally damage immunity, even he might have perished in that explosion.
Han Xing promptly pasted the Blast Flame Arrow skill information.

[Blast Flame Arrow]: Instantly condenses a mass of Fire Element power, gathers it at the arrowhead, deals explosive damage in a range determined by agility * 0.1 meters, damage coefficient is 233% of attack power, cooldown time is 15 seconds.
This was also the first time he used this skill after his Second Transformation.
Unexpectedly the effect exceeded his expectations greatly.
The main issue was its ridiculously large range of destruction.
Over 60 meters in diameter!

Han Xing’s innate agility was 475 points, after changing two pieces of Golden Equipment, it had already reached 534 points, and further boosted by the Blessing of Honor, it had reached a whopping 657 points!
Hence, resulting in such an exaggerated visual effect.

chapters.title: Chapter 176 - 147: Formidable Combat Power
paragraphs: Watching the terrifying effect caused by the Blast Flame Arrow.
Even Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but comment nearby.
"Wow, isn’t this the Wild Ranger but rather the Nuclear Bomb Arrow Immortal!"
"If Brother Xing’s agility keeps increasing, wouldn’t he destroy a planet with a single arrow?"
Everyone began to realize the terror.
At this moment, Shen Yun reminded, "And don’t forget, Brother Xing’s other skill, ’Fallen Star Arrow Rain,’ is also related to agility."
With this reminder, Cheng Jianyong seemed to recall something and couldn’t help but swallow.
One day in the future, if Han Xing’s agility attribute reaches a terrifying height, it might really be possible to achieve the effect of an arrow-destroying star.
The Wild Ranger profession has really high growth potential and is terrifying!
With the group’s wave of skills, nearly eighty percent of the over a thousand monsters were wiped out.
The remaining one to two hundred Blood Tide Monsters also fled in all directions.
However, under the firepower of the three remote units present, how could they escape?
After these thousands of monsters were all annihilated,
everyone had the same feeling in their hearts.
That is a sense of ease.
Unparalleled ease.
One thousand Blood Tide Monsters were enough to destroy a well-equipped Survivor team of Blood Tide Monsters.
But under the wave of skills from the five, more than half were directly taken down.
Of course, this was also related to the fact that these monsters’ levels weren’t high.
Plus, with Han Xing and the others’ high-quality equipment and their level suppression, it resulted in a direct crush.
The experience from over a thousand monsters caused the experience bar of the five to soar quite a bit.
At this moment, Han Xing noticed a burst of white light rising from Coal Ball nearby.
Han Xing was delighted in his heart.
This little guy has finally reached level 20!
Since pets only gain 80% of Han Xing’s experience value, Coal Ball’s level was always a bit lower than Han Xing’s.
Now, it finally broke through to level 20, becoming a Three-star powerful creature.
However, this time, Coal Ball did not activate a new skill.
The system didn’t give any relevant prompts either.
Although Han Xing felt a bit regretful, he was still content.
After all, Coal Ball was already strong enough now.
The eight currently activated skills were all extraordinary.
In addition, after reaching level 20, Coal Ball’s attribute panel once again skyrocketed.
Han Xing is now level 21, with four pieces of Golden Equipment and one piece of Orange Equipment, barely reaching an agility attribute of 534 points.
And now Coal Ball’s agility attribute has reached 712 points.
What does this mean?
You should know that even in the Battle Merit Store, the Constitution of the Moon Armor Puppet is just reaching 750 points.
That’s a Lord-level creature.
And now Coal Ball’s strongest attribute is comparable to a Lord-level creature of the same level!
Of course, the other attributes can’t compare.
Even Coal Ball’s highest Power just barely broke 400 points.
This kind of development can be said to be an extremely extreme agility-type creature.
After cleaning up the battle spoils.
The Sky Island continued to move forward, looking for other smaller-scale Blood Tide Monsters.
Next, they encountered about two or three waves of monsters, all with numbers ranging from a few hundred to over a thousand.
The group followed the same method, first luring the Blood Tide Monsters to the Sky Island territory and then using a wave of area skills to concentrate fire.
Han Xing’s Blast Flame Arrow had only a 15-second cooldown, with ample damage and a wide range, making it simply a divine skill for clearing monsters.
Although it’s a bit slower than crushing with a Catapult, the group didn’t mind spending a bit more time.
Two hours later, the time had reached late at night.
Han Xing took a soft breath and said, "Alright, everyone has worked hard today, let’s go back and rest."
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded in agreement.
A lot happened today, and battling all night long did make them a little tired.
Han Xing was just about to raise the territory shield,
when he suddenly spotted another wave of Blood Tide Monsters not far ahead.
However, their target wasn’t themselves but a small Sky Island with survivors ahead.
That Sky Island was also not large, barely over ten thousand square meters.
The owner of that territory didn’t seem very strong.
After suffering some casualties, only seven or eight survivors were left, guarding a Lord’s Castle, making their last stand.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang also noticed the disturbance not far away.
Then, they both looked at Han Xing with expectant eyes.
Noticing their expectant gazes, Han Xing nodded.
Since they saw it, they might as well help out.
For them, it wouldn’t take much time at all.
In the next moment, the giant island slowly approached.
When they were still a few kilometers away from that Survivor’s Sky Island, Han Xing directly controlled the giant crossbow arrows and fired them in a volley.
Clatter.
The Blood Tide Monsters surrounding the Lord’s Castle were instantly half-destroyed!
Inside the Lord’s Castle, the female Survivors’ eyes were bewildered.
They looked young, with pure looks, and their eyes carried a bit of fear.
Before they could react, they suddenly saw the scene where hundreds of monsters were directly slain!
At this moment, they realized someone had come to rescue them!
The Blood Tide monsters were suddenly severely damaged, and the remaining monsters immediately flew into the air to escape.
Han Xing brought his four teammates and slowly approached the edge of the territory.
Under normal circumstances, Han Xing wasn’t planning to interact with these people.
He could just leave right after rescuing them.
However, Han Xing happened to notice that the back-up crossbow arrows for the siege crossbow were running low.
This thing, he had made tens of thousands of them before.
He originally thought they’d last for a long time, but due to recent frequent battles, the giant crossbow arrows were also being consumed rapidly.
Although he managed to retrieve some of them.
But more were lost due to missing the target and disappearing into thin air.
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help thinking.
That Thunderbolt Tower, the magic-like defensive building, is much better.
There’s no need for ammunition loading.
Therefore, Han Xing decided to go to the other’s territory to retrieve these hundreds of giant crossbow arrows and dismantle the monster corpses along the way.
After the two Sky Islands approached each other.
Several human figures quickly emerged from the fortress of that territory.
The two groups looked at each other.
Han Xing noticed that most of the survivors were young girls that looked around seventeen or eighteen years old.
Their eyes still carried a pure glint.
If they were on Blue Star, they should be in high school at that age.
But here, they have to be prepared for battle, facing the threat of death.
Luckily, they were not the second batch of survivors entering Sky Island Paradise.
Otherwise, they wouldn’t have had any power to protect themselves at all.
These girls showed some fear when they saw Han Xing.
Due to the overwhelming scene of crossbow arrows showering just now, it left a deep impression on them.
But they also knew that these people were the benefactors who saved their lives.
Among them, a girl with fresh and unique temperament, and exquisite features walked out and said, "Tha...thank you all for the rescue, we are extremely grateful!"
She was wearing a set of silver-white knight armor and was tall.
After speaking, the girl then took the initiative to bow to Han Xing and the others to express her gratitude.
The survivors behind her also bowed to express their thanks.
Han Xing waved his hand, not caring, and casually asked, "No need to be polite."
Then, Han Xing calmly said, "Let me ask a question, can we go to your territory?"
The female knight looked bewildered but quickly responded and hastily said, "Uh... Sure."
Under normal circumstances, survivors who don’t know each other are rarely allowed into one’s territory.
Although she didn’t know what the other party wanted to do in their territory.
But she also knows that if this man really harbors ill intentions toward them, they wouldn’t be able to resist given their strength.
Hearing their response, a smile appeared on Han Xing’s lips.
"Thank you."
The next moment, Han Xing led his teammates into the ravaged territory.
Then, under Han Xing’s guidance, the group started dismantling the mutant corpses, retrieving the giant arrows from them.
The cursed blood from these mutants was material that Han Xing was in great need of.
While the giant arrows were not expensive to produce, making one still takes several seconds.
Han Xing’s crafting interface was occupied for 24 hours with the Curse-Blood Antidote, leaving no time to make other things.
So things like this, where savings can be made, should be saved.
At this point, the girls finally realized.
He wasn’t interested in their territory at all but rather the monster corpses.
Without caring about their mental activities, the group spent only a couple of minutes clearing the corpses of several hundred monsters.
Then, Han Xing said to the group of survivors, "Thanks for cooperating, farewell."
After speaking, he returned to the territory with his companions.
Just as Han Xing was about to navigate the Sky Island away.
The outstandingly tempered female knight hurriedly said, "Please, please wait a moment!"
Han Xing curiously turned his head back.
At this moment, that girl gathered courage and asked, "I wonder, can we join your team?"
Everyone was stunned for a moment.
Including Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, who also looked over.
At this time, the eyes of those girls were full of hopeful gazes.
Han Xing looked at their equipment and level.
Except for the female knight who had a full set of purple equipment, the others wore a mix of blue and purple.
Compared to other survivors, they could only be considered ordinary.
The castle in their territory was probably built by them together.
Of course, Han Xing was not belittling their strength.
To him, a survivor’s help is negligible.
After a moment, Han Xing shook his head and said, "Sorry, our team isn’t recruiting at the moment."
Having said that, Han Xing turned with his team and left.
Upon hearing these words, the girls across couldn’t help showing disappointment.
Watching Han Xing’s back.
The female knight lightly bit her lip, seemingly making a difficult decision, and said, "We can sign a Lord Contract with you! Please, please let us join you."
This time, it was Han Xing who was a bit surprised.
