The Wild Ranger profession has really high growth potential and is terrifying!
With the group’s wave of skills, nearly eighty percent of the over a thousand monsters were wiped out.
The remaining one to two hundred Blood Tide Monsters also fled in all directions.
However, under the firepower of the three remote units present, how could they escape?
After these thousands of monsters were all annihilated,
everyone had the same feeling in their hearts.
That is a sense of ease.
Unparalleled ease.
One thousand Blood Tide Monsters were enough to destroy a well-equipped Survivor team of Blood Tide Monsters.
But under the wave of skills from the five, more than half were directly taken down.
Of course, this was also related to the fact that these monsters’ levels weren’t high.
Plus, with Han Xing and the others’ high-quality equipment and their level suppression, it resulted in a direct crush.
The experience from over a thousand monsters caused the experience bar of the five to soar quite a bit.
At this moment, Han Xing noticed a burst of white light rising from Coal Ball nearby.
Han Xing was delighted in his heart.
This little guy has finally reached level 20!
Since pets only gain 80% of Han Xing’s experience value, Coal Ball’s level was always a bit lower than Han Xing’s.
Now, it finally broke through to level 20, becoming a Three-star powerful creature.
However, this time, Coal Ball did not activate a new skill.
The system didn’t give any relevant prompts either.
Although Han Xing felt a bit regretful, he was still content.
After all, Coal Ball was already strong enough now.
The eight currently activated skills were all extraordinary.
In addition, after reaching level 20, Coal Ball’s attribute panel once again skyrocketed.
Han Xing is now level 21, with four pieces of Golden Equipment and one piece of Orange Equipment, barely reaching an agility attribute of 534 points.
And now Coal Ball’s agility attribute has reached 712 points.
What does this mean?
You should know that even in the Battle Merit Store, the Constitution of the Moon Armor Puppet is just reaching 750 points.
That’s a Lord-level creature.
And now Coal Ball’s strongest attribute is comparable to a Lord-level creature of the same level!
Of course, the other attributes can’t compare.
Even Coal Ball’s highest Power just barely broke 400 points.
This kind of development can be said to be an extremely extreme agility-type creature.
After cleaning up the battle spoils.
The Sky Island continued to move forward, looking for other smaller-scale Blood Tide Monsters.
Next, they encountered about two or three waves of monsters, all with numbers ranging from a few hundred to over a thousand.
The group followed the same method, first luring the Blood Tide Monsters to the Sky Island territory and then using a wave of area skills to concentrate fire.
Han Xing’s Blast Flame Arrow had only a 15-second cooldown, with ample damage and a wide range, making it simply a divine skill for clearing monsters.
Although it’s a bit slower than crushing with a Catapult, the group didn’t mind spending a bit more time.
Two hours later, the time had reached late at night.
Han Xing took a soft breath and said, "Alright, everyone has worked hard today, let’s go back and rest."
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded in agreement.
A lot happened today, and battling all night long did make them a little tired.
Han Xing was just about to raise the territory shield,
when he suddenly spotted another wave of Blood Tide Monsters not far ahead.
However, their target wasn’t themselves but a small Sky Island with survivors ahead.
That Sky Island was also not large, barely over ten thousand square meters.
The owner of that territory didn’t seem very strong.
After suffering some casualties, only seven or eight survivors were left, guarding a Lord’s Castle, making their last stand.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang also noticed the disturbance not far away.
Then, they both looked at Han Xing with expectant eyes.
Noticing their expectant gazes, Han Xing nodded.
Since they saw it, they might as well help out.
For them, it wouldn’t take much time at all.
In the next moment, the giant island slowly approached.
When they were still a few kilometers away from that Survivor’s Sky Island, Han Xing directly controlled the giant crossbow arrows and fired them in a volley.
Clatter.
The Blood Tide Monsters surrounding the Lord’s Castle were instantly half-destroyed!
Inside the Lord’s Castle, the female Survivors’ eyes were bewildered.
They looked young, with pure looks, and their eyes carried a bit of fear.
Before they could react, they suddenly saw the scene where hundreds of monsters were directly slain!
At this moment, they realized someone had come to rescue them!
The Blood Tide monsters were suddenly severely damaged, and the remaining monsters immediately flew into the air to escape.
Han Xing brought his four teammates and slowly approached the edge of the territory.
Under normal circumstances, Han Xing wasn’t planning to interact with these people.
He could just leave right after rescuing them.
However, Han Xing happened to notice that the back-up crossbow arrows for the siege crossbow were running low.
This thing, he had made tens of thousands of them before.
He originally thought they’d last for a long time, but due to recent frequent battles, the giant crossbow arrows were also being consumed rapidly.
Although he managed to retrieve some of them.
But more were lost due to missing the target and disappearing into thin air.
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help thinking.
That Thunderbolt Tower, the magic-like defensive building, is much better.
There’s no need for ammunition loading.
Therefore, Han Xing decided to go to the other’s territory to retrieve these hundreds of giant crossbow arrows and dismantle the monster corpses along the way.
After the two Sky Islands approached each other.
Several human figures quickly emerged from the fortress of that territory.
The two groups looked at each other.
Han Xing noticed that most of the survivors were young girls that looked around seventeen or eighteen years old.
Their eyes still carried a pure glint.
If they were on Blue Star, they should be in high school at that age.
But here, they have to be prepared for battle, facing the threat of death.
Luckily, they were not the second batch of survivors entering Sky Island Paradise.
Otherwise, they wouldn’t have had any power to protect themselves at all.
These girls showed some fear when they saw Han Xing.
Due to the overwhelming scene of crossbow arrows showering just now, it left a deep impression on them.
But they also knew that these people were the benefactors who saved their lives.
Among them, a girl with fresh and unique temperament, and exquisite features walked out and said, "Tha...thank you all for the rescue, we are extremely grateful!"
She was wearing a set of silver-white knight armor and was tall.
After speaking, the girl then took the initiative to bow to Han Xing and the others to express her gratitude.
The survivors behind her also bowed to express their thanks.
Han Xing waved his hand, not caring, and casually asked, "No need to be polite."
Then, Han Xing calmly said, "Let me ask a question, can we go to your territory?"
The female knight looked bewildered but quickly responded and hastily said, "Uh...
Sure."
Under normal circumstances, survivors who don’t know each other are rarely allowed into one’s territory.
Although she didn’t know what the other party wanted to do in their territory.
But she also knows that if this man really harbors ill intentions toward them, they wouldn’t be able to resist given their strength.
Hearing their response, a smile appeared on Han Xing’s lips.
"Thank you."
The next moment, Han Xing led his teammates into the ravaged territory.
Then, under Han Xing’s guidance, the group started dismantling the mutant corpses, retrieving the giant arrows from them.
The cursed blood from these mutants was material that Han Xing was in great need of.
While the giant arrows were not expensive to produce, making one still takes several seconds.
Han Xing’s crafting interface was occupied for 24 hours with the Curse-Blood Antidote, leaving no time to make other things.
So things like this, where savings can be made, should be saved.
At this point, the girls finally realized.
He wasn’t interested in their territory at all but rather the monster corpses.
Without caring about their mental activities, the group spent only a couple of minutes clearing the corpses of several hundred monsters.
Then, Han Xing said to the group of survivors, "Thanks for cooperating, farewell."
After speaking, he returned to the territory with his companions.
Just as Han Xing was about to navigate the Sky Island away.
The outstandingly tempered female knight hurriedly said, "Please, please wait a moment!"
Han Xing curiously turned his head back.
At this moment, that girl gathered courage and asked, "I wonder, can we join your team?"
Everyone was stunned for a moment.
Including Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, who also looked over.
At this time, the eyes of those girls were full of hopeful gazes.
Han Xing looked at their equipment and level.
Except for the female knight who had a full set of purple equipment, the others wore a mix of blue and purple.
Compared to other survivors, they could only be considered ordinary.
The castle in their territory was probably built by them together.
Of course, Han Xing was not belittling their strength.
To him, a survivor’s help is negligible.
After a moment, Han Xing shook his head and said, "Sorry, our team isn’t recruiting at the moment."
Having said that, Han Xing turned with his team and left.
Upon hearing these words, the girls across couldn’t help showing disappointment.
Watching Han Xing’s back.
The female knight lightly bit her lip, seemingly making a difficult decision, and said, "We can sign a Lord Contract with you!
Please, please let us join you."
This time, it was Han Xing who was a bit surprised.

chapters.title: Chapter 177 - 148: Overwhelming Forces
paragraphs: Hearing that these people wanted to sign a Lord contract with him.
Han Xing turned around and asked in confusion, "Do you know what it means to sign a Lord contract?"
Signing a Lord contract is equivalent to signing an indenture, working for the Lord.
Not only do they have to give 40% of their resources to the Lord, but their warehouse will also be open to the Lord, and they must stand up together to resist when there is danger in the territory.
Although Han Xing didn’t care for their small amount of resources.
But in this way, for at least a year, they can’t escape surviving in Han Xing’s territory.
The female knight with an extraordinary temperament nodded heavily.
Her clear eyes carrying a hint of earnestness, excitedly said, "I understand, but we do not regret it!"

Then, with a bitter smile on her face, she said, "We are all students from Xinyang Academy, and this experience made us realize that it’s really hard for ordinary people like us to survive in this world."
"So instead of continuing to struggle, it is better to choose to join a powerful force."
"Even if it means giving up resources, it’s no big deal."
"We will also help fight when the territory faces danger!"
After the female knight finished speaking, her team members also nodded one after another.
Han Xing’s eyes showed a thoughtful look.
From the beginning, he never intended to recruit other survivors into his territory.
The complexity of human hearts made him realize that people are the hardest to manage.
Even with a Lord contract, it’s not like they will be 100% obedient to you.
He would rather use the Lord Contract Scroll to recruit the natives of this world.
At least that way, he could see their loyalty.
The female knight saw Han Xing hesitating and quickly pressed her advantage, saying, "Benefactor, if you don’t need us to fight, we can also help with other tasks."
"Washing clothes, cooking, farming, fertilizing, even cleaning the territory, we can do it all!"
Seeing their sincere attitude, Zhang Lianmeng seemed to have softened a bit.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng leaned over and said, "Brother Xing, why not let them join us?
Han Xing was stunned for a moment; he originally wanted to refuse, but listening to Zhang Lianmeng, he began to reassess these survivors in front of him.
Because previously, he had the idea of using the Lord Contract Scroll to recruit a few natives to help Zhang Lianmeng manage his territory.
With such a big territory, just Su Xiaoyang and Zhang Lianmeng alone, they really had their hands full.
If they were to help manage according to the female knight’s conditions.
It indeed seemed quite good?
After all, there weren’t many of them.
And there are still many vacant houses in his territory.
Splitting them up into a couple of rooms would be enough for them to live in.
Han Xing pondered for a moment and nodded.
Seeing this, the female knight’s brows immediately relaxed.
She showed a genuine smile, her whole being exuding a pure aura.
In terms of looks, she was only slightly inferior to Su Xiaoyang and Zhang Lianmeng, and walking down the street, she would also be the focus of attention.
The female knight said happily, "Thank you! Thank you!"
"Can we sign the Lord contract now?"
Her tone was tense but carried a hint of expectation.
Han Xing nodded, "Yes."
Then, he initiated the contract with them.
These people quickly signed.
The system prompt appeared.
[Survivor Lanlan has signed a Lord contract with you, your territory population +1.]
[Survivor Sunflower Seeds has signed a Lord contract with you, your territory population +1.]
It was at this time Han Xing also realized that the female knight’s virtual name was Lanlan.
After the contract was completed.
The female knight named Lanlan said excitedly, "Thank you, from now on, you’re our Lord!
Hearing the term used by the other party, Han Xing was a bit surprised.
He was about to suggest they use another term.
At this time, the other girls also said in unison, "Thank you, Lord!"
Han Xing waved his hand, after all, it’s just a term, they can call him whatever they wish.
Then, Han Xing signaled Zhang Lianmeng with his eyes.
Zhang Lianmeng nodded gently and gracefully walked over to the group of young girls.
"Come on, little sisters, I’ll take you into the city and find you a place to stay."
Those young girls, upon seeing Zhang Lianmeng, had their eyes shine with admiration and exclaimed in surprise, "Wow! Such a beautiful sister!"
"Are you the Lord’s lover? So beautiful, truly a perfect match!"
Zhang Lianmeng’s face turned red instantly, and she waved her hand, "No... not a lover..."
However, this group of young girls seemed not to hear her denial and continued their praises.
"Yes, yes, this beautiful sister is not only gorgeous but kind-hearted, too. Thanks to her speaking up, our Lord accepted us."
"And such a perfect figure, it’s something I don’t even dare to dream of having..."
"So envious, boohoo..."
Zhang Lianmeng was a bit embarrassed by their compliments and shyly lowered her head.
After Zhang Lianmeng took them into the territory.
According to the contract.
Everything of these survivors belonged to Han Xing, including all the territory resources.
Once the one-year contract period ends, if they want to leave, by then, Han Xing will only return to them a piece of core territory.
In front of everyone.
Han Xing disassembled their territory into small blocks and merged them into his own territory.
As for the castle they had built, Han Xing moved it to an open space outside the Lord’s Mansion.

chapters.title: Chapter 178 - 148: Overwhelming Forces
paragraphs: Lanlan and her classmates watched as the foundation they had struggled for a month to build was destroyed in an instant.
They felt a sense of loss in their hearts.
But soon, they swept these emotions aside.
Because they had arrived in Xingyu City!
Under the guidance of Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, the eyes of these young girls sparkled with delight!
It was the look girls have when they see something they love.
The sight of those rows of beautiful, artistically styled buildings instantly captured the hearts of these young girls.
The young girls opened their mouths wide in excitement.
"Oh my... what beautiful houses!"
"Are we going to live in such a beautiful little town from now on?"
They looked at Zhang Lianmeng in disbelief.
Zhang Lianmeng smiled lightly and nodded.
Upon receiving a positive response, the young girls could barely contain their exuberant cheers.
"That’s great! Thank you, beautiful sister!"
"The Lord is amazing to have built such a beautiful city!"
"Yes, yes, this is the life I’ve always dreamed of!"
They kept expressing their amazement, very satisfied with Xingyu City.
In their hearts, their admiration for the seemingly stern and mysterious Lord increased several levels.
At this time, Zhang Lianmeng led them to two small villa buildings.
"Brother Xing asked me to arrange accommodations for you, so you can live here from now on."
"I’ve already granted you access to these two buildings."
"There are many rooms inside, if it’s not enough, I can open up one more building for you."
The small group of girls looked at Zhang Lianmeng with gratitude and said, "It’s enough, it’s enough. Thank you, Lord, and thank you, Lady of the Lord."
Zhang Lianmeng quickly stopped them, "No... don’t call me that!"
After speaking, she glanced sideways at Su Xiaoyang.
But Su Xiaoyang seemed unreactive.
Because she suffered from severe social anxiety, directly interacting with so many strangers already had her muscles tense.
If not for Zhang Lianmeng’s encouragement, Su Xiaoyang would have fled long ago due to embarrassment.
At that moment, Lanlan seemed to notice Zhang Lianmeng’s gaze and she also saw Su Xiaoyang hiding behind Zhang Lianmeng.
Immediately, Lanlan’s eyes brightened again, "Wow, this beautiful sister is also stunning!"
Upon hearing Lanlan speak, the nearby girls turned to look, their eyes also lighting up!
"Another beauty, so tall and fair!"
"This beautiful sister has captivated my heart."
"Ohhh, she’s how I dream of looking like."
Under the sweet-talking barrage from these young girls, both Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang found it hard to cope.
While Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang were settling the young girls.
In the Land of the Abandoned Gods, some unknown corners.
Blood began to surge in large quantities from the Blood Altar.
Gurgle... gurgle...
Vast quantities of blood gushed out from the altar, sprinkling across the sky, forming a blood-red waterfall.
In these blood currents, there seemed to be some mysterious power embedded.
Countless creatures continuously emerged from it.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
The wings of these creatures flapped, gathering near the Blood Altar, greedily absorbing the surrounding blood energy.
As time passed, these creatures’ bodies gradually grew larger.
If there were other survivors present, they’d be shocked to find the Attribute Panels of these creatures growing at a terrifying speed!
Initially, most monsters were around Level 15 or 16, but within just a few hours, their levels had already reached 17 or 18!
At this rate, breaking through Level 20 to become Three-star monsters is just a matter of days!
The speed at which these Blood Tide Monsters grow stronger far exceeds that of the survivors.
Meanwhile, more grotesque creatures continued to crawl out of the Blood Altar, their numbers increasing steadily.
Covering the sky and sun, numbering in the millions!
And this is only the number of monsters from one Blood Altar.
Throughout the Land of the Abandoned Gods, who knows how many altars like this are continuously supplying monsters.
They seemed to be waiting for something, not moving immediately.
Just then, from one altar, thousands of blood-red tentacles suddenly emerged, writhing freely in the air.
Then, a row of eerie white teeth gradually surfaced from the Blood Pool.
Whoosh!
As the torrential blood spray surged forth, a colossal figure emerged from the pool.
Its body exceeded a hundred meters, resembling an octopus, but with a gigantic mouth atop its head.
"Hiss! Hiss!"
After a series of sharp sounds.
At this moment, the surrounding Blood Tide Monsters voluntarily cleared a large area.
This octopus-like mutated creature stood amidst the swarm, gazing far into unknown regions ahead.
The next day.
Han Xing and the others got up early and hurriedly checked the area around their territory.
Luckily, they hadn’t encountered any Blood Tide Monsters’ attacks last night.
At this moment, Han Xing stood in the territory, speaking with doubt, "This is strange, how come there wasn’t a wave of Blood Tide Monsters last night’s late hours."
Cheng Jianyong was equally puzzled, "Indeed, I stayed up all night expecting an attack, but until dawn, not a single hair! It nearly scared me out of my wits.
"Moreover, not even in the chat channel did I hear about any survivors being attacked by Blood Tide Monsters."
"Almost as if those monsters all paused their actions in unison."
After listening to Cheng Jianyong’s description, everyone felt very puzzled.
But they also knew, the Blood Tide that brewed for so long couldn’t possibly end here!
Last night.
After yesterday’s Blood Tide Burst event, many learned their lesson and began forming alliances with nearby teams.
Among them, some took on the Lord Contract model, others the cooperation model.
The former requires sufficiently strong abilities to make other survivors willingly give up their territories and sign a contract with you to become a vassal.
The latter involves combining territories when everyone’s strength is similar, to jointly resist the Blood Tide Monster invasion.
More and more Sky Islands merged, forming a massive territory.
Just then, a system notification appeared.
"Survivors from Blue Star, congratulations on getting through the initial stage of the Blood Tide."
"But, please do not be complacent, because an even greater crisis is brewing..."
"As time passes, Blood Tide Monsters will become even stronger, even more terrifying!"
"Under the Blood Tide, they won’t give you any breathing space, all survivors must brace for battle at any moment..."
After the notification ended, Han Xing and others felt a sense of impending doom.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong suddenly exclaimed, "They’re coming! So many monsters!"
His voice trembled somewhat, and among it, everyone could hear a hint of fear.
When their gaze turned towards the sky.
In the distance, a massive blood cloud was flying over, black and overwhelming.
That blood cloud was enormous.
Covering the sky and sun, it seemed infinite!
They realized this blood cloud was actually formed by a vast army of Blood Tide Monsters.
However, this quantity far exceeded everyone’s expectations!
It was too much...
Previously, just tens of thousands of monsters attacking had them scrambling.
But this time, just a glance, and there were well over a million!
Han Xing took a deep breath and quickly said, "Everyone, prepare for battle!"
With those words, all attack buildings in the territory switched to battle mode!
The relatives of Shen Yun and others, having had prior experience, didn’t need Han Xing’s orders to hide within Xingyu City.
The newly joined young girls now watched the sky with pale faces, their bodies trembling.
At the same time.
In this area, more survivors on Sky Islands also noticed the enormous blood cloud on the horizon.
Their target was clearly all survivors within hundreds of kilometers!

If there were other survivors present, they’d be shocked to find the Attribute Panels of these creatures growing at a terrifying speed!
Initially, most monsters were around Level 15 or 16, but within just a few hours, their levels had already reached 17 or 18!
At this rate, breaking through Level 20 to become Three-star monsters is just a matter of days!
The speed at which these Blood Tide Monsters grow stronger far exceeds that of the survivors.
Meanwhile, more grotesque creatures continued to crawl out of the Blood Altar, their numbers increasing steadily.
Covering the sky and sun, numbering in the millions!
And this is only the number of monsters from one Blood Altar.
Throughout the Land of the Abandoned Gods, who knows how many altars like this are continuously supplying monsters.
They seemed to be waiting for something, not moving immediately.
Just then, from one altar, thousands of blood-red tentacles suddenly emerged, writhing freely in the air.
Then, a row of eerie white teeth gradually surfaced from the Blood Pool.
Whoosh!
As the torrential blood spray surged forth, a colossal figure emerged from the pool.
Its body exceeded a hundred meters, resembling an octopus, but with a gigantic mouth atop its head.
"Hiss!
Hiss!"
After a series of sharp sounds.
At this moment, the surrounding Blood Tide Monsters voluntarily cleared a large area.
This octopus-like mutated creature stood amidst the swarm, gazing far into unknown regions ahead.
The next day.
Han Xing and the others got up early and hurriedly checked the area around their territory.
Luckily, they hadn’t encountered any Blood Tide Monsters’ attacks last night.
At this moment, Han Xing stood in the territory, speaking with doubt, "This is strange, how come there wasn’t a wave of Blood Tide Monsters last night’s late hours."
Cheng Jianyong was equally puzzled, "Indeed, I stayed up all night expecting an attack, but until dawn, not a single hair!
It nearly scared me out of my wits.
"Moreover, not even in the chat channel did I hear about any survivors being attacked by Blood Tide Monsters."
"Almost as if those monsters all paused their actions in unison."
After listening to Cheng Jianyong’s description, everyone felt very puzzled.
But they also knew, the Blood Tide that brewed for so long couldn’t possibly end here!
Last night.
After yesterday’s Blood Tide Burst event, many learned their lesson and began forming alliances with nearby teams.
Among them, some took on the Lord Contract model, others the cooperation model.
The former requires sufficiently strong abilities to make other survivors willingly give up their territories and sign a contract with you to become a vassal.
The latter involves combining territories when everyone’s strength is similar, to jointly resist the Blood Tide Monster invasion.
More and more Sky Islands merged, forming a massive territory.
Just then, a system notification appeared.
"Survivors from Blue Star, congratulations on getting through the initial stage of the Blood Tide."
"But, please do not be complacent, because an even greater crisis is brewing..."
"As time passes, Blood Tide Monsters will become even stronger, even more terrifying!"
"Under the Blood Tide, they won’t give you any breathing space, all survivors must brace for battle at any moment..."
After the notification ended, Han Xing and others felt a sense of impending doom.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong suddenly exclaimed, "They’re coming!
So many monsters!"
His voice trembled somewhat, and among it, everyone could hear a hint of fear.
When their gaze turned towards the sky.
In the distance, a massive blood cloud was flying over, black and overwhelming.
That blood cloud was enormous.
Covering the sky and sun, it seemed infinite!
They realized this blood cloud was actually formed by a vast army of Blood Tide Monsters.
However, this quantity far exceeded everyone’s expectations!
It was too much...
Previously, just tens of thousands of monsters attacking had them scrambling.
But this time, just a glance, and there were well over a million!
Han Xing took a deep breath and quickly said, "Everyone, prepare for battle!"
With those words, all attack buildings in the territory switched to battle mode!
The relatives of Shen Yun and others, having had prior experience, didn’t need Han Xing’s orders to hide within Xingyu City.
The newly joined young girls now watched the sky with pale faces, their bodies trembling.
At the same time.
In this area, more survivors on Sky Islands also noticed the enormous blood cloud on the horizon.
Their target was clearly all survivors within hundreds of kilometers!

chapters.title: Chapter 179 - 149: Xingyu City, Unyielding
paragraphs: At this moment, Lanlan and the other girls were still in a state of confusion.
Zhang Lianmeng quickly reminded, "You should go to the City Lord’s Mansion. Do not come out until the battle is over!"
The group of girls hesitated, casting a glance at the towering City Lord’s Mansion.
Then, the female knight named Lanlan mustered up the courage and said, "Don’t we need to help here?"
"We...we can help fight too..."
Although well-intentioned,
everyone could hear that she had no confidence in her voice.
Han Xing said directly, "We don’t need you to fight here, go quickly."
Hearing this, Lanlan decisively made up her mind and pulled her friends to rush toward the Lord’s Mansion.
At this moment.
The large blood-colored clouds in the sky were rapidly approaching.
But fortunately, they were not all heading their way.
Han Xing saw that from the Blood Tide army, a small group of monsters kept breaking off, swooping down.
Even a small group consisted of thousands or even tens of thousands of monsters!
They seemed to have discovered other Survivor Sky Islands, splitting their forces, then launching attacks on them.
Those Sky Islands were dozens of kilometers away from Han Xing.
Everywhere in sight, large-scale battles were erupting!
Han Xing knew it would soon be their turn!
Compared to the speed of the monster horde, the Sky Island’s advancement was still lagging!
If they fled now, they would soon be overtaken by the monsters.
Han Xing simply stood still, preparing to confront the monster onslaught head-on.
Facing such a terrifying number of monsters, even Han Xing couldn’t help but clench his fists.
At this moment, another system notification popped up.
[Your territory building, Flamethrower Catapult, has been constructed successfully...]
[Your territory building, Siege Crossbow Arrow Launcher Platform, has been constructed successfully...]
After the battle ended last night, Han Xing rushed to make a batch of catapults and siege crossbow arrows.
Although the number was not large, there were nearly a hundred combined.
Although there were no powerful magic buildings like the Thunderbolt Tower, these catapults still provided Han Xing with a lot of security.
As the monster tide approached, Han Xing sharply lifted his eyes.
"Come on, it’s a good time to test the firepower of my attack buildings."
"Let me see where their limits lie!"
Once he finished speaking, the sky above went completely dark.
Numerous Blood Tide Monsters also seemed to notice the gigantic Sky Island below.
The next moment.
A large area of blood-colored clouds broke off from the sky full of red blood clouds.
Compared to the mutated army other survivors faced, the number of monsters Han Xing faced was at least tenfold!
Hundreds of thousands of blood-colored monsters formed a huge torrent, suddenly rushing toward Han Xing!
The scene was like a small boat encountering a tornado storm on the sea, with the risk of capsizing at any moment.
On the territory.
Lanlan and others were already scared pale, the group of girls huddled together, trying to keep warm, but their bodies kept trembling.
Yesterday, they had faced an attack by more than a thousand Blood Tide Monsters, which nearly wiped them out.
If Han Xing hadn’t arrived in time, they might have already died in those monsters’ mouths!
But now, the monsters Han Xing had to face were almost a hundred times more!
The overwhelming numbers were nearly despair-inducing.
Relatives were also shaking in fear.
But they could only pray in their hearts that Han Xing and others could withstand this wave of monster tide attack.
Meanwhile.
The nearest batch of monsters was less than five kilometers from Han Xing’s territory.
One more kilometer and they would be within the catapult’s range!
Han Xing restrained his restless hands, continuing to wait.
meters...
meters...
meters...
The monsters at the forefront had completely entered the range of these attack buildings.
Han Xing still waited.
meters...
meters...
At this time, the entire sky was filled with monsters in their line of sight.
Even the team members who had one hundred percent trust in Han Xing felt the heavy pressure.
And at this moment.
Han Xing moved.
His gaze focused.
In the next moment.
One-third of the siege crossbow arrows, catapults, and Thunderbolt Towers.
At this moment, they all unleashed their destructive attacks.
Swish!
Boom!
Crackle... crackle!
Over a hundred burning fireballs, along with hundreds of giant crossbow arrows shot out.
At the same time, eight Thunderbolt Towers emitted blinding blue radiance!
These attacks landed in the monster group, immediately triggering earth-shattering explosions!
Rumble!
Each fireball exploded as if the sky was shattered by this wave of attacks!
The siege crossbow arrows howled, piercing through countless mutated monsters’ bodies.
Thunder and lightning.
The heavens’ punishment from the Thunderbolt Towers descended!
The ground shook violently under everyone’s feet, and waves of heat rolled in.
This wave alone buried at least thousands of monsters under the terrifying barrage.
Meanwhile, Han Xing was bombarded with system prompts.
[You have slain Blood Tide Mutant*4325, earned Battle Merit*5432...]
[You have slain Blood Tide Mutant*3647, earned Battle Merit*4367...]
The first wave of attack instantly claimed over eight thousand Blood Tide monster lives!
The nearby region was almost cleared of monsters by this concentrated firepower!
Inside Xingyu City, the group of young girls led by Lanlan were already dumbfounded.
What a terrifying tactic!
Such heart-stopping firepower intensity!
That young man stood on the city wall, waved his large hand, and nearly tens of thousands of monsters died instantly!
"What terrifying firepower!"
"The Lord... is amazing!"
This group of young girls watched Han Xing’s back with excitement.
However, their excitement didn’t last long.
The next moment, endless Blood Tide Monsters surged in, once again filling the area that had just been cleared.
The frightening numbers almost made everyone suffocate.
At this moment, the catapults and siege crossbow arrows from the first attack wave were still in a loading state.
However, Han Xing was well prepared.
This is also why he only utilized one-third of the attack buildings.
It was to stagger them and gain recovery time.
At the instant the second wave of monsters charged in.
The Thunderbolt Tower, Flamethrower Catapult, and siege crossbow arrows were activated again.
Rumble!
It was still the same heart-stopping scene.
Thousands of monsters perished once more.
Yet despairingly.
The third wave of Blood Tide Monsters attacked again.
They clawed and roared in the air, seemingly determined not to give up until Han Xing’s territory was conquered!
However, Han Xing wasn’t indulging them.
The third wave of catapults and engineering crossbow arrows launched once more.
At this moment, all Thunderbolt Towers entered a charging state.
Boom! Rumble!
Constant loud noises, dismembered bodies flying everywhere!
The approaching monsters were almost completely annihilated again.
Nonetheless, a few stray monsters still rushed close to Han Xing’s territory, attacking his shield.
Buzz! Buzz!
The Intermediate Spiritual Shield, after being enhanced by the City Lord’s Mansion, had a defense value of 1200.
But even so, it was depleting rapidly.
At this time, all attack devices were in a loading state.
The Thunderbolt Towers required nearly twenty seconds of charging time,
even though Han Xing had calculated the recovery time of these territorial buildings.
But the monsters’ onslaught was too fierce.
Even with three waves attacking in turn, there was still a one- or two-second gap!
At this moment, everyone exchanged heavy looks.
With Han Xing’s permission, they rushed onto the territory, beginning to attack those nearing monsters.
Han Xing’s and Su Xiaoyang’s arrows were the sharpest.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
With just a few arrows, the mutated monsters attacking the shield were dealt with.
But just then.
Even more Blood Tide Monsters charged into an even closer area.
The spectators’ hearts tightened unwittingly.
Once the shield is broken.
They would have to face the attack of the Blood Tide Monsters directly!
But fortunately.
The reloading of the first wave of catapults and Thunderbolt Towers was also complete.
The next moment!
Light and fire erupted.
The Blood Tide Monsters that barely made it within a kilometer of the territory.
Were instantly swept away by the powerful firepower!
Since this time, the firepower-covered area was closer.
The sound of explosive fire bombs was like detonating next to everyone’s ears!
The entire gigantic Sky Island also shook continuously.
At the same time.
In the sky, the blood-colored clouds drifting over the Land of the Abandoned Gods’ advancement slowed.
They simultaneously noticed the explosion site below.
In the bloodthirsty eyes of these Blood Tide Monsters, they witnessed an astonishing scene.
Surrounded by endless monsters, that enormous Sky Island stood like a reef in the storm.
No matter how fierce the winds and waves, it never wavered an inch.
Moreover, to counter this Sky Island, the monsters had paid a tremendous price.
In just a minute or two, at least more than fifty thousand monsters died under Han Xing’s artillery fire.
Han Xing and the others’ resistance seemed to have completely provoked the fury of these Blood Tide Monsters!
At the center of the monster horde, a terrifying creature over a hundred meters tall with various human faces appeared.
Its thousands of eyes simultaneously locked onto the island below.
The next moment, the nearby Blood Tide Monsters seemed to receive a command from some presence.
Then, they all charged towards Han Xing’s territory.
Even to completely level Han Xing’s Sky Island.
It redirected the monsters attacking other Survivors.
As those monsters abandoned their current targets and converged on Xingyu City from all directions.
For a moment, those Survivors felt the pressure suddenly lift.
However, all that pressure now settled on Han Xing’s shoulders.
When those Survivors came back to their senses.
They suddenly saw dozens of kilometers away, that Sky Island surrounded by countless monsters, and swallowed hard.
"Oh my, did they break some heavenly law? So many monsters laying siege to a single Sky Island, how can anyone survive that?"
"Indeed, it’s terrifying. How could anyone survive this scale of Blood Tide?"
"Compared to them, fighting a few thousand monsters is nothing, isn’t it?"
Everyone was momentarily stunned as well.
Indeed, the comrades over there are holding out against hundreds of thousands of monsters.
How do the few thousand monsters here even compare?
Those Survivors who were despairing suddenly felt a surge of determination!

chapters.title: Chapter 180 - 150: Endless Slaughter
paragraphs: The desperate survivors felt a surge of strong fighting spirit.
They shouted one after another, "Brothers! Come with me, the brothers over there have already helped us share a lot of the pressure, we can’t give up either!"
"Let these ugly monsters see our human resilience and courage!"
"That’s right, let’s kill these disgusting creatures!"
"Charge!"
Meanwhile, Han Xing had just dealt with the seventh wave of monsters and was also gradually feeling overwhelmed.
More and more monsters were approaching.
The territory’s defense shield was enduring the siege from the horde of monsters!
Cheng Jianyong complained at this time, "Can’t kill them all, can’t kill them at all!"
"Damn it! How many monsters are there? Are all the monsters nearby coming to get us?"
Everyone had this feeling.
They looked at Han Xing, only to find him furrowing his brows, his eyes on the surrounding monsters, not knowing what he was thinking.
Moments later, Han Xing slowly exhaled and said, "There are too many monsters; we need to change our strategy."
Everyone’s expression became serious, listening carefully.
Han Xing continued, "I will change the attacks on the territory’s buildings from three waves to four. This way, we can achieve seamless integration."
"But inevitably, some of the monsters will get through into our territory."
"We will have to deal with those missed monsters ourselves."
Everyone became more serious.
They knew that the situation was very grave now.
Han Xing mentioned some monsters would get through.
But even that portion was so terrifying in number, enough to wipe out those small survivor squads!
Now was the most dangerous moment.
If they could not hold on, Xingyu City might be swallowed by the endless monster tide.
At this time, hundreds of blood-colored monsters were already crawling on the defense shield, attacking with their sharp teeth or claws.
The defense value began to pour rapidly.
The next moment, a crisp shattering sound came from the defense shield.
The shield was broken.
Over a thousand blood-colored monsters, all with glaring red eyes, appeared within the territory.
Han Xing took a deep breath and ordered, "Full force attack!"
Upon hearing this, everyone unleashed their strongest attacks immediately!
Blast Flame Arrow!
Boom!
Han Xing’s attack preemptively struck.
The Blast Flame Arrow exploded on the spot like a missile, the sixty-meter-wide fireball devouring countless monster bodies.
At the same time, Zhang Lianmeng’s Thunder Baptism had also finished charging.
The next moment, a cloud appeared in the sky over the territory.
Crackling...
Blue arc-shaped lightning fell.
The monster horde was electrocuted, charred inside and out in an instant!
With just one wave of attacks from the two of them, over six hundred blood tide monsters were killed!
In addition, Su Xiaoyang and Cheng Jianyong also started using their burst skills one after another!
Sky Sword!
Sky Arrow Rain!
Swish! Swish swish!
Over a thousand monsters that had rushed into the territory were instantly annihilated!
In the distance, those relatives watching from the Lord’s Mansion felt their hearts jump to their throats when they saw the monsters break the defense shield.
But they didn’t expect these five would be so powerful!
Especially Han Xing and Zhang Lianmeng, their attack effects were more terrifying than ten catapults!
At this time, Lanlan said in bewilderment with the other girls, "What... what skills are these? So impressive!"
"Oh my, why are Sister Lian Meng and the Lord’s attack ranges so terrifying?"

What they didn’t know was that after Zhang Lianmeng advanced to become an Elemental Tutor following her Second Transformation, her newly learned Thunder Baptism skill’s attack range and power were also influenced by her Spirit Attribute.
Zhang Lianmeng now had nearly a full set of golden equipment, and her spirit attribute had been stacked to a very high level, allowing her to unleash such amazing destructive power!
At this time, a wave of attacks from the five had already dealt with most of the invading monsters.
But there were still a few dozen blood tide monsters that continued rushing toward Xingyu City.
They seemed to know that there were a group of weak humans hiding inside.
Han Xing did not make a move.
On the field, Coal Ball had the fastest movement speed.
It began to specifically target those monsters landing in various corners of the territory.
As the black light flickered continuously.
One blood tide monster after another met their end under the claws of the Void Ghost Wolf.
At this moment, the second wave of missed blood tide monsters rushed forward again.
Han Xing hurriedly reminded, "Here they come!"
The remaining four listened and stood ready!
In fact, at their level, their destructive power was not inferior to these territory buildings, and even more formidable.
Last night, they had already tested the power of their new skills.
At this moment, the five individuals and one wolf once again demonstrated amazing destructive power!
With Shen Yun holding a shield, resisting a large wave of the monster tide, Han Xing and others launched the strongest attacks from behind.
Rumble!
One Blast Flame Arrow after another shot down, causing violent explosions at the original site!
As an Elemental Mage, Zhang Lianmeng, aided by top-grade equipment, cleared the monsters at a speed that was almost no weaker than Han Xing’s.
A few seconds later, the second wave of Blood Tide Monsters that had slipped through was thoroughly cleared by the team.
The five of them exchanged smiles.
That was the tacit understanding developed after multiple collaborations.
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but relax his shoulders and quietly let out a breath.
Then, he promptly reminded, "Don’t let down your guard, more monsters will rush in next, so be prepared to respond."
Han Xing was right.
To ensure constant attacks with no gaps, he had to divide the attack buildings into four waves, resulting in a significant reduction in firepower.
Each bombardment left hundreds of monsters slipping through, charging into his territory.
In his heart, he sighed.
Still, these attack devices were far too few!
If the quantity could be doubled, there wouldn’t be a need for them to act at all, no matter how many monsters came, they could devour them completely!
He resolved in his heart to exchange a large amount of materials after passing this crisis, and then mass construct more Flamethrower Catapults and Thunderbolt Towers.
Then came the third wave, and the fourth wave.
One by one, the monsters died at the hands of the five.
Even the pressure on the more than one thousand attack devices drastically reduced.
Meanwhile, with the massive deaths of Blood Tide Monsters.
In the sky, that monster covered in human faces suddenly opened its hundreds of eyes simultaneously.
It looked down at the battle, seeming somewhat surprised.
This time, it had mobilized nearly thirty percent of the Blood Tide Monsters from this area to besiege that Sky Island.
Faced with such a fierce offensive, it was actually still held off by them.
Moreover, in less than ten minutes, the survivors on that Sky Island had already slain over hundreds of thousands of monsters.
At this moment, the monster realized that this Sky Island likely had something special about it.
Something like, survivors who were different!
To spread the Blood Curse across the Land of the Abandoned Gods, such anomalies would undoubtedly be its obstacles, and must be prematurely eradicated.
Considering this, the giant monster immediately decided to mobilize more Blood Tide Monsters to launch an attack!
However, at this time, the monster’s dozens of human faces simultaneously changed color.
It noticed that other survivors’ Sky Islands in this area, due to reduced pressure, began to counterattack.
More and more Sky Islands had already resolved the battle.
The human faces on the giant monster were no longer as calm as before.
It seemed to have made some important decision now.
Beside the giant monster, still there were hundreds of thousands of Blood Tide Monsters, seemingly to protect itself.
But now, to prevent other survivors from freeing themselves and then going to support Han Xing.
It actually again diverted a large amount of force to deal with those survivors about to finish their battles.
To level the Sky Island where Han Xing was located, it was relentless in its efforts.
The blood clouds in the sky became much thinner.
Everyone looked up, faintly able to see the silhouette of that monster which was over a hundred meters tall.
Yet, although it exerted its utmost strength.
But these humans showed a shocking resilience that exceeded the Blood Tide Monsters’ imagination.
At this time, on a giant Sky Island gathering thousands of people.
The Blood Tide Monsters had begun landing.
But these survivors were not afraid at all.
More than two thousand melee professions are neatly lined up at the front.
In their front, there were tens of thousands of mutated creatures.
Above, pieces of huge stones whistled past and fell among the mutated monsters, smashing hundreds of Blood Tide creatures into pulp.
Arrow Towers shot wave after wave into the sky, forcing them to abandon the idea of an aerial strike.
But even if they chose to engage in close combat.
The path was filled with various spike traps, bait traps, and more set up by the Hunters.
Simultaneously, those Elemental Mages, Illusionists, and Hunters and other ranged professions were also furiously attacking from the rear.
Wave after wave of monsters were slain in great numbers before they even got close!
When survivors number is enough, and tactics distributed reasonably, it certainly can match the firepower of hundreds of attack devices!
At the Lord’s Castle, a young-faced man smiled and said, "Wei, how about this wave?"
"I said, as long as we gather enough survivors, it shouldn’t be difficult to withstand the typical monster tide, right?"
"Our Bathing City, if we get through this crisis, would have made a name for ourselves, and more people would join us!"
In front of him, a man with a cold temperament glanced at him, "Be careful, this time, we just withstood the assault of forty to fifty thousand monsters."
"I heard someone say in the chat channel, there’s a more exaggerated one in this area, directly resisting hundreds of thousands of Blood Tide Monsters, much more powerful than us."
As the largest team in this area, Bathing City resisted nearly fifty thousand monsters, already quite a feat.
But when the mentioned man heard there were teams tougher than them, he was wide-eyed.
"What the heck, there are ones tougher than us? Is it an elite big team from a major region?"
Wei shook his head, indicating he didn’t know either.
’Bathing City’ leader’s face also showed a pensive expression.
Moments later, he seriously said, "No matter who they are, being able to resist hundreds of thousands of monsters is an incredible skill."
"However, as formidable as they are, they should also be under quite some pressure now."
"We better quickly finish the battle here and go assist them."

sentences.text: The desperate survivors felt a surge of strong fighting spirit.
They shouted one after another, "Brothers!
Come with me, the brothers over there have already helped us share a lot of the pressure, we can’t give up either!"
"Let these ugly monsters see our human resilience and courage!"
"That’s right, let’s kill these disgusting creatures!"
"Charge!"
Meanwhile, Han Xing had just dealt with the seventh wave of monsters and was also gradually feeling overwhelmed.
More and more monsters were approaching.
The territory’s defense shield was enduring the siege from the horde of monsters!
Cheng Jianyong complained at this time, "Can’t kill them all, can’t kill them at all!"
"Damn it!
How many monsters are there?
Are all the monsters nearby coming to get us?"
Everyone had this feeling.
They looked at Han Xing, only to find him furrowing his brows, his eyes on the surrounding monsters, not knowing what he was thinking.
Moments later, Han Xing slowly exhaled and said, "There are too many monsters; we need to change our strategy."
Everyone’s expression became serious, listening carefully.
Han Xing continued, "I will change the attacks on the territory’s buildings from three waves to four.
This way, we can achieve seamless integration."
"But inevitably, some of the monsters will get through into our territory."
"We will have to deal with those missed monsters ourselves."
Everyone became more serious.
They knew that the situation was very grave now.
Han Xing mentioned some monsters would get through.
But even that portion was so terrifying in number, enough to wipe out those small survivor squads!
Now was the most dangerous moment.
If they could not hold on, Xingyu City might be swallowed by the endless monster tide.
At this time, hundreds of blood-colored monsters were already crawling on the defense shield, attacking with their sharp teeth or claws.
The defense value began to pour rapidly.
The next moment, a crisp shattering sound came from the defense shield.
The shield was broken.
Over a thousand blood-colored monsters, all with glaring red eyes, appeared within the territory.
Han Xing took a deep breath and ordered, "Full force attack!"
Upon hearing this, everyone unleashed their strongest attacks immediately!
Blast Flame Arrow!
Boom!
Han Xing’s attack preemptively struck.
The Blast Flame Arrow exploded on the spot like a missile, the sixty-meter-wide fireball devouring countless monster bodies.
At the same time, Zhang Lianmeng’s Thunder Baptism had also finished charging.
The next moment, a cloud appeared in the sky over the territory.
Crackling...
Blue arc-shaped lightning fell.
The monster horde was electrocuted, charred inside and out in an instant!
With just one wave of attacks from the two of them, over six hundred blood tide monsters were killed!
In addition, Su Xiaoyang and Cheng Jianyong also started using their burst skills one after another!
Sky Sword!
Sky Arrow Rain!
Swish!
Swish swish!
Over a thousand monsters that had rushed into the territory were instantly annihilated!
In the distance, those relatives watching from the Lord’s Mansion felt their hearts jump to their throats when they saw the monsters break the defense shield.
But they didn’t expect these five would be so powerful!
Especially Han Xing and Zhang Lianmeng, their attack effects were more terrifying than ten catapults!
At this time, Lanlan said in bewilderment with the other girls, "What... what skills are these?
So impressive!"
"Oh my, why are Sister Lian Meng and the Lord’s attack ranges so terrifying?"

What they didn’t know was that after Zhang Lianmeng advanced to become an Elemental Tutor following her Second Transformation, her newly learned Thunder Baptism skill’s attack range and power were also influenced by her Spirit Attribute.
Zhang Lianmeng now had nearly a full set of golden equipment, and her spirit attribute had been stacked to a very high level, allowing her to unleash such amazing destructive power!
At this time, a wave of attacks from the five had already dealt with most of the invading monsters.
But there were still a few dozen blood tide monsters that continued rushing toward Xingyu City.
They seemed to know that there were a group of weak humans hiding inside.
Han Xing did not make a move.
On the field, Coal Ball had the fastest movement speed.
It began to specifically target those monsters landing in various corners of the territory.
As the black light flickered continuously.
One blood tide monster after another met their end under the claws of the Void Ghost Wolf.
At this moment, the second wave of missed blood tide monsters rushed forward again.
Han Xing hurriedly reminded, "Here they come!"
The remaining four listened and stood ready!
In fact, at their level, their destructive power was not inferior to these territory buildings, and even more formidable.
Last night, they had already tested the power of their new skills.
At this moment, the five individuals and one wolf once again demonstrated amazing destructive power!
With Shen Yun holding a shield, resisting a large wave of the monster tide, Han Xing and others launched the strongest attacks from behind.
Rumble!
One Blast Flame Arrow after another shot down, causing violent explosions at the original site!
As an Elemental Mage, Zhang Lianmeng, aided by top-grade equipment, cleared the monsters at a speed that was almost no weaker than Han Xing’s.
A few seconds later, the second wave of Blood Tide Monsters that had slipped through was thoroughly cleared by the team.
The five of them exchanged smiles.
That was the tacit understanding developed after multiple collaborations.
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but relax his shoulders and quietly let out a breath.
Then, he promptly reminded, "Don’t let down your guard, more monsters will rush in next, so be prepared to respond."
Han Xing was right.
To ensure constant attacks with no gaps, he had to divide the attack buildings into four waves, resulting in a significant reduction in firepower.
Each bombardment left hundreds of monsters slipping through, charging into his territory.
In his heart, he sighed.
Still, these attack devices were far too few!
If the quantity could be doubled, there wouldn’t be a need for them to act at all, no matter how many monsters came, they could devour them completely!
He resolved in his heart to exchange a large amount of materials after passing this crisis, and then mass construct more Flamethrower Catapults and Thunderbolt Towers.

chapters.title: Chapter 181 - 151: Wholesale Golden Treasure Chests!
paragraphs: At this moment, on Han Xing’s side.
With the airborne monsters mobilizing the monster army again, more Blood Tide monsters surged towards them.
Relying solely on Han Xing’s Sky Island, they withstood nearly thirty percent of the monster’s pressure.
That’s hundreds of thousands in number!
However, even so.
No matter how many monsters there are, they can’t completely take them down.
As many monsters were slain.
In the sky, that monster covered in human faces seemed to feel some urgency too.
Seeing there was no hope left.
At this moment, all its faces closed their eyes.
Then it let out a piercing cry to the sky.
This piercing cry sounded like a baby’s wail, as well as an animal’s.
The intense sound waves drilled into everyone’s mind.
A region hundreds of kilometers around heard this sound.
Ordinary people who had just entered this world, upon hearing this sound, were instantly stunned as if struck by lightning, looking up and passing out.
At the same time, nearby Blood Tide monsters seemed to receive an order.
They simultaneously abandoned their current opponents and converged towards the sky.
Cheng Jianyong had just slashed a mutant monster into two.
In the next moment, he saw.
The monsters surrounding Xingyu City densely packed, at this moment, turned and left.
The blocked sight seemed to brighten again.
When the creatures in the sky flew back into the air and gradually moved away, Han Xing and others stood gasping in place.
After the blood cloud covering the sky dissipated.
This meant they withstood the second wave of the assault.
All the survivors in this region let out heavy sighs of relief, and some simply sat down on the ground.
"Holy crap... finally made it through!"
"It’s terrifying, I’ve never seen such a shocking scene in my life, this is way more than yesterday’s monster numbers!"
"No wonder the system said Blood Tide monsters will become increasingly powerful, it’s only been a day!"
At this moment, a survivor said thankfully, "Luckily, in this region, there’s a group of masters, actually holding back so many monster attacks!"
"If not for them, if we faced so many monsters, we’d be overwhelmed instantly!"
Others also nodded in deep agreement.
At this time, on Han Xing’s territory.
Tens of thousands of mutated monster corpses lay on the ground, looking desolate.
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but complain, "There’s way too many monsters, I don’t even know how many I’ve killed, my hand is about to go numb from cutting!"
Shen Yun, exhausted beside him, glanced at him helplessly.
"Be content, most of the pressure is borne by the catapults and Thunderbolt Towers, we seem formidable but actually we’ve barely taken any injuries."
Cheng Jianyong also agreed with this.
"True, this time, it was all thanks to those thousands of attack buildings, I wonder how other survivors managed to cope."
Shen Yun said, "You don’t need to worry about that, they won’t face as much pressure as we did."
"Didn’t you see, today there weren’t many cries for help on the local channel?"
Cheng Jianyong was momentarily stunned after hearing this, then said, "Seems like, why is that?"
Shen Yun speechlessly said a word, "Why else? Because all those monsters came to us!"
"I dare say, if Brother Xing wasn’t here in this region, the casualty rate would be at least twenty percent higher!"
Cheng Jianyong was speechless, realizing they were killing too fiercely and got noticed by the monster mass.
But it’s also fine, Han Xing and the others this time, indirectly saved a lot of lives.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong looked at the sky, at the distant blood cloud, and asked.
"By the way, did you guys see that thing just now?"
Everyone fell silent for a moment and then nodded.
At the last moment, they all saw the monster covered in human faces in the sky.
It seemed to be the one issuing commands to the whole Blood Tide monster group.
At this moment, Han Xing analyzed, "I fear, the guy in the sky is the leader of this monster group."
"And it looks like it’s at least a Lord Level with above level 20!"
After hearing this, everyone took a deep breath.
A lord-level monster above level 20 is entirely different from those below level 20.
If it had acted just now, the pressure Han Xing’s side faced would be even more terrifying.
But fortunately, they made it through.
At this time.
Seeing the battle ended.
A group of still-frightened young girls came out of Xingyu City.
Lanlan, with her friends, cautiously said, "Lea... Lord, are you all okay?"
Han Xing shook his head, "We’re fine."
Lanlan let out a sigh of relief and then continued to ask, "Are you hurt?"
"I remember being attacked by that group of monsters comes with a curse that only a Holy Profession’s Purification Technique can alleviate."
"Xiaolan and I are both in the Holy Profession, do you need our help?"
Han Xing and the others looked at each other, but didn’t say much.
After all, this woman had a good attitude.
She didn’t know Han Xing had the Blood Curse Antidote, completely immune to that curse.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng grabbed Lanlan’s hand, softly saying, "Thank you, Sister Lanlan, but we’re all fine, Brother Xing is really great, won’t let anything happen to us!"
Her tone carried admiration.
Beside her, Lanlan and her classmates, after hearing this, also nodded in deep agreement.
As witnesses, they observed the scene of the five fighting throughout.
Facing tens of thousands of monsters’ siege, they were simply like five War Gods, slaying countless Blood Tide monsters.

chapters.title: Chapter 182 - 151: Golden Treasure Chest Wholesale! (Part 2)
paragraphs: Meanwhile, the girls couldn’t help but carry a hint of admiration in their eyes as they looked at Han Xing.
It was the gaze one would have toward someone powerful.
At this moment, Han Xing said, "Since you’re out here, might as well clean up the corpses on the territory."
On Sky Island, there were monster corpses everywhere, with blood pooling on the ground, making it a disturbing sight.
Upon hearing this, the girls nodded vigorously like little chicks pecking at rice.
"Yes, Lord, we will clean the territory thoroughly!"
As one of the terms of the contract, one clause was to clean the territory.
The girls had no complaints about this.
Each rolled up her sleeves, facing the task with enthusiasm.
At this time, Han Xing thought of something and added a comment.
"Oh, while breaking down the corpses, be sure to watch out for sudden ’resurrections’ of these monsters."
"If anything happens, make sure to call us immediately."
Hearing the reminder, the girls suddenly realized something and their faces changed.
They then nodded gratefully towards Han Xing.
At that time, for their survival, they had considered forfeiting their freedom to work for Han Xing.
They had even imagined scenarios of being driven as slaves last night.
However, the owner of this territory not only didn’t need them to fight, but he also seemed to have a kind heart.
For a moment, a sense of belonging to Xingyu City emerged in those young girls’ hearts.
Ten minutes later, after the tens of thousands of mutant corpses had been broken down.
Lanlan and her classmates began washing away the bloodstains from the territory.
Meanwhile, Han Xing took Shen Yun, Cheng Jianyong, and others to the Lord’s Mansion hall.
Under the curious gazes of the crowd, Han Xing wore a relaxed smile.
"This time, although the battle was quite tough, the rewards were significant."
"Besides tons of Experience Value, the most important gain was Battle Merit!"
Hearing this, the other four also showed joyous expressions.
In the recent battle, the five of them had killed quite a few Blood Tide Monsters, easily amassing over twenty thousand each!
In a team state, Experience is shared.
Calculating with each Ordinary Monster offering over 7400 Experience Points, over twenty thousand monsters equaled over two hundred million Experience!
With such a massive pile of Experience, the five plus a wolf had all increased by 1 to 2 Levels.
Currently, Han Xing had reached Level 23, while the others were between Level 21 and 22.
After completing the Second Transformation, each Level increase provided even more Attribute boosts for Survivors.
Roughly 1.5 times more than during the First Transformation.
In addition to boosts from Equipment, each Level up significantly strengthened self capabilities!
Nothing brings more security than a rise in strength.
In addition to Experience Value, their biggest harvest this time was Battle Merit!
These Battle Merits can be exchanged for various treasure chests and puppets at the Battle Merit store.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong glanced at his own Battle Merit and exclaimed excitedly, "Wow, I have 21,000 Battle Merits!"
Hearing this number, everyone was taken aback.
Though they knew a lot of Battle Merit was gained, they didn’t expect Cheng Jianyong to have over twenty thousand, enough for two Golden Treasure Chests!
Shen Yun asked, "So many? Why do I only have over 10,000?"
Cheng Jianyong smugly replied, "Hahaha, Xiaoyunzi doesn’t know."
"During the recent battle, I also activated those few catapults on the territory to help fight; all those were real Battle Merit!"
Shen Yun rolled his eyes, "Cheapskate, using that method to snatch Brother Xing’s Battle Merit."
Shen Yun’s catapult numbers were similar to Cheng Jianyong’s, but he was busy holding the front line and didn’t think of those.
Cheng Jianyong retorted with satisfaction, "So what, Brother Xing doesn’t mind!"
Han Xing smiled, indeed not minding.
Cheng Jianyong then asked, "By the way, how much Battle Merit do you all have?"
Zhang Lianmeng checked her panel and softly said, "Over 15,000."
Su Xiaoyang replied, "About 12,000."
After the four reported their Battle Merit, they all felt the gain was substantial.
Although Battle Merit cannot be traded, together they had over 60,000 Points.
Each could obtain at least one Golden Treasure Chest, equivalent to a piece of Golden Equipment!
The large harvest of Battle Merit filled their hearts with joy.
And at this time, the four all simultaneously looked at Han Xing with some expectation in their eyes.
Because they clearly knew how terrifying the number of monsters Han Xing just killed was!
If not 200,000, at least 100,000!
In actuality, the monsters Han Xing defeated far exceeded this number.
Seeing the expectant gazes, Han Xing calmly reported his Battle Merit.
"Hiss..."
Hearing this outrageous number left Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, and the others completely stupefied, unable to recover for a long time.
Moments later, Cheng Jianyong took a deep breath and said in awe, "Oh my, I knew it was a lot, but this is beyond exaggeration!"
"In one battle gaining almost 300,000 Battle Merit, at this rate, wouldn’t Brother Xing soon get that 1,000,000 Points Bright Moon Treasure Chest?"
Everyone agreed.
Shen Yun then said, "By the way, Brother Xing, I remember 300,000 Battle Merits can exchange for a Lord-level Puppet, right?"
"Do you want to save up a bit more to exchange it?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment, glanced at everyone’s equipment, and shook his head.
"Better to exchange for the treasure chests first; we still have three or four low-level Purple Armors. If we can swap them all for Golden Equipment, our battle power will significantly advance."
In fact, accumulating a few more Battle Merits to exchange for a Lord-level Puppet would be the best strategy.
But for Han Xing, accumulating Battle Merits is relatively simple.
He doesn’t need to be this calculative.
Besides, the recent battle proved.

Han Xing decided to first enhance his own strength.
The group nodded in agreement.
The next moment, Han Xing waved his hand, exchanging for 25 Golden Treasure Chests in one go.
The entire council hall was enveloped in golden light!
Even with preparation.
When 25 Golden Treasure Chests were presented before everyone’s eyes, the scene was still a bit overwhelming.
Following Han Xing’s indication, Su Xiaoyang went to open the chests.
Su Xiaoyang eagerly proceeded.
Snap! Snap!
One by one, the Golden Treasure Chests were opened, revealing the dazzling materials inside.
[Successfully opened a Golden Treasure Chest, obtained Constant Gold Ingots*17, Burning Heart*1, Executioner’s Axe (Gold)*1]
[Successfully opened a Golden Treasure Chest, obtained Constant Gold Ingots*11, Emerald Eye*1, Commander’s Longbow (Gold)*1]
After more than a dozen announcements.
[Successfully opened a Golden Treasure Chest, obtained Constant Gold Ingots*9, Thug Gloves (Gold)*1.]
[Successfully opened a Golden Treasure Chest, obtained Constant Gold Ingots*13, Dawn Goddess Statue Construction Plan*1.]
[Successfully opened a Golden Treasure Chest, obtained Dark Night Goddess Statue Construction Plan*1]
All twenty-five chests were opened.
The crowd indulged in the unrestrained joy of opening treasure chests, their faces beaming with excitement.

From the 25 chests.
A total of 17 pieces of Golden Equipment, 3 Purple Equipment Blueprints, 3 Secret Elixir Blueprints, 2 Special Building Blueprints were obtained.

Everyone received one to two pieces of Golden Armor, with all their Attributes soaring!

On Sky Island, there were monster corpses everywhere, with blood pooling on the ground, making it a disturbing sight.
Upon hearing this, the girls nodded vigorously like little chicks pecking at rice.
"Yes, Lord, we will clean the territory thoroughly!"
As one of the terms of the contract, one clause was to clean the territory.
The girls had no complaints about this.
Each rolled up her sleeves, facing the task with enthusiasm.
At this time, Han Xing thought of something and added a comment.
"Oh, while breaking down the corpses, be sure to watch out for sudden ’resurrections’ of these monsters."
"If anything happens, make sure to call us immediately."
Hearing the reminder, the girls suddenly realized something and their faces changed.
They then nodded gratefully towards Han Xing.
At that time, for their survival, they had considered forfeiting their freedom to work for Han Xing.
They had even imagined scenarios of being driven as slaves last night.
However, the owner of this territory not only didn’t need them to fight, but he also seemed to have a kind heart.
For a moment, a sense of belonging to Xingyu City emerged in those young girls’ hearts.

Lanlan and her classmates began washing away the bloodstains from the territory.

Under the curious gazes of the crowd, Han Xing wore a relaxed smile.
"This time, although the battle was quite tough, the rewards were significant."
"Besides tons of Experience Value, the most important gain was Battle Merit!"
Hearing this, the other four also showed joyous expressions.
In the recent battle, the five of them had killed quite a few Blood Tide Monsters, easily amassing over twenty thousand each!
In a team state, Experience is shared.
Calculating with each Ordinary Monster offering over 7400 Experience Points, over twenty thousand monsters equaled over two hundred million Experience!
With such a massive pile of Experience, the five plus a wolf had all increased by 1 to 2 Levels.

After completing the Second Transformation, each Level increase provided even more Attribute boosts for Survivors.

In addition to boosts from Equipment, each Level up significantly strengthened self capabilities!
Nothing brings more security than a rise in strength.
In addition to Experience Value, their biggest harvest this time was Battle Merit!

Why do I only have over 10,000?"
Cheng Jianyong smugly replied, "Hahaha, Xiaoyunzi doesn’t know."

Each could obtain at least one Golden Treasure Chest, equivalent to a piece of Golden Equipment!
