chapters.title: Chapter 183 - 152: Dawn Goddess and Dark Night Goddess
paragraphs: Han Xing and his team, everyone welcomed a complete equipment upgrade!
It’s no exaggeration to say that with their current strength,
they don’t even need to rely on the Thunderbolt Tower and catapults to take on medium-sized monster hordes!
Of course, that’s if the number is within twenty to thirty thousand.
If it’s any more, they can’t handle it.
After dealing with the spoils of the equipment,
Han Xing turned his gaze to the other two special blueprints.
[Dawn Goddess Statue Blueprint]: Allows the construction of a Dawn Goddess Statue within the territory.
[Statue Effect]: Provides 10% additional experience value when monsters are killed. (Note: The effect is not cumulative when multiple statues are built.)
"Oh, a building that adds experience value, good stuff!" Han Xing praised.
Don’t underestimate the 10% experience bonus; it’s not much for other survivors.
For people like Han Xing, who just got billions of experience from one battle, a 10% bonus is tens of millions of experience value.
If this keeps accumulating, the extra experience value could even help him level up several times.
And he could always maintain a level advantage, staying ahead of other survivors.
Han Xing then checked the attributes of the other blueprint.
[Dark Night Goddess Statue Blueprint]: Allows the construction of a Dark Night Goddess Statue within the territory.

[Statue Effect]: During the day, all friendly units gain a 10% increase in all attributes. At night, all friendly units gain a 20% increase in all attributes. (Note: The effect is not cumulative when multiple statues are built.)
"This is also something good!" Han Xing’s eyes lit up with joy.
The two blueprints from the Golden Treasure Chest have excellent attributes.
Moreover, they’re like auras; as long as they’re not destroyed, they continuously provide boosts.
However, Han Xing is unsure
whether the enhancement effect of the Dark Night Goddess Statue can be granted to summoned creatures.
For example, Wolf Cavalry, Minotaurs, Bear Spirits, etc.
If it can, that would be a huge gain!
After all, he has another special piece of equipment in hand.
The Vim Divine Power Horn.
Once the horn is blown, everyone enters a frenzied state with a great increase in speed.
Combined with the attack power boost from the Dark Night Goddess Statue, it would be even more satisfying!
Thinking of this, he quickly checked the construction materials needed for these two statues.
[Materials needed for constructing the Dawn Goddess Statue]: Refined Iron*150000, Mithril*5000, Spirit Core*200000, Divine Aurora*10000
[Materials needed for constructing the Dark Night Goddess Statue]: Refined Iron*250000, Mithril*10000, Spirit Core*400000, Breath of the Dark Night*50000
Han Xing breathed a sigh of relief.
Thankfully, the materials needed to construct these two statues are relatively standard.
The only unique ones are Divine Aurora and Breath of the Dark Night.
He has a large stockpile of the former.
It’s the Breath of the Dark Night that is currently missing from Han Xing’s warehouse.
However, before the server merger, Han Xing saw this material in the trading channel.
After this merger, with billions of people sharing one trading channel, the quantity of items in it will definitely multiply exponentially.
Even the rarest materials will have considerable reserves.
A quick search for ’Breath of the Dark Night’ yielded hundreds of thousands of sale listings.
And the price isn’t high; about 200 Spirit Cores for one.
Han Xing generously swept down 50000 Breath of the Dark Night for one million Spirit Cores.
Then, he eagerly sought a suitable area to construct the statues.
Buildings with aura effects like this should definitely be constructed as early as possible.
Moreover, they should be built in safe enough places.
And the safest place in the entire territory is his own Xingyu City.
Walking around the main street twice, Han Xing didn’t find a suitable location.
This is because a large number of residential houses occupy the city’s space, leaving only roads for passage.
According to the proportions on the blueprint, constructing these two statues requires at least a hundred square meters of territory space.
At this moment, rubbing his chin, Han Xing thought, "Speaking of which, the scale of Xingyu City is indeed a bit small."
"Once this wave of Blood Tide is over, I’ll find a way to expand a bit more, striving to create a complete city," Han Xing confidently thought.
While searching for a suitable construction area, Han Xing suddenly saw a white building covering thousands of square meters next to the Lord’s Mansion.
"Hmm, what’s that?"
He checked his territory buildings and found that the name corresponding to this building is a church.
[Church]: Special territory building.
[Defense Value]: 200
[Effect]: For those with faith in divine beings, they can come here to pray for peace of mind.
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing said, "It seems that Lamino is still a devout believer, having specially built a church near the Lord’s Mansion."
"However, this place is now called Xingyu City."
"Here, I don’t need to worship any deity."
Han Xing immediately decided to demolish the church, turning the space into a vacant lot for building statues.
The next moment, he directly clicked the building destruction function on the territory.
Rumble~
The white church collapsed with a roar, bricks, and rubble falling before it quickly turned into ruins.
Hearing the commotion from the city center,
the girls leaned on the small balcony on the second floor, looking ahead in confusion.
Beside Lanlan, a little girl asked puzzledly, "Sister Lanzhi, what’s the Lord doing?"
Lanlan shook her head and said with a sense of bewilderment, "I don’t know, maybe it’s demolishing the house..."
"Demolishing the house?"
Several young girls exchanged glances, and then suddenly laughed out loud.
Han Xing didn’t know about the discussion the young girls were having about him behind his back.
Once the dust settled, he summoned several Puppet Giants to pack up and remove all the stone debris.
Then, he began laying down bricks and placing various granite stones on top.
The area quickly transformed into a flat and spacious square.
Han Xing clapped his hands with satisfaction and said, "Great, as the only vacant area in Xingyu City, henceforth, this will be called the Town Square."
At this moment, a system notification appeared.
[Your territory building, ’Town Square’ has been successfully named.]
Han Xing was taken aback.
He had just said it casually, could you really just name it like that?
Simultaneously, the residents of Xingyu City also heard the system prompt, and surprised expressions appeared on their faces.
The name Town Square, full of modern city vibes, seemed to evoke memories from their days on Blue Star.
After clearing the site, Han Xing directly started the construction with a click.
[Constructing the Dawn Goddess Statue, estimated time remaining 13 hours 42 minutes...]
[Constructing the Dark Night Goddess Statue, estimated time remaining 15 hours 23 minutes...]
On the Town Square, two clouds of smoke covering dozens of square meters appeared.
Han Xing calculated in his mind, according to the blueprint scale.
These two statues are at least nearly thirty meters high.
They can almost match the height of the tallest building in his territory, the Lord’s Mansion!
And, Han Xing had also seen portraits of these two goddesses on the blueprints.
Whether it’s the intention of the blueprints’ creator to depict them this way, or if the two goddesses naturally looked like this.
Their faces and figures are exceptionally beautiful.
The Dawn Goddess wears a laurel crown and a white long dress that doesn’t quite hide her voluptuous figure, especially her chest size, which even rivals Zhang Lianmeng.
She gently caresses a harp in her arms, with notes of purity circling around her.
The Dark Night Goddess wears a thin gauze dress; compared to Dawn, Dark Night’s figure is more slender but appears very toned.
In the blueprint, the Dark Night Goddess holds a Dark Night Longsword, her gaze fixed forward, exuding a spirited and heroic aura.
"Wow, as expected of goddesses? Even what’s depicted on the blueprint is already of peerless beauty. If they were real, it would be something else," Han Xing couldn’t help but marvel.
The appearance of the two goddesses is truly stunning.
By then, when others see Xingyu City, they will likely be drawn to these two goddesses’ statues at first glance.
After completing the construction of the two goddess statues, Han Xing was just about to take a break.
At this moment, another system notification appeared.
[Your territory building, the Wolf Cavalry Camp has been completed.]
Upon hearing this notification, Han Xing’s eyes lit up with joy.
"Huh? The Wolf Cavalry Camp is finished too?"
"Awesome!"
He hurried to the empty space below Xingyu City.
There, in an area covered with dirt, a building similar to a camp suddenly appeared.
It occupies about a few dozen square meters, and underneath it was a faintly glowing Teleportation Array.
This is the Wolf Cavalry Camp.
Unable to contain his excitement, Han Xing opened the building interface.
[Wolf Cavalry Camp]: By consuming Spirit Cores, you can summon Wolf Cavalry to fight for you.
Note: The level of the summoned Wolf Cavalry is the same as the technology level, current level is Level 1.
[Technology]: Basic Beast Tamer lv1 (currently can summon lv1 Wolf Cavalry, each level increase +1 Wolf Cavalry level).
Another technology upgrade?
Han Xing’s eyes brightened, this is his expertise!
"Do you want to consume materials: 50,000 Refined Iron, 1,000 Mithril, to upgrade Basic Beast Tamer technology?"
"Yes!"
"Upgrade successful, your Wolf Cavalry Camp technology, Basic Beast Tamer has been upgraded to lv2."
Han Xing began to rapidly click!
It was a direct consumption of 450,000 Refined Iron and 9,000 Mithril, upgrading Basic Beast Tamer to Intermediate Beast Tamer lv1.
The summoned Wolf Cavalry level has now reached level 11.
Upon reaching intermediate level, the materials required for further technology upgrades have nearly doubled.
But fortunately, Mithril and Refined Iron are among the materials he has in the largest stockpile.
Han Xing continued clicking.
From Intermediate Beast Tamer lv1, he clicked all the way to Advanced Beast Tamer Lv3.
At this point, the summoned Wolf Cavalry level had reached level 23.
It wasn’t that Han Xing didn’t want to click further.
But the system notified him that the Wolf Cavalry Camp technology level cannot exceed that of the lord itself.
Han Xing had no choice but to close the technology interface.
But thinking about it, it does make sense.
If there weren’t such a restriction, with his material reserves, he could completely max out the Beast Tamer technology.
By then, if Han Xing could summon a whole group of fifty or sixty-level Wolf Cavalry.
Any Blood Tide, any Lord-level creatures, would all be trampled by the Wolf Cavalry’s iron hooves!

chapters.title: Chapter 184 - 153: Summoning Wolf Cavalry
paragraphs: However, being able to summon lv23 Wolf Cavalry now is quite impressive.
Thinking of this, Han Xing couldn’t wait to summon the Wolf Cavalry.
At this moment, a system prompt appeared.
[Do you want to consume 2300 Spirit Cores to summon 1 Wolf Cavalry to fight for you?]
"Yes."
The next moment, the Teleportation Array beneath the Wolf Cavalry Camp began to emit a subtle glow.
A progress bar of 10 seconds appeared before him.
When the progress bar reached the end, a humanoid figure appeared.
The next moment, Han Xing locked eyes with a pair of bloodthirsty eyes.
This was a creature with green skin and two stout tusks growing from its mouth.
Beneath the green skin were bulging muscles.
With a height close to two meters, it exuded a strong sense of oppression!
This was the appearance of the Wolf Cavalry.
At the moment of eye contact with Han Xing, the fierce gleam in the wolf cavalry’s eyes instantly receded, replaced by a look of loyalty!
It knelt on one knee respectfully, saying, "Lord, the Wolf Cavalry is at your service!"
Seeing that it could speak, Han Xing was not surprised.
He looked at the status panel of this Wolf Cavalry.
[Wolf Cavalry (Three-Star Ordinary Creatures)]
[Level]: lv23
[Attributes]: Power 453, Agility 447, Spirit 374, Constitution 402.
[Skills]:
Intermediate Riding Skill: (When the Wolf Cavalry rides a mount during battle, Attack Power increases by 20%),
Wolf Cavalry Charge: (When the Wolf Cavalry rides a mount for a swift assault, it deals 130% damage to all enemies along the route)
Seeing the attributes of this Wolf Cavalry, Han Xing nodded in satisfaction.
Compared to average monsters of the same level, the Wolf Cavalry is clearly stronger.
At this moment, Han Xing asked, "As a Wolf Cavalry, where is your mount?"
The Wolf Cavalry shook its head and said: "Lord, the camp you built can only summon creatures with the bloodline of Wolf Cavalry."
"And our mounts are tamed later, so they didn’t teleport with us."
Upon hearing the Wolf Cavalry’s answer, Han Xing’s eyes showed a thoughtful look.
Without the ability to summon mounts, these Wolf Cavalries are essentially like ordinary three-star creatures, their combat effectiveness greatly reduced.
But even so, it’s still quite good.
After all, Han Xing primarily intends for the Wolf Cavalry to use their numerical advantage to crush the monster hordes.
As for the mounts, if there’s an opportunity in the future, he’ll keep an eye out for them.
Maybe he can build some facilities like the Black Cloud Horse Camp to equip the Wolf Cavalry with a batch of mounts.
Of course, Han Xing could also catch a batch of beast cubs to tame later, and they could be used as mounts.
But if he does this, the time cycle will be too long.
Han Xing waved his hand, instructing the Wolf Cavalry to find a place to line up and wait.
The Wolf Cavalry respectfully retreated.
The next moment.
Han Xing started summoning a large number of Wolf Cavalries.
[Do you want to consume 23 million Spirit Cores to summon 10,000 Wolf Cavalries?]
Han Xing directly summoned nearly ten thousand Wolf Cavalries at once, which at 5 seconds per Cavalry, would take a full 14 hours!
But luckily, the progress bars for these Wolf Cavalries are independent and don’t occupy his production interface progress.
He’s not in a rush now.
Instead, he quietly waited.
Every 10 seconds, a flash of white light would pass through the Wolf Cavalry Camp.
The next moment, a tall Wolf Cavalry Warrior with green skin would appear inside the Teleportation Array.
Han Xing set a gathering point for them.
The newly summoned Wolf Cavalries would automatically come to that open space and line up to wait.
Until Han Xing issues a command, they would remain in place.
After observing for a while, Han Xing left assured.
He now had another major task to undertake!
And that is trading!
After building two statues and upgrading the Wolf Cavalry Camp Technology, his material stockpiles were completely depleted.
This left Han Xing with a sense of urgency.
Especially after experiencing an event where hundreds of thousands of monsters besieged him today, Han Xing felt a strong sense of crisis!
Although Xingyu City already has a terrifying number of siege constructions.
But it’s not enough!
Who knows if tomorrow even more numerous and stronger monsters might appear to besiege him?
Therefore, Han Xing still needs to build a large number of attack constructions to ensure everything is foolproof!
But all this requires a lot of materials.
However, before trading, Han Xing also wanted to see what major events had happened recently among the survivors.
Then, he clicked into the public chat channel.
It was as expected.
Currently, survivors around the world are facing terrifying numbers of monster attacks.
Each region experiences monster hordes ranging from hundreds of thousands to millions.
No Sky Island where survivors reside was spared.
For a while, countless Sky Islands were destroyed.
Thousands of Survivors either died at the claws of those monsters or were cursed by the Blood Curse, becoming those terrifying monsters.
The casualty rate soared!
But fortunately, after yesterday’s first Blood Tide burst event, it made everyone realize the power in numbers.
More and more survivors have started to unite.
Of course, they don’t all form alliances by signing Lord Contracts, but rather by fair cooperation.
Some smaller teams have also gathered hundreds of Survivors with combat abilities.
As for the larger teams, the number of Professionals at this moment even exceeds ten thousand!
Under the collective warmth of so many people, although the battles remain difficult, relatively, the casualty rate is somewhat lower.
At this juncture, numerous considerable forces have formed in the public areas.
Like ’Kunlun’ in Zone 2, ’Divine Hall’ in Zone 3, ’Kyushu’ in Zone 4, etc.
They all publicly announced their positions in the communal regions.
Within a short span, these teams gathered tens of thousands of people, counting each other’s family members, the number exceeds hundreds of thousands!
These people indeed have prowess.
As previously mentioned, under the Blood Tide, the more people gathered, the greater the safety.
And the larger the number, the more benefits they can bring.
Now, more and more Survivors are considering joining those large teams for protection.
But to join these large teams, one must sign a Lord Contract, which makes many Survivors quite reluctant.
"This is outrageous, Zone 3’s Divine Hall states that to join them, you must first sign a two-year Lord Contract and hand over 30% of resources."
"Yeah, and even worse, Zone 5’s Heart Joy Club requires a direct three-year contract and 50% resource handover, some small groups even sign directly for five years!"
"Outrageous!"
"Exactly!"
The Survivors vented their frustrations in the chat channel.
"But there’s no choice, given their strong power, anyone with a dozen Catapults on their territory can form their own faction."
"I’d rather team up with those whose strength is similar to mine, cooperation is all that matters, anyway, my territory has one or two Arrow Towers!"
"Brother, my territory also has a Catapult, I have a few friends together, want to form a team together?"
Upon hearing this, the person couldn’t contain his joy: "Sure, I’ll come over immediately."
More and more people are joining forces.
At that moment, a message appeared in the public chat channel.
Strangely, the speaker’s name was actually in gold.
The Survivors were simultaneously shocked.
"Oh wow, a golden name, is this some VIP privilege?"
"Brother, how did you recharge your membership, give a payment portal."
"Hahaha, get one for me too!"
A Survivor named Yang Jun said: "Everyone be serious, our leader wants to say something important."
"Your leader? Is he the one with the golden name?"
"What’s your team called?"
The Survivor named Yang Jun slowly said: "Huayi Alliance, Zhou Huang."
Upon hearing this name, the chat channel fell into a silence.
This Huayi Alliance seemed to be quite famous, and despite newly merging zones for less than a day, many have heard of this team’s name.
Apparently, they are recognized as the top team in the entire server.
Their leader Zhou Huang is a legendary character.
Not long after entering Sky Island Paradise, during the time when everyone was exceedingly short on resources, especially struggling for water sources.
By unknown means, Zhou Huang gathered a vast amount of fresh water resources and distributed it freely to survivors in Zone 1, saving countless people.
Then, using his personal charisma, he united nearly seventy percent of the Survivors in Zone 1, founding the Huayi Alliance.
After the initial zone merge,
While all the zones were wary and hostile towards each other,
Zhou Huang led his Huayi Alliance to conquer all the major teams from Zone 1 to 100.
Ultimately, Zone 1 housed only Huayi Alliance as a single team.
And upon accomplishing all this, Zhou Huang took only one month.
Just hearing these deeds is sufficient to demonstrate how remarkable this person’s means are.
Moments later, the Survivor with the golden ID spoke.
"Fellow compatriots, hello, I am Zhou Huang."
"Many of you may have heard of me, while some may be unfamiliar with my name."
"I am President of Zone 1’s ’Huayi Alliance’, and on the eve of the Blood Tide disaster breakout, I have already gathered over ten thousand brothers to jointly build a Survivor Sanctuary!"
"This Sanctuary’s Sky Island is tremendously large, we have built numerous houses on it for everyone’s accommodation."
"Moreover, we have constructed dozens of Flamethrower Catapults, hundreds of regular Catapults, as well as various Arrow Towers, with ample firepower."
"Just now, we managed to withstand such a monster tide and did not suffer significant casualties."
After listening to Zhou Huang’s account, everyone clearly realized how powerful the publicly acknowledged top team in the entire server is.
Yet, Zhou Huang’s following words further shocked the billions of Survivors watching in the chat channel.
Zhou Huang continued: "I mention these not to show off in front of everyone."
"But to inform you all, I learned by certain means that the upcoming Blood Tide will become increasingly horrifying."
"Today’s monster swarm scale encountered is merely a teaser."
"The terror of the Blood Tide is actually far beyond our imagination!"

chapters.title: Chapter 185 - 154: Saint and Deal
paragraphs: "The terror of the Blood Tide actually far exceeds our imagination."
Zhou Huang solemnly reminded, his tone revealing seriousness.
"If any compatriots are struggling at this time, they can come to us."
"No matter your strength, background, the ’Huayi Alliance’ welcomes you to join us."
"Moreover, we don’t need you to sign the Lord Contract, as long as you can help resist during the Blood Tide monster invasion!"
"Our goal is for everyone to develop together and build a city of survivors where everyone can live peacefully without being disturbed by monsters!"
After listening to Zhou Huang’s narration, the chat channel was silent for a long time.
They seemed to find it hard to believe that someone would be willing to save so many unrelated people without asking for anything in return.
It can be said that if Zhou Huang wasn’t lying to them, in the future, it would certainly attract tens of millions or even billions of survivors to come to them!
By then, the ’Huayi Alliance’ would truly earn the title of the top team across the server.
Many people were already tempted, but they wouldn’t blindly choose to believe because of someone else’s words.
Thus, they asked in the chat channel one after another.
"Director Zhou, is what you’re saying true? Can anyone join, regardless of their strength?"
"Director Zhou, how many people are there with you now, and can we bring our families?"
"Our Flower Hotel was just attacked by Blood Tide monsters, now there are less than ten of us left, is Director Zhou willing to take us in?"
For these questions, Zhou Huang’s replies were consistently affirmative.
And to prevent others from worrying he was a fraud, Zhou Huang also voluntarily uploaded a video.
Everyone saw in the video a large Sky Island with various landscapes on it.
On that Sky Island, dozens of flamethrower catapults were lined up, a row of Lord’s Cottages were built in the center of the territory, seemingly as a place for survivors to live long-term.
Meanwhile, thousands of survivors were active on it, counting those relatives, the numbers exceeded one hundred thousand.
Clearly, it resembled a human gathering place.
After seeing the video, the survivors completely believed what Zhou Huang said.
At this time, Zhou Huang continued, "Our coordinates are, 415211, 8741, 15112."
"Trust me Zhou Huang, or trust our compatriots in the ’Huayi Alliance,’ and gather at these coordinates."
"We will stay here for one day."
After Zhou Huang finished speaking, the survivors responded one after another, "Director Zhou, we trust you!"
"That’s right, I’m coming over right away."
"Thank you, Director Zhou!"
In an instant, countless Sky Islands began to converge towards his location.
Following this event, billions of survivors worldwide will remember the name Zhou Huang.
Seeing so many people respond, Zhou Huang’s serious tone also gradually relaxed.
Moments later, Zhou Huang continued, "By the way, there’s one more thing."
"If any compatriots are infected with the Blood Curse in battle, don’t panic, and certainly don’t act impulsively."
"Although the Purification Technique of the Holy Profession cannot completely remove the Blood Curse, it can have a delaying effect, and as long as you stay alive, there is hope."
"In the recent battle, many of our brothers suffered the Blood Curse. If anyone has a method to remove this curse, or even just a clue, Zhou will reward you greatly!"
At this moment, in Han Xing’s territory.
Shen Yun and the others also saw Zhou Huang’s speech.
He seemed to have some special privilege, as when he spoke in the public channel, it actually appeared with a flashing light on the survivors’ chat panel.
It felt as if the system had given him special permission.
Everyone knew that this Zhou Huang was definitely not simple.
In the team channel.
Cheng Jianyong was surprised and said, "Brother Xing, Xiaoyunzi, I just learned about this Zhou Huang’s deeds from other survivors, and found this guy is really impressive?"
"He actually subdued a hundred districts, and hundreds of teams large and small in just a month, his methods are remarkable!"
Shen Yun nodded, "Indeed impressive. I’ve also heard that the survivors around him are very loyal to him, they’ve risen to a fanatical level."
"I really don’t know if it’s his charisma or if Zhou Huang has other means."
The two remained silent.
However, the strength Zhou Huang currently shows is still inferior to Han Xing.
But it’s hard to say he doesn’t have other means.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong said again with a strange expression, "By the way, is there really such a Saint? Not asking for anything in return, just thinking about saving more people?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment, "This Zhou Huang, he has some skills."
"Regardless of whether he’s a real Saint or not, this speech can be said to have gathered countless popularity for him."
"You should know, today is the first day the second batch of humans came to this world, and many people haven’t even figured out the basic rules."
"In the state of billions of survivors being confused, Zhou Huang said he could accept them unconditionally."
"Regardless of whether this works or not, Zhou Huang and the Huayi Alliance behind him will be remembered by these survivors."
After listening, the two nodded.
After closing the team chat, Han Xing murmured softly, "I need to quickly enhance my strength too!"
Han Xing opened the trading channel and, after observing the recent market prices for a while.
He began consignment directly.
He first put thousands of blue backpacks and over twenty thousand white backpacks.
Along with tens of thousands of bottles of Intermediate Life Secret Elixir and Wild Bear Power Secret Elixir, all on sale.

"As expected, the style of Star River God remains unchanged."
"Stop talking and quickly inform the leader!"
Instantly, information about Han Xing quickly spread to the ears of teams in the 2 major regions.
At this time, the leader of Cybertron, Optimus Prime, had just resolved a wave of Blood Tide Monsters.
Upon receiving the news, Optimus Prime’s face showed some surprise: "Oh? Star River is starting to consign items again, this time including intermediate life secret elixirs?"
"Prices are 20% lower than market rate?"
Optimus Prime’s face showed shock, and he quickly said, "Go, regardless of how much there is, buy it all for me!"
Beside him, a middle-aged man with a sullen face asked, "Leader, should we buy as much as there is?"
Optimus Prime nodded heavily, "Yes, if materials are insufficient, I permit you to use the resources from the team warehouse!"
The middle-aged man seemed surprised, "Leader, is it prudent to be so impulsive?"
"What if this batch of items doesn’t sell?"
However, Optimus Prime looked at him with contempt, "What do you know?"
"Buying Star River’s items is equivalent to investing; it’s a guaranteed profit, which is the consensus of people from our original 2 major regions!"
"Everyone urgently needs life secret elixirs now; even if we don’t use them all, I can resell them for a profit!"
"Chen Tian, you joined our Cybertron recently, I don’t blame you for not knowing this."
"But I hope you won’t question my decisions in the future."
Optimus Prime’s tone was not very friendly.
The middle-aged man was taken aback after hearing this.
At this moment, an old member of Cybertron quickly intervened to smooth things over, "Leader, I’ve already arranged everything here."
"The materials from the team warehouse have also been requested for transfer, and it should be enough to buy a large quantity of Star River’s items."
Optimus Prime nodded in satisfaction after hearing this.
Through the battles of the past few days, although Cybertron team suffered considerable casualties, they also gained a substantial amount of battle merit.
This battle merit can be exchanged for treasure chests to obtain many materials.
Therefore, Optimus Prime already had considerable resources stockpiled.
But evidently, not only was Cybertron a team benefiting from the Blood Tide Incident.
Other teams from the former 2 regions, such as the Digital Celestial Team, Autocratic for Ten Thousand Years, also received the news and began to flood the trade channels.
After all, buying Star River’s items is akin to making money, a consensus among survivors from the 2 major regions!
At one point, the trade channel saw a large number of survivors discussing the name Star River.
Survivors from other regions felt puzzled but didn’t pay much attention to it.
After all, each major region had a few celebrities before.
Over time, everyone got used to it.
Meanwhile, the system prompts were already flooding Han Xing’s screen.
[Transaction successful, you received Spirit Core*60000, you lost Space Backpack (Blue)*1.]
[Transaction successful, you received Mithril*5213, you lost Intermediate Life Secret Elixir*100.]
One transaction message after another appeared.
Soon, Han Xing’s batch of backpacks and elixirs were sold out.
Compared to previous transactions, the prices Han Xing set this time were slightly elevated.
The materials exchanged were worth approximately 1 billion Spirit Cores.
A trace of joy appeared in Han Xing’s eyes, as this result exceeded his estimated 800 million by another 200 million.
It seemed that as long as the quality of the items was solid, there was no worry about finding buyers!
However, it’s a pity.
Han Xing urgently needed the Minotaur Totem but didn’t get it through exchange.
At this time, in the trade channel.
Many survivors flocking to join in and try to grab a share mostly ended up empty-handed.
Because Han Xing’s backpacks and elixirs were mainly snatched up by those large teams.
They held an abundance of materials, and their bids were in the hundreds and thousands, directly grabbing large quantities.
This caused many survivors to be left with nothing if they were a bit slower.
"Did you guys manage to grab anything? I didn’t even get a single hair!"
"I didn’t either, kept getting prompts that the item was sold out."
"Damn! Who’s so quick?"
"Who else, those teams... some people have been eyeing Star God for a long time."
Upon hearing their discussion, Han Xing was a bit surprised.
He hadn’t expected that those large teams were monitoring him and so quickly swept away this batch of backpacks and elixirs.
But there’s nothing he could do.
After all, the consignment rule is such that whoever is quick gets it first.
Unless Han Xing chose to trade item by item, but that’d be too time-consuming.
Han Xing shook his head and started to review the other two types of materials he just obtained through the trade.
The first type is Witch Root Grass.
As one of the main materials to produce the Blood Antidote, a total of over 40,000 were acquired in this transaction!
The second type is Thunder Stone.
As the most extensive and powerful attacking structure on his territory, the Thunderbolt Tower has demonstrated its prowess to Han Xing!
The main material to build Thunderbolt Tower is Thunder Stone.
In this transaction, the number of Thunder Stones acquired reached an astonishing over 20,000.
This means Han Xing can build over 20 more Thunderbolt Towers!
A hint of excitement appeared on Han Xing’s face.
With massive materials coming in, he was getting wealthy again.
However, the crucial Minotaur Totem is still missing.
Han Xing mused thoughtfully: "It seems that blue backpacks and these elixirs are not sufficient to make them trade such precious items as Minotaur Totems with me."
"But it doesn’t matter, my next batch of items will be even more valuable!"
Han Xing looked at the batch of purple space backpacks in his warehouse.
There are as many as over 5300 of them.
Previously, Han Xing checked the trade channel for the prices of purple backpacks.
The rare quality purple backpacks, with spaces between 300~500, sell for between 150,000 to 200,000.
Higher ones with spaces between 600~700 sell for between 250,000 to 300,000.
As for full attributes, the space backpacks with 800 grids occasionally appear in the trade channel.
But people don’t actually sell them.
In seller’s notes, they clearly stated it’s for showing off, and if anyone wants, they have to exchange it with golden equipment.
Bear in mind, even a piece of 15-level golden equipment would cost over 500,000 Spirit Cores at this stage.
Unless some particularly wealthy survivor, no one would trade golden equipment for backpacks at this time.
Compared to Han Xing’s original expectation of 250,000 Spirit Cores,
market prices generally far exceeded that.
And this provided Han Xing the space to raise prices.
"It seems the market for purple backpacks is quite large, I can also increase the price a bit more."
Thinking of this, Han Xing began setting prices and proceeded to click consign.
Meanwhile, in the trade channel, survivors who thought Han Xing had sold everything were about to disperse.
When the name Star River appeared again, it instantly attracted the attention of tens of thousands of survivors!

chapters.title: Chapter 187 - 155: Booming Market
paragraphs: Han Xing once again set up the related consignment conditions.
[Consignment Item]: Space Backpack (Purple), Quality - Treasure, Space: 800, Attached Effect - Physical Strength (Constitution +24), Attached Knight Rune: Defense Value +13, Magic Resistance +9.
[Required Items]: Spirit Core 300000, Mithril*3000, Permanent Gold Ingot*125, Ice Heart*1, Thunder Stone*500...
[Consignor]: Star River.
Seller’s Note: "Purple exquisite backpack, comes with a superb rune, priced at 300,000 Spirit Cores."
"If Spirit Cores are insufficient, other materials can also be exchanged."
"Large purchase of Witch Root Grass, Thunder Stone, Strong Beast Hide, Minotaur Totem, and various building blueprints."
"Those with the above items, please contact me for priority transactions."
In the trading channel, many were astonished at the backpack with a full 800 slots capacity.
"Whoa! Purple backpack, 800 slots! Is this like carrying a warehouse with you?"
"And that rune, what a powerful effect!"
"Should I say, as expected of the Star God? Every move is so extraordinary!"
"Hurry, inform the group leader that the Star God’s transaction is not over yet, and this time the item for sale is actually a purple backpack!"
At the same time, Cybertron, Peak of Ceasefire, and including Boundless, all received the news.
Boundless exclaimed in surprise: "What? Purple backpack?"
"Where did this Star River get the blueprints from again?"
At this moment, a beautiful lady beside asked: "Young Master Wu, Star River’s batch of backpacks have superb attributes and come with a very strong rune effect."
"In terms of attribute strength, it equals half an equipment, and if you equip two pieces, it’s like having the attributes of one additional equipment."
"Should we..."
The beautiful woman didn’t continue because she knew Boundless understood her implication.
Boundless pondered for a moment, nodded, and said: "I understand, go fetch the materials from the team warehouse, try to acquire as many as possible."
"To build an elite team, these things cannot be skimped on."
The beautiful woman gently nodded, "Yes."
Optimus Prime had just leveraged the team’s advantage, seizing over a thousand blue backpacks and several thousand bottles of Life Secret Elixir in one go.
Just as he thought he was about to make a huge profit this time, he suddenly received the news.
Star River consigned a batch of backpacks with even more powerful attributes in the trading channel.
Optimus Prime was stunned on the spot.
Although he knew Star River had plenty of good items.
He hadn’t expected that in just such a short time, the other party brought out the 800-slot backpack again!
As the leader of a large group, he knew very well the significance of this purple backpack.
The rare quality comes with over 20 additional four-dimensional attributes, plus a Knight Rune.
Equipping two would give dozens more defense and attributes compared to others.
At this stage, where the top survivors have similar attributes.
The bonus from two backpacks could directly widen this gap.
Nobody wants to be inferior!
Moments later, Optimus Prime took a deep breath and said to his confidant next to him: "Go, immediately bid for this batch of backpacks for me, as many as possible!"
The man next to him showed a troubled expression, "Leader, it may be impossible..."
Optimus Prime glared and hurriedly asked: "Impossible? Why?"
The middle-aged man hesitated and said: "Just now, when you had us bid for that batch of blue backpacks and Life Secret Elixirs, we already exhausted the team warehouse’s resources."
"Now, our material reserve is worth less than 200,000 Spirit Cores, you see..."
Optimus Prime froze upon hearing this.
"Only less than 200,000 Spirit Cores left?"
"Didn’t we just recruit a few thousand new people in Cybertron? Did they exhaust their resources as well?"
The confidant nodded.
Optimus Prime was dumbfounded.
Cybertron, as a large group, already had considerable strength in the original two major zones.
Since merging all global survivors into one major zone, he aggressively expanded, recruiting many newcomers over the past two days.
And they all signed at least a one-year Lord Contract with them.
Optimus Prime had felt the experience of earning a fortune rapidly.
He thought his current resource acquisition speed was fast enough.
But unexpectedly, just buying a batch of backpacks and potions from Star River nearly drained his foundation.
Now, he deeply realized how terrifyingly fast Star River’s resource accrual speed was!
Optimus Prime said helplessly: "I understand, see if you can borrow some resources from the brothers."
"We’ll return to them after we sell off this batch of items in our hands."
The confidant was stunned upon hearing this.
Borrowing resources from team members, saying that out loud would be embarrassing.
But there was no other choice, the temptation of the purple backpack was simply too great.
Helpless, he could only do as told.
Meanwhile.
More and more survivors and their teams received the message.
Star River, once a prominent figure of the original two major zones, stirred waves again in the trading channel!
This time, a large batch of exceptional, purple backpacks with strong attached attributes!
After the Blood Tide Monster invasion, the once dull trading channel started lively discussions.
The subject of their discussion was a survivor named Star River.
"Brothers, the Star God’s batch of backpacks is amazing, I’m seriously considering selling everything I have to bid for them!"
"300,000 Spirit Cores, so expensive, but much cheaper than what others are selling for."
"I don’t have enough materials on me, does anyone have some to lend me? I’ll pay you back later!"
"Damn, I also need to find someone to borrow materials from!"
Watching more and more people discussing in the trading channel.
Survivors from other areas finally couldn’t help but ask, "Who is the Star God? Is he famous?"
However, no one responded to them. Instead, they excitedly started looking everywhere to borrow materials, hoping to bid for a few more purple backpacks!
After all, they all knew that backpacks of such excellent quality could sell for 350,000 or even 400,000 Spirit Cores, and people would still buy them.
Buying one is worth it!
Seeing that survivors from two major areas didn’t answer them, those people’s hearts felt like being scratched by a cat’s paw, unbearably itchy.
Curiosity about Star River arose strongly in their hearts, and they started trying to find out who Star River was.
However, after learning about Han Xing’s deeds, they were taken aback.
From the early days of the game, Star River sold Spiritual Spring Water in large quantities, gathering a massive amount of resources.
Later, several transactions established him as the recognized number one in the area.
Then, he dominated the leaderboard all the way.
Not only did he consecutively secure first place for himself three times, but he also helped his friends dominate the top ten.
As more stories about Star River were dug up,
everyone was surprised to realize that he was a legendary character not inferior to Zhou Huang!
It’s just that his development route seemed different from Zhou Huang’s.
Compared to Zhou Huang’s team model, Star River preferred to concentrate all resources in his own hands.
But they also heard that Star River had his own small group.
Information about Han Xing began to spread rapidly among the leaders of various areas.
The Divine Hall of Zone 3, Kyushu of Zone 4, the Immortal Mansion of Zone 5...
These people all learned that a legendary character had appeared in the trading channel again.
Moreover, the importance of this character could no longer be ignored!
After all, two purple backpacks were equivalent to an additional piece of equipment’s attributes.
Those top-tier existences didn’t want to fall behind, especially during the outbreak of the Blood Tide disaster.
The appearance of the purple backpack sparked a wave among the leaders of various territories.
For them, although the price of 300,000 Spirit Cores was a bit high, it was acceptable.
For a while, Han Xing received a flood of private messages.
He usually kept the status of rejecting messages from strangers.
Now, needing to trade, Han Xing had to activate the private chat function.
He glanced over them.
Most were invitations to join their teams.
Like the currently popular Divine Hall and Kyushu, they offered generous treatments.
Some teams even directly promised to let him be the vice leader.
But for Han Xing, their offered benefits couldn’t move him at all.
Some private messages wanted to bulk trade a batch of purple backpacks from him and hoped for a cheaper price.
Han Xing simply ignored these.
He said helplessly, "What are you thinking, trying to stock up from me, right?"
"With this effort, why shouldn’t I just sell more in the trading channel?"
Anyway, the purple backpack market was very hot.
Meanwhile, system notifications of successful trades kept appearing.
[Transaction successful, you received Spirit Core *214000, Refined Iron *41121, and...]
[Transaction successful, you received Spirit Core *114000, Thunder Stone *124, and lost Space Backpack (Purple) *1]
The trade exceeded Han Xing’s expectations in its intensity.
There was no worry about selling this batch of backpacks.
In just five minutes, Han Xing had traded over two thousand backpacks, acquiring materials worth seven to eight billion.
This included a large amount of precious materials like Witch Root Grass, Thunder Stone, and Strong Beast Hide.
As time fermented.
The booming trade market attracted more people’s attention.
More and more people entered the trading channel and learned about Star River’s story.
Currently, on a vast island.
There were various powerful attack constructions and rows of Lord’s Cottages.
This island had even been divided into living and combat areas.
A large-scale battle had just ended there, and thousands of fully-equipped survivors were cleaning up the battlefield.
In the living area, 100,000 Blue Star humans who had just descended into this world were moving about inside.
It presented the appearance of a human settlement!
At this moment, a man with regular features and determined eyes was standing at the edge of the territory.
This person was Zhou Huang.
He was managing his team and accepting a group of survivors who had come to join him.

Information about Han Xing began to spread rapidly among the leaders of various areas.
The Divine Hall of Zone 3, Kyushu of Zone 4, the Immortal Mansion of Zone 5...
These people all learned that a legendary character had appeared in the trading channel again.
Moreover, the importance of this character could no longer be ignored!
After all, two purple backpacks were equivalent to an additional piece of equipment’s attributes.
Those top-tier existences didn’t want to fall behind, especially during the outbreak of the Blood Tide disaster.
The appearance of the purple backpack sparked a wave among the leaders of various territories.
For them, although the price of 300,000 Spirit Cores was a bit high, it was acceptable.
For a while, Han Xing received a flood of private messages.
He usually kept the status of rejecting messages from strangers.
Now, needing to trade, Han Xing had to activate the private chat function.
He glanced over them.
Most were invitations to join their teams.
Like the currently popular Divine Hall and Kyushu, they offered generous treatments.
Some teams even directly promised to let him be the vice leader.
But for Han Xing, their offered benefits couldn’t move him at all.
Some private messages wanted to bulk trade a batch of purple backpacks from him and hoped for a cheaper price.
Han Xing simply ignored these.
He said helplessly, "What are you thinking, trying to stock up from me, right?"
"With this effort, why shouldn’t I just sell more in the trading channel?"
Anyway, the purple backpack market was very hot.
Meanwhile, system notifications of successful trades kept appearing.
[Transaction successful, you received Spirit Core *214000, Refined Iron *41121, and...]
[Transaction successful, you received Spirit Core *114000, Thunder Stone *124, and lost Space Backpack (Purple) *1]
The trade exceeded Han Xing’s expectations in its intensity.
There was no worry about selling this batch of backpacks.
In just five minutes, Han Xing had traded over two thousand backpacks, acquiring materials worth seven to eight billion.
This included a large amount of precious materials like Witch Root Grass, Thunder Stone, and Strong Beast Hide.
As time fermented.
The booming trade market attracted more people’s attention.
More and more people entered the trading channel and learned about Star River’s story.
Currently, on a vast island.
There were various powerful attack constructions and rows of Lord’s Cottages.
This island had even been divided into living and combat areas.
A large-scale battle had just ended there, and thousands of fully-equipped survivors were cleaning up the battlefield.
In the living area, 100,000 Blue Star humans who had just descended into this world were moving about inside.
It presented the appearance of a human settlement!
At this moment, a man with regular features and determined eyes was standing at the edge of the territory.
This person was Zhou Huang.
He was managing his team and accepting a group of survivors who had come to join him.

chapters.title: Chapter 188 - 156: Zhou Huang’s Ambition
paragraphs: Among these survivors, there are more or less some physical issues.
Some may be blind, some may be deaf, and others are simply physically disabled.
With their physical condition, coming to this world is basically a death sentence.
But everyone has the will to survive, no one wants to quietly die like a weed by the roadside.
This group of physically challenged individuals started actively speaking in the chat channel, looking for others who are disadvantaged and formed a mutual aid society.
They hadn’t even organized yet, and they saw or heard Zhou Huang’s speech on the public channel.
At this moment.
A pair of physically challenged middle-aged man and woman among the survivors, supporting each other, came forward; they seemed to be a couple.
The woman had no legs, so she could only lie on the ground, using her hands for support.
Although physically disabled, you could still see the tenacious gaze in the woman’s eyes.
She looked at Zhou Huang and gratefully said, "Director Zhou, thank you, you’re truly a good person."
"My husband and I just arrived in this world, and because of our physical defects, we didn’t dare follow the system prompts to fight monsters."
"When we encountered others, they were unwilling to accept us..."
"If we hadn’t seen your message, my husband and I would have prepared to end it all."
"I kneel here to thank you!"
After saying this, the middle-aged couple was about to kneel and kowtow to Zhou Huang.
Zhou Huang quickly helped them up, seriously shaking his head and said, "Aunt Liu, there’s no need for that."
"Since you’ve come all the way to our ’Huayi Alliance’ territory, I, Zhou Huang, will honor my word and certainly take care of you!"
The middle-aged couple exchanged looks and showed gratitude on their faces.
At this moment, Zhou Huang glanced at their physical condition, furrowed his brow and said, "Aunt Liu, what’s with your and your husband’s body?"
This question seemed somewhat piercing, touching their hearts.
The woman without legs hesitated for a moment and explained, "To be honest, Director Zhou, my husband and I were left with sequelae from a car accident."
"To save my life, the doctor amputated my legs, and my husband lost an arm too."
"Now, we’re just useless..."
Saying this, the middle-aged woman bit her lip, and said firmly, "If Director Zhou finds it difficult, we can leave, we don’t want to be a burden on you..."
After speaking, the middle-aged woman used her hands to try to crawl back to her territory.
Seeing this, Zhou Huang quickly pulled her and said, "Aunt Liu, you misunderstood."
"I didn’t mean to drive you away, I just wanted to see if there’s a possibility for your bodies to recover."
"Recover?"
A trace of surprise appeared on the faces of the middle-aged couple.
Zhou Huang nodded and said, "Yes."
"Currently, everyone only experiences the dangers of this world, but haven’t realized the enormous opportunities."
"The magic and might of this world is beyond your imagination!"
"Opportunity?"
Behind the middle-aged couple, the group of physically challenged survivors, all focused their attention on Zhou Huang!
Zhou Long, with a smile, continued, "That’s right!"
"The first opportunity before you is the upgrading system!"
"We survivors from Blue Star obtain experience by fighting monsters and then upgrade; every level up enhances physical fitness.
"Though your bodies may be weak now, as long as you level up a few times, your physical indices will soar!"
"By then, if not reaching a superhuman level, maintaining daily life should be sufficient."
After hearing Zhou Huang’s explanation, the middle-aged couple, along with other survivors, showed a look of surprise.
As the second batch of survivors sent here, either due to physical reasons or needing to care for relatives, their level and equipment were far behind others.
Among them, most are still at level 0, without having killed a single monster.
Hence, they haven’t experienced the benefits of attribute enhancement.
At this moment, they couldn’t help asking, "Director Zhou, do you mean we can become as strong as you in the future?"
Zhou Huang nodded, "That’s definite."
"Not only that, as you continue to grow stronger, your bodies will regain vitality and even lifespan can be increased!"
"And, I will endeavor to find items that can help restore your bodies."
Hearing this, all survivors showed a shocked expression.
Zhou Huang continued, "Do not doubt, as I just said, the power of this world far surpasses anything you can imagine."
"Even revival of the dead is possible, let alone repairing physical defects."
"Moreover, our ’Huayi Alliance’ will protect you before you’ve grown."
This sentence accurately struck at their vital point.
Restoring the body and living like a normal person is something they yearn for!
And this man promises to help them achieve this dream one day!
For a moment, the group looked at Zhou Huang with eyes full of gratitude, respect, and even admiration.
At this moment, the middle-aged man beside the disabled woman, with red eyes, said, "Director Zhou, not to mention anything else."
"If you can help me heal this leg, I, Old Chen, am willing to work like a horse for you for the rest of my life!"
"I, Lao Huang, as well!"
"Director Zhou, I’m willing to face the flames for you!"
Thud!
Thud!
The group of survivors knelt down in unison.
Zhou Huang quickly waved his hands to stop them, saying, "Please get up, please get up! You are exaggerating too much."
"As humans, even though we have come to this world, we are still compatriots, with the same blood flowing through us. It’s only right to help you."
"Besides, I haven’t even healed you yet, so thank me after you’ve fully recovered."
After speaking, Zhou Huang personally went over and helped each of the survivors up.
The survivors were all deeply moved.
Then, under Zhou Huang’s arrangement, the survivors settled down with the other people in the territory.
There is no denying it, Zhou Huang indeed possesses a unique ability; with just a few words, he won the loyalty of all the survivors.
Moreover, when these words come from him, there’s not a trace of insincerity or pretentiousness.
It’s as if this person truly embodies light and justice.
At that moment, a middle-aged man, who rarely spoke, approached Zhou Huang and whispered a few words.
Zhou Huang, who always wore a gentle smile, showed a hint of surprise.
"Oh? There’s actually such a person."
"You mean, his name is Star River?"
The middle-aged man nodded, and with a serious expression, asked, "Colonel... I mean, Director Zhou, I’m wondering if we should reach out to him and try to pull him into our team."
"After all, from the information I have, it seems this Star River hasn’t formed a team yet.
"And the amount of resources he holds is estimated to be enough to build at least a thousand flamethrower catapults. Such a powerful force, I think, should be under our control!"
Zhou Huang looked at him seriously, then after a moment, asked with a light smile, "Uncle Jun, do you think someone at my level would willingly live under someone else’s roof?"
The middle-aged man was momentarily stunned, seemingly unable to believe that Zhou Huang rated Star River on the same level as himself.
He clearly knew how powerful the man before him was.
To establish a team recognized as the top among billions of people speaks to his abilities.
Seeing Zhou Huang refuse, the middle-aged man cautiously asked, "Then should I have the brothers find out Star River’s location...?"
"After all, he hasn’t established a team yet..."
The meaning of this statement was obvious, feeling that Han Xing was still weak, it was the best time to act.
After hearing this, Zhou Huang didn’t answer.
Instead, he looked at him with a smile, full of inscrutable meaning.
The middle-aged man felt a chill under his smile and hurriedly explained.
"Leader... Director! I didn’t mean any harm, I just wanted him to contribute some of his resources."
"After all, ever since you released that statement, a large number of survivors have been gathering towards us every moment."
"Now, the number of these lower-level survivors has exceeded 200,000."
"At this stage, they can’t offer us help, and just feeding them daily is a huge expense..."
"For the bigger picture, we indeed need more resources to expand the territory, even if it’s to cultivate farmland, grow some crops, at least give them something to do..."
After saying this, the middle-aged man carefully glanced at Zhou Huang.
Zhou Huang thought for a moment, patted his shoulder, and said, "I know, and I don’t blame you, you’re thinking for the bigger picture."
The middle-aged man finally breathed a sigh of relief upon hearing this.
Zhou Huang continued, "I’m aware of the difficulties you mentioned."
"However, things will be resolved soon."
"Uncle Jun, trust me."
"Even if we face greater difficulties ahead, I will lead everyone to survive."
"And even lead all of humanity to victory!"
"By then, I will be the Human Emperor of the new world!"
Hearing Zhou Huang’s bold declaration, the middle-aged man didn’t have a shred of doubt.
Instead, he looked at the man before him with a gaze of admiration.
Because he believed, this man could achieve it!
Meanwhile, Han Xing was still frantically trading.
Twenty minutes later.
All 5,200 backpacks were sold out.
At the same time, Han Xing also reaped nearly 1.6 billion in materials.
Han Xing, with an uncontrollable look of joy in his eyes, exclaimed excitedly, "Wow, this feels awesome!"
"This time, I’ve truly hit the jackpot!"
This trade made Han Xing realize the demand for purple backpacks.
The 5,200 backpacks couldn’t satisfy the huge market demand at all!

chapters.title: Chapter 189 - 157: Goddess of Nature, All Things Grow
paragraphs: This amount of backpacks is completely insufficient to meet the overwhelming market demand.
Han Xing can produce more backpacks and reap substantial profits from it!
For this reason, Han Xing deliberately exchanged more Strong Beast Hide during material transactions.
He looked at the materials in his warehouse and fell into deep ecstasy.
"Wow! Forty thousand Strong Beast Hides, just these alone, could make seven to eight thousand purple backpacks!"
"Converted to Spirit Core, that’s a value of 2.4 billion!"
A thick sense of joy appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
And this was just a small part of his current transaction gains.
Apart from Strong Beast Hide, he also has over thirty thousand Thunder Stones, plus over twenty thousand acquired from selling blue backpacks.
Now, his Thunder Stone reserve has reached 50,000!
This amount is enough for Han Xing to erect over 50 more Lightning Towers, doubling the number directly!
Additionally, there’s a massive amount of Refined Iron, Mithril, and even tens of thousands of Permanent Gold Ingots!
These materials could again establish over a thousand Flamethrower Catapults!
Thinking of this, Han Xing became even more excited!
Now, just by absorbing all the resources obtained from this transaction and converting them into combat power.
Then, his territory’s defensive strength will once again undergo a qualitative change!
At that time, he will truly be unafraid of the Blood Tide crisis!
However, after selling all these purple backpacks, Han Xing’s resources will be nearly depleted.
In the short term, he can no longer acquire resources like he did today.
"It seems I must prepare for the next transaction as soon as possible."
"But, what should I sell next time?"
Han Xing fell into contemplation.
He currently has a very ample supply of materials.
By turning all the forty thousand plus Strong Beast Hides into backpacks, he could make around eight thousand purple backpacks.
If sold at the current price, Han Xing could once again harvest materials worth over 2.4 billion.
Moreover, he can continue this model.
But there’s a precondition.
And that is time is needed to make purple backpacks.
Assuming one purple backpack takes 200 seconds to make, with an advanced assembly line technology boost, it also requires 100 seconds.
of them, taking over 200 hours.
At least 9 days are needed!
But now, Han Xing can’t spare so much time making purple backpacks.
He also has to manufacture large amounts of Blood Curse Antidote.
During the Blood Tide, Blood Curse Antidote is the most urgently needed item for all survivors.
This time’s transaction, the three materials yielded quite a lot, just for Blood Curse Antidote, over a hundred thousand bottles can be made!
However, although making Blood Curse Antidote takes much less time than purple backpacks, the sheer number is overwhelming.
Over one hundred thousand bottles, calculated at ten seconds per bottle, also need over 200 hours, nearly twelve days.
With Refining Workshop’s technological acceleration, it still takes 6 days, equivalent to producing only over ten thousand bottles daily.
This output can’t meet the demand of Blue Star’s tens of billions of survivors.
Han Xing frowned, "It seems, I must quickly acquire some items that can speed up production time, or territory buildings with acceleration functions."
"Otherwise, I won’t be able to maximize the value of the Blood Curse Antidote formula I have."
At this moment, Han Xing said somewhat regretfully.
"Although this time I earned a lot of materials, I didn’t get the Minotaur Totem and building blueprints I most wanted."
Even though Han Xing specifically noted the need for relevant items, and was even willing to sell purple backpacks in bulk for exchange.
But those large regiment leaders are cunning.
They would rather pay more Spirit Core than trade those precious things.
Thinking about this, a contemplative look appeared in Han Xing’s eyes again.
He murmured softly: "After this server merger, among tens of billions of people, there should be a lot of good stuff."
"Although the total value of purple backpacks is very high, a single one is still not enough to make them give up their treasures."
"Only by offering something even more precious can I get them to hand over the treasures they hold!"
Han Xing glanced at his own backpack.
Now, the item that should tempt them, is the Blood Curse Antidote.
But this thing, the value of a single bottle isn’t as great as imagined.
After all, unless the Blood Curse stacks to an intolerable level.
Before that, survivors can still maintain life using a Holy Profession’s Purification Technique.
Han Xing pondered: "If Blood Curse Antidote won’t work, then what other precious things do I have?"
Han Xing opened his own warehouse, searching through the vast amount of materials.
This search indeed yielded quite a few good things.
That is, the dozens of pieces of Golden Equipment piled up in a corner of the warehouse!
Han Xing counted them, there were actually as many as 18 items!
These were the dozen or so unused pieces of Golden Equipment Han Xing obtained when opening Golden Treasure Chests, all above Level 20.
These pieces of equipment, in terms of total value, might not compare to those thousands of backpacks.
But rarity makes them valuable.
Currently, the trading channel rarely sees such high-level Golden Equipment.
According to market price, the value of these Golden Equipment ranges from 1 to 2 million Spirit Core.
Those with Legendary Level effects are sold for over 2.5 million.
Currently, the vast majority of survivors hover around Level 15-16, with only a small elite group reaching Level 20 at this time.
After a moment of contemplation, Han Xing took out all these Golden Equipment from his backpack.

Han Xing opened his own warehouse, searching through the vast amount of materials.
This search indeed yielded quite a few good things.
That is, the dozens of pieces of Golden Equipment piled up in a corner of the warehouse!
Han Xing counted them, there were actually as many as 18 items!
These were the dozen or so unused pieces of Golden Equipment Han Xing obtained when opening Golden Treasure Chests, all above Level 20.
These pieces of equipment, in terms of total value, might not compare to those thousands of backpacks.
But rarity makes them valuable.
Currently, the trading channel rarely sees such high-level Golden Equipment.
According to market price, the value of these Golden Equipment ranges from 1 to 2 million Spirit Core.
Those with Legendary Level effects are sold for over 2.5 million.
Currently, the vast majority of survivors hover around Level 15-16, with only a small elite group reaching Level 20 at this time.
After a moment of contemplation, Han Xing took out all these Golden Equipment from his backpack.

chapters.title: Chapter 190 - 157: Goddess of Nature, All Things Grow
paragraphs: Then, one by one, he began to set trading conditions.
[Consignment Item Information]: Commander’s Longbow (Gold), Blood Battleaxe (Gold), Cutter’s Dagger (Gold), Soul Heart Short Blade...
[Consignment Requirement]: Same-level Golden Equipment, Territory Building Blueprints, Minotaur Totem, Ice Heart...
[Consignor]: Star River
Seller’s Note: Collecting same-value Golden Armor, blueprints, Minotaur Totem, rare materials, and other items in large quantities. If unsure about the price, feel free to PM me.
After setting all these.
Han Xing clicked to list them.
When eighteen pieces of level 20 Golden Armor appeared in the trading channel, all with the same consignor name, it caused another sensation tonight!
Everyone was shocked by the powerful attributes of those 18 pieces of Golden Armor.
"So much Golden Armor, Legendary Quality!"
"They’re all above level 20 Golden Armor, such strong attributes!"
"The consignor is Star River again, this is the third time tonight!"
"Yes, I said the Star God has been dormant for so long, but when he strikes, it’s truly extraordinary!"
That night, millions of survivors who experienced three waves of trading events deeply remembered the name Star River.
And they remembered one phrase.
Produce by Star River, guaranteed to be a premium product!
As long as it’s something he sells, buying it will never be a loss.
"Wow, this Blood Battleaxe is actually Legendary Quality, and it has an execution effect!"
"That Commander’s Longbow is great too, trap damage increased by 30%, it’s simply a hunter’s divine artifact!"
"And the attributes of other Golden Armor are equally formidable!"
"Who has building blueprints, go trade with the Star God fast!"
As news of a large amount of Golden Armor appeared on the trading channel, more and more survivors poured in.
Golden Armor with such powerful attributes is particularly favored by those top entities.
At the same time, Han Xing also received a lot of private messages from survivors.
"Would you trade the Giant Rock Barrier blueprint for the Blood Battleaxe?"
"Steel Guardian blueprint for the Shadow Greatsword!"
"Would Star God be willing to join our Penglai?"
"Composite Cannon blueprint..."
Han Xing glanced through and filtered out some useless information.
Indeed, he found a lot of good things among them!
Han Xing’s eyes also showed some delight.
Sure enough, as long as the items offered are precious enough, you won’t worry about these people not surrendering their treasures!
Among the hundreds of private messages, Han Xing even saw quite a few blueprints that tempted him.
Most of them are attack-type buildings, without any special effects.
These blueprints replicate many of the functions of buildings on his territory.
With these materials, he’d rather build more catapults and Thunderbolt Towers.
However, among them, Han Xing did find a few interesting blueprints.
One of them is called ’Territory Core Acceleration Device.’
Its function is to consume a large amount of Spirit Core, allowing the territory’s movement speed to increase by three times!
If used properly, this thing is definitely an escape artifact.
Han Xing felt it was worth a Golden Weapon, so he decisively made the exchange.
[Transaction successful, you received the ’Territory Core Acceleration Device Blueprint’, and lost Commander’s Longbow (Gold) *1]
Another blueprint he also found very promising.
[Natural Goddess Statue Construction Plan]: Accelerates the growth speed of all plants on the territory by 30%, accompanied by the effect: All Things Grow.
This blueprint is also something he urgently needs at the moment.
With this, he could realize his idea of mass planting Witch Root Grass and greatly shorten its production cycle.
After all, the quantity of Witch Root Grass on the trading channel is limited.
Even if he swept it all, it wouldn’t meet his needs for crafting Blood Curse Antidote.
So, the best approach is to be self-sufficient.
If he can solve the source of materials like Witch Root Grass, Han Xing could really start mass-producing Curse-Blood Antidote now.
Han Xing also directly clicked on the trade.
[Transaction successful, you received Natural Goddess Statue Blueprint *1, and lost Black Fire Staff (Gold) *1]
Next, Han Xing continued to review messages one by one.
However, the blueprints sent afterward were somewhat mixed with mediocre ones.
Among them, someone even sent over a toilet construction blueprint.
Han Xing couldn’t help but twitch the corner of his mouth.
Even though he specifically marked that he needed items to speed up territory construction and equipment crafting.
But it’s unclear whether people don’t have them or simply don’t want to give them up.
So far, Han Xing hasn’t seen relevant tool information.
Yet, they do have other parts of Golden Armor.
Though some of the attributes of these armors are a notch below what Han Xing is selling.
But if there are parts he doesn’t own or are usable by Zhang Lianmeng and others.
Han Xing would still choose to exchange.
When all these dozen pieces of Golden Armor were traded, Han Xing swapped for a total of 14 pieces of Golden Armor.
Cloth Armor, Leather Armor, Light Armor are all included, and there are bracelets, necklaces, rings, etc...
Han Xing plans to distribute these armors shortly.
By then, the five of them will almost be fully equipped with a set of Golden Armor, their strength able to be enhanced to another level.
Besides.
Han Xing also traded for three building blueprints and a small totem.
They are respectively:
Ice Arrow Tower, Natural Goddess Statue, Territory Core Acceleration Device.
And Minotaur Totem.
Although he didn’t get the speed-enhancing tools he most desired, Han Xing still breathed a heavy sigh of relief.
To this extent.
Everything Han Xing had been stockpiling in the warehouse these few days was finally traded away.
"It’s finally over, this time, the harvest was extraordinarily plentiful!" Han Xing had joy in his eyes.
More than just plentiful.
After an hour, through three waves of trading.
Han Xing acquired materials worth approximately 3.5 billion Spirit Cores!
What is the concept of 3.5 billion?
Since Han Xing entered Sky Island Paradise, the total value of various tools exchanged through several trades did not exceed 1.5 billion!
And these tools allowed him to build thousands of siege crossbow arrow launchers, over four hundred flamethrower catapults, and twenty-seven Thunderbolt Towers.
And this time, it nearly doubled, if not more!
Han Xing was also excitedly checking the other three items he just exchanged.
The first one is a blueprint for an attack building, called the Ice Arrow Tower.
[Ice Arrow Tower]: Territory-type defensive building.

[Building Effect]: Every 5 seconds, emits an ice arrow with deceleration effect, dealing 1000 points of ice attribute damage to the enemy, with a maximum range of 10,000 meters, causing 2.5 seconds of deceleration.
[Construction Materials Required]: Refined Iron *80000, Mithril *3000, Permanent Gold Ingot *150, Ether *500000, Ice Crystal Stone *2000.
This Ice Arrow Tower is also quite a decent defensive building.
But compared to the Thunderbolt Tower, it falls short by a long way.
Firstly, the ice arrows it shoots are not area damage, if it didn’t have the deceleration effect, at most it would be an enhanced version of a siege crossbow arrow.
Moreover, it requires a lot of materials, which an ordinary survivor can hardly mass-produce.
However, the Ice Arrow Tower has the advantage of attacking frequency.
seconds per ice arrow shot, accompanied by a 2.5-second deceleration status.
Meaning there’s only a 2.5-second window in between.
If you build enough Ice Arrow Towers, you can fully achieve continuous deceleration effect.
Thus, not only does it slow down the speed of those monsters, but it also provides other siege devices more charging time.
Han Xing also decided, to build a couple of hundred Ice Arrow Towers to serve as auxiliary towers for the Thunderbolt Tower.
The second blueprint is the Goddess Statue.
[Natural Goddess Statue]: Special building.
[Building Effect]: Accelerates growth speed of all plants within the territory by 30%.
The statue can autonomously absorb the power of nature from the world, and every 72 hours, it can release the ’All Things Grow’ effect once.
[All Things Grow]: Accelerates plant growth cycle by 7 days within a 100*100 meter area of the territory.
It can also directly use 720,000 Spirit Cores to immediately release the ’All Things Grow’ effect.
"Whoa? This accompanying effect is quite interesting?"
Seeing the attached All Things Grow, Han Xing’s eyes lit up.
Previously he thought this statue could only accelerate the growth cycle by 30%.
Now, he’s discovered an unexpected surprise!
