chapters.title: Chapter 191 - 158: Sleeping Soundly Without Worries (Happy New Year)
paragraphs: Han Xing discovered a surprise on this statue.
Moreover, this surprise is greatly beneficial to him!
In his current territory, the most planted material is Witch Root Grass.
According to the effects recorded on the blueprint.
One use of ’All Things Grow’ can shorten the growth cycle of all plants within a 100*100 meter area by 7 days.
An area of tens of thousands of square meters can grow at least more than one hundred thousand Witch Root Grass.
Calculating based on their 30-day growth cycle, after accelerating by 30%, it’s roughly 21 days.
After that, just three more waves of ’All Things Grow’ can directly mature all these Witch Root Grass.
In other words, from the time Han Xing plants the Witch Root Grass, as long as he invests 2.16 million Spirit Core, he can directly harvest!
Calculating it, this is completely a profitable deal!
Han Xing’s mood became better.
Witch Root Grass can be mass matured, the Cursed Blood now has tens of millions in the trading channel.
And the Divine Aurora...
He can also construct hundreds of Aurora Aggregators again, with an hourly output that is quite impressive.
This way, the sources of the three materials to make Cursed Blood are all settled!
"Great, if I expedite the production of Cursed Blood now, I should have 50,000 bottles by tomorrow."
"Then I can assess and sell a batch of antidotes!" Han Xing couldn’t help but clench his fists.
Then, he took out that small totem from his backpack, with the item introduction appearing on it.
[Minotaur Totem]: Special type item, possessing this totem grants recognition from the Minotaur tribe.
"Great! With this totem, I can raise a new batch of troops!" Han Xing was excited.
This totem was something he had been searching for all along.
However, the item he wanted most - one that accelerates equipment production time, or a territory building with similar function - was still absent.
Nonetheless, Han Xing’s gains from this transaction were already quite frightening!
The immediate priority now is to quickly transform all these resources into combat power.
Han Xing, also with a face full of excitement, arrived at the wall of Xingyu City.
His gaze was passionate because he could finally build various Defense Towers extravagantly!
The first to be constructed, of course, is the most powerful Thunderbolt Tower!
Its main required material is the Thunder Stone.
In this transaction, he acquired 52,241 pieces.
A total of 52 Thunderbolt Towers, along with the 28 already built in the territory, that makes 80!
When the time comes, the simultaneous burst of 80 Thunderbolt Towers - just thinking about the scene is thrilling!
Han Xing directly clicked on build.
System prompt appeared.
[Consume materials: Refined Iron*300000, Mithril*50000, Permanent Gold Ingot*500, Magic Crystal*200000, Rare Earth*500000, Thunder Stone*1000, build Thunderbolt Tower*1?]
"Yes!"
[Building: City Lord’s Mansion acceleration effect active, estimated remaining time, 18 hours 34 minutes...]
Han Xing began to construct batches of Thunderbolt Towers.
Every few dozen meters, Han Xing would find a piece of free land and click build.
Clicked fifty times in succession, with massive material consumption afterward.
Among them, Refined Iron consumed over 15 million, Mithril consumed over 2.5 million, plus 25,000 pieces of Permanent Gold Ingot!
Just these fifty Thunderbolt Towers almost drained one third of Han Xing’s material reserves.
However, it was all worth it.
Seeing those fifty smoke-spewing bases around the territory, he was thrilled!
"Wonderful, after eighteen hours, I will possess eighty Thunderbolt Towers."
"Then let’s see if those Blood Tide Monsters dare to besiege me!"
"Come as many as you want, I’ll kill as many as come!" Han Xing thought with pride.
"Oh right, also build a batch of Ice Arrow Towers to help Thunderbolt Towers during the energy accumulation interval.
Han Xing looked at his blueprint interface.
A building similar to Arrow Tower appeared.
However, the entire Arrow Tower was blue.
This thing belongs to the same tier as Flamethrower Catapult attack buildings, with Ice Crystal Stone as the main consumed material.
Han Xing’s current Ice Crystal Stone reserves are about 300,000 pieces, if fully invested, can build 150 Ice Arrow Towers, which is quite good.
Near each Thunderbolt Tower, Han Xing found a piece of free ground and directly clicked on build.
[Consume materials: Refined Iron*80000, Mithril*3000, Permanent Gold Ingot*150, Ether*500000, Ice Crystal Stone*2000, build Ice Arrow Tower*1]
"Yes."
[Building, Lord’s Mansion acceleration effect active, remaining time 7 hours 42 minutes...]
This construction time is much shorter compared to Thunderbolt Tower.
Han Xing continued to click crazily.
Soon, 300,000 Ice Crystal Stones were consumed.
In addition, tens of millions of Refined Iron and hundreds of thousands of Mithril were consumed.
Although Han Xing’s resources come quickly, they’re consumed quickly as well.
Just these two types of buildings consumed about half of Han Xing’s material reserves.
Han Xing didn’t mind.
Because he still wants to build other structures.
Flamethrower Catapult!
This item is the second most powerful entity after the Thunderbolt Tower!
Though its range is slightly short, the effect is genuinely impressive.
Not only does it come with large area explosion damage, but targets hit are also inflicted with burning effects.
Han Xing began to batch construct Flamethrower Catapults on the perimeter of the city wall.
[Consume materials..., build Flamethrower Catapult*1?]
"Yes!"
This time, Han Xing directly built 800 flamethrower catapults!
It once again consumed nearly a billion worth of materials.
Now.
The edge of Xingyu City’s walls is almost entirely surrounded by these attack devices!
He only needs to wait until tomorrow, and his territory’s firepower can directly double or triple!
By then, even when faced with larger armies of monsters, he will have no fear!
Then, Han Xing hurriedly went to the Town Square to construct another important item.
Statue of the Goddess of Nature.
This thing can speed up the growth rate of plants within the territory, and with the investment of a large number of spirit cores, it can accelerate the growth cycle of the plants in the territory.
It’s also one of the important buildings that needs to be constructed as soon as possible!
He opened the blueprint interface.
An image of a goddess appeared, wearing a crown of grass, and clothes woven from leaves that only covered her private areas.
She was holding a short wooden bow, her clear eyes were bright and determinedly looking forward, as if nothing could stop her will.
Compared to the Dawn and Dark Night Goddesses, the Goddess of Nature’s figure is more alluring, with a wild beauty.
Han Xing murmured softly, "The Dawn Goddess, the Dark Night Goddess, and the Goddess of Nature."
"Now, there are three goddess statues in my Town Square."
"I wonder how many goddesses there are in this world."
"If possible, I’d really like to collect all these statues and play a game of connecting goddess statues!"
Thinking of this, Han Xing couldn’t help but reveal an evil smile.
Then, he directly clicked on construct.
[Do you want to consume materials to construct a Statue of the Goddess of Nature*1?]
"Yes."
The construction time for the Statue of the Goddess of Nature is similar to the other two goddess statues, and also takes about seven to eight hours.
At this moment, Han Xing began to check the last special blueprint he obtained.
[Territory Core Accelerator]
[Building Effect]: An accelerator can be built on the territory core, increasing its movement speed by 50%.
By investing 20,000 spirit cores each time, the acceleration effect can be used, increasing the territory’s movement speed by 200% for 60 seconds.
"Interesting, accelerating for one minute with 20,000 spirit cores?"
"According to my territory’s current speed, increasing by 50% means nearly 900 kilometers per hour, and increasing by two times means almost three thousand kilometers per hour."
"Hiss..."
After calculating a bit, Han Xing couldn’t help but gasp.
Don’t just look at it as a simple acceleration effect.
But this thing can be used as a lifesaver at critical moments!
For example, when being besieged today, if Han Xing couldn’t hold on.
If there was this acceleration device at that time.
He could have directly controlled the territory to escape, and those monsters wouldn’t have been able to catch up with him at all.
Han Xing could even imagine the scene of his Sky Island speeding ahead, with a large number of monsters chasing behind.
"Oh my, wouldn’t it be like acting out a scene from Fast and Furious?"
Han Xing couldn’t help but laugh mischievously, and then he went straight to the basement of the City Lord’s Mansion.
At a depth of more than ten meters in the basement lies Han Xing’s core territory.
Looking at this one square meter small block, Han Xing also sighed.
It was from this small block that he step by step built this vast Xingyu City.
As he walked along... Huh, it didn’t seem that difficult?
After all, except for some difficulties encountered when he first came to this world.
Later on, his territory development went quite smoothly.
Even Xingyu City was snatched.
Thinking of this, Han Xing revealed a confident smile.
Then, he directly clicked on construct.
[Do you want to consume materials to construct a Core Accelerator*1?]
"Yes."
[Currently constructing, the lord’s mansion acceleration function is in effect, remaining time 12 hours 32 minutes...]
Han Xing exhaled a breath of relief.
After completing all these.
He hurriedly went to the open space below.
Because now, he needed to build another important building, the Minotaur Camp.
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help shaking his head and sighing, "I really am a hardworking and good lord."
Then he took out the Horn Totem from his backpack.
After selecting the location, he also directly clicked on construct.
[Currently constructing Minotaur Camp, remaining time 14 hours 13 minutes...]
After dealing with all these.
Han Xing finally let out a heavy breath of relief.
The two-hour transaction had made his overall territory strength soar several times.
This means that unless he encounters Blood Tide monsters several times more numerous than today or at increasingly higher levels.
Han Xing can now rest easy.
At this time, Han Xing caught a glimpse of the hundreds of green figures under Xingyu City.
There was where he built the Wolf Cavalry Camp.
Now, over three hundred wolf cavalry had already appeared.
Before Han Xing gave an order, they would all stay put, not moving an inch.
This time, Han Xing directly clicked for 10,000, at the speed of one every 10 seconds, it would take twenty-eight hours to summon them all.

Among them, Refined Iron consumed over 15 million, Mithril consumed over 2.5 million, plus 25,000 pieces of Permanent Gold Ingot!
Just these fifty Thunderbolt Towers almost drained one third of Han Xing’s material reserves.
However, it was all worth it.
Seeing those fifty smoke-spewing bases around the territory, he was thrilled!
"Wonderful, after eighteen hours, I will possess eighty Thunderbolt Towers."
"Then let’s see if those Blood Tide Monsters dare to besiege me!"
"Come as many as you want, I’ll kill as many as come!" Han Xing thought with pride.
"Oh right, also build a batch of Ice Arrow Towers to help Thunderbolt Towers during the energy accumulation interval.
Han Xing looked at his blueprint interface.
A building similar to Arrow Tower appeared.
However, the entire Arrow Tower was blue.
This thing belongs to the same tier as Flamethrower Catapult attack buildings, with Ice Crystal Stone as the main consumed material.
Han Xing’s current Ice Crystal Stone reserves are about 300,000 pieces, if fully invested, can build 150 Ice Arrow Towers, which is quite good.
Near each Thunderbolt Tower, Han Xing found a piece of free ground and directly clicked on build.
[Consume materials: Refined Iron*80000, Mithril*3000, Permanent Gold Ingot*150, Ether*500000, Ice Crystal Stone*2000, build Ice Arrow Tower*1]
"Yes."
[Building, Lord’s Mansion acceleration effect active, remaining time 7 hours 42 minutes...]
This construction time is much shorter compared to Thunderbolt Tower.
Han Xing continued to click crazily.
Soon, 300,000 Ice Crystal Stones were consumed.
In addition, tens of millions of Refined Iron and hundreds of thousands of Mithril were consumed.
Although Han Xing’s resources come quickly, they’re consumed quickly as well.
Just these two types of buildings consumed about half of Han Xing’s material reserves.
Han Xing didn’t mind.
Because he still wants to build other structures.
Flamethrower Catapult!
This item is the second most powerful entity after the Thunderbolt Tower!
Though its range is slightly short, the effect is genuinely impressive.
Not only does it come with large area explosion damage, but targets hit are also inflicted with burning effects.
Han Xing began to batch construct Flamethrower Catapults on the perimeter of the city wall.
[Consume materials..., build Flamethrower Catapult*1?]
"Yes!"
This time, Han Xing directly built 800 flamethrower catapults!
It once again consumed nearly a billion worth of materials.
Now.
The edge of Xingyu City’s walls is almost entirely surrounded by these attack devices!
He only needs to wait until tomorrow, and his territory’s firepower can directly double or triple!
By then, even when faced with larger armies of monsters, he will have no fear!
Then, Han Xing hurriedly went to the Town Square to construct another important item.
Statue of the Goddess of Nature.
This thing can speed up the growth rate of plants within the territory, and with the investment of a large number of spirit cores, it can accelerate the growth cycle of the plants in the territory.
It’s also one of the important buildings that needs to be constructed as soon as possible!
He opened the blueprint interface.
An image of a goddess appeared, wearing a crown of grass, and clothes woven from leaves that only covered her private areas.
She was holding a short wooden bow, her clear eyes were bright and determinedly looking forward, as if nothing could stop her will.
Compared to the Dawn and Dark Night Goddesses, the Goddess of Nature’s figure is more alluring, with a wild beauty.
Han Xing murmured softly, "The Dawn Goddess, the Dark Night Goddess, and the Goddess of Nature."
"Now, there are three goddess statues in my Town Square."
"I wonder how many goddesses there are in this world."
"If possible, I’d really like to collect all these statues and play a game of connecting goddess statues!"
Thinking of this, Han Xing couldn’t help but reveal an evil smile.
Then, he directly clicked on construct.
[Do you want to consume materials to construct a Statue of the Goddess of Nature*1?]
"Yes."
The construction time for the Statue of the Goddess of Nature is similar to the other two goddess statues, and also takes about seven to eight hours.
At this moment, Han Xing began to check the last special blueprint he obtained.
[Territory Core Accelerator]
[Building Effect]: An accelerator can be built on the territory core, increasing its movement speed by 50%.
By investing 20,000 spirit cores each time, the acceleration effect can be used, increasing the territory’s movement speed by 200% for 60 seconds.
"Interesting, accelerating for one minute with 20,000 spirit cores?"
"According to my territory’s current speed, increasing by 50% means nearly 900 kilometers per hour, and increasing by two times means almost three thousand kilometers per hour."
"Hiss..."
After calculating a bit, Han Xing couldn’t help but gasp.
Don’t just look at it as a simple acceleration effect.
But this thing can be used as a lifesaver at critical moments!
For example, when being besieged today, if Han Xing couldn’t hold on.
If there was this acceleration device at that time.
He could have directly controlled the territory to escape, and those monsters wouldn’t have been able to catch up with him at all.
Han Xing could even imagine the scene of his Sky Island speeding ahead, with a large number of monsters chasing behind.
"Oh my, wouldn’t it be like acting out a scene from Fast and Furious?"
Han Xing couldn’t help but laugh mischievously, and then he went straight to the basement of the City Lord’s Mansion.
At a depth of more than ten meters in the basement lies Han Xing’s core territory.
Looking at this one square meter small block, Han Xing also sighed.
It was from this small block that he step by step built this vast Xingyu City.
As he walked along...
Huh, it didn’t seem that difficult?
After all, except for some difficulties encountered when he first came to this world.
Later on, his territory development went quite smoothly.
Even Xingyu City was snatched.
Thinking of this, Han Xing revealed a confident smile.
Then, he directly clicked on construct.
[Do you want to consume materials to construct a Core Accelerator*1?]
"Yes."
[Currently constructing, the lord’s mansion acceleration function is in effect, remaining time 12 hours 32 minutes...]
Han Xing exhaled a breath of relief.
After completing all these.
He hurriedly went to the open space below.
Because now, he needed to build another important building, the Minotaur Camp.
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help shaking his head and sighing, "I really am a hardworking and good lord."
Then he took out the Horn Totem from his backpack.
After selecting the location, he also directly clicked on construct.
[Currently constructing Minotaur Camp, remaining time 14 hours 13 minutes...]
After dealing with all these.
Han Xing finally let out a heavy breath of relief.
The two-hour transaction had made his overall territory strength soar several times.
This means that unless he encounters Blood Tide monsters several times more numerous than today or at increasingly higher levels.
Han Xing can now rest easy.
At this time, Han Xing caught a glimpse of the hundreds of green figures under Xingyu City.
There was where he built the Wolf Cavalry Camp.
Now, over three hundred wolf cavalry had already appeared.
Before Han Xing gave an order, they would all stay put, not moving an inch.
This time, Han Xing directly clicked for 10,000, at the speed of one every 10 seconds, it would take twenty-eight hours to summon them all.

chapters.title: Chapter 192 - 159: Dramatic Increase in Strength
paragraphs: After more than twenty hours, Han Xing will have his first army of wolf cavalry.
By that time, they will also bring him considerable support.
Han Xing was just about to start special training for these wolf cavalry.
At this moment.
A graceful figure walked slowly out of Xingyu City.
It was Su Xiaoyang.
Su Xiaoyang’s eyes twinkled, her rosy lips parted slightly, looking at Han Xing, she wanted to say something.
But after making eye contact with Han Xing, her face immediately turned red, and she shyly lowered her head.
Despite having been together for quite some time, this little girl would still blush every time she saw Han Xing.
Han Xing knew her personality, so he took the initiative to ask, "What’s up, Xiaoyang, is there something you need?"
Su Xiaoyang, blushing, sneaked a glance and whispered, her voice like a mosquito’s buzz, "No... it’s nothing..."
Han Xing had a peculiar expression on his face.
The next moment, Su Xiaoyang hurriedly explained.
"I just... just saw you busy all by yourself on the city wall and wanted to, wanted to ask if there’s anything I can help with..."
"You, you shouldn’t overwork yourself, and don’t put too much pressure on yourself..."
Everyone noticed Han Xing’s efforts.
Only Han Xing never mentioned it, and he didn’t seem to mind as well.
However, the observant little Su Xiaoyang noticed all of this.
However, Han Xing was momentarily taken aback, he really didn’t feel any pressure himself.
At the current blood tide outbreak stage, apart from being a bit rushed, it hadn’t reached a terribly stressful degree.
Han Xing was just about to say it was nothing.
But then, he suddenly felt like teasing this little girl a bit.
He pretended to be exhausted and said, "You’re right, Xiaoyang, recently it’s been a bit stressful, too tense."
"Thank you for understanding me."
Upon hearing this, Su Xiaoyang’s eyes showed a look of distress.
She immediately shed her shyness and quickly stepped forward, looking at Han Xing with a face full of concern, "Han... Brother Han Xing, you’ve worked hard!"
"If there’s anything you need help with, just say it, Xiaoyang will do it!"
Listening to the girl’s words that can easily be misunderstood.
Han Xing had a peculiar look in his eyes, and he asked with a strange smile after a brief pause, "Anything at all?"
"Mm-hmm!"
Su Xiaoyang nodded heavily, seemingly extremely happy to be able to help Han Xing.
She seemed to completely miss the implication in Han Xing’s words.
Seeing Su Xiaoyang’s pure eyes, with a hint of expectation.
Han Xing for a moment didn’t have the heart to keep teasing her.
He coughed a couple of times and shook his head, "I don’t have anything that needs help."
Su Xiaoyang’s eyes showed a hint of disappointment.
"Brother Han Xing... do you not like Xiaoyang helping you?"
"Then... then I’ll go get Sister Lian Meng!"
Han Xing hurriedly waved his hands, "No, that’s not what I meant."
"I mean, I really don’t need you guys to help with anything, and I don’t feel any pressure."
"Compared to other survivors, we are much better off here."
"You know, they don’t have as many defense towers, just surviving is extremely hard for them..."
Han Xing had always been very self-aware.
He knew that his circumstances were much better than those of the other survivors.
Because of his unique divine-level talent, Han Xing could maintain an advantage.
Even when faced with the terrifying blood tide, he could handle it with ease.
Having benefited from it, he openly admitted it.
There was no need to become a beneficiary and then criticize other survivors for not working hard enough.
Who isn’t working hard to survive in this world?
After listening, Su Xiaoyang’s disappointment gradually disappeared.
A moment later, she said softly, "Well... if Brother Han Xing needs help with anything else, you must tell us, okay?"
Han Xing nodded, "Don’t worry, I’ll call you guys if anything comes up.
"Mm-hmm." Su Xiaoyang happily nodded after hearing this, then took light steps, running back into Xingyu City.
After dealing with the minotaurs and wolf cavalry.
Han Xing gathered everyone again and went to the lord’s mansion council hall.
Su Xiaoyang’s face still held a bit of shyness.
Zhang Lianmeng glanced at Han Xing, then at Su Xiaoyang, with a meaningful smile at the corner of her mouth.
Han Xing coughed lightly a couple of times and said, "Alright, our plan next is still to gain more battle merit and level up, speeding up our progress to become stronger."
"The system prompt says that those blood tide monsters will get stronger day by day."
"Besides more of them, their levels will continue to rise."
"We must keep a level advantage, always a few levels higher than those monsters, to ensure safety."
Everyone nodded upon hearing this.
Then, Han Xing distributed the 14 pieces of golden equipment he exchanged in the trading channel.
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong’s eyes lit up as they took them.
Since the blood tide outbreak, this was already their third equipment change.
Not only did they eliminate all the low-grade purple armor on themselves, but they also changed into even more advanced golden equipment!
And now, with what Han Xing got for them, they were fully equipped with gold.
In this world, equipment upgrades greatly enhance attributes.
Compared to before the blood tide outbreak.
Everyone’s attributes had at least doubled!
This disaster not only did not cause them losses but also brought them substantial benefits!
And they knew it was all thanks to that man.
Without Han Xing, they would probably have to huddle together for warmth like other survivors.
After everyone had a massive equipment upgrade.
Han Xing began to maneuver Xingyu City, continuing to drift around in the sky.
They hadn’t gone far when a massive horde of Blood Tide Monsters appeared ahead.
A rough estimate suggested this wave of monsters numbered no less than twenty thousand!
The monsters hovered in the air, seemingly having just successfully raided a Survivor’s Sky Island.
Among them, they saw a few monsters with human corpses hanging from them.
Those corpses dangled like rags in the air, with blood dripping continuously.
This gruesome scene caused the complexion of the two girls present to slightly change.
They understood that not all Sky Islands could easily withstand the attacks of Blood Tide Monsters like they could.
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but curse, "These damn monsters!"
Just at that moment.
That group of monsters, upon seeing Han Xing and the others, dove straight down.
They roared towards the sky, waving thousands of tentacles.
It seemed they wanted to tear this group of humans apart!
Han Xing maintained a cold face, without a hint of fear in his heart.
Against a horde of this size, one could simply use the attack buildings in the territory and wipe them out in one focused blast.
But doing so, while simple, didn’t reward any experience.
To maximize benefits and level up quickly as well.
With a chilling gaze, Han Xing said, "Over twenty thousand, let’s handle them ourselves, are we confident?"
The crowd exchanged glances.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun, among others, nodded simultaneously.
After today’s massive equipment upgrade.
The five had consecutively switched to three to five pieces of Golden Equipment, greatly boosting their strength.
Previously, they could handle monster waves of fewer than ten thousand.
Now, with everyone’s improved strength, even more monsters wouldn’t be daunting!
Even Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang tightly gripped their weapons, ready to fight at any moment.
At this moment, the twenty thousand Blood Tide Monsters were less than a thousand meters from Han Xing’s territory.
By now, the monster horde was within everyone’s attack range.
No one moved, waiting for Han Xing’s command.
After multiple collaborations, they had become exceedingly obedient to Han Xing’s orders,
Eight hundred meters from the territory.
The scarlet torrent surged forward, nearly touching the territory’s defense shield.
Under the siege of so many monsters, a shield with only 1200 defense value would be demolished instantly.
Just as the horde was about to contact the shield.
Han Xing directly dispelled the shield.
The next moment, the overwhelming Blood Tide Monsters lunged forward.
By then, they were less than five hundred meters from the group!
The five tightly clutched their weapons.
Four hundred meters...
The gusts rushing towards them and the inherent stench of the monsters could already be felt.
Han Xing suddenly said, "Prepare."
Shen Yun promptly bestowed two Blessings upon Han Xing, then cast Angel’s Shelter upon himself.
Three hundred meters...
Two hundred meters...
One hundred meters...
The stench grew stronger.
Han Xing slowly exhaled, solemnly stating, "Attack!"
In the next moment, the five unleashed their Burst Skills together!
Swish!
In the sky, a Giant Sword flew in, slicing straight through the horde.
One sword cleaved the air!
Fragments of flesh and dismembered limbs scattered messily.
Behind, Su Xiaoyang’s agile silhouette leaped into the air.
Waves of Arrow Rain were fired, turning hundreds of Blood Tide Monsters into beehives.
Then came the terrifying Thundercloud, and an Arrow ablaze with Flame!
Hiss... hiss hiss...
BOOM!
Flame danced with thunder.
After the massive explosion.
The torrent formed by over twenty thousand Blood Tide creatures was directly torn open with a massive gap!
Monster carcasses began to fall like raindrops.
System notifications flooded the screen.
The five exchanged glances, all seeing the joy in each other’s eyes.
In this Burst, they had killed at least over five thousand monsters!
Yet, even now, more monsters charged forth!
Before the Burst Skill cooldown of the last wave was up, if surrounded by monsters now, everyone would have to engage in close combat.
However, considering everyone’s Professions, this was clearly not a good option.
Han Xing wasn’t flustered.
Because he still had many trump cards left unused.
Han Xing quickly contemplated and then quietly said, "To be honest, ever since I crafted this Ice Burial Longbow, I haven’t truly unleashed its effect."
"Today, let me see your combat capabilities!"
In the next moment, everyone saw him raise the Crystal Longbow in his hand.
The red veins on the bow immediately began to flow, like a Pi Yan flower blooming under an icy seal...
Cheng Jianyong suddenly shivered, and asked in confusion, "Xiaoyunzi, do you feel like it suddenly got colder..."
Shen Yun also nodded.
In the next moment, an astonishing chill was released from the Crystal Longbow Han Xing held high!

chapters.title: Chapter 193 - 160: Ice and Snow Emperor, Danger Perception
paragraphs: An astonishing chill was released from the longbow that Han Xing held high!
It was precisely the special effect of the longbow, Ice Burial, the Extreme Cold Domain!
[Extreme Cold Domain]: A Legendary Level effect, when activated, forms an Extreme Cold Domain with a 200-meter diameter centered on the Survivor.

Enemy creatures within the domain receive 150% ice attribute damage every second and have their movement speed reduced by 20% per hit, stacking up to 5 times. The effect lasts for 10 seconds, with a cooldown of 40 minutes.
With Han Xing at the center, a range of two hundred meters around him was instantly covered in a layer of frost over thousands of monsters.
Han Xing’s attack power was already incredibly terrifying.
On top of that, with the blessings from Shen Yun and the 150% damage effect inherent in the Extreme Cold Domain!
With a cracking sound.
Everyone seemed to hear the sound of ice shattering.
Puff! Puff puff!
The sound of bodies being shattered echoed.
The first wave of Blood Tide monsters subjected to the effects of the Extreme Cold Domain fell into a state of severe injury, directly dropping from the sky.
The next second.
The sound of ice crystals shattering echoed again.
The bodies of the mutated ones on the ground were instantly shattered in place, turning into frozen corpse fragments all over the ground...
The system notifications instantly filled the screen.
[Killed Blood Tide Mutant *1123, earned 1142 Battle Merit.]
In two seconds, more than a thousand Blood Tide Mutants were taken down.
With Han Xing at the center, the area within two hundred meters was cleared instantly.
Everyone felt a chill rise up their spine after witnessing the powerful effect caused by Han Xing!
Cheng Jianyong crossed his arms and said with a trembling voice, "What a terrifying effect!"
And this was just the effect of the first wave attack of the ’Extreme Cold Domain.’
This Legendary Level effect can last a full ten seconds, allowing for ten such terrifying group attacks!
For the following eight seconds.
The other four didn’t make a move, staying in place.
One Blood Tide monster after another charged fearlessly.
However, upon entering Han Xing’s Extreme Cold Domain, in an instant, they were frozen into blocks of ice.
Crack! Crack! Crack!
Sounds of ice shattering came continuously.
Each shatter represented thousands of Blood Tide monsters blasted into piles of corpse fragments...
Ten seconds ended.
In the territory, corpses lay scattered across the grounds.
At this moment, Han Xing seemed like an Ice and Snow Emperor, dominating the life and death of these monsters.
Beside him, Shen Yun exhaled lightly, with an expression of shock, "Truly worthy of a weapon of Epic Quality!"
"This legendary effect is absolutely terrifying!"
Cheng Jianyong swallowed his saliva, looked at his Lion Heart Greatsword, then at Han Xing’s Ice Burial.
Suddenly, his Door-Board Greatsword didn’t seem that appealing anymore...
A hint of joy also appeared on Han Xing’s lips.
The legendary effect of Ice Burial exceeded his expectations.
Moreover, he had only used one of the effects of Ice Burial.
There is also a more extreme Epic Level effect on this weapon, Ice Burial!
[Ice Burial]: Epic Level effect, when activated, applies 10 layers of Ice Burial effects to all enemy creatures within an 800-meter radius.

Each layer of the Ice Burial effect reduces the enemy’s movement speed and attack speed by 10%, and ten seconds later, they are detonated, each layer of Ice Burial effect dealing an additional 50% damage.
800-meter area, a massive range!
It can be said that if Han Xing used this effect.
With a single strike, he could eliminate at least tens of thousands of Blood Tide monsters!
However, Han Xing felt there was no need to use the Epic Level effect attack right now.
Because the Blood Tide monsters attacking them.
After two bursts, from the original twenty thousand, had dwindled to less than eight thousand.
This number was already easy for the five to handle.
The ensuing battle was without suspense.
As this wave of Blood Tide monsters was routed and left behind a mass of corpses.
Several hundred mutants flew away into the sky in a panic.
At this moment, a white light flashed on Coal Ball, advancing to Level 21.
While dismantling the monster corpses on the ground, Cheng Jianyong remarked, "Whoa, Little Coal Ball leveled up again, pretty fast."
Shen Yun nodded as well, saying, "It is quite fast, although these Blood Tide monsters aren’t high level, they’re superior in number."
"Each monster gives four to five thousand experience, accumulated over time, the experience gained in a single wave is absolutely terrifying!"
"If we maintain this trend, our leveling speed might not be inferior to the period in the Cloud Secret Realm."
Everyone nodded in agreement with this sentiment.
And then.
Han Xing led the group to continue battling all around.
From dawn till dusk.
Han Xing’s Sky Island continued fighting across thousands of kilometers.
All the Blood Tide monsters encountered were directly wiped out by them.
During this period, they freed at least over twenty Survivor Sky Islands.
Yet, every time after a battle, Han Xing would leave at once.
Not even giving those Survivors a chance to interact.
They could only watch the backs of Han Xing and the others, their eyes filled with gratitude or speculation.
Apart from this, Han Xing also explored those Sky Islands covered by clouds.
As long as the area was below ten thousand, Han Xing accepted all, diving in for exploration.
However, most of the time, the monsters inside were dealt with by the five themselves.
Only when faced with monsters hard to defeat would they use the Defense Tower in the territory.
Exploration, defeating monsters, annexation!
Going through the process, the five worked seamlessly together.
The territory area began expanding crazily.
[Successfully merged with an unclaimed Sky Island, you have gained territory resources: Rich Secret Silver Ore*1, Limestone*17451, Iron Ore...]

chapters.title: Chapter 194 - 160: Ice and Snow Emperor, Danger Sense_2
paragraphs: [Successfully killed 4122 Blood Tide creatures, gained 4745 Battle Merit...]
[Successfully merged an unclaimed Sky Island, you have gained territory resources: 1 Poor Constant Gold Ore, 1 Rich Emerald Ore, Coal *41221...]
After a whole day of relentless combat.
All five people and one wolf leveled up by 1 to 2 levels.
Han Xing is now at level 24, while the others range between levels 21 to 23.
Besides, the area of Han Xing’s territory has significantly expanded.
As the size of the clouds he challenges becomes increasingly vast.
Various new terrains continue to emerge.
Such as small volcanoes, ponds, mines, and more.
After a day, Han Xing’s Sky Island overall expanded by 30%, reaching nearly four hundred thousand square meters.
After the day’s battles ended, everyone began to rest.
Inside the Lord’s Mansion meeting hall.
Han Xing said, "Today is the second day of the Blood Tide burst."
"Through the experience of the past two days, we have vaguely figured out a pattern."
"Which is that these Blood Tide creatures gather a terrifying number of monsters every day to assault our territory."
"But this is only a speculation; nobody knows what will happen next."
"We don’t understand these Blood Tide creatures, nor do we know their exact numbers."
"So tonight, the three of us will take turns to keep watch, and if anything happens, notify the others immediately."
The three Han Xing mentioned are, of course, himself, Cheng Jianyong, and Shen Yun.
Everyone nodded.
Not only Han Xing had this thought.
Other Survivor teams are also staying vigilant, arranging for people to take turns on night watch.
Of course, more Survivors, pressured by the Blood Tide, couldn’t sleep at all.
That night, the vast majority of the billions of people from Blue Star spent a sleepless night.
The next day.
When the first rays of dawn appeared.
All the Survivors grasped their weapons and stepped out of their shelters in unison.
They stared intensely at the horizon, as if fearing that along with the sunlight, countless Blood Tide creatures would also appear.
Amidst the anxious anticipation of the Blue Star Survivors.
The red sun rose slowly.
Until it was completely bright.
No incidents occurred.
In the chat channel, many Survivors questioned with confusion.
"Huh? No monsters attacked us today, did any show up on your side?"
"Not here either."
"I occasionally saw a small group, but the numbers were not large."
Upon hearing the words of other Survivors, everyone felt puzzled.
"What’s going on? Could it be that this Blood Tide disaster has ended?
"No way, the system didn’t announce it, and the Battle Merit leaderboard isn’t even published yet!"
"Maybe they’ll just give out rewards directly without any public announcement."
"Impossible. I saw a really terrifying creature in the monster tide yesterday!"
"Such a creature hasn’t been killed yet, how could it end so soon?"
Han Xing and the others were equally puzzled.
The four of them simultaneously looked at him.
Han Xing was taken aback, and spread his hands, saying, "Don’t look at me, I have no idea what’s going on either."
Everyone smiled awkwardly.
Because Han Xing had known about the Blood Tide outbreak half a month in advance.
Everyone instinctively thought he might know more.
Han Xing continued, "It’s very strange that the Blood Tide didn’t erupt today."
"But regardless, we should maintain our rhythm, continue leveling up, and focus on becoming stronger."
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded together.
Throughout the day, Han Xing still led the five in continuous exploration and monster hunting.
Until sunset in the afternoon.
They only encountered three or four waves of Blood Tide, and the number of monsters was below ten thousand.
Compared to the overwhelming scale of the previous two days, it seemed as if the Blood Tide monsters were completely wiped out by them.
Though puzzled, they didn’t think much of it.
At this moment in Xingyu City.
The five people excitedly tallied up today’s gains.
First, the biggest gain was everyone’s levels.
Under the accumulation of massive Experience Value.
Han Xing has now reached level 25, and the others range from 22 to 24.
Besides that, it was the expansion of territory area.
Today, due to encountering only a few waves of Blood Tide monsters, most time was spent exploring those giant Sky Islands.
And Han Xing’s Xingyu City expanded from over thirty thousand square meters to over fifty thousand, nearly sixty thousand square meters!
And that was while keeping the thickness of his territory the same!
There were now many new terrains on his territory.
Peaks, small islands, forests, and even a small stretch of desert.
These terrains generally contain some resources.
The most abundant resources are naturally the veins buried in the ground.
By rough estimation, the number of veins Han Xing holds is already a terrifying figure.
Various Constant Gold Ore, Rich Secret Silver Ore, Refined Iron Ore, Emerald Ore, if all mined, would be a substantial source of income.
But now, he doesn’t have time to mine, and he lacks the manpower or NPCs for mining.
Though, Han Xing could command the Wolf Cavalry to act as miners.
However, there’s a specialization; it’s not suitable for the Wolf Cavalry, which is meant only for battle, to mine. They might accidentally destroy a whole vein.
So, Han Xing decided to temporarily shelve mining, planning to consider it later.
After all, he is not lacking resources for now.
Besides, there are various large plots of fertile fields, ponds, small rivers, etc.
Han Xing doesn’t have time to plan them now.
He intends to do a unified arrangement once the territory reaches a larger scale.
The third day, fourth day, the same persisted.
The five continued leveling up and fighting monsters, improving their levels simultaneously.
Han Xing’s Sky Island territory area also expanded rapidly.
Now, his territory exceeds one million square meters, a major breakthrough.
These days of battles were astonishingly rewarding.
All four had joyous smiles on their faces.
Except for Han Xing.
Even though the battles of these days were easy.
However, since yesterday afternoon, Han Xing has been frowning.
It’s an indescribable feeling, as if an invisible pair of eyes is watching him.
Yet, whenever Han Xing stops at a Sky Island and takes the opportunity to look around, he still finds nothing unusual.
At this moment, the perceptive Shen Yun seemed to notice Han Xing’s unusual expression.
After the others left.
Shen Yun approached Han Xing, smiled lightly, and asked, "Brother Xing, what’s up these days, you seem to have something on your mind?"
Seeing Shen Yun’s inquiry, Han Xing didn’t want to be enigmatic.
He directly said, "Shen Yun, do you feel like our Sky Island is being watched?"
Upon hearing this, Shen Yun furrowed his brows.
He pondered briefly, then shook his head, "No, Brother Xing, I don’t have that feeling."
"Brother Xing, do you mean you feel something is watching us?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, I don’t know if I’m overthinking, or if it’s just my illusion."
Shen Yun said, "Brother Xing’s intuition has always been accurate; if there’s a cause, there must be a reason. Whether it’s an illusion or not, we shouldn’t let our guard down."
"Shall we continue taking turns keeping watch tonight?"
Han Xing nodded in agreement with this decision.
He called Cheng Jianyong over to explain the situation,
he also had no objections.
Everyone started taking turns on night watch.
Time passed slowly.
The chat channel tonight was exceptionally calm.
As if those Blood Tide creatures all vanished, occasionally only a cry for help could be heard.
However, just as everyone slightly let down their guard.
In the dead of night...
When the blood-red moon climbed back upon the branches.
In every corner of the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
The number of monsters gathered around each of those altars had somehow reached an overwhelming scale!
Covering the Sky and Sun!
Like a blood-red ocean!
Compared to this quantity, the group of monsters that raided the Survivors on the second day was utterly insignificant!

chapters.title: Chapter 195 - 161: Barbarian God Bloodline Max
paragraphs: In corners of the world unseen by global survivors.
One by one, the blood altars, gold has already gathered an astonishing number, a blood tide of monsters covering the sky.
At the same time.
At the center of the altar, even more massive creatures crawled out from inside.
Some resembled underwater creatures, their bodies covered in scales and various writhing parasites.
Some had large curved claws, their bodies completely covered in scales.
But they all share a common feature!
That is, they all possess an aura no less imposing than that hundred-faced monster!
One must know that the monster with hundreds of human faces at least has a three-star lord-level strength!
Just one is enough to bring nightmares to countless players!
However, the number of three-star lord-level monsters in this place has even broken into double digits!
Moreover, what’s more terrifying is.
The blood altar is still squeezing out monsters.
And this time, the power far surpasses before!
Gurgle... Gurgle...
Sounds like underwater waves surging forth came out.
Terrifying blood energy continuously overflowed, even condensing into a substance around.
In the next moment, a blood-red tentacle over a hundred meters long emerged from inside.
The tentacle was covered with white nails, waving in the wind, spraying mucus and blood.
Sticky, slippery.
At this moment, even those three-star lords, along with tens of thousands of blood tide monsters, all retreated several steps.
When the terrifying creature completely emerged from the altar, a monster stitched together from organs of tens of thousands of different creatures emerged in the sky.
As if reflecting the scene of hell into the human world.
In this moment, tens of thousands of blood-colored monsters unexpectedly knelt down in the air.
The next day.
Today is the sixth day of the blood tide eruption.
After waking up from the lord’s mansion, Han Xing went directly to the city wall.
Cheng Jianyong frowned and said, "Brother Xing, last night, still no monsters appeared."
"Moreover, in the chat channels, survivors claiming to encounter blood tide monsters are also becoming fewer."
"It seems as if the blood tide really has ended."
Han Xing, upon hearing this, a faint surprise flashed in his eyes, then he fell into thought.
Cheng Jianyong saw Han Xing thinking, did not disturb him, instead quietly walked into Xingyu City.
Alone, Han Xing murmured quietly, "Logically, it’s impossible for the blood tide to end so simply."
"But the continuous days without blood tide monsters are indeed mysterious."
"Moreover, I always feel that that feeling of being watched has become increasingly intense."
"Peculiar..."
The light in Han Xing’s eyes flickered slightly, his brows tightly furrowed.
If it was just merely the feeling of being watched, it would be fine.
The key is, Han Xing also felt a sense of crisis among it.
This sense of crisis only appeared last time at the Knight Judgment Arena, when confronting lord-level monsters.
And this time, this premonition is even stronger.
Han Xing furrowed his brows, puzzled, "Exactly, what is it?"
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly noticed many system alerts.
[Your territorial building, Thunderbolt Tower is completed...]
[Your territorial building, Ice Arrow Tower is completed...]
[Your territorial building, Flamethrower Catapult is completed...]
During these two days, Han Xing had gathered some resources again and built a batch of defense towers.
Now, the number of Thunderbolt Towers has broken through one hundred.
At this moment, a trace of joy appeared on his face.
So many system alerts indicate the completion of another batch of powerful territorial buildings,
also slightly dispelling that sense of crisis within Han Xing’s heart.
"Great! This way, the defensive capability of my territory can multiply several times again!"
At the same time, Han Xing couldn’t wait and quickly walked to the city wall, inspecting those completed buildings.
First, surrounding Xingyu City, more than a hundred Thunderbolt Towers covering over a hundred square meters each, twenty meters high.
The Thunderbolt Towers were generally dark green, with dense blue magic patterns on the surface.
The sound of crackling electricity occasionally sounded out.
Being surrounded by so many Thunderbolt Towers, just a glance makes you imagine how secure it is to live inside Xingyu City!
Moreover.
On both sides of each Thunderbolt Tower, there are two or three octagonal towers about ten meters high, overall sky blue in color.
These octagonal towers emanated an astonishing chill, always ready to release incredible ice arrow attacks.
Moreover, the attacks from Ice Arrow Towers come with a deceleration effect.
And the attacks from Thunderbolt Towers come with a paralysis effect.
It can be said that just relying on the firepower of two Ice Arrow Towers plus one Thunderbolt Tower is enough to suppress a two-star lord creature!
Currently, the attack buildings on his territory are: 102 Thunderbolt Towers, 274 Ice Arrow Towers.
In addition to two thousand Flamethrower Catapults and over three thousand Siege Crossbow Arrow Launchers!
Looking at the dense catapults and crossbow arrow launcher platforms on the city wall, even that sense of crisis in his heart was dispelled a bit.
Confidence surged within Han Xing!
"Alright, alright, no matter what kind of demons or gods, if they dare to come, I’ll make sure they taste the full force of firepower!"
Meanwhile, Han Xing noticed a prompt.
[Your territory building, the Minotaur Camp, has been completed...]
"Huh? This is finished too?"
Han Xing was thrilled once again, and he eagerly went to the lower part of the territory.
In the open space ahead, there appeared an enormous structure crudely built of stone blocks and round logs.
This building resembled a hexagonal stone tower, standing about eight meters tall and covering more than a hundred square meters.
This is the Minotaur Camp.
At the same time, Han Xing also saw the attributes of the Minotaur Camp.
[Minotaur Camp]: By consuming Spirit Cores, you can summon Minotaurs to fight for you. Through upgrading technology, you can increase the probability of summoning elite Minotaurs and level up.
[Technology 1]: Barbarian Bloodline lv1 (Currently, the probability of summoning elite level Minotaurs is 0.1%. Each level up increases the probability by 0.1%.)
[Technology 2]: Beast Power lv1 (Currently, you can summon lv1 Minotaurs. Each level up increases the Minotaur’s level by 1.)
"Huh? This Minotaur Camp has two kinds of technology too."
"The first Barbarian Bloodline technology can actually increase the probability of summoning elite monsters!"
There was an uncontrollable joy in Han Xing’s eyes, and his breathing became a bit urgent!
"According to the calculation of a 0.1 probability increase per level, if I upgrade this Barbarian Bloodline to level 10, won’t it reach a 1% probability?"
"Doesn’t this mean that for every 100 Minotaurs I summon, one will be an elite level creature?"
Han Xing’s pupils shrank instantly.
This probability is not low; in fact, it is quite high!
It’s worth noting that generally, an elite monster can easily handle those ordinary monsters of the same level.
At least seven or eight ordinary monsters of the same level are needed to deal with one elite monster.

Han Xing immediately clicked yes.

"Upgrade successful, your Minotaur Camp technology: Barbarian Bloodline has been upgraded to level 2, and the probability of summoning elite Minotaurs has increased. The current probability is: 0.2%."

Directly boosting the Barbarian Bloodline technology to level 30.
Now, the name of this technology has become Barbarian King Bloodline lv1.
The probability of summoning elite Minotaurs has reached 3%!
Meanwhile, Han Xing noticed that the plus sign next to this technology was still lit.
This indicated that Han Xing could continue upgrading it.
"Great!"
"It seems this Barbarian Bloodline technology, like the assembly line technology, is not limited by my level!"
Han Xing was overjoyed.
Because this means, as long as the materials are sufficient.
Han Xing could keep leveling it up to the max!
After reaching level 30, the materials needed for upgrading the technology doubled again.
But Han Xing didn’t care!
He continued clicking madly!
Consuming tens of millions of Spirit Cores, plus several million Refined Iron!
Finally, the Barbarian Bloodline had been upgraded to level 50, which is the full level state.
Now, the Barbarian Bloodline has become Barbarian God Bloodline lv: max!
The probability of summoning elite level Minotaurs is as high as 5%!
For every 10,000 Minotaurs Han Xing summons, 500 are elite level monsters!

Additional effect: Barbarian God’s Call. (There is a 0.5% probability to summon Leader Level Minotaurs.)

Han Xing exclaimed in shock!
He didn’t expect that after maxing out the technology, there would be such an additional effect.
Not only has the probability of summoning elite monsters greatly increased, but Leader Level Minotaurs can also be summoned, and the probability is not low!
0.5% means that for every 1,000 Minotaurs, there will be 5 Leader Monsters!
At this moment, Han Xing was filled with emotion.
These tens of millions of Spirit Cores were really worth it!
The power of the Minotaur Camp exceeded Han Xing’s expectations!

The second technology, ’Beast Power’, is similar to the ’Beast Tamer’ technology of the Wolf Cavalry Camp.
Han Xing, familiar with the procedure, began to click on this technology.

sentences.text: In corners of the world unseen by global survivors.
One by one, the blood altars, gold has already gathered an astonishing number, a blood tide of monsters covering the sky.
At the same time.
At the center of the altar, even more massive creatures crawled out from inside.
Some resembled underwater creatures, their bodies covered in scales and various writhing parasites.
Some had large curved claws, their bodies completely covered in scales.
But they all share a common feature!
That is, they all possess an aura no less imposing than that hundred-faced monster!
One must know that the monster with hundreds of human faces at least has a three-star lord-level strength!
Just one is enough to bring nightmares to countless players!
However, the number of three-star lord-level monsters in this place has even broken into double digits!
Moreover, what’s more terrifying is.
The blood altar is still squeezing out monsters.
And this time, the power far surpasses before!
Gurgle...
Gurgle...
Sounds like underwater waves surging forth came out.
Terrifying blood energy continuously overflowed, even condensing into a substance around.
In the next moment, a blood-red tentacle over a hundred meters long emerged from inside.
The tentacle was covered with white nails, waving in the wind, spraying mucus and blood.
Sticky, slippery.
At this moment, even those three-star lords, along with tens of thousands of blood tide monsters, all retreated several steps.
When the terrifying creature completely emerged from the altar, a monster stitched together from organs of tens of thousands of different creatures emerged in the sky.
As if reflecting the scene of hell into the human world.
In this moment, tens of thousands of blood-colored monsters unexpectedly knelt down in the air.
The next day.
Today is the sixth day of the blood tide eruption.
After waking up from the lord’s mansion, Han Xing went directly to the city wall.
Cheng Jianyong frowned and said, "Brother Xing, last night, still no monsters appeared."
"Moreover, in the chat channels, survivors claiming to encounter blood tide monsters are also becoming fewer."
"It seems as if the blood tide really has ended."
Han Xing, upon hearing this, a faint surprise flashed in his eyes, then he fell into thought.
Cheng Jianyong saw Han Xing thinking, did not disturb him, instead quietly walked into Xingyu City.
Alone, Han Xing murmured quietly, "Logically, it’s impossible for the blood tide to end so simply."
"But the continuous days without blood tide monsters are indeed mysterious."
"Moreover, I always feel that that feeling of being watched has become increasingly intense."
"Peculiar..."
The light in Han Xing’s eyes flickered slightly, his brows tightly furrowed.
If it was just merely the feeling of being watched, it would be fine.
The key is, Han Xing also felt a sense of crisis among it.
This sense of crisis only appeared last time at the Knight Judgment Arena, when confronting lord-level monsters.
And this time, this premonition is even stronger.
Han Xing furrowed his brows, puzzled, "Exactly, what is it?"
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly noticed many system alerts.
[Your territorial building, Thunderbolt Tower is completed...]
[Your territorial building, Ice Arrow Tower is completed...]
[Your territorial building, Flamethrower Catapult is completed...]
During these two days, Han Xing had gathered some resources again and built a batch of defense towers.
Now, the number of Thunderbolt Towers has broken through one hundred.
At this moment, a trace of joy appeared on his face.
So many system alerts indicate the completion of another batch of powerful territorial buildings,
also slightly dispelling that sense of crisis within Han Xing’s heart.
"Great!
This way, the defensive capability of my territory can multiply several times again!"
At the same time, Han Xing couldn’t wait and quickly walked to the city wall, inspecting those completed buildings.
First, surrounding Xingyu City, more than a hundred Thunderbolt Towers covering over a hundred square meters each, twenty meters high.
The Thunderbolt Towers were generally dark green, with dense blue magic patterns on the surface.
The sound of crackling electricity occasionally sounded out.
Being surrounded by so many Thunderbolt Towers, just a glance makes you imagine how secure it is to live inside Xingyu City!
Moreover.
On both sides of each Thunderbolt Tower, there are two or three octagonal towers about ten meters high, overall sky blue in color.
These octagonal towers emanated an astonishing chill, always ready to release incredible ice arrow attacks.
Moreover, the attacks from Ice Arrow Towers come with a deceleration effect.
And the attacks from Thunderbolt Towers come with a paralysis effect.
It can be said that just relying on the firepower of two Ice Arrow Towers plus one Thunderbolt Tower is enough to suppress a two-star lord creature!
Currently, the attack buildings on his territory are: 102 Thunderbolt Towers, 274 Ice Arrow Towers.
In addition to two thousand Flamethrower Catapults and over three thousand Siege Crossbow Arrow Launchers!
Looking at the dense catapults and crossbow arrow launcher platforms on the city wall, even that sense of crisis in his heart was dispelled a bit.
Confidence surged within Han Xing!

chapters.title: Chapter 196 - 162: Unease Within
paragraphs: Han Xing began clicking to upgrade the second technology.
"Would you like to consume materials: 70000 Refined Iron, 2000 Mithril, to enhance the Beast Power technology?"
The materials required to upgrade Minotaur Camp technology were slightly more than those for Wolf Cavalry, but not unreasonably so.
Han Xing directly clicked yes.
"Upgrade successful, the Minotaur Camp technology’s Beast Power has been raised to Level 2."
Then, Han Xing clicked ten times in a row, and the technology: Beast Power Level 1 also transformed into Fierce Beast Power Level 1.
Continuing to click to full level, Fierce Beast Power also transformed into Beast King’s Power.
Han Xing kept clicking until Beast King’s Power reached Level 5.
Now, the summoned Minotaurs’ level had reached Level 25.
Like the Wolf Cavalry Camp, this too was limited by Han Xing’s level.
It couldn’t exceed the Survivors’ level.
Once both technologies were upgraded.
Han Xing directly consumed 500,000 Spirit Cores to summon a thousand Minotaurs at once!
At the same time, progress bars appeared above the Minotaur Camp.
The countdown was 10 seconds, much slower than summoning Wolf Cavalry.
Han Xing also waited silently.
Meanwhile.
In the location of the original number one group in District 2, the ’Kunlun’ Sky Island.
Boundless, with a head of silver hair, fluttered in the wind.
He looked at the vast Sky Island below him, a trace of delight appeared in his cold expression.
Since the merge, the scale of Boundless’s team has expanded rapidly.
In just two days, the number of Professionals above Level 15 had exceeded 30,000, plus 150,000 family members.
Subtracting those who died in battle midway or from the Blood Curse outbreak.
Now, the number of people on Kunlun’s team Sky Island was approaching 200,000.
The management always wore excited expressions on their faces.
Walking in the territory, they could enjoy the reverent gazes of numerous Survivors.
And as the number of people expanded, the speed of resource acquisition also increased faster and faster.
Their territory size also began expanding rapidly.
Currently, the ’Kunlun’ team was in a state of vigorous development at all times.
Boundless’s lips just curved into a smile when his expression suddenly changed.
He seemed to have discovered some enemy, scanning the entire camp.
Furthermore, he occasionally glanced around, closely observing the faces of those Survivors in the territory.
In Boundless’s icy pupils, dangerous glints flickered continuously.
Those Survivors who inadvertently met his gaze instantly froze.
They were terrified not to move, seemingly unsure of what action of theirs had angered their unyielding leader.
However, Boundless only looked at them once before quickly moving his gaze away.
Even the beautiful woman who had been following him noticed that he was not in the right state.
At this moment, the beautiful woman with flowing eyes, bright eyes, and white teeth gently leaned beside Boundless and asked, "Young Master Wu, what’s been going on with you recently?"
"Is it because there are too many new people joining, and you feel a bit uneasy?"
Boundless did not answer.
The beautiful woman seemed to understand something, skillfully wrapped Boundless’s wrist, and placed it under her arm.
She wore a tight-fitting Magic Robe, with Boundless’s hand tightly against her.
Boundless felt the soft sensation transmitted from his arm, giving her a glance.
She chuckled lightly, "Young Master Wu, if you’re feeling too stressed recently, you can come to me..."
The beautiful woman smiled shallowly, looking at Boundless with alluring eyes, and said, "Although I’m not skilled in other aspects, in this, it’s my forte...
"I promise... to serve Young Master Wu comfortably..."
Boundless’s expression changed slightly, feeling a burst of heat in his abdomen as he looked at the beautiful woman’s rosy face.
After some hesitation, he eventually withdrew his hand.
"Talk to you later, I’m not in the mood right now." Boundless waved his hand.
The beautiful woman hesitated to speak but ultimately did not pursue the matter further.
At this point, Boundless arrived at the core castle of the territory, frowning.
These past two days, he also felt like he was being watched.
Especially since last night, the feeling had intensified.
Initially, Boundless thought another team’s infiltrators had snuck into his territory to gather intelligence.
However, everyone was bound by a Lord Contract with him.
According to the contract’s limitations, these people could not betray the Lord or harm his interests.
Even selling information from the territory to others was not allowed.
After confirming these Survivors were fine, Boundless kept observing the surrounding situation.
However, he still discovered nothing.
"What exactly is it...?"
A moment later, Boundless shook his head and said, "Could it be I’m overthinking?"
On the other side.
Zhou Huang was patrolling his territory.
In just two days, Zhou Huang’s territory size visibly expanded several times.
From the original 20-odd square meters, it skyrocketed to nearly a million square meters!
This expansion rate was even faster than Han Xing’s by a notch!
At this moment.
Middle-aged Yang Jun, with an excited expression, reported, "Leader, as per your instructions, the team members have been exploring those Sky Islands covered by clouds."
"Just as you expected, the monsters inside aren’t relatively strong."
"Those brothers who went in finished the fight without danger and brought back abundant resources!"
"Now, our food and drink issue won’t be a worry in the short term."
"When we get agriculture going in the future, even accommodating a million people won’t be any pressure!"
Speaking of this, the middle-aged man named Yang Jun looked at Zhou Huang with deep admiration and respect.
Ever since Zhou Huang sent out that message.
Tens of thousands of survivors join them every day.
And Zhou Huang accepts everyone.
No matter what your strength, what your status.
Even those with naturally low intelligence, who wouldn’t contribute to the team in the future, he also accepts.
But as the number of people on the territory increases, everyone’s living space is continuously compressed.
And with more people, there are more disputes.
Because of the competition for limited resources and living space, there have been a dozen or so disturbances among the survivors in recent days.
Moreover, since they didn’t have them sign the Lord Contract, effective control cannot be formed.
Because of this, Yang Jun and the management team are extremely busy.
At this point, Zhou Huang began to take action.
He divided the tens of thousands of survivors from the Huayi Alliance into small teams and sent them out to explore.
Furthermore, Zhou Huang sternly instructed them to act according to his directions and not to contact other Sky Islands midway.
The crowd discovered that by following the coordinates given by Zhou Huang, the destinations were all small Sky Islands.
Ranging from about a thousand to five thousand square meters.
The survivors of the Huayi Alliance cautiously opened the clouds.
Only to find that inside most Sky Islands were low-level monsters.
In some, there were even no monsters at all.
The team members were able to bring back various resources without danger.
Veins of minerals, fertile land, pools, rivers...
As more and more team members returned safely, the territory also began to expand rapidly.
With the abundance of resources, the disputes were resolved easily.
Meanwhile, after clearing the Cloud Sky Islands in this area, Zhou Huang quickly changed locations and gave instructions again, directing the team to approach the safe Sky Islands.
They were amazed to find.
Zhou Huang seemed to have the ability to foresee!
Before even entering those clouds, he knew what was inside.
And he could make the most correct judgments and the most reasonable distribution based on the team members’ strengths.
Under Zhou Huang’s leadership.
Their territory expanded rapidly.
And as the number of people increased, this model did not collapse but rather became more fluent!
Every moment, Zhou Huang was constantly issuing instructions, planning for those team members.
He was like a 24-hour high-speed running computer.
No one knew how this man’s brain operated.
But he had unparalleled organizational skills.
Not only that.
When those team members left the team’s base to explore outside.
Zhou Huang wasn’t idle either.
He controlled his Sky Island and found a ruined town.
This town had no important buildings, but it had a large number of residences.
Inside, a Two-star Lord-level creature lurked.
Zhou Huang used the strong firepower of the territory to shoot it dead directly.
After annexing this town, not only did it solve the housing problem for the residents, but it also saved a lot of resources to build more siege constructions!
In just two days, the number of Flamethrower Catapults on Zhou Huang’s territory exceeded a hundred.
In addition, there were Arrow Towers, Beast-Catching Net Launchers, and Rotating Blade Launchers, with the total exceeding one thousand.
And this was not even the most powerful part of his territory.
The most powerful part was the over one hundred thousand Level 15 and above survivors.
With those affiliated, the total population exceeded 500,000!
Now, the Huayi Alliance was undoubtedly the top group across all servers!
Yang Jun, full of excitement, said, "Leader, should we continue publishing coordinates today to recruit more survivors?"
Compared to a few days ago, Yang Jun once opposed Zhou Huang’s decisions, but now he was completely endorsing them!
He would never doubt Zhou Huang’s words again, already convinced.
He thought Zhou Huang would agree directly.
However, he shook his head and said, "Uncle Jun, today we should temporarily stop recruiting people."
"Also, have the brothers outside stay on the Sky Island and not go out."
Hearing this, Yang Jun was taken aback.
Although he would no longer doubt Zhou Huang’s decisions.
The situation looked very promising.
Under the pressure of the Blood Tide, their recruiting was going smoothly.
Once the Blood Tide ended, those survivors wouldn’t be as obedient.
And yet, he felt that Zhou Huang seemed a bit anxious these past two days for some reason.
Seeing Zhou Huang not explain, Yang Jun nodded and retreated.
After Yang Jun left.
Zhou Huang’s smile disappeared and turned into a look of deep concern.

He was like a 24-hour high-speed running computer.
No one knew how this man’s brain operated.
But he had unparalleled organizational skills.
Not only that.
When those team members left the team’s base to explore outside.
Zhou Huang wasn’t idle either.
He controlled his Sky Island and found a ruined town.
This town had no important buildings, but it had a large number of residences.
Inside, a Two-star Lord-level creature lurked.
Zhou Huang used the strong firepower of the territory to shoot it dead directly.
After annexing this town, not only did it solve the housing problem for the residents, but it also saved a lot of resources to build more siege constructions!
In just two days, the number of Flamethrower Catapults on Zhou Huang’s territory exceeded a hundred.
In addition, there were Arrow Towers, Beast-Catching Net Launchers, and Rotating Blade Launchers, with the total exceeding one thousand.
And this was not even the most powerful part of his territory.
The most powerful part was the over one hundred thousand Level 15 and above survivors.
With those affiliated, the total population exceeded 500,000!
Now, the Huayi Alliance was undoubtedly the top group across all servers!
Yang Jun, full of excitement, said, "Leader, should we continue publishing coordinates today to recruit more survivors?"
Compared to a few days ago, Yang Jun once opposed Zhou Huang’s decisions, but now he was completely endorsing them!
He would never doubt Zhou Huang’s words again, already convinced.
He thought Zhou Huang would agree directly.
However, he shook his head and said, "Uncle Jun, today we should temporarily stop recruiting people."
"Also, have the brothers outside stay on the Sky Island and not go out."
Hearing this, Yang Jun was taken aback.
Although he would no longer doubt Zhou Huang’s decisions.
The situation looked very promising.
Under the pressure of the Blood Tide, their recruiting was going smoothly.
Once the Blood Tide ended, those survivors wouldn’t be as obedient.
And yet, he felt that Zhou Huang seemed a bit anxious these past two days for some reason.
Seeing Zhou Huang not explain, Yang Jun nodded and retreated.
After Yang Jun left.
Zhou Huang’s smile disappeared and turned into a look of deep concern.

chapters.title: Chapter 197 - 163: Sudden Upheaval!
paragraphs: At this moment, the necklace on Zhou Huang’s chest was hanging with a bead the size of an eyeball.
The bead suddenly burst with a dazzling golden light, and within this golden light, a hint of blood red was concealed.
Zhou Huang seemed accustomed to it, muttering softly, "Today, this is the third time it has warned me."
"Crisis, what exactly is it..."
"Is it targeting just me, or all of humanity?"
At this moment, Zhou Huang seemed to have thought of something.
He suddenly took off the necklace from his neck and held the bead in his hand,
gently stroking it.
A moment later, it seemed a faint image appeared in his eyes.
The image was blood red.
Zhou Huang abruptly opened his eyes.
He spoke with a hint of fear.
"Damn it! Among that group of monsters, such terrifying creatures have already appeared!"
"Moreover, they even know how to use tactics!"
"If they really succeed, then humanity is doomed!"
Zhou Huang’s heart pounded wildly, his voice trembling: "No, this information must be spread quickly!"
"Otherwise, humanity is in danger!"
However, before Zhou Huang could react.
He suddenly noticed his Lord’s Mansion being rapidly covered in a blood-red light.
"They’ve come, so quickly?"
Zhou Huang was suddenly startled!
Meanwhile.
Han Xing stood on the open ground below Xingyu City.
In front of him appeared over a hundred creatures, each standing two and a half meters tall, with earth-yellow skin all over.
On their heads were massive minotaur heads, and they carried huge totems on their shoulders.
Their strong muscles were as hard as blocks of stone.
Just from their appearance, one can imagine the terrifying damage caused when they swing their totems to attack enemies.
In front of this group of minotaurs over two meters tall stood a few minotaur monsters nearly three meters tall.
Their large, bell-like eyes looked down at the human below.
However, the moment Han Xing raised his head.
The minotaur monster immediately snorted out white mist from its nose.
"Snort... Snort..."
"Honorable Lord, the Minotaur Vanguard is at your service!"
After saying this, the minotaur monsters knelt down in unison.
This group of minotaur monsters was the hundred troops Han Xing had just summoned.
Han Xing also saw the attributes of these monsters in front of him.
[Minotaur Warrior (Three-Star Ordinary Creature)]
[Level]: lv25
[Attributes]: Power 514, Agility 403, Spirit 354, Constitution 493.
[Skills]: Shattering, Barbarian Charge!
[Minotaur Vanguard (Three-Star Elite Creature)]
[Level]: lv25
[Attributes]: Power 557, Agility 431, Spirit 402, Constitution 541.
[Skills]: Shattering, Barbarian Charge! War Trample!
Shattering: Minotaurs swing their huge totems, and upon hitting an enemy, there is a 50% chance to deal armor-piercing damage!

Barbarian Charge: Minotaurs unleash the Barbarian Power within them, their speed skyrockets, dealing 150% damage to all enemies along the way. Creatures with power lower than the minotaur will be knocked away.
War Trample: Minotaur Vanguard swings their huge totem, dealing 200% damage to enemies within a 5-meter range and causing a 2-second dizziness effect.
"So strong!"
Han Xing said excitedly,
This group of minotaur monsters completely outclassed the Wolf Cavalry in attributes and was much stronger than average Level 25 monsters!
Especially those few Minotaur Vanguards; their attributes were even more formidable than typical Leader Monsters!
Seeing Han Xing’s satisfied expression, the Minotaur Vanguard at the front snorted, exhaling a breath of white mist.
Han Xing excitedly said: "You, and you, show me a War Trample."
Regarding Han Xing’s strange command.
The Minotaur Vanguards exchanged glances but complied as well.
"As you command, Lord.
With these words, two Minotaur Vanguards charged to the open ground ahead.
They raised their giant totems, over three meters long and as thick as a barrel, and leapt high.
Then, holding the totems, they fell heavily!
Boom!
The ground sounded as if being hit by a meteorite, leaving it filled with web-like cracks.
The intense tremor even made Han Xing’s feet feel unsteady!
Just imagining being at the center of the Minotaur Vanguard’s attack range is terrifying!
Han Xing’s eyes showed a gleam of joy. He nodded and said, "Good, good, you’ve performed well."
"From now on, you’ll be called Niu Da, and you Niu Er, and the rest of you, line up accordingly."
"Thank you, Lord, for bestowing names!" Five elite minotaurs knelt down on one knee respectfully.
Han Xing patted their shoulders.
Finding it felt like patting blocks of wall, he couldn’t help but exclaim, "Impressive, truly solid!"
After reviewing the attributes of this group of minotaurs,
Han Xing looked over to another open space in his territory.
There he saw a large expanse of green figures.
This was the other type of troops Han Xing had recently summoned, the Wolf Cavalry.
Their numbers reached as many as ten thousand!
They stood in neat rows, like a well-trained army, waiting for Han Xing’s inspection.
Looking at his Wolf Cavalry army, Han Xing said with satisfaction, "Wolf Cavalry, raise your weapons."
The next moment, ten thousand Wolf Cavalry simultaneously raised their silver great swords.
An awe-inspiring aura emanated from them.
The Wolf Cavalry, by nature, were exceptionally battle-capable creatures.
Ten thousand pairs of eyes focused on Han Xing, their gazes bright, seemingly awaiting his next command.
Just when they thought that their Lord was going to let them showcase their prowess,
they saw Han Xing waving his hand, saying: "Alright, alright, put down your weapons."
"I just wanted to see how you follow commands; there’s no need for you to fight right now."
