chapters.title: Chapter 198 - 163: Sudden Upheaval!
paragraphs: The wolf cavalry froze for a moment but still lowered their weapons in unison.
Han Xing clapped his hands and said with satisfaction, "Very good, quite obedient."
At this moment, Han Xing glanced at his warehouse.
Through the nonstop production over the past few days, the number of Blood Curse Antidotes had exceeded 100,000 bottles!
A hint of joy appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
"In these days, there must be quite a few survivors around the world affected by the Blood Curse."
"100,000 bottles of the Blood Curse Antidote might be a bit too few for billions of survivors, but it should be enough to sell a batch."
Thinking of this, Han Xing prepared to return to Starfall City to sell the first batch of potions.
And just at this moment.
A series of alerts suddenly flashed before Han Xing’s eyes.
"Warning! Warning!"
"Your territory defense shield is under attack, remaining defense value: 164..."
The instant he saw this alert, Han Xing quickly turned around.
"Who the hell is attacking me?" Han Xing cursed.
Just then, another system alert appeared.
"Warning! Your territory defense shield has been destroyed!"
In less than a second.
The territory defense shield with 1,200 defense points was instantly shattered!
"Damn it!"
At that moment, a wave of chill ran down Han Xing’s spine.
When he tried to see who was attacking him.
He suddenly saw a monster exuding a blood-colored mist charging towards Han Xing’s territory.
At the same time, the name of the monster also appeared before Han Xing.
[Mutant: Touch of the Evil God (Three-star Lord-level)]
Seeing the bright red description, Han Xing was utterly shocked.
"Holy crap!" Han Xing shouted, ready to flee on the spot.
The monster seemed prepared long ago; the instant the territory defense shield shattered.
It charged straight towards Han Xing!
Even before it got close, Han Xing felt an almost terrifying sense of crisis!
"Damn it! It’s a Lord-level creature, and an assassination type at that!"
Without much thought, Han Xing directly activated all the Thunderbolt Towers and Ice Arrow Towers on his territory.
Preparing for those territorial buildings to deal with it.
The next moment.
Hundreds of high-level buildings emitted a dazzling light.
Over a hundred thick arcs of electricity and over two hundred large ice spears poured down simultaneously!
However, the speed of that Lord-level monster was terrifyingly fast!
It seemed to have been preparing for this assassination for a long time.
Blood aura surged dozens of meters around it!
In an instant, it was close at Han Xing’s side!
Even the arcs released by the Thunderbolt Tower couldn’t reach in time.
A life-and-death crisis was upon him!
Meanwhile.
The moment they heard the warning.
Zhang Lianmeng, Su Xiaoyang, and the other two.
Immediately dropped what they were doing and dashed out of Starfall City!
In the next moment.
They saw hundreds of devastating blue beams sweeping overhead
And saw a silhouette standing on the open ground below Starfall City.
It was Han Xing!
In front of him stood a monstrous creature enshrouded in a blood mist, with an aura frighteningly fierce!
At this point, the creature was less than five meters away from Han Xing!
A blood-dripping bone blade extended from the blood mist, slashing towards Han Xing with terrifying speed.
This slash was so fast that the air constantly hissed.
The four gasped in unison.
"Watch out!!!"
However, the Lord-level creature was proficient in assassination.
Its burst skill couldn’t be easily dodged!
Even creatures of the same Lord-level, if not killed by this strike, would be heavily injured!
However, just as the bone blade was less than half a meter from Han Xing’s face, a smile appeared at the corner of Han Xing’s mouth.
In the next moment, an overwhelming power burst out from Han Xing.
His whole person soared like a rocket, instantly retreating dozens of meters!
This was the exclusive skill of the Wild Ranger.
Madness Instinct combined with Instant Shadow Flash!
The former could increase movement speed by 500% for ten seconds.
While Instant Shadow Flash allowed Han Xing to dash a short distance in an instant!
These two skills combined to form a formidable burst skill.
Even the Three-star Lord-level creature was shocked by Han Xing’s sudden burst of speed.
Inside Starfall City, the four who were rushing over suddenly froze.
This seemingly fatal situation.
Was directly resolved with Han Xing’s burst!
Even the lord-level creature that ambushed Han Xing was somewhat dumbfounded.
How did this guy achieve such a terrifying speed?
He even vaguely exceeded the scope of a three-star creature!
However, before it could think any further.
In the sky.
Over a hundred Thunderbolt Towers, plus more than two hundred Ice Arrow Towers, had launched their attacks.
If hit, even as a three-star lord-level creature, it would definitely be obliterated.
It felt the threat of death!
At this moment.
Han Xing saw the blood mist on the monster’s body begin to surge and instantly transform into a scarlet lightning, rushing out of the territory.
However, how could Han Xing let it escape?
"Bastard, you ambushed me and want to run?"
"Stay here for me!"
Han Xing gave a quick shake of his longbow, activating the epic effect on his weapon!
Ice Burial!
An instant-level epic effect!
Terrifying cold was released in an instant.
Crack! Crack, crack, crack!
A series of ice-crystal covering sounds arrived.
The ten-layer Ice Burial effect was fully applied to this lord-level monster, directly freezing it in layers!
Plop!
A massive ice sculpture fell to the ground.
This ice sculpture was about ten meters high, with an ice layer four to five meters thick, sealing the evil existence within it like millennia-old ice.
Moreover, not only was this lord-level monster frozen, but even the formless blood energy emanating from it was completely frozen.
The first appearance of the epic effect, Ice Burial, shocked everyone.
However, the strength of this creature at the three-star lord level was not illusory.
In less than half a second.
Tiny cracks had already appeared on the massive Profound Ice created by the ten layers of Ice Burial!
Crack! Crack, crack!
A second later.
With a crisp explosion.
This scarlet monster broke free from inside.
With a smile of being liberated on its face, just as it wanted to flee, it realized it was already too late!
Though the Ice Burial only delayed it for less than two seconds.
But precisely this two-second delay severed its last chance of escape.
The next moment.
The sky was filled with thunder pillars and ice spears arriving.
Rumble!
The blinding lightning almost solidified, even evolving into plasma.
The next moment, this entire area turned into a sea of plasma.
Over a hundred Thunderbolt Towers, which could instantly kill three-star elite monsters, attacked a single target simultaneously.
Plus more than two hundred slightly less damaging Ice Arrow Towers, their firepower was enough to obliterate any creature below four stars!
At this moment, the entire Xingyu City was in intense, intense shaking!
When the commotion ended.
The three-star lord-level Blood Tide monster on the ground was blasted into ashes!
Not even a corpse was left!
At this moment, a system notification appeared.
"Successfully killed mutant: Touch of the Evil God (three-star lord-level), you gained Battle Merit *5000, you received Sacred Artifact Fragment *1."
A glowing fragment appeared in Han Xing’s backpack.
Before he could check it.
At this moment, a server-wide announcement appeared.
System Announcement:
"Attention all survivors, the first survivor to kill a lord-level Blood Tide creature has appeared!"
"The Battle Merit ranking is now open, and survivors can now check their rank and related rewards through the Battle Merit leaderboard."
On the other side, Shen Yun and the other three sighed in relief when they saw Han Xing was fine.
The next moment, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang ran over together.
One on the left, and one on the right, they grabbed Han Xing’s hands and began checking his injuries inch by inch.
Han Xing spread his hands, a face full of helplessness, allowing the two women to explore up and down his body.
After confirming that Han Xing was really fine, Zhang Lianmeng directly burst into tears.
"Boohoo... It scared me to death."
However, before Han Xing could say any comforting words.
The next moment, his expression changed drastically again!
Everyone noticed.
In the sky around, at an unknown time, a red line had appeared.
This red line seemingly formed a huge circle, with Han Xing’s Sky Island located at the center of this circle.
The next moment, these red lines gradually extended, turning into an impenetrable wall of red blood cloud.
Moreover, this blood cloud was exhibiting a surrounding trend, continuously converging towards the Sky Island where Han Xing was!
Everyone knew that hidden within these blood clouds were nearly a sea of Blood Tide monsters.
But this quantity had completely exceeded their expectations.
At this moment, including Han Xing, everyone felt a shadow cast over their hearts.

This red line seemingly formed a huge circle, with Han Xing’s Sky Island located at the center of this circle.
The next moment, these red lines gradually extended, turning into an impenetrable wall of red blood cloud.
Moreover, this blood cloud was exhibiting a surrounding trend, continuously converging towards the Sky Island where Han Xing was!
Everyone knew that hidden within these blood clouds were nearly a sea of Blood Tide monsters.
But this quantity had completely exceeded their expectations.
At this moment, including Han Xing, everyone felt a shadow cast over their hearts.

chapters.title: Chapter 199 - 164: Why Run Away?
paragraphs: The terrifying number of blood tide creatures gathered into a massive blood cloud that covered the sky.
With a surrounding posture, they charged towards Xingyu City.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun were almost frozen in a daze, murmuring.
"I... damn it!!!"
"This is way too outrageous..."
When they snapped back to reality, the sky had already turned black, leaving no trace of light visible.
A shadow had already cast over the hearts of the five people!
And at this moment, a system prompt appeared in everyone’s ears.
"Warning! Warning!"
"All survivors, please note, the blood tide disaster has reached the second stage!"
"In this stage, blood tide monsters will become craftier and stronger, with many elite monsters and leader monsters roaming around!"
"Mutated creatures above the lord level have emerged in the world!"
"Survivors from Blue Star, please increase your pace and quickly find the Blood Altar to prevent more blood tide monsters from emerging!"
At this time.
On the Sky Island Territory where the ’Kunlun’ team was located, corpses were scattered everywhere.
A three-star lord-level creature, similar to the one beside Han Xing, was slaughtering wildly on the Boundless territory.
[Mutant: Evil God’s Fang (Three-star Lord Level)]
At the moment of seeing this monster’s attributes.
For the first time, panic appeared in the cold pupils of Boundless.
He had no idea how this lord appeared.
In its hands, their Basic Defense Shield couldn’t even hold for a moment.
Like thin paper, shattering at a touch.
Even before Boundless could react.
The lord-level creature was already charging straight at him!
Even with a body clad in golden equipment, Boundless dared not confront its edge.
And at this moment.
Boundless decisively operated all the catapults and spinning blades on the territory to attack himself!
The charging momentum of that lord-level creature slightly halted.
It seemed even Boundless’s decisiveness took it by surprise.
Seizing this little time.
A terrifying burst of blood energy erupted from Boundless, slashing out a stunning Sword Qi, driving the lord-level monster back!
However, seeing that it couldn’t instantly kill him, the monster turned and began a large-scale slaughter among the survivors.
And then, the scene before them unfolded.
In just a few seconds, at least dozens of brothers had died at the hands of this monster.
Among them were many of his trusted aides!
Boundless’s heart was bleeding.
The next moment, his eyes instantly turned blood red.
"Damn creature, I’m going to kill you!"
He lifted the Golden Greatsword, intending to charge towards the lord monster.
Moreover, he immediately drove all the attack buildings on the territory to focus fire on that lord creature.
Yet, the strength of the lord-level creature exceeded Boundless’s imagination.
Even when faced with the siege of the crowd, it could easily cope.
And with every strike, dozens of survivors fell painfully beneath its blade lined with sharp teeth.
Even as Boundless urged various territorial buildings to focus-fire it.
The lord-level monster evaded with terrifying speed.
Boundless and the others didn’t have that kind of strong control skills that Han Xing had!
Unable to limit this creature’s speed.
It was almost like a Wolf King entering a flock of sheep, roaming leisurely inside, wantonly slaughtering!
Boundless was nearly frantic.
He took a deep breath, seemingly having made a significant decision.
Boundless gritted his teeth, "Damn creature, you forced my hand!"
The next moment, a mysterious Stone Gargoyle Mask suddenly appeared in his hand.
The mask exuded strands of black aura.
However, the lord-level creature felt a strong sense of threat from it.
A survivor like Boundless, who was already at the pinnacle of the human race’s echelon.
More or less, they had their own fortunes.
For example, the Stone Gargoyle Mask in his hand, and the pendant on Zhou Huang’s neck.
Boundless discovered that once he wore this mask, his Vampire Warrior Traits would be maximized.
Not only would all attributes increase several times over, but even his Vampire Talent would be elevated to its peak.
No matter how severe the injury, he could instantly recover by sucking blood, practically rendering him with an undying body.
As if, this mask was specifically crafted for his profession.
However, it came with severe side effects.
Which was while wearing this mask, it would constantly drain his vitality.
In other words, it would sap his lifespan.
Once a certain limit was exceeded, it might even transform the wearer into another form.
In that form, Boundless would become a terrifying creature that had lost its sanity, knowing only slaughter!
However, at this moment, Boundless was utterly enraged, "You’re doomed! Today, no matter the cost, I’m going to slay you!"
At this moment, the lord-level creature seemed to realize something.
It suddenly leapt into the air, as if preparing to escape.
Just as Boundless put on the mask, a terrifying aura spilled from his body.
At this time, the lord-level creature lightly tossed a mass of blood energy towards where the ordinary people were gathered.
The face of Boundless, just about to burst, instantly turned green.
When he turned back to look.
He found that thousands of ordinary people had already been stained by the blood energy, rolling on the ground in agony.
And signs of mutation had already appeared on their bodies.
"Damn it! Damn it all!"
Boundless was about to explode with rage!
The lord-level creature left unscathed.
However, this was not the most despairing part for Boundless.
When he saw the sky in all directions,
four blood-colored oceans flew toward him, slowly closing in on him.
In Boundless’s eyes, a hint of fear finally emerged.
At the same time, many large-scale Sky Islands encountered the same situation.
Cybertron, Divine Hall, Kyushu, Immortal Mansion, Autocratic for Ten Thousand Years, Huayi Alliance...
These large groups faced a situation similar to Boundless.
This group of blood-colored creatures appeared to be premeditated and organized.
First, a lord-level creature raided to delay time.
However, before they could react,
blood tide monsters of hundreds of thousands, even millions, suddenly appeared, surrounding them completely!
This cut off any possibility of escape!
At this moment, the chat channel exploded instantly!
Tens of thousands of messages flooded the screen every second!
"Holy shit! There’s no way out of this?"
"A lord-level monster just shows up like that, out of nowhere?"
"We are Fenghua Nine Heavens, there’s a blood tide here with over a million! Is there any team nearby, we need support!"
"I have over a hundred thousand blood tide monsters here! We’re really done for this time!"
In every corner of the Land of the Abandoned Gods, blood tide monsters launched a full-scale attack.
There were so many of them, and the vast majority of survivors encountered varying scales of blood tides.
Especially the large teams, they were the main focus of the blood tide monsters.
The number of blood tide monsters besieging their Sky Island Territories ranged from hundreds of thousands to even millions!
These large teams were all sending out SOS messages in the chat channel.
At this time.
Han Xing stood on his territory, his expression solemn as well.
Blood tide monsters had them completely surrounded from all sides.
Everyone saw both the system announcements and the information in the chat channel.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong said with a bitter smile, "Damn... there are not just a million, there are tens of millions of monsters, right?"
Shen Yun also turned pale and said, "I fear it’s even more than that; I’ve never heard of anyone encountering this many monsters in the entire chat channel."
"We’re really in a bloody mess, running into such a terrifying scale all at once..."
A thick shadow of dread cast over everyone’s heart.
At this moment, Han Xing shook his head and said, "I’m afraid, it’s not because of our bad luck."
"It’s because we have already been targeted by these guys."
Everyone was puzzled upon hearing this.
Shen Yun immediately realized something.
He had sensed something was off about Han Xing’s state these past few days.
So it was because of this?
Han Xing continued, "The system prompt says the blood tide monsters have become more cunning, which indirectly indicates they’re intelligent."
"There might be an entity among them that commands the entire blood tide monster army."
"During the last blood tide outbreak, we killed too many monsters, catching their attention."
"That’s why they’ve focused on us as targets for special attention..."
Everyone was taken aback upon hearing this.
Then they all smiled bitterly.
They never expected that the system’s warning that the blood tide monsters would grow stronger day by day
would manifest not only in their strength but also in their intelligence.
These monsters had evolved to employ tactics in just a couple of days.
Who knows what could happen if this continued.
Shen Yun said worriedly, "This is really becoming troublesome..."
"Right now, those blood tide monsters are only around level ten, which is manageable."
"But once they all level up to above level 20, facing so many three-star monsters will be utterly catastrophic!"
Cheng Jianyong realized this too, and while he was anxious, he couldn’t help but look at Han Xing.
"Brother Xing, isn’t there a way to stop these monsters?" Cheng Jianyong asked.
Han Xing glanced at Cheng Jianyong and directly replied, "Yes."
Cheng Jianyong’s heart leapt with joy after hearing this.
"What way, Brother Xing?"
Han Xing paused for a moment and replied, "The way is to find the location of the altar mentioned by the system."
"I suppose that so-called altar is the birthplace of these monsters."
Everyone was taken aback as well.
Although they had heard the relevant system prompts,
so far,
they didn’t know what the altar looked like or where it was.
While everyone was talking,
a flood of blood tide monsters was about to descend upon them.
Cheng Jianyong asked at this time, "Brother Xing, what do we do now?"
"Should we try to escape while there’s still time?"
Shen Yun also showed a hint of retreat in his eyes upon hearing this.
Even though they knew Han Xing was strong, and their own strength wasn’t weak,
they were facing tens of millions of monsters!
The scale wasn’t even comparable, was it?
So all along, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun hadn’t thought of resisting; they were thinking about how to run away.
However, upon hearing this, Han Xing asked in confusion,
"Escape? Why should we escape?"

chapters.title: Chapter 200 - 165: Surging War Intent
paragraphs: "Why are we running?" Han Xing asked in confusion.
Cheng Jianyong looked bewildered, "Uh... but..."
He wanted to say that staying would be waiting for death.
However, he met Han Xing’s gaze.
It was a gaze filled with strong confidence!
Han Xing waved his hand and said directly, "Don’t worry."
"Although these Blood Tide Monsters are getting stronger, aren’t we also getting stronger?"
"I haven’t been idle these past two days either!"
The crowd heard the calm and surging war intent in Han Xing’s tone!
Yes, from the start, it seemed Han Xing never mentioned running away.
And listening to this tone, Han Xing seemed to be looking forward to a confrontation with these monsters?
But is that possible?
Such a scale of monster tide is not something a single force can withstand, not even Zhou Huang could do it.
Unless all five of the strongest teams from zones 1 to 5 were united, there would be a slight chance of resistance!
Han Xing didn’t speak but looked at the series of twenty-meter-tall black towers on his territory.
The surge in the number of Defense Towers gave him confidence to face more monsters!
This confidence even affected Cheng Jianyong and the others.
Everyone looked at Han Xing, and the fear in their eyes seemed to gradually fade away.
Even if it seemed like a scene seeking death.
At this moment, however, these five people were unswervingly committed!
At this time.
An endless horde of Blood Tide Monsters was already pouring in from all directions.
The first wave of the army was still over ten thousand meters away from Xingyu City.
This distance was already within the attack range of the Lightning Towers.
But Han Xing did not rush to attack.
He manipulated the territorial building page.
There were over three thousand Siege Crossbow Arrow Launchers and two thousand Flamethrower Catapults on it!
Plus more than one hundred and eighty Ice Arrow Towers and eighty Lightning Towers!
Compared to the previous two days, Han Xing’s territorial defense capability had undergone a qualitative change!
The number of attack buildings increased by more than threefold!
This is not as simple as 1+1.
It means that.
As long as Han Xing could reasonably control the attack rhythm of these territorial buildings, he could achieve continuous and comprehensive fire coverage.
No matter how many monsters, they could withstand it!
And their only concern was the Lord-level Monsters among them!
Meanwhile.
The monstrous army was already approaching Han Xing’s territory, less than five thousand meters away.
At this time, Xingyu City was like a submarine plunging into the deep sea, teetering on the edge of danger!
Surrounded by surging seawater from all sides, it seemed about to be engulfed.
The mere sight of this scene imparted a profound sense of despair and suffocation.
Everyone subconsciously held their breath.
The Blood Tide army was rapidly closing in, the distance remaining was less than three thousand meters!
At this moment, they could even see those horrifying, twisted faces.
Xingyu City was about to be swallowed by the massive Blood Tide!
And just then.
A sudden burst of dazzling firelight and electric light erupted from this tiny vessel!
Boom——
Over eight hundred flame shells, the size of washbasins, roared out amidst thick smoke!
Thousands of giant crossbow arrows shot out.
Plus more than twenty blue beams of light with a diameter of over twenty meters and a length of over twenty thousand meters pierced the sky.
The next moment, all these attacks landed amidst the dense cluster of monsters.
Rumble!
Hundreds of shells exploded like brilliant fireworks blossoming on the seabed!
Dazzlingly bright.
The explosions were deafening!
At this moment, it seemed like the sky was shattered.
Countless monsters died horribly under the terrifying bombardment, turning to ashes.
With such a dense cluster of monsters.
The first wave of bombardment directly took the lives of over thirty to forty thousand Blood Tide Monsters.
Han Xing’s battle merits soared almost instantly by fifty to sixty thousand!
"So strong..."
"Such terrifying firepower..."
Everyone murmured in a daze.
Even though they had witnessed this many times.
Every time the Catapults and Lightning Towers unleashed their power, showing their destructive might, it still brought a strong sense of security!
The root of all fear stemmed from insufficient firepower.
As long as the sound of thunder and flames exploded continued to roar, they believed Xingyu City would never fall!
However, just as the surrounding monsters were cleared away, the air was filled with more monsters filling the gap, charging towards Han Xing’s territory with fearless fervor.
Han Xing wasn’t going to be polite to them either.
Facing the monsters was the same firepower level of the second wave attack!
The blinding blue beams of light emanating from the Lightning Towers froze every monster in its path, as the terrifying electric energy rampaged through their bodies!
After a series of crackling explosions.
The surrounding three-thousand-meter area was once again cleared.
Those monsters continued to charge fearlessly.
And Han Xing obliged, once again prompting the Catapults and Lightning Towers to bombard them.
Repeatedly!
After four waves of attack.
All the attack buildings on Han Xing’s territory had almost completed one round of attacks.
The blood-colored monsters, seeing the discharge of firepower finally stop, each showed a twisted grin, charging madly forth!
On the field, Cheng Jianyong and others watched Han Xing nervously.
Even the relatives inside the Lord’s Mansion couldn’t help but feel their hearts tighten!
However, the firepower only paused for less than a second!
All the buildings that launched the first round of attacks, including the Lightning Tower, had already recharged.
The corner of Han Xing’s mouth revealed a trace of delight.
"Good, just as I calculated."
"The Lightning Tower has completed four rounds of attacks, right at the end of a 20-second recharge period!"
"This way, we can achieve uninterrupted, all-around strikes!"
The next moment, the howling shells and the destructive blue beams surged forth.
Boom!
An earth-shattering explosion erupted.
The monster horde that had barely reached within a thousand meters of Sky Island was again cleared one by one.
Then, the cycle began anew!
With each wave of charge, at least forty to fifty thousand monsters perished.
Han Xing clenched his fist, the corner of his mouth showing a slight smile.
"Come on, let me feel the rush of rapidly increasing battle merit!"
"Let’s see if I give out first, or these monsters do!"
Inside the Lord’s Mansion.
Those hundreds of relatives had, over these few days, adapted to the rhythm of this world.
Especially when encountering Blood Tide Monsters, they knew what they should do.
That is to hide in the Lord’s Mansion at the first moment, not to create more chaos for Han Xing and others.
Because, in a disaster of such magnitude, anything they did would be futile.
If even those few couldn’t hold the line, they could only await their end.
All hope could only be placed on them... Wait, no, on that man carrying the Crystal Longbow.
And this man lived up to expectations, effortlessly dealing with the monsters each time.
But today’s a bit different.
Even though they knew Han Xing was strong, unimaginably strong.
The number of monsters far exceeded everyone’s expectations!
Tens of millions!
What kind of concept is that?
If each monster spat, it could flood their territory.
Yet in such a terrifying tide of monsters, that man once again showcased astounding prowess and terrifying development speed.
In just two days, he erected a number of attack structures several times what they had before.
And, he steadfastly withstood the onslaught of these tens of millions of monsters, remaining unshakeable!
Everyone was nearly dumbfounded.
At this moment, Lanlan and a group of young girls watched the silhouette on the distant open ground with nearly worshipful eyes.
This was their Lord!
Lanlan couldn’t help but feel fortunate.
Fortunately, she had taken the initiative to ask Han Xing to sign a Lord Contract with them at the time.
Otherwise, if they had encountered such a monster tide, they might have been torn to shreds in the first second.
She was grateful in her heart to Han Xing for agreeing to their request back then.
"The Lord is sure to win!"
"Go, Lord!"
This group of young girls silently prayed in their hearts, cheering Han Xing on.
At this moment.
The thunderous rumbles in the sky came wave after wave!
Han Xing’s side had already launched twelve rounds of attacks, with about more than four hundred thousand Blood Tide Monsters perishing!
Seeing that prolonged attacks yielded no results.
At this moment, within the Blood Tide army!
Suddenly, several lines separated.
Like a blood-red curtain being torn down the middle.
In those rifts, terrifying creatures more than a hundred meters in size and of various forms appeared.
From a distance, everyone could see that these monsters were far from ordinary!
But among them, the sharp-eyed Shen Yun spotted a familiar figure.
That monster covered with human faces.
According to everyone’s previous speculation, the monster’s power might be at the Three-star Lord Level!
Shen Yun immediately warned, "Brother Xing, be careful, those Lord-level ones might make a move now!"
Upon hearing this, everyone’s expressions instantly became solemn.
Lord-level creatures, any one of them could become a nightmare for the Survivors.
And now, just a glance revealed at least a dozen of them!
If so many Lord Monsters simultaneously launched an attack on their territory.
If they couldn’t hold them off, the consequences would be unimaginable!
"Brother Xing, should we make a move?"
Cheng Jianyong swung his Great Sword with a serious expression.
Shen Yun and the others also snapped into combat readiness.
They feared that if those Lord Monsters came en masse, the Defense Towers might not be able to hold!
To achieve seamless, all-around bombardment, Han Xing divided the attack structures in the territory into four cycles.
And naturally, the killing power of the Defense Towers had greatly reduced.
Though it could annihilate those Ordinary and Elite Monsters in an instant, and even seriously wound Leader Monsters.
But if faced with Lords.
One round of attack might not deal effective damage to them.
By then, if these Lord Creatures braved the firepower of the Lightning Tower and the Catapults and charged into the territory.
They would find themselves in a dilemma.
Lord-level creatures are not roadside beasts; each one possesses terrifying power.
If they couldn’t hold them off, the consequences would be unimaginable!
Everyone couldn’t help but grow tense, even ready to face the brunt of the Lord-level Monster charge.
At this moment, Han Xing waved his hand and said, "No need, let’s just observe for now."
Upon hearing this, everyone stayed where they were.
Without Han Xing’s order, they wouldn’t make reckless moves.
The atmosphere descended into an eerie standoff.
The four of them fixed their eyes on the sky, closely watching every move of those Lord Monsters.

sentences.text: "Why are we running?" Han Xing asked in confusion.
Cheng Jianyong looked bewildered, "Uh... but..."
He wanted to say that staying would be waiting for death.
However, he met Han Xing’s gaze.
It was a gaze filled with strong confidence!
Han Xing waved his hand and said directly, "Don’t worry."
"Although these Blood Tide Monsters are getting stronger, aren’t we also getting stronger?"
"I haven’t been idle these past two days either!"
The crowd heard the calm and surging war intent in Han Xing’s tone!
Yes, from the start, it seemed Han Xing never mentioned running away.
And listening to this tone, Han Xing seemed to be looking forward to a confrontation with these monsters?
But is that possible?
Such a scale of monster tide is not something a single force can withstand, not even Zhou Huang could do it.
Unless all five of the strongest teams from zones 1 to 5 were united, there would be a slight chance of resistance!
Han Xing didn’t speak but looked at the series of twenty-meter-tall black towers on his territory.
The surge in the number of Defense Towers gave him confidence to face more monsters!
This confidence even affected Cheng Jianyong and the others.
Everyone looked at Han Xing, and the fear in their eyes seemed to gradually fade away.
Even if it seemed like a scene seeking death.
At this moment, however, these five people were unswervingly committed!
At this time.
An endless horde of Blood Tide Monsters was already pouring in from all directions.
The first wave of the army was still over ten thousand meters away from Xingyu City.
This distance was already within the attack range of the Lightning Towers.
But Han Xing did not rush to attack.
He manipulated the territorial building page.
There were over three thousand Siege Crossbow Arrow Launchers and two thousand Flamethrower Catapults on it!
Plus more than one hundred and eighty Ice Arrow Towers and eighty Lightning Towers!
Compared to the previous two days, Han Xing’s territorial defense capability had undergone a qualitative change!
The number of attack buildings increased by more than threefold!
This is not as simple as 1+1.
It means that.
As long as Han Xing could reasonably control the attack rhythm of these territorial buildings, he could achieve continuous and comprehensive fire coverage.
No matter how many monsters, they could withstand it!
And their only concern was the Lord-level Monsters among them!
Meanwhile.
The monstrous army was already approaching Han Xing’s territory, less than five thousand meters away.
At this time, Xingyu City was like a submarine plunging into the deep sea, teetering on the edge of danger!
Surrounded by surging seawater from all sides, it seemed about to be engulfed.
The mere sight of this scene imparted a profound sense of despair and suffocation.
Everyone subconsciously held their breath.
The Blood Tide army was rapidly closing in, the distance remaining was less than three thousand meters!
At this moment, they could even see those horrifying, twisted faces.
Xingyu City was about to be swallowed by the massive Blood Tide!
And just then.
A sudden burst of dazzling firelight and electric light erupted from this tiny vessel!
Boom——
Over eight hundred flame shells, the size of washbasins, roared out amidst thick smoke!
Thousands of giant crossbow arrows shot out.
Plus more than twenty blue beams of light with a diameter of over twenty meters and a length of over twenty thousand meters pierced the sky.
The next moment, all these attacks landed amidst the dense cluster of monsters.
Rumble!
Hundreds of shells exploded like brilliant fireworks blossoming on the seabed!
Dazzlingly bright.
The explosions were deafening!
At this moment, it seemed like the sky was shattered.
Countless monsters died horribly under the terrifying bombardment, turning to ashes.
With such a dense cluster of monsters.
The first wave of bombardment directly took the lives of over thirty to forty thousand Blood Tide Monsters.
Han Xing’s battle merits soared almost instantly by fifty to sixty thousand!
"So strong..."
"Such terrifying firepower..."
Everyone murmured in a daze.
Even though they had witnessed this many times.
Every time the Catapults and Lightning Towers unleashed their power, showing their destructive might, it still brought a strong sense of security!
The root of all fear stemmed from insufficient firepower.
As long as the sound of thunder and flames exploded continued to roar, they believed Xingyu City would never fall!
However, just as the surrounding monsters were cleared away, the air was filled with more monsters filling the gap, charging towards Han Xing’s territory with fearless fervor.
Han Xing wasn’t going to be polite to them either.
Facing the monsters was the same firepower level of the second wave attack!
The blinding blue beams of light emanating from the Lightning Towers froze every monster in its path, as the terrifying electric energy rampaged through their bodies!
After a series of crackling explosions.
The surrounding three-thousand-meter area was once again cleared.
Those monsters continued to charge fearlessly.
And Han Xing obliged, once again prompting the Catapults and Lightning Towers to bombard them.
Repeatedly!
After four waves of attack.
All the attack buildings on Han Xing’s territory had almost completed one round of attacks.
The blood-colored monsters, seeing the discharge of firepower finally stop, each showed a twisted grin, charging madly forth!
On the field, Cheng Jianyong and others watched Han Xing nervously.
Even the relatives inside the Lord’s Mansion couldn’t help but feel their hearts tighten!
However, the firepower only paused for less than a second!
All the buildings that launched the first round of attacks, including the Lightning Tower, had already recharged.
The corner of Han Xing’s mouth revealed a trace of delight.
"Good, just as I calculated."
"The Lightning Tower has completed four rounds of attacks, right at the end of a 20-second recharge period!"
"This way, we can achieve uninterrupted, all-around strikes!"
The next moment, the howling shells and the destructive blue beams surged forth.
Boom!
An earth-shattering explosion erupted.
The monster horde that had barely reached within a thousand meters of Sky Island was again cleared one by one.
Then, the cycle began anew!
With each wave of charge, at least forty to fifty thousand monsters perished.
Han Xing clenched his fist, the corner of his mouth showing a slight smile.
"Come on, let me feel the rush of rapidly increasing battle merit!"
"Let’s see if I give out first, or these monsters do!"
Inside the Lord’s Mansion.
Those hundreds of relatives had, over these few days, adapted to the rhythm of this world.
Especially when encountering Blood Tide Monsters, they knew what they should do.
That is to hide in the Lord’s Mansion at the first moment, not to create more chaos for Han Xing and others.
Because, in a disaster of such magnitude, anything they did would be futile.
If even those few couldn’t hold the line, they could only await their end.
All hope could only be placed on them...
Wait, no, on that man carrying the Crystal Longbow.
And this man lived up to expectations, effortlessly dealing with the monsters each time.
But today’s a bit different.
Even though they knew Han Xing was strong, unimaginably strong.
The number of monsters far exceeded everyone’s expectations!
Tens of millions!
What kind of concept is that?
If each monster spat, it could flood their territory.
Yet in such a terrifying tide of monsters, that man once again showcased astounding prowess and terrifying development speed.
In just two days, he erected a number of attack structures several times what they had before.
And, he steadfastly withstood the onslaught of these tens of millions of monsters, remaining unshakeable!
Everyone was nearly dumbfounded.
At this moment, Lanlan and a group of young girls watched the silhouette on the distant open ground with nearly worshipful eyes.
This was their Lord!
Lanlan couldn’t help but feel fortunate.
Fortunately, she had taken the initiative to ask Han Xing to sign a Lord Contract with them at the time.
Otherwise, if they had encountered such a monster tide, they might have been torn to shreds in the first second.
She was grateful in her heart to Han Xing for agreeing to their request back then.
"The Lord is sure to win!"
"Go, Lord!"
This group of young girls silently prayed in their hearts, cheering Han Xing on.
At this moment.
The thunderous rumbles in the sky came wave after wave!
Han Xing’s side had already launched twelve rounds of attacks, with about more than four hundred thousand Blood Tide Monsters perishing!
Seeing that prolonged attacks yielded no results.
At this moment, within the Blood Tide army!
Suddenly, several lines separated.
Like a blood-red curtain being torn down the middle.
In those rifts, terrifying creatures more than a hundred meters in size and of various forms appeared.
From a distance, everyone could see that these monsters were far from ordinary!
But among them, the sharp-eyed Shen Yun spotted a familiar figure.
That monster covered with human faces.
According to everyone’s previous speculation, the monster’s power might be at the Three-star Lord Level!
Shen Yun immediately warned, "Brother Xing, be careful, those Lord-level ones might make a move now!"
Upon hearing this, everyone’s expressions instantly became solemn.
Lord-level creatures, any one of them could become a nightmare for the Survivors.
And now, just a glance revealed at least a dozen of them!
If so many Lord Monsters simultaneously launched an attack on their territory.
If they couldn’t hold them off, the consequences would be unimaginable!
"Brother Xing, should we make a move?"
Cheng Jianyong swung his Great Sword with a serious expression.
Shen Yun and the others also snapped into combat readiness.
They feared that if those Lord Monsters came en masse, the Defense Towers might not be able to hold!
To achieve seamless, all-around bombardment, Han Xing divided the attack structures in the territory into four cycles.
And naturally, the killing power of the Defense Towers had greatly reduced.
Though it could annihilate those Ordinary and Elite Monsters in an instant, and even seriously wound Leader Monsters.
But if faced with Lords.
One round of attack might not deal effective damage to them.
By then, if these Lord Creatures braved the firepower of the Lightning Tower and the Catapults and charged into the territory.
They would find themselves in a dilemma.
Lord-level creatures are not roadside beasts; each one possesses terrifying power.
If they couldn’t hold them off, the consequences would be unimaginable!
Everyone couldn’t help but grow tense, even ready to face the brunt of the Lord-level Monster charge.
At this moment, Han Xing waved his hand and said, "No need, let’s just observe for now."
Upon hearing this, everyone stayed where they were.
Without Han Xing’s order, they wouldn’t make reckless moves.
The atmosphere descended into an eerie standoff.
The four of them fixed their eyes on the sky, closely watching every move of those Lord Monsters.
